[31m+[39m
[31m+ function attachRidersToParticipantTeams([39m
[31m+   teams: RaceParticipantTeam[],[39m
[31m+   riderRows: RaceParticipantRider[][39m
[31m+ ): RaceParticipantTeam[] {[39m
[31m+   const ridersByTeamId = new Map<string, RaceParticipantRider[]>()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (const rider of riderRows ?? []) {[39m
[31m+     const lookupIds = Array.from([39m
[31m+       new Set([39m
[31m+         [rider.team_id][39m
[31m+           .map((value) => value?.trim())[39m
[31m+           .filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value))[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     for (const lookupId of lookupIds) {[39m
[31m+       const teamRiders = ridersByTeamId.get(lookupId) ?? [][39m
[31m+       teamRiders.push(rider)[39m
[31m+       ridersByTeamId.set(lookupId, teamRiders)[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const matchedRiderIds = new Set<string>()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const teamsWithRiders = teams.map((team) => {[39m
[31m+     const lookupIds = Array.from([39m
[31m+       new Set([39m
[31m+         [[39m
[31m+           team.participating_club_id,[39m
[31m+           team.club_id,[39m
[31m+           team.owner_club_id,[39m
[31m+           team.team_id,[39m
[31m+           team.id,[39m
[31m+           team.race_team_entry_id,[39m
[31m+         ][39m
[31m+           .map((value) => value?.trim())[39m
[31m+           .filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value))[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const matchedRidersById = new Map<string, RaceParticipantRider>()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     for (const lookupId of lookupIds) {[39m
[31m+       const matchedRiders = ridersByTeamId.get(lookupId) ?? [][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       for (const rider of matchedRiders) {[39m
[31m+         matchedRidersById.set(rider.id ?? rider.rider_id, rider)[39m
[31m+         matchedRiderIds.add(rider.id ?? rider.rider_id)[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const currentTeamName = getParticipantTeamName(team)[39m
[31m+     const riders = sortParticipantRiders([39m
[31m+       Array.from(matchedRidersById.values()).map((rider) => ({[39m
[31m+         ...rider,[39m
[31m+         team_name_snapshot: currentTeamName,[39m
[31m+       }))[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       ...team,[39m
[31m+       club_name: currentTeamName,[39m
[31m+       team_name_snapshot: currentTeamName,[39m
[31m+       riders,[39m
[31m+       assigned_riders_count: riders.length,[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const missingRiders = (riderRows ?? []).filter([39m
[31m+     (rider) => !matchedRiderIds.has(rider.id ?? rider.rider_id)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const sortTeamsByRaceOrder = ([39m
[31m+     participantTeams: RaceParticipantTeam[][39m
[31m+   ): RaceParticipantTeam[] =>[39m
[31m+     [...participantTeams].sort(compareParticipantTeamsByRaceOrder)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (missingRiders.length === 0) return sortTeamsByRaceOrder(teamsWithRiders)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const missingRidersByTeamId = new Map<string, RaceParticipantRider[]>()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (const rider of missingRiders) {[39m
[31m+     const teamKey =[39m
[31m+       rider.team_id?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       rider.team_name_snapshot?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       `unknown-team-${rider.race_id || 'race'}`[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const teamRiders = missingRidersByTeamId.get(teamKey) ?? [][39m
[31m+     teamRiders.push(rider)[39m
[31m+     missingRidersByTeamId.set(teamKey, teamRiders)[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const syntheticTeams: RaceParticipantTeam[] = Array.from([39m
[31m+     missingRidersByTeamId.entries()[39m
[31m+   ).map(([teamKey, teamRiders]) => {[39m
[31m+     const firstRider = teamRiders[0][39m
[31m+     const teamName =[39m
[31m+       firstRider?.team_name_snapshot?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       'Race team'[39m
[31m+     const teamId = firstRider?.team_id?.trim() || teamKey[39m
[31m+     const raceId = firstRider?.race_id ?? teams[0]?.race_id ?? ''[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       id: teamId,[39m
[31m+       race_id: raceId,[39m
[31m+       team_id: teamId,[39m
[31m+       club_id: isUuid(teamId) ? teamId : null,[39m
[31m+       owner_club_id: isUuid(teamId) ? teamId : null,[39m
[31m+       participating_club_id: isUuid(teamId) ? teamId : null,[39m
[31m+       parent_club_id: null,[39m
[31m+       club_type: null,[39m
[31m+       race_team_entry_id: null,[39m
[31m+       status: 'accepted',[39m
[31m+       club_name: teamName,[39m
[31m+       country_code: null,[39m
[31m+       club_tier: null,[39m
[31m+       world_tier: null,[39m
[31m+       assigned_riders_count: teamRiders.length,[39m
[31m+       team_name_snapshot: teamName,[39m
[31m+       logo_url_snapshot: null,[39m
[31m+       jersey_url_snapshot: null,[39m
[31m+       country_code_snapshot: null,[39m
[31m+       ranking_snapshot: null,[39m
[31m+       competition_display: 'Race participant',[39m
[31m+       competition_rank: null,[39m
[31m+       competition_points: null,[39m
[31m+       division_key: null,[39m
[31m+       riders: sortParticipantRiders([39m
[31m+         teamRiders.map((rider) => ({[39m
[31m+           ...rider,[39m
[31m+           team_name_snapshot: teamName,[39m
[31m+         }))[39m
[31m+       ),[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return sortTeamsByRaceOrder([...teamsWithRiders, ...syntheticTeams])[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatCompetitionName(value?: string | number | null): string | null {[39m
[31m+   if (value === null || value === undefined) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const raw = String(value).trim()[39m
[31m+   if (!raw) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const normalized = raw.toLowerCase().replace(/[-_\s]+/g, '')[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   switch (normalized) {[39m
[31m+     case 'worldteam':[39m
[31m+     case 'worldtour':[39m
[31m+       return 'World Team'[39m
[31m+     case 'proteam':[39m
[31m+       return 'Pro Team'[39m
[31m+     case 'proteama':[39m
[31m+       return 'Pro Team A'[39m
[31m+     case 'proteamb':[39m
[31m+       return 'Pro Team B'[39m
[31m+     case 'proteams':[39m
[31m+       return 'Pro Team S'[39m
[31m+     case 'continental':[39m
[31m+     case 'continentalteam':[39m
[31m+       return 'Continental Team'[39m
[31m+     case 'development':[39m
[31m+     case 'developmentteam':[39m
[31m+       return 'Development Team'[39m
[31m+     case 'amateur':[39m
[31m+     case 'amateurteam':[39m
[31m+       return 'Amateur Team'[39m
[31m+     default:[39m
[31m+       return raw[39m
[31m+         .replace(/_/g, ' ')[39m
[31m+         .replace(/-/g, ' ')[39m
[31m+         .replace(/\b\w/g, (char) => char.toUpperCase())[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getParticipantCompetitionLabel(team: RaceParticipantTeam): string {[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     team.competition_display?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+     formatCompetitionName(team.club_tier) ||[39m
[31m+     formatCompetitionName(team.world_tier) ||[39m
[31m+     'Competition —'[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getRiderOverallDisplay(rider: RaceParticipantRider): string {[39m
[31m+   const overall = asNumber(rider.overall_snapshot)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (rider.can_view_exact_overall && overall !== null) {[39m
[31m+     return `OVR ${Math.round(overall)}`[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return rider.overall_range_label ?? 'OVR —'[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatPendingApplicationNumber(value?: number | null): string {[39m
[31m+   const parsed = asNumber(value)[39m
[31m+   return parsed === null ? '—' : parsed.toLocaleString()[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatPendingApplicationChance(value?: number | null): string {[39m
[31m+   const parsed = asNumber(value)[39m
[31m+   return parsed === null ? '—' : `${Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(100, parsed)))}%`[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getPendingApplicationChanceBarWidth(value?: number | null): string {[39m
[31m+   const parsed = asNumber(value)[39m
[31m+   if (parsed === null) return '0%'[39m
[31m+   return `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, parsed))}%`[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+           <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500">Estimated chance</div>[39m

[31m+             {formatPendingApplicationChance(quote.estimated_acceptance_chance_pct)}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-1 text-xs font-semibold text-sky-700">[39m
[31m+             {quote.chance_label ?? 'Application estimate'}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <div className="mt-4 h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-white">[39m
[31m+         <div[39m
[31m+           className="h-full rounded-full bg-sky-600"[39m
[31m+           style={{ width: getPendingApplicationChanceBarWidth(quote.estimated_acceptance_chance_pct) }}[39m
[31m+         />[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-4">[39m
[31m+         <div className="rounded-2xl bg-white px-4 py-3 shadow-sm ring-1 ring-sky-100">[39m
[31m+           <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">Applied teams</div>[39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-1 font-bold text-slate-950">[39m
[31m+             {formatPendingApplicationNumber(quote.applied_teams ?? quote.submitted_application_teams)}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <div className="rounded-2xl bg-white px-4 py-3 shadow-sm ring-1 ring-sky-100">[39m
[31m+           <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">Already accepted</div>[39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-1 font-bold text-slate-950">[39m
[31m+             {formatPendingApplicationNumber(quote.accepted_teams)}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <div className="rounded-2xl bg-white px-4 py-3 shadow-sm ring-1 ring-sky-100">[39m
[31m+           <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">Target / max teams</div>[39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-1 font-bold text-slate-950">[39m
[31m+             {formatPendingApplicationNumber(quote.target_teams)} / {formatPendingApplicationNumber(quote.max_teams)}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <div className="rounded-2xl bg-white px-4 py-3 shadow-sm ring-1 ring-sky-100">[39m
[31m+           <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">Application strength</div>[39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-1 font-bold text-slate-950">[39m
[31m+             {formatPendingApplicationNumber(quote.commitment_score)}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {quote.chance_summary ? ([39m
[31m+         <p className="mt-4 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">{quote.chance_summary}</p>[39m
[31m+       ) : null}[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function usePublishedRaceStageIds([39m
[31m+   stages: RaceStage[][39m
[31m+ ): string[] {[39m
[31m+   const stageIds = useMemo([39m
[31m+     () => stages.map((stage) => stage.id),[39m
[31m+     [stages][39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const stageIdsKey = stageIds.join('|')[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const [[39m
[31m+     publishedStageIds,[39m
[31m+     setPublishedStageIds,[39m
[31m+   ] = useState<string[]>([])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (stageIds.length === 0) {[39m
[31m+       setPublishedStageIds((current) =>[39m
[31m+         current.length === 0 ? current : [][39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+       return[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     let cancelled = false[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     async function loadPublishedStages() {[39m
[31m+       const results = await Promise.all([39m
[31m+         stageIds.map(async (stageId) => {[39m
[31m+           const { data, error } =[39m
[31m+             await raceDetailReadRpc([39m
[31m+               'get_race_stage_live_state_v1',[39m
[31m+               {[39m
[31m+                 p_stage_id: stageId,[39m
[31m+               }[39m
[31m+             )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           if (error) {[39m
[31m+             console.error([39m
[31m+               `Could not load live state for stage ${stageId}:`,[39m
[31m+               error[39m
[31m+             )[39m
[31m+             return null[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           const value = Array.isArray(data)[39m
[31m+             ? data[0][39m
[31m+             : data[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           const liveState =[39m
[31m+             value &&[39m
[31m+             typeof value === 'object'[39m
[31m+               ? (value as RaceStageLiveState)[39m
[31m+               : null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           return liveState?.results_visible === true[39m
[31m+             ? stageId[39m
[31m+             : null[39m
[31m+         })[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (cancelled) return[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const nextPublishedStageIds =[39m
[31m+         results.filter([39m
[31m+           (stageId): stageId is string =>[39m
[31m+             Boolean(stageId)[39m
[31m+         )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       /*[39m
[31m+        * Keep the existing array reference when the publication[39m
[31m+        * state has not changed.[39m
[31m+        *[39m
[31m+        * This prevents the results effects from restarting every[39m
[31m+        * five seconds.[39m
[31m+        */[39m
[31m+       setPublishedStageIds([39m
[31m+         (currentPublishedStageIds) => {[39m
[31m+           const unchanged =[39m
[31m+             currentPublishedStageIds.length ===[39m
[31m+               nextPublishedStageIds.length &&[39m
[31m+             currentPublishedStageIds.every([39m
[31m+               (stageId, index) =>[39m
[31m+                 stageId ===[39m
[31m+                 nextPublishedStageIds[index][39m
[31m+             )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           return unchanged[39m
[31m+             ? currentPublishedStageIds[39m
[31m+             : nextPublishedStageIds[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     void loadPublishedStages()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const interval = window.setInterval([39m
[31m+       () => {[39m
[31m+         void loadPublishedStages()[39m
[31m+       },[39m
[31m+       5000[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return () => {[39m
[31m+       cancelled = true[39m
[31m+       window.clearInterval(interval)[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }, [stageIdsKey])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return publishedStageIds[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function RaceResultsHub({[39m
[31m+   race,[39m
[31m+   stages,[39m
[31m+   participantTeams,[39m
[31m+   participantsLoading,[39m
[31m+   participantsError,[39m
[31m+   currentClubId,[39m
[31m+   viewerClubFamilyIds,[39m
[31m+   teamEntryStatus,[39m
[31m+   onOpenTeamProfile,[39m
[31m+   onOpenRiderProfile,[39m
[31m+   restoreRaceInformationOpen = false,[39m
[31m+   restoreRaceInformationTab,[39m
[31m+   stageResultsOverride = null,[39m
[31m+   engineTestModeLabel = null,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   race: Race[39m
[31m+   stages: RaceStage[][39m
[31m+   participantTeams: RaceParticipantTeam[][39m
[31m+   participantsLoading: boolean[39m
[31m+   participantsError: string | null[39m
[31m+   currentClubId?: string | null[39m
[31m+   viewerClubFamilyIds?: string[][39m
[31m+   teamEntryStatus?: string | null[39m
[31m+   onOpenTeamProfile: (teamId: string, context?: { raceInfoExpanded?: boolean; raceInfoTab?: RaceInfoTab }) => void[39m
[31m+   onOpenRiderProfile: (riderId: string, context?: { raceInfoExpanded?: boolean; raceInfoTab?: RaceInfoTab }) => void[39m
[31m+   restoreRaceInformationOpen?: boolean[39m
[31m+   restoreRaceInformationTab?: RaceInfoTab[39m
[31m+   stageResultsOverride?: RaceStageResultsOverride | null[39m
[31m+   engineTestModeLabel?: string | null[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<RaceInfoTab>(restoreRaceInformationTab ?? 'participants')[39m
[31m+   const raceInformationSectionRef = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null)[39m
[31m+   const [classificationView, setClassificationView] =[39m
[31m+     useState<ClassificationView>('general')[39m
[31m+   const [stageId, setStageId] = useState<string>(stages[0]?.id ?? '')[39m
[31m+   const [stageResultView, setStageResultView] =[39m
[31m+     useState<StageResultView>('stage_general')[39m
[31m+   const [isExpanded, setIsExpanded] = useState(Boolean(restoreRaceInformationOpen))[39m
[31m+   const [fullStandingModal, setFullStandingModal] =[39m
[31m+     useState<'race' | 'stage' | null>(null)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const [classificationPayload, setClassificationPayload] =[39m
[31m+     useState<RaceResultsViewPayload | null>(null)[39m
[31m+   const [classificationLoading, setClassificationLoading] = useState(false)[39m
[31m+   const [classificationError, setClassificationError] = useState<string | null>(null)[39m
[31m+   const [[39m
[31m+     availableClassificationStageIds,[39m
[31m+     setAvailableClassificationStageIds,[39m
[31m+   ] = useState<string[]>([])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const [stageResultsPayload, setStageResultsPayload] =[39m
[31m+     useState<RaceResultsViewPayload | null>(null)[39m
[31m+   const [stagePointResults, setStagePointResults] =[39m
[31m+     useState<RacePointResultRow[]>([])[39m
[31m+   const [stageResultsLoading, setStageResultsLoading] = useState(false)[39m
[31m+   const [stageResultsError, setStageResultsError] = useState<string | null>(null)[39m
[31m+   const [inlineApplicationQuote, setInlineApplicationQuote] = useState<RaceApplicationQuote | null>(null)[39m
[31m+   const [inlineApplicationQuoteLoading, setInlineApplicationQuoteLoading] = useState(false)[39m
[31m+   const [inlineApplicationQuoteError, setInlineApplicationQuoteError] = useState<string | null>(null)[39m
[31m+   const [raceFavorites, setRaceFavorites] = useState<RaceFavoriteRow[]>([])[39m
[31m+   const [raceFavoritesLoading, setRaceFavoritesLoading] = useState(false)[39m
[31m+   const [raceFavoritesError, setRaceFavoritesError] = useState<string | null>(null)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const publishedStageIds =[39m
[31m+     usePublishedRaceStageIds(stages)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const publishedStageIdSet = useMemo([39m
[31m+     () => new Set(publishedStageIds),[39m
[31m+     [publishedStageIds][39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const publishedStages = useMemo([39m
[31m+     () =>[39m
[31m+       [...stages][39m
[31m+         .filter([39m
[31m+           (stage) =>[39m
[31m+             publishedStageIdSet.has(stage.id) ||[39m
[31m+             isStageWeatherCanceled(stage) ||[39m
[31m+             stageResultsOverride?.stageId === stage.id[39m
[31m+         )[39m
[31m+         .sort([39m
[31m+           (left, right) =>[39m
[31m+             Number(left.stage_number) -[39m
[31m+             Number(right.stage_number)[39m
[31m+         ),[39m
[31m+     [stages, publishedStageIdSet, stageResultsOverride][39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const normalizedRaceStatus =[39m
[31m+     race.status?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? ''[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const raceHasStarted =[39m
[31m+     publishedStages.length > 0 ||[39m
[31m+     [[39m
[31m+       'active',[39m
[31m+       'completed',[39m
[31m+       'finished',[39m
[31m+       'archived',[39m
[31m+     ].includes(normalizedRaceStatus)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (!restoreRaceInformationOpen) return[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     setIsExpanded(true)[39m
[31m+     setActiveTab(restoreRaceInformationTab ?? 'participants')[39m
[31m+   }, [restoreRaceInformationOpen, restoreRaceInformationTab])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const openProfileContext = useMemo([39m
[31m+     () => ({[39m
[31m+       raceInfoExpanded: true,[39m
[31m+       raceInfoTab: activeTab,[39m
[31m+     }),[39m
[31m+     [activeTab][39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function openTeamProfileFromRaceInfo(teamId: string) {[39m
[31m+     onOpenTeamProfile(teamId, openProfileContext)[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function openRiderProfileFromRaceInfo(riderId: string) {[39m
[31m+     onOpenRiderProfile(riderId, openProfileContext)[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function toggleRaceInformation() {[39m
[31m+     setIsExpanded((currentValue) => {[39m
[31m+       const nextValue = !currentValue[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       /*[39m
[31m+        * Before the race starts:[39m
[31m+        *   Teams & riders opens first.[39m
[31m+        *[39m
[31m+        * Once the race starts:[39m
[31m+        *   Results opens first whenever the card is expanded.[39m
[31m+        */[39m
[31m+       if (nextValue) {[39m
[31m+         setActiveTab([39m
[31m+           raceHasStarted[39m
[31m+             ? 'results'[39m
[31m+             : 'participants'[39m
[31m+         )[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return nextValue[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function handleRaceInformationTabChange(nextTab: RaceInfoTab) {[39m
[31m+     setActiveTab(nextTab)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {[39m
[31m+       raceInformationSectionRef.current?.scrollIntoView({[39m
[31m+         behavior: 'smooth',[39m
[31m+         block: 'start',[39m
[31m+       })[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (publishedStages.length === 0) {[39m
[31m+       setStageId('')[39m
[31m+       return[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const selectedStageIsPublished =[39m
[31m+       publishedStages.some([39m
[31m+         (stage) => stage.id === stageId[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (!selectedStageIsPublished) {[39m
[31m+       /*[39m
[31m+        * Default to the latest published stage.[39m
[31m+        */[39m
[31m+       setStageId([39m
[31m+         publishedStages[[39m
[31m+           publishedStages.length - 1[39m
[31m+         ].id[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }, [publishedStages, stageId])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const selectedStage =[39m
[31m+     publishedStages.find([39m
[31m+       (stage) => stage.id === stageId[39m
[31m+     ) ??[39m
[31m+     publishedStages[[39m
[31m+       publishedStages.length - 1[39m
[31m+     ] ??[39m
[31m+     null[39m
[31m+   const selectedStageIsTimeTrialLike =[39m
[31m+     isTimeTrialLikeStage(selectedStage)[39m
[31m+   const selectedStageIsTeamTimeTrialLike =[39m
[31m+     isTeamTimeTrialLikeStage(selectedStage)[39m
[31m+   const selectedStageAllowsSprintPointView =[39m
[31m+     !selectedStageIsTeamTimeTrialLike[39m
[31m+   const selectedStageWeatherCanceled = isStageWeatherCanceled(selectedStage)[39m
[31m+   const raceAllStagesWeatherCanceled = isRaceAllWeatherCanceled(race)[39m
[31m+   const raceHasWeatherCancellation =[39m
[31m+     raceAllStagesWeatherCanceled || isRacePartlyWeatherCanceled(race)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const viewerTeamId = getViewerTeamId(currentClubId)[39m
[31m+   const viewerTeamIds = getViewerTeamIds(viewerTeamId, viewerClubFamilyIds)[39m
[31m+   const effectiveEntryStatus = teamEntryStatus ?? race.existing_application_status ?? null[39m
[31m+   const showPendingApplicationInfo =[39m
[31m+     activeTab === 'participants' &&[39m
[31m+     isPendingRaceApplicationStatus(effectiveEntryStatus) &&[39m
[31m+     !participantsLoading &&[39m
[31m+     !participantsError &&[39m
[31m+     participantTeams.length === 0 &&[39m
[31m+     !isRaceStartlistLocked(race.status)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (!race.id || !isUuid(race.id)) {[39m
[31m+       setRaceFavorites([])[39m
[31m+       setRaceFavoritesError(null)[39m
[31m+       setRaceFavoritesLoading(false)[39m
[31m+       return[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     let cancelled = false[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     async function loadRaceFavorites() {[39m
[31m+       setRaceFavoritesLoading(true)[39m
[31m+       setRaceFavoritesError(null)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const { data, error } = await raceDetailReadRpc('get_race_favorites_v1', {[39m
[31m+         p_race_id: race.id,[39m
[31m+         p_limit: 5,[39m
[31m+       })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (cancelled) return[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (error) {[39m
[31m+         console.warn('Could not load race favorites:', error.message)[39m
[31m+         setRaceFavorites([])[39m
[31m+         setRaceFavoritesError(error.message)[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         setRaceFavorites(((data ?? []) as RaceFavoriteRow[]).slice(0, 5))[39m
[31m+         setRaceFavoritesError(null)[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       setRaceFavoritesLoading(false)[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     void loadRaceFavorites()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return () => {[39m
[31m+       cancelled = true[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }, [race.id])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if ([39m
[31m+       !isExpanded ||[39m
[31m+       !race.id ||[39m
[31m+       activeTab !== 'results'[39m
[31m+     ) {[39m
[31m+       setAvailableClassificationStageIds([])[39m
[31m+       return[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     let cancelled = false[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     async function loadAvailableClassificationStages() {[39m
[31m+       const { data, error } = await supabase[39m
[31m+         .from('race_classification_standings')[39m
[31m+         .select('after_stage_id')[39m
[31m+         .eq('race_id', race.id)[39m
[31m+         .eq('classification_type', 'general')[39m
[31m+         .eq('entity_type', 'rider')[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (cancelled) return[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (error) {[39m
[31m+         console.error([39m
[31m+           'Could not load available classification stages:',[39m
[31m+           error[39m
[31m+         )[39m
[31m+         setAvailableClassificationStageIds([])[39m
[31m+         return[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       setAvailableClassificationStageIds([39m
[31m+         Array.from([39m
[31m+           new Set([39m
[31m+             (data ?? [])[39m
[31m+               .map((row) => row.after_stage_id)[39m
[31m+               .filter([39m
[31m+                 (stageId): stageId is string =>[39m
[31m+                   typeof stageId === 'string' &&[39m
[31m+                   stageId.length > 0[39m
[31m+               )[39m
[31m+           )[39m
[31m+         )[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     loadAvailableClassificationStages()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return () => {[39m
[31m+       cancelled = true[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }, [race.id, activeTab, isExpanded])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const availableClassificationStageIdSet =[39m
[31m+     useMemo([39m
[31m+       () =>[39m
[31m+         new Set([39m
[31m+           availableClassificationStageIds[39m
[31m+         ),[39m
[31m+       [availableClassificationStageIds][39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   /*[39m
[31m+    * Stage 1 selected → classification after Stage 1[39m
[31m+    * Stage 2 selected → classification after Stage 2[39m
[31m+    * Stage 3 selected → classification after Stage 3,[39m
[31m+    * but only after Stage 3 is published.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   const classificationResultsStageId =[39m
[31m+     selectedStage &&[39m
[31m+     !isStageWeatherCanceled(selectedStage) &&[39m
[31m+     publishedStageIdSet.has([39m
[31m+       selectedStage.id[39m
[31m+     ) &&[39m
[31m+     availableClassificationStageIdSet.has([39m
[31m+       selectedStage.id[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+       ? selectedStage.id[39m
[31m+       : null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+ function RaceClassificationTable({[39m
[31m+   rows,[39m
[31m+   view,[39m
[31m+   participantTeams,[39m
[31m+   currentClubId,[39m
[31m+   viewerClubFamilyIds,[39m
[31m+   onOpenTeamProfile,[39m
[31m+   onOpenRiderProfile,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   rows: RaceClassificationRow[][39m
[31m+   view: ClassificationView[39m
[31m+   participantTeams: RaceParticipantTeam[][39m
[31m+   currentClubId?: string | null[39m
[31m+   viewerClubFamilyIds?: string[][39m
[31m+   onOpenTeamProfile: (teamId: string) => void[39m
[31m+   onOpenRiderProfile: (riderId: string) => void[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   if (rows.length === 0) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl bg-white p-4 text-sm text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+         No classification data available for this view.[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const isPointsView = view === 'points' || view === 'mountain'[39m
[31m+   const columnCount = isPointsView ? 4 : 5[39m
[31m+   const viewerTeamId = getViewerTeamId(currentClubId)[39m
[31m+   const viewerTeamIds = getViewerTeamIds(viewerTeamId, viewerClubFamilyIds)[39m
[31m+   const userRiderIds = getUserRiderIdSet(participantTeams, viewerTeamIds)[39m
[31m+   const participantRiderById = new Map([39m
[31m+     participantTeams.flatMap((team) =>[39m
[31m+       team.riders.map([39m
[31m+         (rider) => [rider.rider_id, rider] as const[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const { topRows, extraUserRows } = buildTopRowsWithUserExtras([39m
[31m+     rows,[39m
[31m+     (row) => {[39m
[31m+       if (row.entity_type === 'team') {[39m
[31m+         return isViewerTeamRow(row, viewerTeamIds)[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return Boolean([39m
[31m+         (row.rider_id && userRiderIds.has(row.rider_id)) ||[39m
[31m+           isViewerTeamRow(row, viewerTeamIds)[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     },[39m
[31m+     15[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const getFullClassificationRiderName = (row: RaceClassificationRow): string => {[39m
[31m+     const participantRider = row.rider_id[39m
[31m+       ? participantRiderById.get(row.rider_id)[39m
[31m+       : null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       participantRider?.rider_full_name?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       row.display_name_snapshot?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       participantRider?.rider_name_snapshot?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       '—'[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const renderLinkedRiderName = (row: RaceClassificationRow) => {[39m
[31m+     const label = getFullClassificationRiderName(row)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (!row.rider_id) {[39m
[31m+       return <span className={RESULT_RIDER_NAME_ONE_LINE_CLASS}>{label}</span>[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <button[39m
[31m+         type="button"[39m
[31m+         onClick={() => onOpenRiderProfile(row.rider_id as string)}[39m
[31m+         className={RESULT_RIDER_NAME_ONE_LINE_CLASS}[39m
[31m+         title={label}[39m
[31m+       >[39m
[31m+         {label}[39m
[31m+       </button>[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const renderLinkedTeamName = (teamId?: string | null, label?: string | null) => ([39m
[31m+     <ResultTeamJerseyCell[39m
[31m+       teamId={teamId}[39m
[31m+       teamName={label}[39m
[31m+       participantTeams={participantTeams}[39m
[31m+       onOpenTeamProfile={onOpenTeamProfile}[39m
[31m+     />[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const renderRow = (row: RaceClassificationRow) => ([39m
[31m+     <tr[39m
[31m+       key={`${row.classification_type}-${row.entity_type}-${row.rank}-${row.rider_id ?? row.team_id ?? row.display_name_snapshot}`}[39m
[31m+       className={`${viewerTeamRowClass(row, viewerTeamIds)} border-b border-slate-100`}[39m
[31m+     >[39m
[31m+       <td className="px-3 py-3 font-semibold text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+         {row.rank ?? '—'}[39m
[31m+       </td>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <td className="px-3 py-3 font-medium text-slate-900 whitespace-nowrap">[39m
[31m+         {row.entity_type === 'team'[39m
[31m+           ? renderLinkedTeamName(row.team_id, row.display_name_snapshot)[39m
[31m+           : renderLinkedRiderName(row)}[39m
[31m+       </td>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <td className="max-w-0 px-2 py-1.5 text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+         {row.entity_type === 'team'[39m
[31m+           ? '—'[39m
[31m+           : renderLinkedTeamName(row.team_id, row.team_name_snapshot)}[39m
[31m+       </td>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-semibold text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+         {isPointsView[39m
[31m+           ? formatResultPoints(row.points)[39m
[31m+           : formatRaceClock(row.total_time_seconds)}[39m
[31m+       </td>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {!isPointsView ? ([39m
[31m+         <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+           {formatClassificationGap(row.gap_seconds)}[39m
[31m+         </td>[39m
[31m+       ) : null}[39m
[31m+     </tr>[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="mt-4 overflow-x-auto rounded-xl bg-white">[39m
[31m+       <table className="min-w-full table-fixed text-sm">[39m
[31m+         <colgroup>[39m
[31m+           <col className="w-[8%]" />[39m
[31m+           <col className={isPointsView ? 'w-[40%]' : 'w-[37%]'} />[39m
[31m+           <col className={isPointsView ? 'w-[35%]' : 'w-[32%]'} />[39m
[31m+           <col className={isPointsView ? 'w-[17%]' : 'w-[16%]'} />[39m
[31m+           {!isPointsView ? <col className="w-[7%]" /> : null}[39m
[31m+         </colgroup>[39m
[31m+         <thead>[39m
[31m+           <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 text-left text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+             <th className="px-3 py-3">#</th>[39m
[31m+             <th className="px-3 py-3">{view === 'team' ? 'Team' : 'Rider'}</th>[39m
[31m+             <th className="px-3 py-3">Team</th>[39m
[31m+             <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right">[39m
[31m+               {isPointsView ? 'Points' : 'Time'}[39m
[31m+             </th>[39m
[31m+             {!isPointsView ? ([39m
[31m+               <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right">Gap</th>[39m
[31m+             ) : null}[39m
[31m+           </tr>[39m
[31m+         </thead>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <tbody>[39m
[31m+           {topRows.map(renderRow)}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           {extraUserRows.length > 0 ? ([39m
[31m+             <EllipsisTableRow colSpan={columnCount} />[39m
[31m+           ) : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           {extraUserRows.map(renderRow)}[39m
[31m+         </tbody>[39m
[31m+       </table>[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function StageResultsTable({[39m
[31m+   rows,[39m
[31m+   participantTeams,[39m
[31m+   classificationRows,[39m
[31m+   currentClubId,[39m
[31m+   viewerClubFamilyIds,[39m
[31m+   onOpenTeamProfile,[39m
[31m+   onOpenRiderProfile,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   rows: RaceStageResultRow[][39m
[31m+   participantTeams: RaceParticipantTeam[][39m
[31m+   classificationRows?: RaceClassificationRow[][39m
[31m+   currentClubId?: string | null[39m
[31m+   viewerClubFamilyIds?: string[][39m
[31m+   onOpenTeamProfile: (teamId: string) => void[39m
[31m+   onOpenRiderProfile: (riderId: string) => void[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   if (rows.length === 0) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl bg-white p-4 text-sm text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+         No stage result data available.[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const participantRiderById = new Map([39m
[31m+     participantTeams.flatMap((team) =>[39m
[31m+       team.riders.map([39m
[31m+         (rider) => [rider.rider_id, rider] as const[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const classificationRiderNameById = new Map<string, string>()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (const classificationRow of classificationRows ?? []) {[39m
[31m+     const riderId = classificationRow.rider_id?.trim()[39m
[31m+     const displayName = classificationRow.display_name_snapshot?.trim()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (!riderId || !displayName) continue[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const existingName = classificationRiderNameById.get(riderId)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     /*[39m
[31m+      * Stage-result rows often only contain short snapshots such as[39m
[31m+      * "G. Peeters". The classification payload, however, already has[39m
[31m+      * the full display name for the same rider on the same race/stage.[39m
[31m+      * Prefer that full-name source so non-user riders are not stuck with[39m
[31m+      * initial-only names in the Stage Results table.[39m
[31m+      */[39m
[31m+     if (!existingName || displayName.length > existingName.length) {[39m
[31m+       classificationRiderNameById.set(riderId, displayName)[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function getFullStageResultRiderName([39m
[31m+     row: RaceStageResultRow[39m
[31m+   ): string {[39m
[31m+     const participantRider = row.rider_id[39m
[31m+       ? participantRiderById.get(row.rider_id)[39m
[31m+       : null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const classificationFullName = row.rider_id[39m
[31m+       ? classificationRiderNameById.get(row.rider_id)[39m
[31m+       : null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       classificationFullName?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       row.full_name?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       row.rider_full_name?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       participantRider?.rider_full_name?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       row.display_name?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       row.rider_name?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       participantRider?.rider_name_snapshot?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       row.rider_name_snapshot?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       '—'[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const sortedRows = sortRankedRows(rows)[39m
[31m+   const winnerElapsedSeconds = (() => {[39m
[31m+     const winner = sortedRows.find([39m
[31m+       (row) => row.elapsed_seconds !== null && row.elapsed_seconds !== undefined[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     const parsed = Number(winner?.elapsed_seconds)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null[39m
[31m+   })()[39m
[31m+   const viewerTeamId = getViewerTeamId(currentClubId)[39m
[31m+   const viewerTeamIds = getViewerTeamIds(viewerTeamId, viewerClubFamilyIds)[39m
[31m+   const userRiderIds = getUserRiderIdSet(participantTeams, viewerTeamIds)[39m
[31m+   const { topRows, extraUserRows } = buildTopRowsWithUserExtras([39m
[31m+     rows,[39m
[31m+     (row) =>[39m
[31m+       Boolean([39m
[31m+         (row.rider_id && userRiderIds.has(row.rider_id)) ||[39m
[31m+           isViewerTeamRow(row, viewerTeamIds)[39m
[31m+       ),[39m
[31m+     15[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const renderLinkedStageResultRiderName = (row: RaceStageResultRow) => {[39m
[31m+     const label = getFullStageResultRiderName(row)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (!row.rider_id) {[39m
[31m+       return <span className={RESULT_RIDER_NAME_ONE_LINE_CLASS}>{label}</span>[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <button[39m
[31m+         type="button"[39m
[31m+         onClick={() => onOpenRiderProfile(row.rider_id as string)}[39m
[31m+         className={RESULT_RIDER_NAME_ONE_LINE_CLASS}[39m
[31m+         title={label}[39m
[31m+       >[39m
[31m+         {label}[39m
[31m+       </button>[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const renderLinkedStageResultTeamName = (row: RaceStageResultRow) => ([39m
[31m+     <ResultTeamJerseyCell[39m
[31m+       teamId={row.team_id}[39m
[31m+       teamName={row.team_name_snapshot}[39m
[31m+       participantTeams={participantTeams}[39m
[31m+       onOpenTeamProfile={onOpenTeamProfile}[39m
[31m+     />[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const renderRow = (row: RaceStageResultRow) => ([39m
[31m+     <tr[39m
[31m+       key={`${row.rank}-${row.rider_id}`}[39m
[31m+       className={`${viewerTeamRowClass(row, viewerTeamIds)} border-b border-slate-100`}[39m
[31m+     >[39m
[31m+       <td className="px-3 py-3 font-semibold text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+         {row.rank ?? '—'}[39m
[31m+       </td>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <td className="px-3 py-3 font-medium text-slate-900 whitespace-nowrap">[39m
[31m+         {renderLinkedStageResultRiderName(row)}[39m
[31m+       </td>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <td className="max-w-0 px-2 py-1.5 text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+         {renderLinkedStageResultTeamName(row)}[39m
[31m+       </td>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right">[39m
[31m+         <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+           {formatStageResultTime(row, winnerElapsedSeconds)}[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       </td>[39m
[31m+     </tr>[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="mt-4 overflow-x-auto rounded-xl bg-white">[39m
[31m+       <table className="min-w-full table-fixed text-sm">[39m
[31m+         <colgroup>[39m
[31m+           <col className="w-[8%]" />[39m
[31m+           <col className="w-[44%]" />[39m
[31m+           <col className="w-[36%]" />[39m
[31m+           <col className="w-[12%]" />[39m
[31m+         </colgroup>[39m
[31m+         <thead>[39m
[31m+           <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 text-left text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+             <th className="px-3 py-3">#</th>[39m
[31m+             <th className="px-3 py-3">Rider</th>[39m
[31m+             <th className="px-3 py-3">Team</th>[39m
[31m+             <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right">Time</th>[39m
[31m+           </tr>[39m
[31m+         </thead>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <tbody>[39m
[31m+           {topRows.map(renderRow)}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           {extraUserRows.length > 0 ? <EllipsisTableRow colSpan={4} /> : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           {extraUserRows.map(renderRow)}[39m
[31m+         </tbody>[39m
[31m+       </table>[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function StagePointResultsTable({[39m
[31m+   rows,[39m
[31m+   view,[39m
[31m+   participantTeams,[39m
[31m+   currentClubId,[39m
[31m+   viewerClubFamilyIds,[39m
[31m+   onOpenTeamProfile,[39m
[31m+   onOpenRiderProfile,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   rows: AggregatedStagePointResultRow[][39m
[31m+   view: StagePointAggregateView[39m
[31m+   participantTeams: RaceParticipantTeam[][39m
[31m+   currentClubId?: string | null[39m
[31m+   viewerClubFamilyIds?: string[][39m
[31m+   onOpenTeamProfile: (teamId: string) => void[39m
[31m+   onOpenRiderProfile: (riderId: string) => void[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const label = view === 'mountain' ? 'mountain point' : 'sprint point'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (rows.length === 0) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl bg-white p-4 text-sm text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+         No {label} data available for this stage.[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const showBonus = view === 'sprint'[39m
[31m+   const columnCount = showBonus ? 5 : 4[39m
[31m+   const viewerTeamId = getViewerTeamId(currentClubId)[39m
[31m+   const viewerTeamIds = getViewerTeamIds(viewerTeamId, viewerClubFamilyIds)[39m
[31m+   const userRiderIds = getUserRiderIdSet(participantTeams, viewerTeamIds)[39m
[31m+   const participantRiderById = new Map([39m
[31m+     participantTeams.flatMap((team) =>[39m
[31m+       team.riders.map([39m
[31m+         (rider) => [rider.rider_id, rider] as const[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const { topRows, extraUserRows } = buildTopRowsWithUserExtras([39m
[31m+     rows,[39m
[31m+     (row) =>[39m
[31m+       Boolean([39m
[31m+         (row.rider_id && userRiderIds.has(row.rider_id)) ||[39m
[31m+           isViewerTeamRow(row, viewerTeamIds)[39m
[31m+       ),[39m
[31m+     15[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const getFullPointRiderName = (row: AggregatedStagePointResultRow): string => {[39m
[31m+     const participantRider = row.rider_id[39m
[31m+       ? participantRiderById.get(row.rider_id)[39m
[31m+       : null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       participantRider?.rider_full_name?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       row.rider_name_snapshot?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       participantRider?.rider_name_snapshot?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       '—'[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const renderLinkedPointRiderName = (row: AggregatedStagePointResultRow) => {[39m
[31m+     const label = getFullPointRiderName(row)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (!row.rider_id) {[39m
[31m+       return <span className={RESULT_RIDER_NAME_ONE_LINE_CLASS}>{label}</span>[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <button[39m
[31m+         type="button"[39m
[31m+         onClick={() => onOpenRiderProfile(row.rider_id as string)}[39m
[31m+         className={RESULT_RIDER_NAME_ONE_LINE_CLASS}[39m
[31m+         title={label}[39m
[31m+       >[39m
[31m+         {label}[39m
[31m+       </button>[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const renderLinkedPointTeamName = (row: AggregatedStagePointResultRow) => ([39m
[31m+     <ResultTeamJerseyCell[39m
[31m+       teamId={row.team_id}[39m
[31m+       teamName={row.team_name_snapshot}[39m
[31m+       participantTeams={participantTeams}[39m
[31m+       onOpenTeamProfile={onOpenTeamProfile}[39m
[31m+     />[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const renderRow = (row: AggregatedStagePointResultRow) => ([39m
[31m+     <tr[39m
[31m+       key={`${view}-${row.rank}-${row.rider_id ?? row.rider_name_snapshot}`}[39m
[31m+       className={`${viewerTeamRowClass(row, viewerTeamIds)} border-b border-slate-100`}[39m
[31m+     >[39m
[31m+       <td className="px-3 py-3 font-semibold text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+         {row.rank ?? '—'}[39m
[31m+       </td>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <td className="px-3 py-3 font-medium text-slate-900 whitespace-nowrap">[39m
[31m+         {renderLinkedPointRiderName(row)}[39m
[31m+       </td>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <td className="max-w-0 px-2 py-1.5 text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+         {renderLinkedPointTeamName(row)}[39m
[31m+       </td>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-semibold text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+         {row.points_awarded}[39m
[31m+       </td>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {showBonus ? ([39m
[31m+         <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+           {row.bonus_seconds_awarded > 0 ? `${row.bonus_seconds_awarded}s` : '—'}[39m
[31m+         </td>[39m
[31m+       ) : null}[39m
[31m+     </tr>[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="mt-4 overflow-x-auto rounded-xl bg-white">[39m
[31m+       <table className="min-w-full table-fixed text-sm">[39m
[31m+         <colgroup>[39m
[31m+           <col className="w-[8%]" />[39m
[31m+           <col className={showBonus ? 'w-[38%]' : 'w-[44%]'} />[39m
[31m+           <col className={showBonus ? 'w-[34%]' : 'w-[32%]'} />[39m
[31m+           <col className={showBonus ? 'w-[10%]' : 'w-[16%]'} />[39m
[31m+           {showBonus ? <col className="w-[10%]" /> : null}[39m
[31m+         </colgroup>[39m
[31m+         <thead>[39m
[31m+           <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 text-left text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+             <th className="px-3 py-3">#</th>[39m
[31m+             <th className="px-3 py-3">Rider</th>[39m
[31m+             <th className="px-3 py-3">Team</th>[39m
[31m+             <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right">Pts</th>[39m
[31m+             {showBonus ? ([39m
[31m+               <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right">Bonus</th>[39m
[31m+             ) : null}[39m
[31m+           </tr>[39m
[31m+         </thead>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <tbody>[39m
[31m+           {topRows.map(renderRow)}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           {extraUserRows.length > 0 ? ([39m
[31m+             <EllipsisTableRow colSpan={columnCount} />[39m
[31m+           ) : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           {extraUserRows.map(renderRow)}[39m
[31m+         </tbody>[39m
[31m+       </table>[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type BackendStageProfilePoint = {[39m
[31m+   km: number[39m
[31m+   elevation: number[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type TerrainReplaySegment = {[39m
[31m+   startKm: number[39m
[31m+   endKm: number[39m
[31m+   distanceKm: number[39m
[31m+   climbMultiplier: number[39m
[31m+   weightedDistance: number[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type TerrainReplayTimingModel = {[39m
[31m+   distanceKm: number[39m
[31m+   totalWeightedDistance: number[39m
[31m+   durationFactor: number[39m
[31m+   segments: TerrainReplaySegment[][39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getTerrainReplayClimbMultiplier(gradientPercent: number): number {[39m
[31m+   if (!Number.isFinite(gradientPercent) || gradientPercent <= 0.5) return 1[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   /*[39m
[31m+    * Flat and downhill sections keep the normal replay movement speed.[39m
[31m+    * Positive gradients consume more replay time, so the leader marker visibly[39m
[31m+    * slows on climbs without changing any authoritative race-engine result.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   return Math.min(3, 1 + (gradientPercent - 0.5) * 0.15)[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildTerrainReplayTimingModel([39m
[31m+   points: BackendStageProfilePoint[],[39m
[31m+   distanceKm: number[39m
[31m+ ): TerrainReplayTimingModel {[39m
[31m+   const safeDistanceKm = Math.max(1, Number(distanceKm) || 1)[39m
[31m+   const normalized = points[39m
[31m+     .map((point) => ({[39m
[31m+       km: Math.max(0, Math.min(safeDistanceKm, Number(point.km) || 0)),[39m
[31m+       elevation: Number(point.elevation) || 0,[39m
[31m+     }))[39m
[31m+     .sort((left, right) => left.km - right.km)[39m
[31m+     .filter([39m
[31m+       (point, index, rows) =>[39m
[31m+         index === 0 || Math.abs(point.km - rows[index - 1].km) > 0.000001[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (normalized.length === 0) {[39m
[31m+     normalized.push([39m
[31m+       { km: 0, elevation: 0 },[39m
[31m+       { km: safeDistanceKm, elevation: 0 }[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   } else {[39m
[31m+     if (normalized[0].km > 0) {[39m
[31m+       normalized.unshift({ km: 0, elevation: normalized[0].elevation })[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const last = normalized[normalized.length - 1][39m
[31m+     if (last.km < safeDistanceKm) {[39m
[31m+       normalized.push({ km: safeDistanceKm, elevation: last.elevation })[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const segments: TerrainReplaySegment[] = [][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (let index = 1; index < normalized.length; index += 1) {[39m
[31m+     const previous = normalized[index - 1][39m
[31m+     const next = normalized[index][39m
[31m+     const segmentDistanceKm = Math.max(0, next.km - previous.km)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (segmentDistanceKm <= 0) continue[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const gradientPercent =[39m
[31m+       ((next.elevation - previous.elevation) / (segmentDistanceKm * 1000)) *[39m
[31m+       100[39m
[31m+     const climbMultiplier = getTerrainReplayClimbMultiplier(gradientPercent)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     segments.push({[39m
[31m+       startKm: previous.km,[39m
[31m+       endKm: next.km,[39m
[31m+       distanceKm: segmentDistanceKm,[39m
[31m+       climbMultiplier,[39m
[31m+       weightedDistance: segmentDistanceKm * climbMultiplier,[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (segments.length === 0) {[39m
[31m+     segments.push({[39m
[31m+       startKm: 0,[39m
[31m+       endKm: safeDistanceKm,[39m
[31m+       distanceKm: safeDistanceKm,[39m
[31m+       climbMultiplier: 1,[39m
[31m+       weightedDistance: safeDistanceKm,[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const totalWeightedDistance = segments.reduce([39m
[31m+     (sum, segment) => sum + segment.weightedDistance,[39m
[31m+     0[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     distanceKm: safeDistanceKm,[39m
[31m+     totalWeightedDistance: Math.max(safeDistanceKm, totalWeightedDistance),[39m
[31m+     durationFactor: Math.max(1, totalWeightedDistance / safeDistanceKm),[39m
[31m+     segments,[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getTerrainAwareDistanceProgressFraction([39m
[31m+   elapsedFraction: number,[39m
[31m+   model: TerrainReplayTimingModel[39m
[31m+ ): number {[39m
[31m+   const normalizedElapsed = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, elapsedFraction))[39m
[31m+   const targetWeightedDistance =[39m
[31m+     normalizedElapsed * model.totalWeightedDistance[39m
[31m+   let completedWeightedDistance = 0[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (const segment of model.segments) {[39m
[31m+     const segmentEnd =[39m
[31m+       completedWeightedDistance + segment.weightedDistance[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (targetWeightedDistance <= segmentEnd) {[39m
[31m+       const segmentFraction = Math.max([39m
[31m+         0,[39m
[31m+         Math.min([39m
[31m+           1,[39m
[31m+           (targetWeightedDistance - completedWeightedDistance) /[39m
[31m+             Math.max(segment.weightedDistance, 0.000001)[39m
[31m+         )[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+       const currentKm =[39m
[31m+         segment.startKm + segment.distanceKm * segmentFraction[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return Math.max([39m
[31m+         0,[39m
[31m+         Math.min(1, currentKm / Math.max(model.distanceKm, 1))[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     completedWeightedDistance = segmentEnd[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return 1[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getTerrainAwareElapsedProgressFractionForDistance([39m
[31m+   distanceFraction: number,[39m
[31m+   model: TerrainReplayTimingModel[39m
[31m+ ): number {[39m
[31m+   const normalizedDistance = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, distanceFraction))[39m
[31m+   const targetKm = normalizedDistance * model.distanceKm[39m
[31m+   let completedWeightedDistance = 0[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (const segment of model.segments) {[39m
[31m+     if (targetKm >= segment.endKm) {[39m
[31m+       completedWeightedDistance += segment.weightedDistance[39m
[31m+       continue[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (targetKm <= segment.startKm) break[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const segmentDistanceCompleted = targetKm - segment.startKm[39m
[31m+     completedWeightedDistance +=[39m
[31m+       segmentDistanceCompleted * segment.climbMultiplier[39m
[31m+     break[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return Math.max([39m
[31m+     0,[39m
[31m+     Math.min([39m
[31m+       1,[39m
[31m+       completedWeightedDistance /[39m
[31m+         Math.max(model.totalWeightedDistance, 0.000001)[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type StageRouteMarker = {[39m
[31m+   type: string[39m
[31m+   km: number[39m
[31m+   label: string[39m
[31m+   category?: string | null[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ type StageProfileDetailItem = Record<string, JsonValue>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type StageProfileDetailPayload = {[39m
[31m+   stage_id: string[39m
[31m+   race_id: string[39m
[31m+   stage_number: number[39m
[31m+   stage_title: string | null[39m
[31m+   route_label: string | null[39m
[31m+   stage_summary: string | null[39m
[31m+   weather_summary: string | null[39m
[31m+   weather_snapshot: JsonObject | null[39m
[31m+   stage_weather?: JsonObject | null[39m
[31m+   phase9_preparation?: JsonObject | null[39m
[31m+   distance_km: number | null[39m
[31m+   elevation_gain_m: number | null[39m
[31m+   terrain_type: string | null[39m
[31m+   profile_type: string | null[39m
[31m+   terrain_split: {[39m
[31m+     flat?: number[39m
[31m+     hilly?: number[39m
[31m+     mountain?: number[39m
[31m+     cobbled?: number[39m
[31m+   } | null[39m
[31m+   profile_points: BackendStageProfilePoint[][39m
[31m+   route_markers: StageRouteMarker[][39m
[31m+   intermediate_sprints: StageProfileDetailItem[][39m
[31m+   mountain_climbs: StageProfileDetailItem[][39m
[31m+   has_profile: boolean[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeStageProfilePoint(value: unknown): BackendStageProfilePoint | null {[39m
[31m+   const point = getRecord(value)[39m
[31m+   const km = Number(point.km)[39m
[31m+   const elevation = Number(point.elevation ?? point.elevation_m)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!Number.isFinite(km) || !Number.isFinite(elevation)) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return { km, elevation }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeStageRouteMarker(value: unknown): StageRouteMarker | null {[39m
[31m+   const marker = getRecord(value)[39m
[31m+   const km = Number(marker.km)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!Number.isFinite(km)) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const categoryValue =[39m
[31m+     typeof marker.category === 'string' && marker.category.trim()[39m
[31m+       ? marker.category.trim()[39m
[31m+       : typeof marker.kom_category === 'string' && marker.kom_category.trim()[39m
[31m+         ? marker.kom_category.trim()[39m
[31m+         : typeof marker.climb_category === 'string' && marker.climb_category.trim()[39m
[31m+           ? marker.climb_category.trim()[39m
[31m+           : null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     type: typeof marker.type === 'string' ? marker.type.toLowerCase() : 'marker',[39m
[31m+     km,[39m
[31m+     label:[39m
[31m+       typeof marker.label === 'string' && marker.label.trim()[39m
[31m+         ? marker.label[39m
[31m+         : typeof marker.type === 'string'[39m
[31m+           ? humanizeCode(marker.type)[39m
[31m+           : 'Marker',[39m
[31m+     category: categoryValue,[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeStageProfileDetailPayload(value: unknown): StageProfileDetailPayload {[39m
[31m+   const record = getRecord(value)[39m
[31m+   const terrainSplit = getRecord(record.terrain_split)[39m
[31m+   const stageWeather = getRecord(record.stage_weather)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     stage_id: typeof record.stage_id === 'string' ? record.stage_id : '',[39m
[31m+     race_id: typeof record.race_id === 'string' ? record.race_id : '',[39m
[31m+     stage_number: Number.isFinite(Number(record.stage_number)) ? Number(record.stage_number) : 0,[39m
[31m+     stage_title: typeof record.stage_title === 'string' ? record.stage_title : null,[39m
[31m+     route_label: typeof record.route_label === 'string' ? record.route_label : null,[39m
[31m+     stage_summary: typeof record.stage_summary === 'string' ? record.stage_summary : null,[39m
[31m+     weather_summary: typeof record.weather_summary === 'string' ? record.weather_summary : null,[39m
[31m+     weather_snapshot: getRecord(record.weather_snapshot) as JsonObject,[39m
[31m+     stage_weather: Object.keys(stageWeather).length[39m
[31m+       ? (stageWeather as JsonObject)[39m
[31m+       : null,[39m
[31m+     phase9_preparation: (() => {[39m
[31m+       const phase9Preparation = getRecord([39m
[31m+         record.phase9_preparation ?? record.phase9Preparation[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+       return Object.keys(phase9Preparation).length[39m
[31m+         ? (phase9Preparation as JsonObject)[39m
[31m+         : null[39m
[31m+     })(),[39m
[31m+     distance_km: Number.isFinite(Number(record.distance_km)) ? Number(record.distance_km) : null,[39m
[31m+     elevation_gain_m: Number.isFinite(Number(record.elevation_gain_m))[39m
[31m+       ? Number(record.elevation_gain_m)[39m
[31m+       : null,[39m
[31m+     terrain_type: typeof record.terrain_type === 'string' ? record.terrain_type : null,[39m
[31m+     profile_type: typeof record.profile_type === 'string' ? record.profile_type : null,[39m
[31m+     terrain_split: Object.keys(terrainSplit).length[39m
[31m+       ? {[39m
[31m+           flat: Number.isFinite(Number(terrainSplit.flat)) ? Number(terrainSplit.flat) : 0,[39m
[31m+           hilly: Number.isFinite(Number(terrainSplit.hilly)) ? Number(terrainSplit.hilly) : 0,[39m
[31m+           mountain: Number.isFinite(Number(terrainSplit.mountain)) ? Number(terrainSplit.mountain) : 0,[39m
[31m+           cobbled: Number.isFinite(Number(terrainSplit.cobbled)) ? Number(terrainSplit.cobbled) : 0,[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       : null,[39m
[31m+     profile_points: arrayOrEmpty<unknown>(record.profile_points)[39m
[31m+       .map(normalizeStageProfilePoint)[39m
[31m+       .filter((point): point is BackendStageProfilePoint => point !== null)[39m
[31m+       .sort((a, b) => a.km - b.km),[39m
[31m+     route_markers: arrayOrEmpty<unknown>(record.route_markers)[39m
[31m+       .map(normalizeStageRouteMarker)[39m
[31m+       .filter((marker): marker is StageRouteMarker => marker !== null)[39m
[31m+       .sort((a, b) => a.km - b.km),[39m
[31m+     intermediate_sprints: arrayOrEmpty<StageProfileDetailItem>(record.intermediate_sprints),[39m
[31m+     mountain_climbs: arrayOrEmpty<StageProfileDetailItem>(record.mountain_climbs),[39m
[31m+     has_profile: Boolean(record.has_profile),[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function formatProfileDetailValue(value: JsonValue | number | string | null | undefined): string {[39m
[31m+   if (value === null || value === undefined) return '—'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (Array.isArray(value)) {[39m
[31m+     return value.length ? value.map((entry) => formatProfileDetailValue(entry)).join(' / ') : '—'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (typeof value === 'object') {[39m
[31m+     const entries = Object.entries(value as Record<string, JsonValue>)[39m
[31m+     return entries.length[39m
[31m+       ? entries.map(([key, entryValue]) => `${humanizeCode(key)}: ${formatProfileDetailValue(entryValue)}`).join(' · ')[39m
[31m+       : '—'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return String(value)[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatPointsSchemeLabel(value: JsonValue | undefined): string {[39m
[31m+   if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length === 0) return '—'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return value.map((entry) => formatProfileDetailValue(entry)).join(' / ')[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getProfileDetailNumber([39m
[31m+   item: StageProfileDetailItem | null | undefined,[39m
[31m+   key: string[39m
[31m+ ): number | null {[39m
[31m+   const value = item?.[key][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (typeof value !== 'number' && typeof value !== 'string') return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return asNumber(value)[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getProfileDetailBoolean([39m
[31m+   item: StageProfileDetailItem | null | undefined,[39m
[31m+   key: string[39m
[31m+ ): boolean {[39m
[31m+   const value = item?.[key][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (typeof value === 'boolean') return value[39m
[31m+   if (typeof value === 'number') return value === 1[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (typeof value === 'string') {[39m
[31m+     const normalized = value.trim().toLowerCase()[39m
[31m+     return normalized === 'true' || normalized === '1' || normalized === 'yes'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return false[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ const isSameKm = (a: unknown, b: unknown) =>[39m
[31m+   Math.abs(Number(a) - Number(b)) < 0.11[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getFinishClimb([39m
[31m+   mountainClimbs: StageProfileDetailItem[],[39m
[31m+   finishKm: number | null[39m
[31m+ ): StageProfileDetailItem | null {[39m
[31m+   const markedFinishClimb = mountainClimbs.find((climb) =>[39m
[31m+     getProfileDetailBoolean(climb, 'is_finish_climb')[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (markedFinishClimb) return markedFinishClimb[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (finishKm === null) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     mountainClimbs.find((climb) => {[39m
[31m+       const climbKm = getProfileDetailNumber(climb, 'km')[39m
[31m+       return climbKm !== null && Math.abs(climbKm - finishKm) <= 0.2[39m
[31m+     }) ?? null[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function StageFinishPointCard({[39m
[31m+   isMountainFinish,[39m
[31m+   finishKm,[39m
[31m+   finishPoint,[39m
[31m+   finishClimb,[39m
[31m+   suppressTimeBonuses = false,[39m
[31m+   allowDefaultFinishPoints = true,[39m
[31m+   defaultFinishPointsScheme = DEFAULT_FINISH_POINTS_SCHEME,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   isMountainFinish: boolean[39m
[31m+   finishKm: number | string | null | undefined[39m
[31m+   finishPoint?: RaceStagePoint | null[39m
[31m+   finishClimb?: StageProfileDetailItem | null[39m
[31m+   suppressTimeBonuses?: boolean[39m
[31m+   allowDefaultFinishPoints?: boolean[39m
[31m+   defaultFinishPointsScheme?: JsonValue[][39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const configuredFinishBonuses = finishPoint?.time_bonus_seconds[39m
[31m+   const finishPointBonuses = suppressTimeBonuses[39m
[31m+     ? [][39m
[31m+     : hasConfiguredPointValues(configuredFinishBonuses)[39m
[31m+       ? configuredFinishBonuses[39m
[31m+       : DEFAULT_FINISH_TIME_BONUSES[39m
[31m+   const configuredFinishPoints = finishPoint?.points_scheme[39m
[31m+   const finishPoints = allowDefaultFinishPoints[39m
[31m+     ? hasConfiguredPointValues(configuredFinishPoints)[39m
[31m+       ? configuredFinishPoints[39m
[31m+       : defaultFinishPointsScheme[39m
[31m+     : configuredFinishPoints ?? [][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (isMountainFinish) {[39m
[31m+     const climbName = formatProfileDetailValue(finishClimb?.['name'])[39m
[31m+     const category = formatProfileDetailValue(finishClimb?.['category'])[39m
[31m+     const lengthKm = formatProfileDetailValue(finishClimb?.['length_km'])[39m
[31m+     const avgGradient = formatProfileDetailValue(finishClimb?.['avg_gradient'])[39m
[31m+     const titleDetails = [climbName, category][39m
[31m+       .filter((value) => value && value !== '—')[39m
[31m+       .join(' · ')[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className="flex w-full items-start justify-between gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50/60 px-4 py-3 text-sm">[39m
[31m+         <div className="min-w-0">[39m
[31m+           <div className="font-semibold text-slate-950">[39m
[31m+             {titleDetails ? `🏁 Mountain finish · ${titleDetails}` : '🏁 Mountain finish'}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-1 text-slate-600">[39m
[31m+             km {formatProfileDetailValue(finishKm)}[39m
[31m+             {lengthKm !== '—' ? ` · ${lengthKm} km` : ''}[39m
[31m+             {avgGradient !== '—' ? ` at ${avgGradient}%` : ''}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <div className="min-w-[260px] text-right text-slate-600">[39m
[31m+           <div>[39m
[31m+             <span className="font-medium text-slate-500">Mountain classification: </span>[39m
[31m+             {formatPointsSchemeLabel(finishClimb?.['points_scheme'])}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           {hasConfiguredPointValues(finishPointBonuses) ? ([39m
[31m+             <div className="mt-1">[39m
[31m+               <span className="font-medium text-slate-500">GC time bonuses: </span>[39m
[31m+               {formatPointsSchemeLabel(finishPointBonuses)}[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+           ) : null}[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="flex w-full items-start justify-between gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-green-200 bg-green-50/60 px-4 py-3 text-sm">[39m
[31m+       <div className="min-w-0">[39m
[31m+         <div className="font-semibold text-slate-950">🏁 Finish sprint</div>[39m
[31m+         <div className="mt-1 text-slate-600">km {formatProfileDetailValue(finishKm)}</div>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <div className="min-w-[260px] text-right text-slate-600">[39m
[31m+         {hasConfiguredPointValues(finishPoints) ? ([39m
[31m+           <div>[39m
[31m+             <span className="font-medium text-slate-500">Points classification finish: </span>[39m
[31m+             {formatPointsSchemeLabel(finishPoints)}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         ) : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         {hasConfiguredPointValues(finishPointBonuses) ? ([39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-1">[39m
[31m+             <span className="font-medium text-slate-500">GC time bonuses: </span>[39m
[31m+             {formatPointsSchemeLabel(finishPointBonuses)}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         ) : null}[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
