[31m+[39m
[31m+ const STAGE_PROFILE_CHART_MARKER_TYPES = new Set([[39m
[31m+   'start',[39m
[31m+   'finish',[39m
[31m+   'sprint',[39m
[31m+   'kom',[39m
[31m+   'climb',[39m
[31m+   'mountain_climb',[39m
[31m+ ])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type StageProfileChartMarker = StageRouteMarker & {[39m
[31m+   chartType: string[39m
[31m+   chartLabel: string[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getNormalizedChartMarkerType(marker: StageRouteMarker): string {[39m
[31m+   return marker.type?.toLowerCase() ?? ''[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getClimbCategoryLabel([39m
[31m+   marker: StageRouteMarker,[39m
[31m+   mountainClimbs: StageProfileDetailItem[][39m
[31m+ ): string {[39m
[31m+   const matchingClimb = mountainClimbs.find((climb) => {[39m
[31m+     const climbKm = getProfileDetailNumber(climb, 'km')[39m
[31m+     return climbKm !== null && isSameKm(climbKm, marker.km)[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+   const climbCategory = formatProfileDetailValue(matchingClimb?.['category'])[39m
[31m+   const category =[39m
[31m+     climbCategory && climbCategory !== '—'[39m
[31m+       ? climbCategory[39m
[31m+       : marker.category?.trim()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (category) {[39m
[31m+     const normalizedCategory = category.toUpperCase()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (normalizedCategory === 'HC') return 'HC'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const categoryMatch = category.match(/^cat(?:egory)?\s*(HC|\d+)$/i)[39m
[31m+     if (categoryMatch) {[39m
[31m+       const rawCategory = categoryMatch[1].toUpperCase()[39m
[31m+       return rawCategory === 'HC' ? 'HC' : `Cat ${rawCategory}`[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (/^\d+$/.test(category)) return `Cat ${category}`[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return category[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const label = marker.label?.trim() ?? ''[39m
[31m+   const catMatch = label.match(/(?:cat(?:egory)?\s*)?(HC|[1-4])\b/i)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!catMatch) return 'KOM'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const rawCategory = catMatch[1].toUpperCase()[39m
[31m+   return rawCategory === 'HC' ? 'HC' : `Cat ${rawCategory}`[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildStageProfileChartMarkers([39m
[31m+   markers: StageRouteMarker[],[39m
[31m+   mountainClimbs: StageProfileDetailItem[] = [][39m
[31m+ ): StageProfileChartMarker[] {[39m
[31m+   let sprintCount = 0[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return markers[39m
[31m+     .filter((marker) => {[39m
[31m+       const type = marker.type?.toLowerCase()[39m
[31m+       return STAGE_PROFILE_CHART_MARKER_TYPES.has(type ?? '')[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+     .map((marker) => {[39m
[31m+       const chartType = getNormalizedChartMarkerType(marker)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (chartType === 'start') {[39m
[31m+         return { ...marker, chartType, chartLabel: 'Start' }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (chartType === 'finish') {[39m
[31m+         return { ...marker, chartType, chartLabel: 'Finish' }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (chartType === 'sprint') {[39m
[31m+         sprintCount += 1[39m
[31m+         return { ...marker, chartType, chartLabel: `Sprint ${sprintCount}` }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return { ...marker, chartType, chartLabel: getClimbCategoryLabel(marker, mountainClimbs) }[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type StageProfileReplayEntityMarker = {[39m
[31m+   id: string[39m
[31m+   label: string[39m
[31m+   progressPercent: number[39m
[31m+   startOrder: number[39m
[31m+   highlighted?: boolean[39m
[31m+   topLabel?: string | null[39m
[31m+   topLabelColor?: string[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type StageProfileAuxiliaryMarker = {[39m
[31m+   id: string[39m
[31m+   km: number[39m
[31m+   label: string[39m
[31m+   color?: string[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function StageProfileChart({[39m
[31m+   points,[39m
[31m+   markers,[39m
[31m+   distanceKm,[39m
[31m+   terrainType,[39m
[31m+   mountainClimbs = [],[39m
[31m+   replayProgressPercent = null,[39m
[31m+   replayEntityMarkers = [],[39m
[31m+   replayEntityMarkerStyle = 'badge',[39m
[31m+   auxiliaryMarkers = [],[39m
[31m+   compact = false,[39m
[31m+   roadReplayCompactUi = false,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   points: BackendStageProfilePoint[][39m
[31m+   markers: StageRouteMarker[][39m
[31m+   distanceKm: number[39m
[31m+   terrainType?: string | null[39m
[31m+   mountainClimbs?: StageProfileDetailItem[][39m
[31m+   replayProgressPercent?: number | null[39m
[31m+   replayEntityMarkers?: StageProfileReplayEntityMarker[][39m
[31m+   replayEntityMarkerStyle?: 'badge' | 'line'[39m
[31m+   auxiliaryMarkers?: StageProfileAuxiliaryMarker[][39m
[31m+   compact?: boolean[39m
[31m+   roadReplayCompactUi?: boolean[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const chartInstanceId = useId().replace(/:/g, '')[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!points.length || !distanceKm) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className="rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 px-4 py-8 text-sm text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+         Stage profile chart is not available yet.[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const normalizedPoints: StageProfilePoint[] = points.map((point) => ({[39m
[31m+     km: Number(point.km),[39m
[31m+     elevation_m: Number(point.elevation),[39m
[31m+   }))[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const width = compact ? 1000 : 920[39m
[31m+   const height = compact ? 242 : 320[39m
[31m+   const padding = compact[39m
[31m+     ? { top: 34, right: 18, bottom: 42, left: 64 }[39m
[31m+     : { top: 38, right: 18, bottom: 52, left: 70 }[39m
[31m+   const safeDistanceKm = Math.max(1, Number(distanceKm))[39m
[31m+   const innerHeight = height - padding.top - padding.bottom[39m
[31m+   const innerWidth = width - padding.left - padding.right[39m
[31m+   const pathPayload = buildStageProfilePath([39m
[31m+     normalizedPoints,[39m
[31m+     width,[39m
[31m+     height,[39m
[31m+     padding,[39m
[31m+     terrainType[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!pathPayload) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className="rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 px-4 py-8 text-sm text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+         Stage profile chart is not available yet.[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const parsed = JSON.parse(pathPayload) as {[39m
[31m+     linePath: string[39m
[31m+     areaPath: string[39m
[31m+     coordinates: Array<{ x: number; y: number; km: number; elevation_m: number }>[39m
[31m+     minElevation: number[39m
[31m+     maxElevation: number[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const rawTickValues = getElevationTickValues(parsed.minElevation, parsed.maxElevation)[39m
[31m+   const targetLineCount = 5[39m
[31m+   const stepIndex = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(rawTickValues.length / targetLineCount))[39m
[31m+   const tickValues = rawTickValues.filter((_, index) => index % stepIndex === 0)[39m
[31m+   const minKm = 0[39m
[31m+   const maxKm = safeDistanceKm[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const xForKm = (km: number) => {[39m
[31m+     const clampedKm = Math.max(minKm, Math.min(maxKm, Number(km)))[39m
[31m+     return padding.left + ((clampedKm - minKm) / Math.max(maxKm - minKm, 1)) * innerWidth[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const yForElevation = (elevation: number) =>[39m
[31m+     padding.top +[39m
[31m+     innerHeight -[39m
[31m+     ((Number(elevation) - parsed.minElevation) / Math.max(parsed.maxElevation - parsed.minElevation, 1)) *[39m
[31m+       innerHeight[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const filteredChartMarkers = buildStageProfileChartMarkers(markers, mountainClimbs)[39m
[31m+   const chartMarkers = filteredChartMarkers.length[39m
[31m+     ? filteredChartMarkers[39m
[31m+     : buildStageProfileChartMarkers([[39m
[31m+         { type: 'start', km: 0, label: 'Start' },[39m
[31m+         { type: 'finish', km: safeDistanceKm, label: 'Finish' },[39m
[31m+       ])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const replayProgressFraction =[39m
[31m+     replayProgressPercent === null[39m
[31m+       ? null[39m
[31m+       : Math.max(0, Math.min(1, replayProgressPercent / 100))[39m
[31m+   const replayProgressKm =[39m
[31m+     replayProgressFraction === null[39m
[31m+       ? null[39m
[31m+       : safeDistanceKm * replayProgressFraction[39m
[31m+   const progressTrailGradientId = `stage-progress-trail-gradient-${chartInstanceId}`[39m
[31m+   const progressAreaGradientId = `stage-progress-area-gradient-${chartInstanceId}`[39m
[31m+   const profileAboveMaskId = `stage-profile-above-mask-${chartInstanceId}`[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const getProfileElevationAtKm = (km: number): number => {[39m
[31m+     const coordinates = [...parsed.coordinates].sort([39m
[31m+       (left, right) => left.km - right.km[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (coordinates.length === 0) return parsed.minElevation[39m
[31m+     if (km <= coordinates[0].km) return coordinates[0].elevation_m[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     for (let index = 1; index < coordinates.length; index += 1) {[39m
[31m+       const previous = coordinates[index - 1][39m
[31m+       const next = coordinates[index][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (km > next.km) continue[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const distance = Math.max(0.001, next.km - previous.km)[39m
[31m+       const fraction = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (km - previous.km) / distance))[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return ([39m
[31m+         previous.elevation_m +[39m
[31m+         (next.elevation_m - previous.elevation_m) * fraction[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return coordinates[coordinates.length - 1].elevation_m[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const replayProgressX =[39m
[31m+     replayProgressKm === null ? null : xForKm(replayProgressKm)[39m
[31m+   const replayProgressY =[39m
[31m+     replayProgressKm === null[39m
[31m+       ? null[39m
[31m+       : yForElevation(getProfileElevationAtKm(replayProgressKm))[39m
[31m+   const activeReplayEntityMarkers = replayEntityMarkers[39m
[31m+     .map((marker) => {[39m
[31m+       const progressFraction = Math.max([39m
[31m+         0,[39m
[31m+         Math.min(1, Number(marker.progressPercent) / 100)[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+       const km = safeDistanceKm * progressFraction[39m
[31m+       return {[39m
[31m+         ...marker,[39m
[31m+         km,[39m
[31m+         x: xForKm(km),[39m
[31m+         y: yForElevation(getProfileElevationAtKm(km)),[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+     .filter((marker) => marker.progressPercent > 0 && marker.progressPercent < 100)[39m
[31m+   const activeAuxiliaryMarkers = auxiliaryMarkers[39m
[31m+     .map((marker) => ({[39m
[31m+       ...marker,[39m
[31m+       x: xForKm(Number(marker.km)),[39m
[31m+       color: marker.color ?? '#16a34a',[39m
[31m+     }))[39m
[31m+     .filter((marker) => marker.km > 0 && marker.km < safeDistanceKm)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const progressTrailPath = (() => {[39m
[31m+     if (replayProgressKm === null || replayProgressKm <= 0) return ''[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const sourceCoordinates = [...parsed.coordinates].sort([39m
[31m+       (left, right) => left.km - right.km[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     const trailCoordinates = sourceCoordinates.filter([39m
[31m+       (point) => point.km < replayProgressKm - 0.000001[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     trailCoordinates.push({[39m
[31m+       x: xForKm(replayProgressKm),[39m
[31m+       y: yForElevation(getProfileElevationAtKm(replayProgressKm)),[39m
[31m+       km: replayProgressKm,[39m
[31m+       elevation_m: getProfileElevationAtKm(replayProgressKm),[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (trailCoordinates.length === 0) return ''[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return trailCoordinates.reduce((path, point, index) => {[39m
[31m+       if (index === 0) return `M ${point.x} ${point.y}`[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const previous = trailCoordinates[index - 1][39m
[31m+       const controlX = (previous.x + point.x) / 2[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return `${path} C ${controlX} ${previous.y}, ${controlX} ${point.y}, ${point.x} ${point.y}`[39m
[31m+     }, '')[39m
[31m+   })()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const progressCompletedAreaPath = (() => {[39m
[31m+     if ([39m
[31m+       replayProgressKm === null ||[39m
[31m+       replayProgressKm <= 0 ||[39m
[31m+       replayProgressX === null ||[39m
[31m+       replayProgressY === null[39m
[31m+     ) {[39m
[31m+       return ''[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const sourceCoordinates = [...parsed.coordinates].sort([39m
[31m+       (left, right) => left.km - right.km[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     const completedTerrainCoordinates = sourceCoordinates.filter([39m
[31m+       (point) => point.km < replayProgressKm - 0.000001[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     completedTerrainCoordinates.push({[39m
[31m+       x: replayProgressX,[39m
[31m+       y: replayProgressY,[39m
[31m+       km: replayProgressKm,[39m
[31m+       elevation_m: getProfileElevationAtKm(replayProgressKm),[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (completedTerrainCoordinates.length === 0) return ''[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const terrainReturnPath = [...completedTerrainCoordinates][39m
[31m+       .reverse()[39m
[31m+       .map((point) => `L ${point.x} ${point.y}`)[39m
[31m+       .join(' ')[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return [[39m
[31m+       `M ${padding.left} ${padding.top}`,[39m
[31m+       `L ${replayProgressX} ${padding.top}`,[39m
[31m+       `L ${replayProgressX} ${replayProgressY}`,[39m
[31m+       terrainReturnPath,[39m
[31m+       `L ${padding.left} ${padding.top}`,[39m
[31m+       'Z',[39m
[31m+     ].join(' ')[39m
[31m+   })()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white">[39m
[31m+       <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${height}`} className="h-auto w-full">[39m
[31m+         <defs>[39m
[31m+           <mask id={profileAboveMaskId} maskUnits="userSpaceOnUse">[39m
[31m+             <rect x="0" y="0" width={width} height={height} fill="white" />[39m
[31m+             <path d={parsed.areaPath} fill="black" />[39m
[31m+           </mask>[39m
[31m+         </defs>[39m
[31m+         {replayProgressX !== null ? ([39m
[31m+           <defs>[39m
[31m+             <linearGradient[39m
[31m+               id={progressTrailGradientId}[39m
[31m+               gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse"[39m
[31m+               x1={padding.left}[39m
[31m+               y1="0"[39m
[31m+               x2={Math.max(padding.left + 1, replayProgressX)}[39m
[31m+               y2="0"[39m
[31m+             >[39m
[31m+               <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#2563eb" stopOpacity="0.14" />[39m
[31m+               <stop offset="40%" stopColor="#2563eb" stopOpacity="0.34" />[39m
[31m+               <stop offset="78%" stopColor="#2563eb" stopOpacity="0.72" />[39m
[31m+               <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#2563eb" stopOpacity="1" />[39m
[31m+             </linearGradient>[39m
[31m+             <linearGradient[39m
[31m+               id={progressAreaGradientId}[39m
[31m+               gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse"[39m

[31m+               <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#2563eb" stopOpacity="0.035" />[39m

[31m+             </linearGradient>[39m
[31m+           </defs>[39m
[31m+         ) : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         {tickValues.map((tick) => {[39m
[31m+           const y = yForElevation(tick)[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+         {progressCompletedAreaPath ? ([39m
[31m+           <path[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+         {replayEntityMarkerStyle === 'line' ? ([39m
[31m+           <path[39m
[31m+             d={parsed.linePath}[39m
[31m+             fill="none"[39m
[31m+             stroke="#334155"[39m
[31m+             strokeWidth="3"[39m
[31m+             pointerEvents="none"[39m
[31m+           />[39m
[31m+         ) : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         {activeAuxiliaryMarkers.map((marker) => ([39m
[31m+           <g key={`aux-marker-${marker.id}`} aria-label={`${marker.label} at ${marker.km.toFixed(1)} kilometres`}>[39m
[31m+             <line[39m
[31m+               x1={marker.x}[39m
[31m+               y1={padding.top}[39m
[31m+               x2={marker.x}[39m

[31m+             />[39m

[31m+               x={marker.x - 34}[39m
[31m+               y={padding.top - 24}[39m
[31m+               width="68"[39m
[31m+               height="20"[39m
[31m+               rx="10"[39m
[31m+               fill={marker.color}[39m
[31m+             />[39m
[31m+             <text[39m
[31m+               x={marker.x}[39m
[31m+               y={padding.top - 10}[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+         {chartMarkers.map((marker, index) => {[39m
[31m+           const x = xForKm(Number(marker.km))[39m
[31m+           const markerType = marker.chartType[39m
[31m+           const isFinish = markerType === 'finish'[39m
[31m+           const isSprint = markerType === 'sprint'[39m
[31m+           const isKom =[39m
[31m+             markerType === 'kom' ||[39m
[31m+             markerType === 'climb' ||[39m
[31m+             markerType === 'mountain_climb'[39m
[31m+           const fill = isFinish ? '#2563eb' : isSprint ? '#22c55e' : isKom ? '#ef4444' : '#64748b'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           return ([39m
[31m+             <g key={`${marker.type}-${marker.km}-${index}`}>[39m

[31m+                 x2={x}[39m

[31m+ function userTeamParticipatedInRace([39m
[31m+   participantTeams: RaceParticipantTeam[],[39m
[31m+   viewerTeamIds?: ViewerTeamIdSource[39m
[31m+ ): boolean {[39m
[31m+   const viewerIds = normalizeViewerTeamIds(viewerTeamIds)[39m
[31m+   if (viewerIds.size === 0) return false[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return participantTeams.some((team) => isViewerTeamRow(team, viewerIds))[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type StageReplayAvailability = {[39m
[31m+   status: 'loading' | 'not_available' | 'not_open' | 'available' | 'error'[39m
[31m+   calculated: boolean[39m
[31m+   reason: string | null[39m
[31m+   replayOpensGameAt: string | null[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type RaceReplayCoinAccess = {[39m
[31m+   race_id: string[39m
[31m+   coin_cost: number[39m
[31m+   coin_balance: number[39m
[31m+   has_coin_unlock: boolean[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeRaceReplayCoinAccess(data: unknown): RaceReplayCoinAccess | null {[39m
[31m+   const value = Array.isArray(data) ? data[0] : data[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) {[39m
[31m+     return null[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const row = value as Record<string, unknown>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     race_id: String(row.race_id ?? ''),[39m
[31m+     coin_cost: Number(row.coin_cost ?? 2),[39m
[31m+     coin_balance: Number(row.coin_balance ?? 0),[39m
[31m+     has_coin_unlock:[39m
[31m+       row.has_coin_unlock === true ||[39m
[31m+       row.has_coin_unlock === 'true' ||[39m
[31m+       row.has_coin_unlock === 1,[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeStageReplayAvailability([39m
[31m+   data: unknown,[39m
[31m+   errorMessage?: string | null[39m
[31m+ ): StageReplayAvailability {[39m
[31m+   if (errorMessage) {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       status: 'error',[39m
[31m+       calculated: false,[39m
[31m+       reason: errorMessage,[39m
[31m+       replayOpensGameAt: null,[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const value = Array.isArray(data) ? data[0] : data[39m
[31m+   if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       status: 'error',[39m
[31m+       calculated: false,[39m
[31m+       reason: 'Replay lifecycle returned no readable payload.',[39m
[31m+       replayOpensGameAt: null,[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const row = value as Record<string, unknown>[39m
[31m+   const rawStatus = String(row.status ?? 'not_available')[39m
[31m+   const status: StageReplayAvailability['status'] =[39m
[31m+     rawStatus === 'available' || rawStatus === 'not_open' || rawStatus === 'not_available'[39m
[31m+       ? rawStatus[39m
[31m+       : 'error'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     status,[39m
[31m+     calculated: row.calculated === true || row.calculated === 'true',[39m
[31m+     reason: typeof row.reason === 'string' ? row.reason : null,[39m
[31m+     replayOpensGameAt:[39m
[31m+       typeof row.replay_opens_game_at === 'string'[39m
[31m+         ? row.replay_opens_game_at[39m
[31m+         : null,[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function StageReplayAccessCard({[39m
[31m+   race,[39m
[31m+   stage,[39m
[31m+   currentClubId,[39m
[31m+   viewerClubFamilyIds,[39m
[31m+   participantTeams,[39m
[31m+   currentGameDate,[39m
[31m+   canViewRaceReplay,[39m
[31m+   replayAccessLoading = false,[39m
[31m+   onOpenReplay,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   race: Race | null[39m
[31m+   stage: RaceStage | null[39m
[31m+   currentClubId?: string | null[39m
[31m+   viewerClubFamilyIds?: string[][39m
[31m+   participantTeams: RaceParticipantTeam[][39m
[31m+   currentGameDate?: string | null[39m
[31m+   canViewRaceReplay?: boolean | null[39m
[31m+   replayAccessLoading?: boolean[39m
[31m+   onOpenReplay: (stage: RaceStage) => void[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   // Kept in the public component contract because the page already passes it;[39m
[31m+   // replay timing itself is authoritative backend state, never a browser date guess.[39m
[31m+   void currentGameDate[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const [replayAvailability, setReplayAvailability] =[39m
[31m+     useState<StageReplayAvailability>({[39m
[31m+       status: 'loading',[39m
[31m+       calculated: false,[39m
[31m+       reason: null,[39m
[31m+       replayOpensGameAt: null,[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+   const [coinAccess, setCoinAccess] = useState<RaceReplayCoinAccess | null>(null)[39m
[31m+   const [coinAccessLoading, setCoinAccessLoading] = useState(false)[39m
[31m+   const [coinPurchaseLoading, setCoinPurchaseLoading] = useState(false)[39m
[31m+   const [coinPurchaseError, setCoinPurchaseError] = useState<string | null>(null)[39m
[31m+   const [coinPurchaseMessage, setCoinPurchaseMessage] = useState<string | null>(null)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const viewerTeamIds = getViewerTeamIds(currentClubId, viewerClubFamilyIds)[39m
[31m+   const localParticipationAccess = userTeamParticipatedInRace([39m
[31m+     participantTeams,[39m
[31m+     viewerTeamIds[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const userParticipated = canViewRaceReplay === true || localParticipationAccess[39m
[31m+   const hasCoinReplayUnlock = coinAccess?.has_coin_unlock === true[39m
[31m+   const hasReplayAccess = userParticipated || hasCoinReplayUnlock[39m
[31m+   const replayAvailable = replayAvailability.status === 'available'[39m
[31m+   const stageWeatherCanceled = isStageWeatherCanceled(stage)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (!stage?.id || stageWeatherCanceled) {[39m
[31m+       setReplayAvailability({[39m
[31m+         status: 'not_available',[39m
[31m+         calculated: false,[39m
[31m+         reason: stageWeatherCanceled ? 'weather_cancelled' : 'stage_missing',[39m
[31m+         replayOpensGameAt: null,[39m
[31m+       })[39m
[31m+       return[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     let cancelled = false[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     async function loadReplayAvailability(): Promise<void> {[39m
[31m+       setReplayAvailability((current) => ({ ...current, status: 'loading' }))[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc([39m
[31m+         'get_universal_race_stage_replay_payload_v1',[39m
[31m+         { p_stage_id: stage.id }[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (cancelled) return[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       setReplayAvailability([39m
[31m+         normalizeStageReplayAvailability(data, error?.message ?? null)[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     void loadReplayAvailability()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return () => {[39m
[31m+       cancelled = true[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }, [stage?.id, stageWeatherCanceled])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (!race?.id || userParticipated) {[39m
[31m+       setCoinAccess(null)[39m
[31m+       setCoinAccessLoading(false)[39m
[31m+       setCoinPurchaseError(null)[39m
[31m+       setCoinPurchaseMessage(null)[39m
[31m+       return[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     let cancelled = false[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     async function loadCoinAccess(): Promise<void> {[39m
[31m+       setCoinAccessLoading(true)[39m
[31m+       setCoinPurchaseError(null)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc([39m
[31m+         'get_race_replay_coin_access_v1',[39m
[31m+         {[39m
[31m+           p_race_id: race.id,[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (cancelled) return[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (error) {[39m
[31m+         console.warn('Could not load coin replay access:', error.message)[39m
[31m+         setCoinAccess(null)[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         setCoinAccess(normalizeRaceReplayCoinAccess(data))[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       setCoinAccessLoading(false)[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     void loadCoinAccess()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return () => {[39m
[31m+       cancelled = true[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }, [race?.id, userParticipated])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   async function purchaseReplayAccess(): Promise<void> {[39m
[31m+     if (!race?.id || !replayAvailable || coinPurchaseLoading) return[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     setCoinPurchaseLoading(true)[39m
[31m+     setCoinPurchaseError(null)[39m
[31m+     setCoinPurchaseMessage(null)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc([39m
[31m+         'purchase_race_replay_access_v1',[39m
[31m+         {[39m
[31m+           p_race_id: race.id,[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (error) throw error[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const nextAccess = normalizeRaceReplayCoinAccess(data)[39m
[31m+       setCoinAccess(nextAccess)[39m
[31m+       setCoinPurchaseMessage([39m
[31m+         `Replay unlocked for ${nextAccess?.coin_cost ?? 2} coins.`[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('coin-balance-changed'))[39m
[31m+     } catch (caught) {[39m
[31m+       setCoinPurchaseError([39m
[31m+         caught instanceof Error[39m
[31m+           ? caught.message[39m
[31m+           : 'Failed to unlock this race replay.'[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setCoinPurchaseLoading(false)[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const canWatch = Boolean([39m
[31m+     stage && !stageWeatherCanceled && replayAvailable && hasReplayAccess[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const checkingReplayAccess =[39m
[31m+     replayAvailability.status === 'loading' ||[39m
[31m+     replayAccessLoading ||[39m
[31m+     coinAccessLoading[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const replayStatusText = stageWeatherCanceled[39m
[31m+     ? 'This stage was canceled. No replay is available.'[39m
[31m+     : replayAvailability.status === 'not_open'[39m
[31m+       ? 'Replay will be available at the scheduled stage time.'[39m
[31m+       : replayAvailability.status === 'not_available'[39m
[31m+         ? 'Replay is not available yet.'[39m
[31m+         : replayAvailability.status === 'error'[39m
[31m+           ? 'Replay is temporarily unavailable.'[39m
[31m+           : userParticipated[39m
[31m+             ? `Replay is available for ${race?.name ?? 'this race'}.`[39m
[31m+             : hasCoinReplayUnlock[39m
[31m+               ? `Replay is available for ${race?.name ?? 'this race'}.`[39m
[31m+               : `Replay is available. Teams that did not participate can unlock it for ${coinAccess?.coin_cost ?? 2} coins.`[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm">[39m
[31m+       <div className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+         Live race[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <h3 className="mt-2 text-lg font-semibold text-slate-950">[39m
[31m+         {stageWeatherCanceled[39m
[31m+           ? 'Stage canceled'[39m
[31m+           : replayAvailable[39m
[31m+             ? 'Replay available'[39m
[31m+             : 'Replay unavailable'}[39m
[31m+       </h3>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-5 text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+         {replayStatusText}[39m
[31m+       </p>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {replayAvailability.replayOpensGameAt &&[39m
[31m+       replayAvailability.status !== 'available' ? ([39m
[31m+         <div className="mt-3 text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+           Replay available at the scheduled stage time: {replayAvailability.replayOpensGameAt}[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       ) : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {stageWeatherCanceled ? ([39m
[31m+         <div className="mt-4">[39m
[31m+           <WeatherCancellationNotice stage={stage} race={race} compact />[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       ) : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {!stageWeatherCanceled &&[39m
[31m+       replayAvailable &&[39m
[31m+       !userParticipated &&[39m
[31m+       !hasCoinReplayUnlock ? ([39m
[31m+         <div className="mt-5 space-y-3">[39m
[31m+           <button[39m
[31m+             type="button"[39m
[31m+             onClick={() => void purchaseReplayAccess()}[39m
[31m+             disabled={[39m
[31m+               coinPurchaseLoading ||[39m
[31m+               coinAccessLoading ||[39m
[31m+               Number(coinAccess?.coin_balance ?? 0) <[39m
[31m+                 Number(coinAccess?.coin_cost ?? 2)[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+             className="w-full rounded-2xl border border-yellow-300 bg-yellow-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-yellow-950 transition hover:bg-yellow-100 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"[39m
[31m+           >[39m
[31m+             {coinPurchaseLoading[39m
[31m+               ? 'Unlocking replay…'[39m
[31m+               : `Unlock replay · ${coinAccess?.coin_cost ?? 2} coins`}[39m
[31m+           </button>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           <div className="text-center text-xs text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+             Coin balance: {Number(coinAccess?.coin_balance ?? 0).toLocaleString('en-US')}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           {coinPurchaseError ? ([39m
[31m+             <div className="rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-red-700">[39m
[31m+               {coinPurchaseError}[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+           ) : null}[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       ) : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {coinPurchaseMessage ? ([39m
[31m+         <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-emerald-700">[39m
[31m+           {coinPurchaseMessage}[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       ) : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <button[39m
[31m+         type="button"[39m
[31m+         disabled={!canWatch || checkingReplayAccess}[39m
[31m+         onClick={() => {[39m
[31m+           if (stage && canWatch) onOpenReplay(stage)[39m
[31m+         }}[39m
[31m+         className={`mt-5 w-full rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold transition ${[39m
[31m+           canWatch[39m
[31m+             ? 'bg-slate-950 text-white hover:bg-slate-800'[39m
[31m+             : 'cursor-not-allowed bg-slate-100 text-slate-400'[39m
[31m+         }`}[39m
[31m+       >[39m
[31m+         {stageWeatherCanceled[39m
[31m+           ? 'Replay unavailable'[39m
[31m+           : checkingReplayAccess[39m
[31m+             ? 'Checking replay…'[39m
[31m+             : replayAvailability.status === 'not_open' ||[39m
[31m+                 replayAvailability.status === 'not_available' ||[39m
[31m+                 replayAvailability.status === 'error'[39m
[31m+               ? 'Replay unavailable'[39m
[31m+               : canWatch[39m
[31m+                 ? 'Watch replay'[39m
[31m+                 : !hasReplayAccess[39m
[31m+                   ? `Unlock for ${coinAccess?.coin_cost ?? 2} coins`[39m
[31m+                   : 'Replay unavailable'}[39m
[31m+       </button>[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type SimpleReplayStandingSource = {[39m
[31m+   riderId: string[39m
[31m+   riderName: string[39m
[31m+   teamName: string[39m
[31m+   countryCode: string | null[39m
[31m+   finalRank: number[39m
[31m+   finalGapSeconds: number[39m
[31m+   finalElapsedSeconds: number | null[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type SimpleReplayStandingRow = SimpleReplayStandingSource & {[39m
[31m+   liveRank: number[39m
[31m+   groupLabel: string[39m
[31m+   liveGapSeconds: number[39m
[31m+   freshness: number[39m
[31m+   energy: number[39m
[31m+   movementEnergyCost: number[39m
[31m+   attackEnergyCost: number[39m
[31m+   chaseEnergyCost: number[39m
[31m+   shelterEnergySaving: number[39m
[31m+   energyCostSincePreviousCheckpoint: number[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type SimpleReplayComment = {[39m
[31m+   progress: number[39m
[31m+   title: string[39m
[31m+   description: string[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type IntegratedRoadStageReplayStep = {[39m
[31m+   fromCheckpointIndex: number[39m
[31m+   toCheckpointIndex: number[39m
[31m+   movement: ReturnType<typeof calculateTerrainMovement>[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type IntegratedRoadStageReplay = {[39m
[31m+   checkpoints: Checkpoint[][39m
[31m+   steps: IntegratedRoadStageReplayStep[][39m
[31m+   comments: SimpleReplayComment[][39m
[31m+   phaseBoundaryCrossingCount: number[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ const INTEGRATION_BASE_GROUP_SPEED_KMH = 40[39m
[31m+ const INTEGRATION_CHECKPOINT_SECONDS = 600[39m
[31m+ const INTEGRATION_GROUP_ID = 'peloton-1'[39m
[31m+ const INTEGRATION_COOPERATION_LEVEL = 0.9[39m
[31m+ const INTEGRATION_ROUNDING_FACTOR = 1_000_000[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function roundIntegrationValue(value: number): number {[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     Math.round(value * INTEGRATION_ROUNDING_FACTOR) /[39m
[31m+     INTEGRATION_ROUNDING_FACTOR[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeRioIntegrationStageType(value: string): RoadStageType {[39m
[31m+   const normalized = value.trim().toLowerCase()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (normalized === 'mountain') return 'mountain'[39m
[31m+   if (normalized === 'hilly') return 'hilly'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return 'flat'[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function inferRioIntegrationFinishType([39m
[31m+   stage: RaceStage,[39m
[31m+   stageType: RoadStageType[39m
[31m+ ): RoadStageFinishType {[39m
[31m+   const finishHint = `${stage.finish_type ?? ''} ${stage.profile_type ?? ''}`[39m
[31m+     .trim()[39m
[31m+     .toLowerCase()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return stageType === 'flat' &&[39m
[31m+     (stage.stage_number === 1 || /sprint|sprinter/.test(finishHint))[39m
[31m+     ? 'sprint'[39m
[31m+     : 'standard'[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getRioIntegrationReferenceKey([39m
[31m+   stageNumber: number[39m
[31m+ ): CanonicalRoadStageProfileKey {[39m
[31m+   if (stageNumber === 3) return 'rio-stage-3-mountain'[39m
[31m+   if (stageNumber === 6) return 'rio-stage-6-hilly'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return 'rio-stage-1-flat'[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function createRioIntegrationStageReference([39m
[31m+   race: Race,[39m
[31m+   stage: RaceStage[39m
[31m+ ): CanonicalRoadStageReference {[39m
[31m+   const stageType = normalizeRioIntegrationStageType(stage.terrain_type)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     key: getRioIntegrationReferenceKey(stage.stage_number),[39m
[31m+     raceId: race.id,[39m
[31m+     stageId: stage.id,[39m
[31m+     stageNumber: stage.stage_number,[39m
[31m+     stageType,[39m
[31m+     finishType: inferRioIntegrationFinishType(stage, stageType),[39m
[31m+     buttonLabel: `Rio Stage ${stage.stage_number} · ${formatTerrainModelLabel(stageType)}`,[39m
[31m+     fallbackStageTitle:[39m
[31m+       stage.name?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       `Rio Tour Stage ${stage.stage_number}: ${formatStageRoute(stage)}`,[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function createIntegratedRoadStageReplay([39m
[31m+   profile: RoadStageProfile[39m
[31m+ ): IntegratedRoadStageReplay {[39m
[31m+   const firstPhase = profile.terrainPhases[0][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!firstPhase) {[39m
[31m+     throw new Error('The integrated replay requires at least one terrain phase')[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const initialSpeedKmh = roundIntegrationValue([39m
[31m+     INTEGRATION_BASE_GROUP_SPEED_KMH *[39m
[31m+       calculateTerrainSpeedMultiplier([39m
[31m+         firstPhase.terrainType,[39m
[31m+         firstPhase.averageGradientPercent[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const riderIds = flatStageFixture.riders.map((rider) => rider.riderId)[39m
[31m+   const initialCheckpoint: Checkpoint = {[39m
[31m+     checkpointIndex: 0,[39m
[31m+     raceSecond: 0,[39m
[31m+     currentKm: 0,[39m
[31m+     groups: [[39m
[31m+       {[39m
[31m+         groupId: INTEGRATION_GROUP_ID,[39m
[31m+         riderIds: [...riderIds],[39m
[31m+         distanceKm: 0,[39m
[31m+         speedKmh: initialSpeedKmh,[39m
[31m+         gapSecondsToLeader: 0,[39m
[31m+         active: true,[39m
[31m+         baseSpeedBeforeGroupAdvantageKmh: INTEGRATION_BASE_GROUP_SPEED_KMH,[39m
[31m+         cooperationLevel: INTEGRATION_COOPERATION_LEVEL,[39m
[31m+       },[39m
[31m+     ],[39m
[31m+     riderSnapshots: flatStageFixture.riders.map((rider) => ({[39m
[31m+       riderId: rider.riderId,[39m
[31m+       distanceKm: 0,[39m
[31m+       speedKmh: initialSpeedKmh,[39m
[31m+       currentGroupId: INTEGRATION_GROUP_ID,[39m
[31m+       freshness: rider.startingFreshness,[39m
[31m+       energy: rider.startingFreshness,[39m
[31m+       movementEnergyCost: 0,[39m
[31m+       attackEnergyCost: 0,[39m
[31m+       chaseEnergyCost: 0,[39m
[31m+       shelterEnergySaving: 0,[39m
[31m+       energyCostSincePreviousCheckpoint: 0,[39m
[31m+     })),[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   const checkpoints: Checkpoint[] = [initialCheckpoint][39m
[31m+   const steps: IntegratedRoadStageReplayStep[] = [][39m
[31m+   const comments: SimpleReplayComment[] = [[39m
[31m+     {[39m
[31m+       progress: 0,[39m
[31m+       title: 'Stage simulation starts',[39m
[31m+       description: `All ${riderIds.length} controlled riders start together. The shared runner begins on ${formatTerrainModelLabel(firstPhase.terrainType).toLowerCase()} terrain at ${initialSpeedKmh.toFixed(3)} km/h.`,[39m
[31m+     },[39m
[31m+   ][39m
[31m+   let phaseBoundaryCrossingCount = 0[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   while ([39m
[31m+     checkpoints[checkpoints.length - 1].currentKm <[39m
[31m+     profile.distanceKm - 0.000001[39m
[31m+   ) {[39m
[31m+     if (checkpoints.length > 500) {[39m
[31m+       throw new Error('The integrated replay exceeded its checkpoint safety limit')[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const previousCheckpoint = checkpoints[checkpoints.length - 1][39m
[31m+     const movement = calculateTerrainMovement({[39m
[31m+       profile,[39m
[31m+       startKm: previousCheckpoint.currentKm,[39m
[31m+       durationSeconds: INTEGRATION_CHECKPOINT_SECONDS,[39m
[31m+       baseSpeedKmh: INTEGRATION_BASE_GROUP_SPEED_KMH,[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (movement.elapsedDurationSeconds <= 0 || movement.distanceKm <= 0) {[39m
[31m+       throw new Error('The integrated replay could not advance the stage')[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const lastSegment = movement.segments[movement.segments.length - 1][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (!lastSegment) {[39m
[31m+       throw new Error('The integrated replay movement returned no terrain segment')[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const averageSpeedKmh = roundIntegrationValue([39m
[31m+       (movement.distanceKm / movement.elapsedDurationSeconds) * 3600[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     const previousRiderById = new Map([39m
[31m+       previousCheckpoint.riderSnapshots.map((snapshot) => [[39m
[31m+         snapshot.riderId,[39m
[31m+         snapshot,[39m
[31m+       ] as const)[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     const riderSnapshots = flatStageFixture.riders.map((rider) => {[39m
[31m+       const previousSnapshot = previousRiderById.get(rider.riderId)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (!previousSnapshot) {[39m
[31m+         throw new Error(`Missing integrated rider snapshot: ${rider.riderId}`)[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const energyStep = calculateRiderEnergyStep({[39m
[31m+         currentEnergy: previousSnapshot.energy,[39m
[31m+         freshness: rider.startingFreshness,[39m
[31m+         endurance: rider.endurance,[39m
[31m+         speedKmh: averageSpeedKmh,[39m
[31m+         elapsedSeconds: movement.elapsedDurationSeconds,[39m
[31m+         riderCount: riderIds.length,[39m
[31m+         cooperationLevel: INTEGRATION_COOPERATION_LEVEL,[39m
[31m+       })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return {[39m
[31m+         riderId: rider.riderId,[39m
[31m+         distanceKm: movement.endKm,[39m
[31m+         speedKmh: lastSegment.effectiveSpeedKmh,[39m
[31m+         currentGroupId: INTEGRATION_GROUP_ID,[39m
[31m+         freshness: energyStep.freshness,[39m
[31m+         energy: energyStep.energyAfter,[39m
[31m+         movementEnergyCost: energyStep.movementEnergyCost,[39m
[31m+         attackEnergyCost: 0,[39m
[31m+         chaseEnergyCost: 0,[39m
[31m+         shelterEnergySaving: energyStep.shelterEnergySaving,[39m
[31m+         energyCostSincePreviousCheckpoint:[39m
[31m+           energyStep.energyCostSincePreviousCheckpoint,[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+     const checkpointIndex = checkpoints.length[39m
[31m+     const checkpoint: Checkpoint = {[39m
[31m+       checkpointIndex,[39m
[31m+       raceSecond: roundIntegrationValue([39m
[31m+         previousCheckpoint.raceSecond + movement.elapsedDurationSeconds[39m
[31m+       ),[39m
[31m+       currentKm: movement.endKm,[39m
[31m+       groups: [[39m
[31m+         {[39m
[31m+           groupId: INTEGRATION_GROUP_ID,[39m
[31m+           riderIds: [...riderIds],[39m
[31m+           distanceKm: movement.endKm,[39m
[31m+           speedKmh: lastSegment.effectiveSpeedKmh,[39m
[31m+           gapSecondsToLeader: 0,[39m
[31m+           active: true,[39m
[31m+           baseSpeedBeforeGroupAdvantageKmh: INTEGRATION_BASE_GROUP_SPEED_KMH,[39m
[31m+           cooperationLevel: INTEGRATION_COOPERATION_LEVEL,[39m
[31m+         },[39m
[31m+       ],[39m
[31m+       riderSnapshots,[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     checkpoints.push(checkpoint)[39m
[31m+     steps.push({[39m
[31m+       fromCheckpointIndex: previousCheckpoint.checkpointIndex,[39m
[31m+       toCheckpointIndex: checkpointIndex,[39m
[31m+       movement,[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+     phaseBoundaryCrossingCount += movement.phaseBoundaryCrossingCount[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const terrainSequence = movement.segments[39m
[31m+       .map((segment) => formatTerrainModelLabel(segment.terrainType))[39m
[31m+       .filter((value, index, values) => index === 0 || value !== values[index - 1])[39m
[31m+       .join(' → ')[39m
[31m+     const progress = Math.max([39m
[31m+       0,[39m
[31m+       Math.min(100, (movement.endKm / profile.distanceKm) * 100)[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     const finished = movement.stageFinished[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     comments.push({[39m
[31m+       progress,[39m
[31m+       title: finished[39m
[31m+         ? 'Stage finish reached'[39m
[31m+         : movement.crossedPhaseBoundary[39m
[31m+           ? `Terrain transition: ${terrainSequence}`[39m
[31m+           : `${terrainSequence} phase`,[39m
[31m+       description: finished[39m
[31m+         ? `The shared runner reaches ${profile.distanceKm.toFixed(1)} km after ${formatPreciseRaceClock(checkpoint.raceSecond)}. All riders remain in one group because terrain-driven separation is scheduled for a later B2 milestone.`[39m
[31m+         : `From ${movement.startKm.toFixed(1)} to ${movement.endKm.toFixed(1)} km, terrain changes the base ${INTEGRATION_BASE_GROUP_SPEED_KMH.toFixed(1)} km/h group speed to an average ${averageSpeedKmh.toFixed(3)} km/h across ${movement.segments.length} segment${movement.segments.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}.`,[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     checkpoints,[39m
[31m+     steps,[39m
[31m+     comments,[39m
[31m+     phaseBoundaryCrossingCount,[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function calculateIntegratedReplayKm([39m
[31m+   step: IntegratedRoadStageReplayStep | undefined,[39m
[31m+   elapsedSeconds: number,[39m
[31m+   fallbackKm: number[39m
[31m+ ): number {[39m
[31m+   if (!step || elapsedSeconds <= 0) return fallbackKm[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   let remainingSeconds = elapsedSeconds[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (const segment of step.movement.segments) {[39m
[31m+     if (remainingSeconds >= segment.durationSeconds) {[39m
[31m+       remainingSeconds -= segment.durationSeconds[39m
[31m+       fallbackKm = segment.endKm[39m
[31m+       continue[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return roundIntegrationValue([39m
[31m+       segment.startKm +[39m
[31m+         (segment.effectiveSpeedKmh * remainingSeconds) / 3600[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return step.movement.endKm[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function createIntegratedReplayHash(value: unknown): string {[39m
[31m+   const source = JSON.stringify(value)[39m
[31m+   let hash = 2166136261[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (let index = 0; index < source.length; index += 1) {[39m
[31m+     hash ^= source.charCodeAt(index)[39m
[31m+     hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619)[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return `fnv1a-${(hash >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0')}`[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function getSimpleReplayFallbackRows([39m
[31m+   participantTeams: RaceParticipantTeam[][39m
[31m+ ): SimpleReplayStandingSource[] {[39m
[31m+   return participantTeams[39m
[31m+     .flatMap((team) =>[39m
[31m+       team.riders.map((rider) => ({[39m
[31m+         riderId: rider.rider_id,[39m
[31m+         riderName: getRaceParticipantRiderDisplayName(rider),[39m
[31m+         teamName: getParticipantTeamName(team),[39m
[31m+         countryCode: rider.country_code ?? rider.country_code_snapshot ?? team.country_code,[39m
[31m+       }))[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     .slice(0, 40)[39m
[31m+     .map((row, index) => ({[39m
[31m+       ...row,[39m
[31m+       finalRank: index + 1,[39m
[31m+       finalGapSeconds: index === 0 ? 0 : Math.floor(index / 4) * 8,[39m
[31m+       finalElapsedSeconds: null,[39m
[31m+     }))[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function getSimpleReplayResultRows([39m
[31m+   resultRows: RaceStageResultRow[],[39m
[31m+   participantTeams: RaceParticipantTeam[][39m
[31m+ ): SimpleReplayStandingSource[] {[39m
[31m+   const participantRiderLookup = new Map<[39m
[31m+     string,[39m
[31m+     {[39m
[31m+       riderName: string[39m
[31m+       teamName: string[39m
[31m+       countryCode: string | null[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   >()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   participantTeams.forEach((team) => {[39m
[31m+     team.riders.forEach((rider) => {[39m
[31m+       participantRiderLookup.set(rider.rider_id, {[39m
[31m+         riderName: getRaceParticipantRiderDisplayName(rider),[39m
[31m+         teamName: getParticipantTeamName(team),[39m
[31m+         countryCode:[39m
[31m+           rider.country_code ??[39m
[31m+           rider.country_code_snapshot ??[39m
[31m+           team.country_code ??[39m
[31m+           team.country_code_snapshot,[39m
[31m+       })[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const normalizedRows = [...resultRows][39m
[31m+     .filter((row) => row.rider_id)[39m
[31m+     .sort([39m
[31m+       (left, right) =>[39m
[31m+         Number(left.rank ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) -[39m
[31m+         Number(right.rank ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     .map((row, index) => {[39m
[31m+       const riderId = row.rider_id ?? `result-rider-${index}`[39m
[31m+       const participant = participantRiderLookup.get(riderId)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return {[39m
[31m+         riderId,[39m
[31m+         riderName:[39m
[31m+           row.full_name?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+           row.rider_full_name?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+           row.display_name?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+           row.rider_name?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+           row.rider_name_snapshot?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+           participant?.riderName ||[39m
[31m+           'Unknown rider',[39m
[31m+         teamName:[39m
[31m+           row.team_name_snapshot?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+           participant?.teamName ||[39m
[31m+           'Unknown team',[39m
[31m+         countryCode:[39m
[31m+           row.rider_country_code ??[39m
[31m+           row.nationality_code ??[39m
[31m+           row.country_code ??[39m
[31m+           participant?.countryCode ??[39m
[31m+           null,[39m
[31m+         finalRank: Number(row.rank ?? index + 1),[39m
[31m+         finalGapSeconds: Math.max(0, Number(row.gap_seconds ?? 0)),[39m
[31m+         finalElapsedSeconds:[39m
[31m+           row.elapsed_seconds === null || row.elapsed_seconds === undefined[39m
[31m+             ? null[39m
[31m+             : Number(row.elapsed_seconds),[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return normalizedRows.length > 0[39m
[31m+     ? normalizedRows[39m
[31m+     : getSimpleReplayFallbackRows(participantTeams)[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildSimpleReplayStandingRows([39m
[31m+   rows: SimpleReplayStandingSource[],[39m
[31m+   checkpoint: Checkpoint[39m
[31m+ ): SimpleReplayStandingRow[] {[39m
[31m+   const rowByRiderId = new Map([39m
[31m+     rows.map((row) => [row.riderId, row] as const)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const groupById = new Map([39m
[31m+     checkpoint.groups.map((group) => [group.groupId, group] as const)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const orderedRiderIds = checkpoint.groups.flatMap((group) => group.riderIds)[39m
[31m+   const checkpointRiderIds = new Set(orderedRiderIds)[39m
[31m+   const completeOrder = [[39m
[31m+     ...orderedRiderIds,[39m
[31m+     ...rows[39m
[31m+       .map((row) => row.riderId)[39m
[31m+       .filter((riderId) => !checkpointRiderIds.has(riderId)),[39m
[31m+   ][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return completeOrder.flatMap((riderId, index) => {[39m
[31m+     const row = rowByRiderId.get(riderId)[39m
[31m+     const riderSnapshot = checkpoint.riderSnapshots.find([39m
[31m+       (snapshot) => snapshot.riderId === riderId[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     const riderGroup = riderSnapshot[39m
[31m+       ? groupById.get(riderSnapshot.currentGroupId)[39m
[31m+       : null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (!row) return [][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return [{[39m
[31m+       ...row,[39m
[31m+       liveRank: index + 1,[39m
[31m+       groupLabel:[39m
[31m+         riderSnapshot?.currentGroupId === 'peloton-1'[39m
[31m+           ? 'Peloton'[39m
[31m+           : 'Breakaway',[39m
[31m+       liveGapSeconds: Math.max(0, riderGroup?.gapSecondsToLeader ?? 0),[39m
[31m+       freshness: riderSnapshot?.freshness ?? 0,[39m
[31m+       energy: riderSnapshot?.energy ?? 0,[39m
[31m+       movementEnergyCost: riderSnapshot?.movementEnergyCost ?? 0,[39m
[31m+       attackEnergyCost: riderSnapshot?.attackEnergyCost ?? 0,[39m
[31m+       chaseEnergyCost: riderSnapshot?.chaseEnergyCost ?? 0,[39m
[31m+       shelterEnergySaving: riderSnapshot?.shelterEnergySaving ?? 0,[39m
[31m+       energyCostSincePreviousCheckpoint:[39m
[31m+         riderSnapshot?.energyCostSincePreviousCheckpoint ?? 0,[39m
[31m+     }][39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildSimpleReplayComments([39m
[31m+   distanceKm: number,[39m
[31m+   checkpoints: Checkpoint[],[39m
[31m+   definition: B1RoadStageSimulationDefinition,[39m
[31m+   inputLabel: string,[39m
[31m+   attackEnabled: boolean[39m
[31m+ ): SimpleReplayComment[] {[39m
[31m+   const riderCount = checkpoints[0]?.riderSnapshots.length ?? 0[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return checkpoints.map((checkpoint, index) => {[39m
[31m+     const previousCheckpoint = checkpoints[index - 1][39m
[31m+     const attackCreated =[39m
[31m+       checkpoint.groups.length === 2 &&[39m
[31m+       previousCheckpoint?.groups.length === 1[39m
[31m+     const catchCreated =[39m
[31m+       checkpoint.groups.length === 1 &&[39m
[31m+       previousCheckpoint?.groups.length === 2 &&[39m
[31m+       checkpoint.currentKm < distanceKm - 0.000001[39m
[31m+     const controlledFinishReached =[39m
[31m+       checkpoint.currentKm >= distanceKm - 0.000001[39m
[31m+     const breakawayGroup = checkpoint.groups.find([39m
[31m+       (group) => group.groupId === definition.separateGroupMovement.breakawayGroupId[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     const pelotonGroup = checkpoint.groups.find([39m
[31m+       (group) => group.groupId === definition.separateGroupMovement.pelotonGroupId[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     const previousPelotonGroup = previousCheckpoint?.groups.find([39m
[31m+       (group) => group.groupId === definition.separateGroupMovement.pelotonGroupId[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     const pelotonGapSeconds = Math.max([39m
[31m+       0,[39m
[31m+       pelotonGroup?.gapSecondsToLeader ?? 0[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     const previousPelotonGapSeconds = Math.max([39m
[31m+       0,[39m
[31m+       previousPelotonGroup?.gapSecondsToLeader ?? 0[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     const breakawaySurvived =[39m
[31m+       controlledFinishReached &&[39m
[31m+       Boolean(breakawayGroup) &&[39m
[31m+       pelotonGapSeconds > 0[39m
[31m+     const caughtPelotonFinished =[39m
[31m+       controlledFinishReached &&[39m
[31m+       checkpoint.groups.length === 1 &&[39m
[31m+       previousCheckpoint?.groups.length === 1 &&[39m
[31m+       checkpoint.checkpointIndex > 0[39m
[31m+     const cooperationActive =[39m
[31m+       Boolean(breakawayGroup && pelotonGroup) &&[39m
[31m+       checkpoint.checkpointIndex >=[39m
[31m+         definition.groupCooperation.splitCheckpointIndex[39m
[31m+     const chaseActive = pelotonGroup?.chaseActive === true[39m
[31m+     const chaseStarted =[39m
[31m+       chaseActive && previousPelotonGroup?.chaseActive !== true[39m
[31m+     const chaseClosedGap =[39m
[31m+       chaseActive &&[39m
[31m+       previousPelotonGapSeconds > 0 &&[39m
[31m+       pelotonGapSeconds < previousPelotonGapSeconds[39m
[31m+     const breakawayAdvantage = Math.max([39m
[31m+       0,[39m
[31m+       breakawayGroup?.totalGroupAdvantageKmh ?? 0[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     const pelotonAdvantage = Math.max([39m
[31m+       0,[39m
[31m+       pelotonGroup?.totalGroupAdvantageKmh ?? 0[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     const averageEnergy =[39m
[31m+       checkpoint.riderSnapshots.reduce([39m
[31m+         (sum, riderSnapshot) => sum + riderSnapshot.energy,[39m
[31m+         0[39m
[31m+       ) / Math.max(checkpoint.riderSnapshots.length, 1)[39m
[31m+     const lowestEnergy = Math.min([39m
[31m+       ...checkpoint.riderSnapshots.map((riderSnapshot) => riderSnapshot.energy)[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     const totalAttackCost = checkpoint.riderSnapshots.reduce([39m
[31m+       (sum, riderSnapshot) => sum + riderSnapshot.attackEnergyCost,[39m
[31m+       0[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     const totalChaseCost = checkpoint.riderSnapshots.reduce([39m
[31m+       (sum, riderSnapshot) => sum + (riderSnapshot.chaseEnergyCost ?? 0),[39m
[31m+       0[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     const breakawayRiderIds = new Set(breakawayGroup?.riderIds ?? [])[39m
[31m+     const pelotonRiderIds = new Set(pelotonGroup?.riderIds ?? [])[39m
[31m+     const breakawayEnergyValues = checkpoint.riderSnapshots[39m
[31m+       .filter((riderSnapshot) => breakawayRiderIds.has(riderSnapshot.riderId))[39m
[31m+       .map((riderSnapshot) => riderSnapshot.energy)[39m
[31m+     const pelotonEnergyValues = checkpoint.riderSnapshots[39m
[31m+       .filter((riderSnapshot) => pelotonRiderIds.has(riderSnapshot.riderId))[39m
[31m+       .map((riderSnapshot) => riderSnapshot.energy)[39m
[31m+     const breakawayAverageEnergy =[39m
[31m+       breakawayEnergyValues.reduce((sum, energy) => sum + energy, 0) /[39m
[31m+       Math.max(breakawayEnergyValues.length, 1)[39m
[31m+     const pelotonAverageEnergy =[39m
[31m+       pelotonEnergyValues.reduce((sum, energy) => sum + energy, 0) /[39m
[31m+       Math.max(pelotonEnergyValues.length, 1)[39m
[31m+     const stageProgress = Math.max([39m
[31m+       0,[39m
[31m+       Math.min(1, checkpoint.currentKm / Math.max(distanceKm, 1))[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       progress: stageProgress * 100,[39m
[31m+       title:[39m
[31m+         checkpoint.checkpointIndex === 0[39m
[31m+           ? 'Initial freshness and live energy'[39m
[31m+           : attackCreated[39m
[31m+             ? 'Controlled attack adds an extra energy cost'[39m
[31m+             : catchCreated[39m
[31m+               ? 'Peloton catches the breakaway'[39m
[31m+               : breakawaySurvived[39m
[31m+                 ? 'Breakaway survives to the finish'[39m
[31m+                 : caughtPelotonFinished[39m
[31m+                   ? attackEnabled[39m
[31m+                   ? 'Caught peloton reaches the finish'[39m
[31m+                   : 'Peloton reaches the finish'[39m
[31m+                   : chaseStarted[39m
[31m+                     ? 'Late-stage peloton chase begins'[39m
[31m+                     : chaseClosedGap[39m
[31m+                       ? 'Peloton chase closes the breakaway gap'[39m
[31m+                       : cooperationActive && pelotonGapSeconds > 0[39m
[31m+                         ? `Energy and cooperation shape checkpoint ${checkpoint.checkpointIndex + 1}`[39m
[31m+                         : cooperationActive[39m
[31m+                           ? 'Drafting, cooperation and energy state applied'[39m
[31m+                           : `Peloton energy checkpoint ${checkpoint.checkpointIndex + 1}`,[39m
[31m+       description:[39m
[31m+         checkpoint.checkpointIndex === 0[39m
[31m+           ? `All ${riderCount} ${inputLabel} riders start together with live energy equal to their starting freshness. Average energy is ${averageEnergy.toFixed(1)} and the lowest rider starts at ${lowestEnergy.toFixed(1)}.`[39m
[31m+           : attackCreated[39m
[31m+             ? `At ${formatRaceClock(checkpoint.raceSecond)}, ${definition.controlledAttack.attackerRiderIds.length} saved-order riders attack and pay ${(definition.energyModel.attackEnergyCost ?? 0).toFixed(1)} energy each (${totalAttackCost.toFixed(1)} total). Drafting and cooperation lift the breakaway by ${breakawayAdvantage.toFixed(3)} km/h and the peloton by ${pelotonAdvantage.toFixed(3)} km/h. Breakaway average energy is ${breakawayAverageEnergy.toFixed(1)} versus ${pelotonAverageEnergy.toFixed(1)} in the peloton.`[39m
[31m+             : catchCreated[39m
[31m+               ? `At ${formatRaceClock(checkpoint.raceSecond)}, the peloton closes the final gap at ${checkpoint.currentKm.toFixed(3)} km. All ${riderCount} riders merge into one peloton, and the former peloton riders pay ${totalChaseCost.toFixed(1)} total chase energy during the catch interval.`[39m
[31m+               : breakawaySurvived[39m
[31m+                 ? `At ${formatRaceClock(checkpoint.raceSecond)}, the breakaway reaches the real ${distanceKm.toFixed(0)} km finish first. Two groups remain and the peloton finishes the live checkpoint ${formatGapValue(pelotonGapSeconds)} behind.`[39m
[31m+                 : caughtPelotonFinished[39m
[31m+                   ? attackEnabled[39m
[31m+                     ? `At ${formatRaceClock(checkpoint.raceSecond)}, the merged ${riderCount}-rider peloton reaches the real ${distanceKm.toFixed(1)} km finish together. Deterministic final ranks, one shared finish time and zero winner gaps are now available.`[39m
[31m+                     : `At ${formatRaceClock(checkpoint.raceSecond)}, the ${riderCount}-rider peloton reaches the real ${distanceKm.toFixed(1)} km finish without an artificial breakaway. Deterministic final ranks and one shared physical time are now available.`[39m
[31m+                   : chaseStarted[39m
[31m+                     ? `At ${formatRaceClock(checkpoint.raceSecond)}, the leader reaches ${(stageProgress * 100).toFixed(1)}% of the real stage. The peloton's B1 chase speed is ${((pelotonGroup?.baseSpeedBeforeChaseKmh ?? 0) + (pelotonGroup?.chaseSpeedBonusKmh ?? 0)).toFixed(3)} km/h before B2 terrain, and ${(pelotonGroup?.speedKmh ?? 0).toFixed(3)} km/h on the active terrain and pays ${totalChaseCost.toFixed(1)} extra energy in total. The gap remains ${formatGapValue(pelotonGapSeconds)} at activation.`[39m
[31m+                     : chaseClosedGap[39m
[31m+                       ? `At ${formatRaceClock(checkpoint.raceSecond)}, the late chase reduces the peloton deficit from ${formatGapValue(previousPelotonGapSeconds)} to ${formatGapValue(pelotonGapSeconds)}. The breakaway remains narrowly ahead, while the peloton pays another ${totalChaseCost.toFixed(1)} energy in chase effort.`[39m
[31m+                       : cooperationActive && pelotonGapSeconds > 0[39m
[31m+                         ? `At ${formatRaceClock(checkpoint.raceSecond)}, the breakaway reaches ${formatKm(breakawayGroup?.distanceKm)} and leads by ${formatGapValue(pelotonGapSeconds)}. Average live energy is ${breakawayAverageEnergy.toFixed(1)} in the breakaway and ${pelotonAverageEnergy.toFixed(1)} in the sheltered peloton.`[39m
[31m+                         : cooperationActive[39m
[31m+                           ? `At ${formatRaceClock(checkpoint.raceSecond)}, both groups remain together at the split while drafting and shelter reduce movement costs. Average energy is ${averageEnergy.toFixed(1)}.`[39m
[31m+                           : `At ${formatRaceClock(checkpoint.raceSecond)}, all ${riderCount} riders remain together at ${formatKm(checkpoint.currentKm)}. Average live energy falls to ${averageEnergy.toFixed(1)}, with the lowest rider at ${lowestEnergy.toFixed(1)}.`,[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getSimpleReplayStagePointLabel(point: RaceStagePoint): string {[39m
[31m+   const pointType = String(point.point_type ?? '').toUpperCase()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (point.name?.trim()) return point.name.trim()[39m
[31m+   if (pointType === 'INTERMEDIATE_SPRINT') return 'Intermediate sprint'[39m
[31m+   if (pointType === 'BONUS_SPRINT') return 'Bonus sprint'[39m
[31m+   if (pointType === 'KOM') {[39m
[31m+     return point.kom_category ? `KOM · Cat ${point.kom_category}` : 'KOM'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (pointType === 'FINISH') return 'Finish sprint'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return humanizeCode(pointType)[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function SimpleReplayStagePointsPanel({[39m
[31m+   pointResults,[39m
[31m+   stagePoints,[39m
[31m+   currentKm,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   pointResults: RacePointResultRow[][39m
[31m+   stagePoints: RaceStagePoint[][39m
[31m+   currentKm: number[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const pointOptions = useMemo(() => {[39m
[31m+     const options = stagePoints[39m
[31m+       .filter((point) => String(point.point_type ?? '').toUpperCase() !== 'START')[39m
[31m+       .map((point) => {[39m
[31m+         const pointType = String(point.point_type ?? '').toUpperCase()[39m
[31m+         const km = Math.max(0, Number(point.km_from_start ?? 0))[39m
[31m+         const categoryLabel =[39m
[31m+           pointType === 'KOM' && point.kom_category[39m
[31m+             ? ` · Cat ${point.kom_category}`[39m
[31m+             : ''[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         return {[39m
[31m+           id: point.id,[39m
[31m+           pointType,[39m
[31m+           label: `${getSimpleReplayStagePointLabel(point)}${categoryLabel} · ${formatKm(km)}`,[39m
[31m+           reached: currentKm >= km - 0.000001,[39m
[31m+           sortOrder: Number(point.sort_order ?? 999),[39m
[31m+           km,[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       })[39m
[31m+       .sort([39m
[31m+         (left, right) =>[39m
[31m+           left.sortOrder - right.sortOrder || left.km - right.km[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return options[39m
[31m+   }, [currentKm, stagePoints])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const [selectedPointId, setSelectedPointId] = useState('')[39m
[31m+   const lastAutomaticallySelectedPointIdRef = useRef('')[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     const selectedStillExists = pointOptions.some([39m
[31m+       (point) => point.id === selectedPointId[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     const reachedPoints = pointOptions.filter((point) => point.reached)[39m
[31m+     const latestReached = reachedPoints[reachedPoints.length - 1] ?? null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if ([39m
[31m+       latestReached &&[39m
[31m+       latestReached.id !== lastAutomaticallySelectedPointIdRef.current[39m
[31m+     ) {[39m
[31m+       lastAutomaticallySelectedPointIdRef.current = latestReached.id[39m
[31m+       setSelectedPointId(latestReached.id)[39m
[31m+       return[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (!latestReached) {[39m
[31m+       lastAutomaticallySelectedPointIdRef.current = ''[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (!selectedStillExists || (!latestReached && currentKm <= 0.000001)) {[39m
[31m+       setSelectedPointId(pointOptions[0]?.id ?? '')[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }, [currentKm, pointOptions, selectedPointId])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const selectedPoint = pointOptions.find([39m
[31m+     (point) => point.id === selectedPointId[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const rows = selectedPoint?.reached[39m
[31m+     ? pointResults[39m
[31m+         .filter([39m
[31m+           (row) =>[39m
[31m+             row.point_id === selectedPointId &&[39m
[31m+             row.rank !== null &&[39m
[31m+             (Number(row.points_awarded ?? 0) > 0 ||[39m
[31m+               Number(row.bonus_seconds_awarded ?? 0) > 0)[39m
[31m+         )[39m
[31m+         .sort((left, right) => Number(left.rank ?? 999) - Number(right.rank ?? 999))[39m
[31m+     : [][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const cumulativeRows = useMemo(() => {[39m
[31m+     const pointById = new Map([39m
[31m+       stagePoints.map((point) => [point.id, point] as const)[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     const totals = new Map<[39m
[31m+       string,[39m
[31m+       {[39m
[31m+         riderId: string[39m
[31m+         teamId: string[39m
[31m+         riderName: string[39m
[31m+         teamName: string[39m
[31m+         sprintPoints: number[39m
[31m+         mountainPoints: number[39m
[31m+         bonusSeconds: number[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     >()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     pointResults.forEach((row) => {[39m
[31m+       const pointId = row.point_id[39m
[31m+       if (!pointId || !row.rider_id) return[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const point = pointById.get(pointId)[39m
[31m+       const pointKm = Number(point?.km_from_start ?? row.km_from_start ?? 0)[39m
[31m+       if (currentKm + 0.000001 < pointKm) return[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const key = `${row.rider_id}|${row.team_id ?? ''}`[39m
[31m+       const existing = totals.get(key) ?? {[39m
[31m+         riderId: row.rider_id,[39m
[31m+         teamId: row.team_id ?? '',[39m
[31m+         riderName: row.rider_name_snapshot ?? row.rider_id,[39m
[31m+         teamName: row.team_name_snapshot ?? row.team_id ?? '—',[39m
[31m+         sprintPoints: 0,[39m
[31m+         mountainPoints: 0,[39m
[31m+         bonusSeconds: 0,[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       const awardedPoints = Number(row.points_awarded ?? 0)[39m
[31m+       const pointType = String(row.point_type ?? point?.point_type ?? '').toUpperCase()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (pointType === 'KOM') {[39m
[31m+         existing.mountainPoints += awardedPoints[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         existing.sprintPoints += awardedPoints[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       existing.bonusSeconds += Number(row.bonus_seconds_awarded ?? 0)[39m
[31m+       totals.set(key, existing)[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return [...totals.values()][39m
[31m+       .filter([39m
[31m+         (row) =>[39m
[31m+           row.sprintPoints > 0 ||[39m
[31m+           row.mountainPoints > 0 ||[39m
[31m+           row.bonusSeconds > 0[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+       .sort([39m
[31m+         (left, right) =>[39m
[31m+           right.sprintPoints +[39m
[31m+             right.mountainPoints -[39m
[31m+             (left.sprintPoints + left.mountainPoints) ||[39m
[31m+           right.bonusSeconds - left.bonusSeconds ||[39m
[31m+           left.riderName.localeCompare(right.riderName)[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+   }, [currentKm, pointResults, stagePoints])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4">[39m
[31m+       <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">[39m
[31m+         <div>[39m
[31m+           <div className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+             Stage points[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+             Rankings and cumulative awards appear when each point is reached.[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <select[39m
[31m+           value={selectedPointId}[39m
[31m+           onChange={(event) => setSelectedPointId(event.target.value)}[39m
[31m+           className="min-w-[260px] rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm"[39m
[31m+           disabled={pointOptions.length === 0}[39m
[31m+         >[39m
[31m+           {pointOptions.length === 0 ? ([39m
[31m+             <option>No stage points available</option>[39m
[31m+           ) : ([39m
[31m+             pointOptions.map((point) => ([39m
[31m+               <option[39m
[31m+                 key={point.id}[39m
[31m+                 value={point.id}[39m
[31m+                 disabled={!point.reached}[39m
[31m+               >[39m
[31m+                 {point.label}[39m
[31m+               </option>[39m
[31m+             ))[39m
[31m+           )}[39m
[31m+         </select>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {pointOptions.length === 0 ? ([39m
[31m+         <div className="rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 p-4 text-sm text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+           This stage has no sprint, KOM, or finish point definitions.[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       ) : !selectedPoint?.reached ? ([39m
[31m+         <div className="rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 p-4 text-sm text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+           This point has not been reached yet.[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       ) : rows.length === 0 ? ([39m
[31m+         <div className="rounded-2xl bg-amber-50 px-4 py-4 text-sm text-amber-800">[39m
[31m+           This point was reached without an awarded result.[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       ) : ([39m
[31m+         <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200">[39m
[31m+           <table className="w-full text-sm">[39m
[31m+             <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+               <tr>[39m
[31m+                 <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left">#</th>[39m
[31m+                 <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left">Rider</th>[39m
[31m+                 <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left">Team</th>[39m
[31m+                 <th className="px-3 py-2 text-right">Points</th>[39m
[31m+                 <th className="px-3 py-2 text-right">Bonus</th>[39m
[31m+               </tr>[39m
[31m+             </thead>[39m
[31m+             <tbody>[39m
[31m+               {rows.map((row) => ([39m
[31m+                 <tr[39m
[31m+                   key={`${row.point_id}-${row.rank}-${row.rider_id ?? row.rider_name_snapshot ?? 'row'}`}[39m
[31m+                   className="border-t border-slate-100"[39m
[31m+                 >[39m
[31m+                   <td className="px-3 py-2 font-semibold">{row.rank}</td>[39m
[31m+                   <td className="px-3 py-2">{row.rider_name_snapshot ?? '—'}</td>[39m
[31m+                   <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-600">{row.team_name_snapshot ?? '—'}</td>[39m
[31m+                   <td className="px-3 py-2 text-right font-semibold">{row.points_awarded ?? 0}</td>[39m
[31m+                   <td className="px-3 py-2 text-right">{row.bonus_seconds_awarded ? `${row.bonus_seconds_awarded}s` : '—'}</td>[39m
[31m+                 </tr>[39m
[31m+               ))}[39m
[31m+             </tbody>[39m
[31m+           </table>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       )}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <div className="mt-4 border-t border-slate-100 pt-4">[39m
[31m+         <div className="mb-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+           Current stage totals[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         {cumulativeRows.length === 0 ? ([39m
[31m+           <div className="rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+             No sprint, KOM, or bonus awards have been revealed yet.[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         ) : ([39m
[31m+           <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200">[39m
[31m+             <table className="w-full text-sm">[39m
[31m+               <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+                 <tr>[39m
[31m+                   <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left">Rider</th>[39m
[31m+                   <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left">Team</th>[39m
[31m+                   <th className="px-3 py-2 text-right">Sprint</th>[39m
[31m+                   <th className="px-3 py-2 text-right">KOM</th>[39m
[31m+                   <th className="px-3 py-2 text-right">Bonus</th>[39m
[31m+                   <th className="px-3 py-2 text-right">Total</th>[39m
[31m+                 </tr>[39m
[31m+               </thead>[39m
[31m+               <tbody>[39m
[31m+                 {cumulativeRows.slice(0, 12).map((row) => ([39m
[31m+                   <tr[39m
[31m+                     key={`${row.riderId}-${row.teamId}`}[39m
[31m+                     className="border-t border-slate-100"[39m
[31m+                   >[39m
[31m+                     <td className="px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+                       {row.riderName}[39m
[31m+                     </td>[39m
[31m+                     <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-600">[39m
[31m+                       {row.teamName}[39m
[31m+                     </td>[39m
[31m+                     <td className="px-3 py-2 text-right">[39m
[31m+                       {row.sprintPoints}[39m
[31m+                     </td>[39m
[31m+                     <td className="px-3 py-2 text-right">[39m
[31m+                       {row.mountainPoints}[39m
[31m+                     </td>[39m
[31m+                     <td className="px-3 py-2 text-right">[39m
[31m+                       {row.bonusSeconds > 0 ? `${row.bonusSeconds}s` : '—'}[39m
[31m+                     </td>[39m
[31m+                     <td className="px-3 py-2 text-right font-semibold">[39m
[31m+                       {row.sprintPoints + row.mountainPoints}[39m
[31m+                     </td>[39m
[31m+                   </tr>[39m
[31m+                 ))}[39m
[31m+               </tbody>[39m
[31m+             </table>[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         )}[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function normalizeUniversalRpcRows<T>(data: unknown): T[] {[39m
[31m+   if (Array.isArray(data)) return data as T[][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (typeof data === 'string') {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const parsed = JSON.parse(data) as unknown[39m
[31m+       if (Array.isArray(parsed)) return parsed as T[][39m
[31m+     } catch {[39m
[31m+       return [][39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (data && typeof data === 'object') {[39m
[31m+     const record = data as Record<string, unknown>[39m
[31m+     for (const key of ['data', 'rows', 'result', 'results']) {[39m
[31m+       if (Array.isArray(record[key])) return record[key] as T[][39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return [][39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function normalizeUniversalPhase9ProductionPayload([39m
[31m+   data: unknown[39m
[31m+ ): UniversalPhase9ProductionPayload | null {[39m
[31m+   let value = data[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (Array.isArray(value) && value.length === 1) {[39m
[31m+     value = value[0][39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (typeof value === 'string') {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       value = JSON.parse(value) as unknown[39m
[31m+     } catch {[39m
[31m+       return null[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return null[39m
