[31m+ function getUniversalReplayDurationSeconds([39m
[31m+   result: UniversalRaceEngineResult[39m
[31m+ ): number {[39m
[31m+   const finalCheckpoint = result.replayTimeline.checkpoints.find([39m
[31m+     (checkpoint) =>[39m
[31m+       checkpoint.checkpointId === result.replayTimeline.finalCheckpointId[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const maximumFinishTime =[39m
[31m+     finalCheckpoint?.riderStates.reduce([39m
[31m+       (maximum, row) =>[39m
[31m+         Math.max(maximum, Number(row.officialTimeSeconds ?? 0)),[39m
[31m+       0[39m
[31m+     ) ?? 0[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return maximumFinishTime > 0 ? maximumFinishTime : 4 * 3600[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getUniversalReplayFramePair([39m
[31m+   frames: readonly UniversalReplayCheckpoint[],[39m
[31m+   progress: number[39m
[31m+ ): {[39m
[31m+   previous: UniversalReplayCheckpoint | null[39m
[31m+   next: UniversalReplayCheckpoint | null[39m
[31m+   fraction: number[39m
[31m+ } {[39m
[31m+   if (frames.length === 0) {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       previous: null,[39m
[31m+       next: null,[39m
[31m+       fraction: 0,[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const normalizedProgress = universalClamp(progress, 0, 1)[39m
[31m+   let previousIndex = 0[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (let index = 0; index < frames.length; index += 1) {[39m
[31m+     const frame = frames[index][39m
[31m+     if (!frame) continue[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (frame.raceProgress.fraction <= normalizedProgress + 0.000001) {[39m
[31m+       previousIndex = index[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const previous = frames[previousIndex] ?? frames[0] ?? null[39m
[31m+   const next = frames[Math.min(frames.length - 1, previousIndex + 1)] ?? previous[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!previous || !next || previous === next) {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       previous,[39m
[31m+       next,[39m
[31m+       fraction: 0,[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const previousProgress = previous.raceProgress.fraction[39m
[31m+   const nextProgress = next.raceProgress.fraction[39m
[31m+   const fraction =[39m
[31m+     nextProgress > previousProgress[39m
[31m+       ? universalClamp([39m
[31m+           (normalizedProgress - previousProgress) /[39m
[31m+             (nextProgress - previousProgress),[39m
[31m+           0,[39m
[31m+           1[39m
[31m+         )[39m
[31m+       : 0[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     previous,[39m
[31m+     next,[39m
[31m+     fraction,[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function haveSameUniversalReplayGroupLineage([39m
[31m+   currentGroup: UniversalReplayCheckpoint['groups'][number] | null,[39m
[31m+   nextGroup: UniversalReplayCheckpoint['groups'][number] | null[39m
[31m+ ): boolean {[39m
[31m+   if (!currentGroup || !nextGroup) return false[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   // Group identity is stable when the authoritative physical group code and[39m
[31m+   // display code are stable. Rider membership may legitimately change at an[39m
[31m+   // exact incident/rejoin checkpoint without creating a different peloton or[39m
[31m+   // breakaway lineage. Requiring identical rider arrays freezes the displayed[39m
[31m+   // gap across precisely those incident intervals.[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     currentGroup.groupCode === nextGroup.groupCode &&[39m
[31m+     currentGroup.displayCode === nextGroup.displayCode[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function interpolateStableUniversalReplayGapSeconds([39m
[31m+   currentGapSeconds: number,[39m
[31m+   nextGapSeconds: number,[39m
[31m+   fraction: number[39m
[31m+ ): number {[39m
[31m+   return Math.max([39m
[31m+     0,[39m
[31m+     currentGapSeconds +[39m
[31m+       (nextGapSeconds - currentGapSeconds) * universalClamp(fraction, 0, 1)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getUniversalReplayGroupBadge(displayCode: string): string {[39m
[31m+   return displayCode || 'P'[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getUniversalReplayGroupBadgeClass([39m
[31m+   displayCode: string,[39m
[31m+   colorKey: string[39m
[31m+ ): string {[39m
[31m+   if (colorKey === 'peloton_blue' || displayCode === 'P') {[39m
[31m+     return 'bg-blue-600'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (colorKey.includes('breakaway') || displayCode.startsWith('B')) {[39m
[31m+     return 'bg-emerald-500'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (colorKey.includes('front') || displayCode.startsWith('F')) {[39m
[31m+     return 'bg-yellow-500'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if ([39m
[31m+     colorKey.includes('chasing') ||[39m
[31m+     colorKey.includes('dropped') ||[39m
[31m+     colorKey.includes('time_limit') ||[39m
[31m+     displayCode.startsWith('C')[39m
[31m+   ) {[39m
[31m+     return 'bg-orange-600'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return 'bg-red-500'[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildUniversalReplayPointResults([39m
[31m+   stagePoints: RaceStagePoint[],[39m
[31m+   input: UniversalRaceEngineInput,[39m
[31m+   checkpoint: UniversalReplayCheckpoint | null,[39m
[31m+   result: UniversalRaceEngineResult[39m
[31m+ ): RacePointResultRow[] {[39m
[31m+   if (!checkpoint) return [][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const riderById = new Map([39m
[31m+     input.riders.map((rider) => [rider.riderId, rider] as const)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const teamById = new Map([39m
[31m+     input.teams.map((team) => [team.teamId, team] as const)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const stagePointById = new Map([39m
[31m+     stagePoints.map((point) => [point.id, point] as const)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const rows: RacePointResultRow[] = [][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   checkpoint.intermediateResults.forEach((event) => {[39m
[31m+     const stagePoint = stagePointById.get(event.pointId)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     event.rankings.forEach((ranking) => {[39m
[31m+       const rider = riderById.get(ranking.riderId)[39m
[31m+       const team = teamById.get(ranking.teamId)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       rows.push({[39m
[31m+         point_id: event.pointId,[39m
[31m+         point_type: event.pointType,[39m
[31m+         point_name:[39m
[31m+           event.pointName ??[39m
[31m+           stagePoint?.name ??[39m
[31m+           humanizeCode(event.pointType),[39m
[31m+         km_from_start: event.kmFromStart,[39m
[31m+         kom_category: stagePoint?.kom_category ?? null,[39m
[31m+         sort_order: stagePoint?.sort_order ?? event.eventOrder,[39m
[31m+         rank: ranking.rank,[39m
[31m+         rider_id: ranking.riderId,[39m
[31m+         team_id: ranking.teamId,[39m
[31m+         rider_name_snapshot:[39m
[31m+           rider?.snapshot.displayName ?? ranking.riderId,[39m
[31m+         team_name_snapshot:[39m
[31m+           team?.snapshot.teamName ?? ranking.teamId,[39m
[31m+         points_awarded: ranking.pointsAwarded,[39m
[31m+         bonus_seconds_awarded: ranking.bonusSecondsAwarded,[39m
[31m+       })[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const phase4 = result.roadRaceResolution.phase4Finish[39m
[31m+   const finishPoint =[39m
[31m+     stagePoints.find([39m
[31m+       (point) =>[39m
[31m+         String(point.point_type ?? '').toUpperCase() === 'FINISH'[39m
[31m+     ) ?? null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if ([39m
[31m+     checkpoint.finalResultsVisible &&[39m
[31m+     phase4 &&[39m
[31m+     finishPoint &&[39m
[31m+     result.finishResolution.complete[39m
[31m+   ) {[39m
[31m+     const phase4AwardsByRank = new Map([39m
[31m+       phase4.finish.rankings.map([39m
[31m+         (ranking) =>[39m
[31m+           [[39m
[31m+             ranking.rank,[39m
[31m+             {[39m
[31m+               pointsAwarded: ranking.pointsAwarded,[39m
[31m+               bonusSecondsAwarded: ranking.bonusSecondsAwarded,[39m
[31m+             },[39m
[31m+           ] as const[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     checkpoint.riderStates[39m
[31m+       .filter([39m
[31m+         (official) =>[39m
[31m+           official.status === 'finished' &&[39m
[31m+           official.finishRank !== null[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+       .forEach((official) => {[39m
[31m+         const awards = phase4AwardsByRank.get(official.finishRank as number)[39m
[31m+         if ([39m
[31m+           !awards ||[39m
[31m+           (awards.pointsAwarded <= 0 &&[39m
[31m+             awards.bonusSecondsAwarded <= 0)[39m
[31m+         ) {[39m
[31m+           return[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         const rider = riderById.get(official.riderId)[39m
[31m+         const team = teamById.get(official.teamId)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         rows.push({[39m
[31m+           point_id: finishPoint.id,[39m
[31m+           point_type: 'FINISH',[39m
[31m+           point_name: finishPoint.name ?? 'Finish',[39m
[31m+           km_from_start: finishPoint.km_from_start,[39m
[31m+           kom_category: null,[39m
[31m+           sort_order: finishPoint.sort_order,[39m
[31m+           rank: official.finishRank,[39m
[31m+           rider_id: official.riderId,[39m
[31m+           team_id: official.teamId,[39m
[31m+           rider_name_snapshot:[39m
[31m+             rider?.snapshot.displayName ?? official.riderId,[39m
[31m+           team_name_snapshot:[39m
[31m+             team?.snapshot.teamName ?? official.teamId,[39m
[31m+           points_awarded: awards.pointsAwarded,[39m
[31m+           bonus_seconds_awarded: awards.bonusSecondsAwarded,[39m
[31m+         })[39m
[31m+       })[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return rows.sort([39m
[31m+     (left, right) =>[39m
[31m+       Number(left.sort_order ?? 999) -[39m
[31m+         Number(right.sort_order ?? 999) ||[39m
[31m+       Number(left.km_from_start ?? 0) -[39m
[31m+         Number(right.km_from_start ?? 0) ||[39m
[31m+       Number(left.rank ?? 999) -[39m
[31m+         Number(right.rank ?? 999)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildUniversalShadowStageResults([39m
[31m+   input: UniversalRaceEngineInput,[39m
[31m+   result: UniversalRaceEngineResult,[39m
[31m+   pointResults: readonly RacePointResultRow[][39m
[31m+ ): RaceStageResultRow[] {[39m
[31m+   if (!result.finishResolution.complete) {[39m
[31m+     throw new Error([39m
[31m+       'The universal finish resolution is incomplete and cannot be displayed.'[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const officialResults = result.finishResolution.classification[39m
[31m+   if (officialResults.length === 0) return [][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const riderById = new Map([39m
[31m+     input.riders.map((rider) => [rider.riderId, rider] as const)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const teamById = new Map([39m
[31m+     input.teams.map((team) => [team.teamId, team] as const)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const phase4FinishByRank = new Map([39m
[31m+     result.roadRaceResolution.phase4Finish?.finish.rankings.map([39m
[31m+       (ranking) => [ranking.rank, ranking] as const[39m
[31m+     ) ?? [][39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const pointTotalsByRiderId = new Map<[39m
[31m+     string,[39m
[31m+     {[39m
[31m+       finishPoints: number[39m
[31m+       sprintPoints: number[39m
[31m+       mountainPoints: number[39m
[31m+       bonusSeconds: number[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   >()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   pointResults.forEach((row) => {[39m
[31m+     if (!row.rider_id) return[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const totals = pointTotalsByRiderId.get(row.rider_id) ?? {[39m
[31m+       finishPoints: 0,[39m
[31m+       sprintPoints: 0,[39m
[31m+       mountainPoints: 0,[39m
[31m+       bonusSeconds: 0,[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const pointType = String(row.point_type ?? '').toUpperCase()[39m
[31m+     const awardedPoints = Number(row.points_awarded ?? 0)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (pointType === 'FINISH') totals.finishPoints += awardedPoints[39m
[31m+     else if (pointType === 'KOM') totals.mountainPoints += awardedPoints[39m
[31m+     else totals.sprintPoints += awardedPoints[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     totals.bonusSeconds += Number(row.bonus_seconds_awarded ?? 0)[39m
[31m+     pointTotalsByRiderId.set(row.rider_id, totals)[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return officialResults.map((official) => {[39m
[31m+     const rider = riderById.get(official.riderId)[39m
[31m+     const team = teamById.get(official.teamId)[39m
[31m+     const phase4Finish =[39m
[31m+       official.rank === null[39m
[31m+         ? null[39m
[31m+         : phase4FinishByRank.get(official.rank) ?? null[39m
[31m+     const totals = pointTotalsByRiderId.get(official.riderId) ?? {[39m
[31m+       finishPoints: phase4Finish?.pointsAwarded ?? 0,[39m
[31m+       sprintPoints: 0,[39m
[31m+       mountainPoints: 0,[39m
[31m+       bonusSeconds: phase4Finish?.bonusSecondsAwarded ?? 0,[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       rank: official.rank,[39m
[31m+       rider_id: official.riderId,[39m
[31m+       team_id: official.teamId,[39m
[31m+       rider_name_snapshot:[39m
[31m+         rider?.snapshot.displayName ?? official.riderId,[39m
[31m+       team_name_snapshot:[39m
[31m+         team?.snapshot.teamName ?? official.teamId,[39m
[31m+       elapsed_seconds: official.officialTimeSeconds,[39m
[31m+       gap_seconds: official.gapSeconds,[39m
[31m+       bonus_seconds:[39m
[31m+         official.status === 'finished' ? totals.bonusSeconds : 0,[39m
[31m+       penalty_seconds: 0,[39m
[31m+       finish_points:[39m
[31m+         official.status === 'finished' ? totals.finishPoints : 0,[39m
[31m+       sprint_points: totals.sprintPoints,[39m
[31m+       mountain_points: totals.mountainPoints,[39m
[31m+       status: official.status,[39m
[31m+       full_name: rider?.snapshot.displayName ?? official.riderId,[39m
[31m+       rider_country_code: rider?.snapshot.countryCode ?? null,[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildUniversalShadowClassifications([39m
[31m+   input: UniversalRaceEngineInput,[39m
[31m+   stageRows: readonly RaceStageResultRow[],[39m
[31m+   participantTeams: readonly RaceParticipantTeam[][39m
[31m+ ): RaceClassificationRow[] {[39m
[31m+   const participantRiderById = new Map([39m
[31m+     participantTeams.flatMap((team) =>[39m
[31m+       team.riders.map((rider) => [rider.rider_id, rider] as const)[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const teamById = new Map([39m
[31m+     input.teams.map((team) => [team.teamId, team] as const)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const adjustedTime = (row: RaceStageResultRow) =>[39m
[31m+     Math.max([39m
[31m+       0,[39m
[31m+       Number(row.elapsed_seconds ?? 0) -[39m
[31m+         Number(row.bonus_seconds ?? 0) +[39m
[31m+         Number(row.penalty_seconds ?? 0)[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   const baseRiderRow = ([39m
[31m+     row: RaceStageResultRow,[39m
[31m+     classificationType: ClassificationView,[39m
[31m+     rank: number,[39m
[31m+     totalTimeSeconds: number | null,[39m
[31m+     gapSeconds: number | null,[39m
[31m+     points: number | null[39m
[31m+   ): RaceClassificationRow => ({[39m
[31m+     classification_type: classificationType,[39m
[31m+     entity_type: 'rider',[39m
[31m+     rank,[39m
[31m+     previous_rank: null,[39m
[31m+     rider_id: row.rider_id,[39m
[31m+     team_id: row.team_id,[39m
[31m+     display_name_snapshot:[39m
[31m+       row.full_name ?? row.rider_name_snapshot ?? row.rider_id,[39m
[31m+     team_name_snapshot: row.team_name_snapshot,[39m
[31m+     total_time_seconds: totalTimeSeconds,[39m
[31m+     gap_seconds: gapSeconds,[39m
[31m+     points,[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const classifications: RaceClassificationRow[] = [][39m
[31m+   const classifiedStageRows = stageRows.filter([39m
[31m+     (row) =>[39m
[31m+       row.status === 'finished' &&[39m
[31m+       row.rank !== null &&[39m
[31m+       row.elapsed_seconds !== null[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const generalRows = [...classifiedStageRows].sort([39m
[31m+     (left, right) =>[39m
[31m+       adjustedTime(left) - adjustedTime(right) ||[39m
[31m+       Number(left.rank ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) -[39m
[31m+         Number(right.rank ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const generalLeaderTime = generalRows.length > 0[39m
[31m+     ? adjustedTime(generalRows[0])[39m
[31m+     : 0[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   generalRows.forEach((row, index) => {[39m
[31m+     const time = adjustedTime(row)[39m
[31m+     classifications.push([39m
[31m+       baseRiderRow([39m
[31m+         row,[39m
[31m+         'general',[39m
[31m+         index + 1,[39m
[31m+         time,[39m
[31m+         time - generalLeaderTime,[39m
[31m+         null[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const buildPointClassification = ([39m
[31m+     type: 'points' | 'mountain',[39m
[31m+     getPoints: (row: RaceStageResultRow) => number[39m
[31m+   ) => {[39m
[31m+     const rows = [...classifiedStageRows][39m
[31m+       .map((row) => ({ row, points: getPoints(row) }))[39m
[31m+       .filter((entry) => entry.points > 0)[39m
[31m+       .sort([39m
[31m+         (left, right) =>[39m
[31m+           right.points - left.points ||[39m
[31m+           Number(left.row.rank ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) -[39m
[31m+             Number(right.row.rank ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     rows.forEach((entry, index) => {[39m
[31m+       classifications.push([39m
[31m+         baseRiderRow([39m
[31m+           entry.row,[39m
[31m+           type,[39m
[31m+           index + 1,[39m
[31m+           null,[39m
[31m+           null,[39m
[31m+           entry.points[39m
[31m+         )[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   buildPointClassification([39m
[31m+     'points',[39m
[31m+     (row) => Number(row.finish_points ?? 0) + Number(row.sprint_points ?? 0)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   buildPointClassification([39m
[31m+     'mountain',[39m
[31m+     (row) => Number(row.mountain_points ?? 0)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const youngRows = generalRows.filter((row) =>[39m
[31m+     row.rider_id[39m
[31m+       ? participantRiderById.get(row.rider_id)?.is_young_rider === true[39m
[31m+       : false[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const youngLeaderTime = youngRows.length > 0 ? adjustedTime(youngRows[0]) : 0[39m
[31m+   youngRows.forEach((row, index) => {[39m
[31m+     const time = adjustedTime(row)[39m
[31m+     classifications.push([39m
[31m+       baseRiderRow([39m
[31m+         row,[39m
[31m+         'young',[39m
[31m+         index + 1,[39m
[31m+         time,[39m
[31m+         time - youngLeaderTime,[39m
[31m+         null[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const teamTimes = new Map<string, number[]>()[39m
[31m+   classifiedStageRows.forEach((row) => {[39m
[31m+     if (!row.team_id) return[39m
[31m+     const values = teamTimes.get(row.team_id) ?? [][39m
[31m+     values.push(adjustedTime(row))[39m
[31m+     teamTimes.set(row.team_id, values)[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+   const rankedTeams = [...teamTimes.entries()][39m
[31m+     .map(([teamId, times]) => ({[39m
[31m+       teamId,[39m
[31m+       totalTime: [...times][39m
[31m+         .sort((left, right) => left - right)[39m
[31m+         .slice(0, 3)[39m
[31m+         .reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0),[39m
[31m+     }))[39m
[31m+     .sort([39m
[31m+       (left, right) =>[39m
[31m+         left.totalTime - right.totalTime ||[39m
[31m+         left.teamId.localeCompare(right.teamId)[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   const teamLeaderTime = rankedTeams[0]?.totalTime ?? 0[39m
[31m+   rankedTeams.forEach((entry, index) => {[39m
[31m+     const team = teamById.get(entry.teamId)[39m
[31m+     classifications.push({[39m
[31m+       classification_type: 'team',[39m
[31m+       entity_type: 'team',[39m
[31m+       rank: index + 1,[39m
[31m+       previous_rank: null,[39m
[31m+       rider_id: null,[39m
[31m+       team_id: entry.teamId,[39m
[31m+       display_name_snapshot: team?.snapshot.teamName ?? entry.teamId,[39m
[31m+       team_name_snapshot: team?.snapshot.teamName ?? entry.teamId,[39m
[31m+       total_time_seconds: entry.totalTime,[39m
[31m+       gap_seconds: entry.totalTime - teamLeaderTime,[39m
[31m+       points: null,[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return classifications[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function UniversalRaceReplayPage({[39m
[31m+   race,[39m
[31m+   stage,[39m
[31m+   participantTeams,[39m
[31m+   onClose,[39m
[31m+   onShadowPreview,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   race: Race[39m
[31m+   stage: RaceStage[39m
[31m+   participantTeams: RaceParticipantTeam[][39m
[31m+   onClose: () => void[39m
[31m+   onShadowPreview?: (preview: RaceStageResultsOverride) => void[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const [profile, setProfile] = useState<StageProfileDetailPayload | null>(null)[39m
[31m+   const [inputSource, setInputSource] = useState<UniversalReplayInputSource>([39m
[31m+     'production_authoritative_pending'[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const [authoritativePayload, setAuthoritativePayload] =[39m
[31m+     useState<UniversalAuthoritativeReplayPayload | null>(null)[39m
[31m+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)[39m
[31m+   const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null)[39m
[31m+   const [replayProgress, setReplayProgress] = useState(0)[39m
[31m+   const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false)[39m
[31m+   const [playbackSpeed, setPlaybackSpeed] = useState<1 | 2 | 4 | 8>(1)[39m
[31m+   const [preStageStandingByRiderId, setPreStageStandingByRiderId] = useState<[39m
[31m+     Record<string, ReplayPreStageStanding>[39m
[31m+   >({})[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     let cancelled = false[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     async function loadUniversalReplayData(): Promise<void> {[39m
[31m+       setLoading(true)[39m
[31m+       setLoadError(null)[39m
[31m+       setAuthoritativePayload(null)[39m
[31m+       setInputSource('production_authoritative_pending')[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const [profileResponse, authoritativeResponse] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         raceDetailReadRpc('get_race_stage_profile_detail_v1', {[39m
[31m+           p_stage_id: stage.id,[39m
[31m+         }),[39m
[31m+         raceDetailReadRpc('get_universal_race_stage_replay_payload_v1', {[39m
[31m+           p_stage_id: stage.id,[39m
[31m+         }),[39m
[31m+       ])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (cancelled) return[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (profileResponse.error) {[39m
[31m+         setProfile(null)[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         try {[39m
[31m+           setProfile(normalizeStageProfileDetailPayload(profileResponse.data))[39m
[31m+         } catch {[39m
[31m+           setProfile(null)[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (authoritativeResponse.error) {[39m
[31m+         setAuthoritativePayload(null)[39m
[31m+         setLoadError([39m
[31m+           'Replay could not be loaded. Please try again shortly.'[39m
[31m+         )[39m
[31m+         setLoading(false)[39m
[31m+         return[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const authoritativeValue = Array.isArray(authoritativeResponse.data)[39m
[31m+         ? authoritativeResponse.data[0][39m
[31m+         : authoritativeResponse.data[39m
[31m+       const nextAuthoritativePayload =[39m
[31m+         authoritativeValue &&[39m
[31m+         typeof authoritativeValue === 'object' &&[39m
[31m+         !Array.isArray(authoritativeValue)[39m
[31m+           ? (authoritativeValue as UniversalAuthoritativeReplayPayload)[39m
[31m+           : null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       setAuthoritativePayload(nextAuthoritativePayload)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const authoritativeInput = nextAuthoritativePayload?.input_snapshot[39m
[31m+       const authoritativeResult =[39m
[31m+         nextAuthoritativePayload?.output_snapshot?.universalResult[39m
[31m+       const hasAuthoritativeReplay =[39m
[31m+         nextAuthoritativePayload?.status === 'available' &&[39m
[31m+         nextAuthoritativePayload?.output_snapshot?.contractVersion ===[39m
[31m+           'universal_race_stage_output_v1' &&[39m
[31m+         authoritativeInput?.race?.raceId === race.id &&[39m
[31m+         authoritativeInput?.stage?.stageId === stage.id &&[39m
[31m+         authoritativeResult?.raceId === race.id &&[39m
[31m+         authoritativeResult?.stageId === stage.id[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (hasAuthoritativeReplay) {[39m
[31m+         setInputSource('production_authoritative_run')[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         setInputSource('production_authoritative_pending')[39m
[31m+         const status = String(nextAuthoritativePayload?.status ?? 'not_available')[39m
[31m+         if (status === 'not_open') {[39m
[31m+           setLoadError(null)[39m
[31m+         } else if (status === 'not_available') {[39m
[31m+           setLoadError([39m
[31m+             'Replay is not available yet.'[39m
[31m+           )[39m
[31m+         } else {[39m
[31m+           setLoadError([39m
[31m+             'Replay is unavailable for this stage.'[39m
[31m+           )[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       setLoading(false)[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     void loadUniversalReplayData()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return () => {[39m
[31m+       cancelled = true[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }, [race.id, stage.id])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const shadowBuild = useMemo<UniversalShadowBuild>(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (inputSource === 'production_authoritative_run') {[39m
[31m+       const input = authoritativePayload?.input_snapshot ?? null[39m
[31m+       const result =[39m
[31m+         authoritativePayload?.output_snapshot?.universalResult ?? null[39m
[31m+       if (!input || !result) {[39m
[31m+         return {[39m
[31m+           input: null,[39m
[31m+           result: null,[39m
[31m+           error: 'Replay data is incomplete.',[39m
[31m+           warnings: [],[39m
[31m+           source: inputSource,[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       if ([39m
[31m+         input.race.raceId !== race.id ||[39m
[31m+         input.stage.stageId !== stage.id ||[39m
[31m+         result.raceId !== race.id ||[39m
[31m+         result.stageId !== stage.id[39m
[31m+       ) {[39m
[31m+         return {[39m
[31m+           input: null,[39m
[31m+           result: null,[39m
[31m+           error: 'Replay data does not match this stage.',[39m
[31m+           warnings: [],[39m
[31m+           source: inputSource,[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       const replayCanProgress =[39m
[31m+         result.replaySynchronization.synchronized ||[39m
[31m+         result.replayProgressGuarantee?.canProgress === true[39m
[31m+       if (!replayCanProgress) {[39m
[31m+         return {[39m
[31m+           input: null,[39m
[31m+           result: null,[39m
[31m+           error: 'Replay data could not be synchronized.',[39m
[31m+           warnings: [],[39m
[31m+           source: inputSource,[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+       return {[39m
[31m+         input,[39m
[31m+         result,[39m
[31m+         error: null,[39m
[31m+         warnings:[39m
[31m+           result.replayProgressGuarantee?.mode === 'degraded'[39m
[31m+             ? ['Replay is available with simplified playback for this stage.'][39m
[31m+             : [],[39m
[31m+         source: inputSource,[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (loading) {[39m
[31m+       return {[39m
[31m+         input: null,[39m
[31m+         result: null,[39m
[31m+         error: null,[39m
[31m+         warnings: [],[39m
[31m+         source: inputSource,[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       input: null,[39m
[31m+       result: null,[39m
[31m+       error: loadError,[39m
[31m+       warnings:[39m
[31m+         authoritativePayload?.status === 'not_open'[39m
[31m+           ? [[39m
[31m+               'Replay will be available at the scheduled stage time.',[39m
[31m+             ][39m
[31m+           : [],[39m
[31m+       source: inputSource,[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }, [authoritativePayload, inputSource, loadError, loading, race.id, stage.id])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const replayFrames = useMemo([39m
[31m+     () => shadowBuild.result?.replayTimeline.checkpoints ?? [],[39m
[31m+     [shadowBuild.result][39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const terrainReplayTimingModel = useMemo(() => {[39m
[31m+     const distanceKm = Math.max(1, Number(stage.distance_km ?? 1))[39m
[31m+     const profilePoints = profile?.profile_points?.length[39m
[31m+       ? profile.profile_points[39m
[31m+       : [[39m
[31m+           { km: 0, elevation: 0 },[39m
[31m+           { km: distanceKm, elevation: 0 },[39m
[31m+         ][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return buildTerrainReplayTimingModel(profilePoints, distanceKm)[39m
[31m+   }, [profile, stage.distance_km])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const distanceReplayProgress = useMemo([39m
[31m+     () =>[39m
[31m+       getTerrainAwareDistanceProgressFraction([39m
[31m+         replayProgress,[39m
[31m+         terrainReplayTimingModel[39m
[31m+       ),[39m
[31m+     [replayProgress, terrainReplayTimingModel][39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     setReplayProgress(0)[39m
[31m+     setPlaying(false)[39m
[31m+   }, [shadowBuild.result])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (!playing || replayFrames.length < 2) return[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const intervalMilliseconds = 100[39m
[31m+     const replayDurationAtOneTimesMilliseconds = 15 * 60 * 1000[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const intervalId = window.setInterval(() => {[39m
[31m+       setReplayProgress((current) => {[39m
[31m+         const next = Math.min([39m
[31m+           1,[39m
[31m+           current +[39m
[31m+             (intervalMilliseconds /[39m
[31m+               replayDurationAtOneTimesMilliseconds) *[39m
[31m+               playbackSpeed[39m
[31m+         )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         if (next >= 1) {[39m
[31m+           window.clearInterval(intervalId)[39m
[31m+           setPlaying(false)[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         return next[39m
[31m+       })[39m
[31m+     }, intervalMilliseconds)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return () => window.clearInterval(intervalId)[39m
[31m+   }, [[39m
[31m+     playing,[39m
[31m+     playbackSpeed,[39m
[31m+     replayFrames.length,[39m
[31m+   ])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const input = shadowBuild.input[39m
[31m+   const result = shadowBuild.result[39m
[31m+   const durationSeconds = result[39m
[31m+     ? getUniversalReplayDurationSeconds(result)[39m
[31m+     : 0[39m
[31m+   const currentRaceSecond = durationSeconds * replayProgress[39m
[31m+   const currentKm =[39m
[31m+     (input?.stage.distanceKm ?? Number(stage.distance_km ?? 0)) *[39m
[31m+     distanceReplayProgress[39m
[31m+   const framePair = useMemo([39m
[31m+     () =>[39m
[31m+       getUniversalReplayFramePair([39m
[31m+         replayFrames,[39m
[31m+         distanceReplayProgress[39m
[31m+       ),[39m
[31m+     [distanceReplayProgress, replayFrames][39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const currentFrame =[39m
[31m+     framePair.previous ??[39m
[31m+     replayFrames[0] ??[39m
[31m+     null[39m
[31m+   const nextFrame =[39m
[31m+     framePair.next ??[39m
[31m+     currentFrame[39m
[31m+   const resultsVisible = currentFrame?.finalResultsVisible === true[39m
[31m+   const replayWinnerName =[39m
[31m+     resultsVisible[39m
[31m+       ? input?.riders.find([39m
[31m+           (rider) =>[39m
[31m+             rider.riderId === result?.finishResolution.winnerRiderId[39m
[31m+         )?.snapshot.displayName ??[39m
[31m+         result?.finishResolution.winnerRiderId ??[39m
[31m+         '—'[39m
[31m+       : 'Hidden until finish'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const teamInputById = useMemo([39m
[31m+     () =>[39m
[31m+       new Map([39m
[31m+         input?.teams.map((team) => [team.teamId, team] as const) ?? [][39m

[31m+         }[39m

[31m+         nextByRiderId[row.rider_id] = current[39m

[31m+       if (!cancelled) {[39m
[31m+         setPreStageStandingByRiderId(nextByRiderId)[39m

[31m+                               </div>[39m

[31m+                                 {replayProgress <= 0[39m
[31m+                                   ? '—'[39m
[31m+                                   : resultsVisible[39m
[31m+                                     ? row.status !== 'finished'[39m

[31m+                                           row.gapSeconds[39m
[31m+                                         )}`}[39m
[31m+                               </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+                               <div className="min-w-0 border-l border-slate-200 px-2.5 leading-tight">[39m
[31m+                                 <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-700">[39m
[31m+                                   <span>GC: {preStage?.generalRank ?? '—'}</span>[39m
[31m+                                   <span className="text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+                                     {preStage[39m
[31m+                                       ? formatClassificationGap([39m
[31m+                                           preStage.generalGapSeconds[39m
[31m+                                         )[39m
[31m+                                       : '—'}[39m
[31m+                                   </span>[39m
[31m+                                 </div>[39m
[31m+                                 <div className="mt-1 whitespace-nowrap text-[9px] text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+                                   KOM {preStage?.mountainPoints ?? 0}[39m
[31m+                                   {' · '}SPR {preStage?.sprintPoints ?? 0}[39m
[31m+                                 </div>[39m
[31m+                               </div>[39m
[31m+                             </div>[39m
[31m+                           )[39m
[31m+                         })}[39m
[31m+                       </div>[39m
[31m+                     )}[39m
[31m+                   </div>[39m
[31m+                 </aside>[39m
[31m+               </section>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+               <section className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm">[39m
[31m+                 <SimpleReplayStagePointsPanel[39m
[31m+                   pointResults={pointResults}[39m
[31m+                   stagePoints={effectiveStagePoints}[39m
[31m+                   currentKm={currentKm}[39m
[31m+                 />[39m
[31m+               </section>[39m
[31m+             </>[39m
[31m+           ) : loading ? ([39m
[31m+             <div className="rounded-2xl bg-white px-4 py-12 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+               Loading universal engine inputs…[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+           ) : ([39m
[31m+             <div className="rounded-2xl bg-white px-4 py-12 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+               Universal engine calculation is not available for this stage.[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+           )}[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function RaceStageProfilePanel({[39m
[31m+   selectedStageId,[39m
[31m+   classificationResultsStageId,[39m
[31m+   selectedStage,[39m
[31m+   race,[39m
[31m+   currentGameDate,[39m
[31m+   currentClubId,[39m
[31m+   viewerClubFamilyIds,[39m
[31m+   participantTeams,[39m
[31m+   hideLiveResults,[39m
[31m+   onOpenReplay,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   selectedStageId: string | null[39m
[31m+   classificationResultsStageId: string | null[39m
[31m+   selectedStage: RaceStage | null[39m
[31m+   race: Race | null[39m
[31m+   currentGameDate: string | null[39m
[31m+   currentClubId?: string | null[39m
[31m+   viewerClubFamilyIds?: string[][39m
[31m+   participantTeams: RaceParticipantTeam[][39m
[31m+   hideLiveResults: boolean[39m
[31m+   onOpenReplay: (stage: RaceStage) => void[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const [profile, setProfile] = useState<StageProfileDetailPayload | null>(null)[39m
[31m+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)[39m
[31m+   const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (!selectedStageId) {[39m
[31m+       setProfile(null)[39m
[31m+       setLoading(false)[39m
[31m+       setErrorMessage(null)[39m
[31m+       return[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     let cancelled = false[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     async function loadProfile() {[39m
[31m+       setLoading(true)[39m
[31m+       setErrorMessage(null)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const { data, error } = await raceDetailReadRpc('get_race_stage_profile_detail_v1', {[39m
[31m+         p_stage_id: selectedStageId,[39m
[31m+       })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (cancelled) return[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (error) {[39m
[31m+         setProfile(null)[39m
[31m+         setErrorMessage(error.message)[39m
[31m+         setLoading(false)[39m
[31m+         return[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       setProfile(normalizeStageProfileDetailPayload(data))[39m
[31m+       setLoading(false)[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     loadProfile()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return () => {[39m
[31m+       cancelled = true[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }, [selectedStageId])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (loading) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm">[39m
[31m+         <div className="text-sm text-slate-500">Loading stage profile…</div>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (errorMessage) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className="rounded-3xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 p-6 text-sm text-rose-700">[39m
[31m+         {errorMessage}[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!profile || !profile.has_profile) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm">[39m
[31m+         <div className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+           Stage profile[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+         <div className="mt-4 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 px-4 py-8 text-sm text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+           Stage profile data is not available yet.[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const profileTerrainSplit: RaceTerrainSplit = profile.terrain_split ?? DEFAULT_TERRAIN_SPLIT[39m
[31m+   const isTimeTrialProfileStage = isTimeTrialLikeStage(selectedStage)[39m
[31m+   const isTeamTimeTrialProfileStage = isTeamTimeTrialLikeStage(selectedStage)[39m
[31m+   const allowSmallTimeTrialFinishPoints =[39m
[31m+     isPrologueOrIndividualTimeTrialStage(selectedStage)[39m
[31m+   const finishPoint = (selectedStage?.points ?? []).find((point) => point.point_type === 'FINISH')[39m
[31m+   const finishMarker = (profile.route_markers ?? []).find([39m
[31m+     (marker) => marker.type.toLowerCase() === 'finish'[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const finishPointRecord = finishPoint ? getRecord(finishPoint) : {}[39m
[31m+   const finishPointMetadata = getRecord(finishPointRecord.metadata)[39m
[31m+   const finishPointType = [[39m
[31m+     finishPointRecord.finish_type,[39m
[31m+     finishPointMetadata.finish_type,[39m
[31m+     selectedStage?.finish_type,[39m
[31m+   ][39m
[31m+     .find((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string')[39m
[31m+     ?.toLowerCase()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const mountainClimbs = profile.mountain_climbs ?? [][39m
[31m+   const fallbackFinishKm =[39m
[31m+     asNumber([39m
[31m+       finishPoint?.km_from_start ??[39m
[31m+         (finishPointRecord.km as number | string | null | undefined)[39m
[31m+     ) ??[39m
[31m+     asNumber(finishMarker?.km) ??[39m
[31m+     profile.distance_km[39m
[31m+   const stageFinishKm = Number(selectedStage?.distance_km ?? profile.distance_km)[39m
[31m+   const finishKm = Number.isFinite(stageFinishKm) ? stageFinishKm : fallbackFinishKm[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const hasMountainFinish = mountainClimbs.some((climb) =>[39m
[31m+     isSameKm(climb.km, finishKm)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const visibleMountainClimbs = mountainClimbs.filter((climb) => {[39m
[31m+     if (!hasMountainFinish) return true[39m
[31m+     return !isSameKm(climb.km, finishKm)[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const finishClimb = hasMountainFinish[39m
[31m+     ? mountainClimbs.find((climb) => isSameKm(climb.km, finishKm)) ?? null[39m
[31m+     : getFinishClimb(mountainClimbs, finishKm)[39m
[31m+   const finishClimbCategory = formatProfileDetailValue(finishClimb?.['category']).toLowerCase()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const finishIsMountain = Boolean([39m
[31m+     hasMountainFinish ||[39m
[31m+       selectedStage?.is_summit_finish ||[39m
[31m+       finishPointType?.includes('mountain') ||[39m
[31m+       finishClimb ||[39m
[31m+       finishClimbCategory.includes('cat')[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const finishPointHasConfiguredPoints = hasConfiguredPointValues([39m
[31m+     finishPoint?.points_scheme[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const shouldShowFinishCard = isTeamTimeTrialProfileStage[39m
[31m+     ? false[39m
[31m+     : isTimeTrialProfileStage[39m
[31m+       ? allowSmallTimeTrialFinishPoints || finishPointHasConfiguredPoints[39m
[31m+       : Boolean([39m
[31m+           finishPoint || finishMarker || profile.distance_km !== null || selectedStage?.finish_city[39m
[31m+         )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const stagePoints = (isTimeTrialProfileStage[39m
[31m+     ? [][39m
[31m+     : [[39m
[31m+         ...(profile.intermediate_sprints ?? []).map((sprint, index) => ({[39m
[31m+           ...sprint,[39m
[31m+           pointType: 'sprint' as const,[39m
[31m+           sortKm: toKmNumber(sprint.km),[39m
[31m+           sortIndex: index,[39m
[31m+         })),[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         ...(visibleMountainClimbs ?? []).map((climb, index) => ({[39m
[31m+           ...climb,[39m
[31m+           pointType: 'kom' as const,[39m
[31m+           sortKm: toKmNumber(climb.km),[39m
[31m+           sortIndex: index,[39m
[31m+         })),[39m
[31m+       ][39m
[31m+   ).sort((a, b) => {[39m
[31m+     if (a.sortKm !== b.sortKm) return a.sortKm - b.sortKm[39m
[31m+     return a.sortIndex - b.sortIndex[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function FinishSprintCard() {[39m
[31m+     if (!shouldShowFinishCard) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <StageFinishPointCard[39m
[31m+         isMountainFinish={finishIsMountain}[39m
[31m+         finishKm={finishKm}[39m
[31m+         finishPoint={finishPoint}[39m
[31m+         finishClimb={finishClimb}[39m
[31m+         suppressTimeBonuses={isTimeTrialProfileStage}[39m
[31m+         allowDefaultFinishPoints={!isTeamTimeTrialProfileStage}[39m
[31m+         defaultFinishPointsScheme={[39m
[31m+           allowSmallTimeTrialFinishPoints[39m
[31m+             ? DEFAULT_TIME_TRIAL_FINISH_POINTS_SCHEME[39m
[31m+             : DEFAULT_FINISH_POINTS_SCHEME[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       />[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_360px]">[39m
[31m+       <div className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm">[39m
[31m+         <div className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+           Stage profile[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <div className="mt-4">[39m
[31m+           <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 xl:flex-row xl:items-start xl:justify-between">[39m
[31m+             <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">[39m
[31m+               <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-slate-950">[39m
[31m+                 {profile.stage_title ?? `Stage ${profile.stage_number}`}[39m
[31m+               </h3>[39m
[31m+               <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">{profile.route_label ?? 'Route TBD'}</p>[39m
[31m+               {profile.stage_summary ? ([39m
[31m+                 <p className="mt-3 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">[39m
[31m+                   {profile.stage_summary}[39m
[31m+                 </p>[39m
[31m+               ) : null}[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             <div className="grid min-w-[280px] grid-cols-2 gap-x-8 gap-y-3 xl:pt-1">[39m
[31m+               <div>[39m
[31m+                 <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">Distance</div>[39m
[31m+                 <div className="mt-1 font-semibold text-slate-950">[39m
[31m+                   {formatKm(profile.distance_km)}[39m
[31m+                 </div>[39m
[31m+               </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+               <div>[39m
[31m+                 <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">Terrain</div>[39m
[31m+                 <div className="mt-1 font-semibold text-slate-950">[39m
[31m+                   {profile.terrain_type ? humanizeCode(profile.terrain_type) : '—'}[39m
[31m+                 </div>[39m
[31m+               </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+               <div>[39m
[31m+                 <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">Profile</div>[39m
[31m+                 <div className="mt-1 font-semibold text-slate-950">[39m
[31m+                   {profile.profile_type ? humanizeCode(profile.profile_type) : '—'}[39m
[31m+                 </div>[39m
[31m+               </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+               <div>[39m
[31m+                 <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">Elevation</div>[39m
[31m+                 <div className="mt-1 font-semibold text-slate-950">[39m
[31m+                   {formatMeters(profile.elevation_gain_m)}[39m
[31m+                 </div>[39m
[31m+               </div>[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         {isStageWeatherCanceled(selectedStage) ? ([39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-4">[39m
[31m+             <WeatherCancellationNotice stage={selectedStage} race={race} />[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         ) : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <div className="mt-4">[39m
[31m+           <StageProfileChart[39m
[31m+             points={profile.profile_points ?? []}[39m
[31m+             markers={profile.route_markers ?? []}[39m
[31m+             distanceKm={Number(profile.distance_km ?? 0)}[39m
[31m+             terrainType={profile.terrain_type}[39m
[31m+             mountainClimbs={profile.mountain_climbs ?? []}[39m
[31m+           />[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         {stagePoints.length > 0 || shouldShowFinishCard || !isTimeTrialProfileStage ? ([39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-6">[39m
[31m+             <section>[39m
[31m+               <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900">Stage points</h3>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+               <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">[39m
[31m+                 {stagePoints.map((point) => {[39m
[31m+                 if (point.pointType === 'sprint') {[39m
[31m+                   return ([39m
[31m+                     <SprintCard[39m
[31m+                       key={`sprint-${point.sortKm}-${point.sortIndex}`}[39m
[31m+                       sprint={point}[39m
[31m+                     />[39m
[31m+                   )[39m
[31m+                 }[39m

[31m+           </div>[39m

[31m+           stage={selectedStage}[39m
[31m+           currentClubId={currentClubId}[39m
[31m+           viewerClubFamilyIds={viewerClubFamilyIds}[39m
[31m+           participantTeams={participantTeams}[39m
[31m+           currentGameDate={currentGameDate}[39m

[31m+         />[39m

[31m+[39m

[31m+           <StageWeatherCard stage={selectedStage} currentGameDate={currentGameDate} />[39m
[31m+         ) : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         {race && !hideLiveResults ? ([39m

[31m+             race={race}[39m
[31m+             classificationResultsStageId={classificationResultsStageId}[39m
[31m+           />[39m
[31m+         ) : null}[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   )[39m

[31m+ function assertRaceDetailReadOnlyRpc(functionName: string) {[39m
[31m+   const normalizedName = functionName.trim()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const looksLikeForbiddenEngineMutation =[39m
[31m+     normalizedName.startsWith('run_race_stage_') ||[39m
[31m+     normalizedName.startsWith('race_engine_admin_') ||[39m
[31m+     normalizedName.startsWith('race_engine_process_') ||[39m
[31m+     normalizedName.startsWith('race_engine_closeout_') ||[39m
[31m+     normalizedName.startsWith('race_engine_write_') ||[39m
[31m+     normalizedName.startsWith('race_engine_apply_') ||[39m
[31m+     normalizedName.startsWith('race_engine_finalize_') ||[39m
[31m+     normalizedName.startsWith('race_engine_pay_') ||[39m
[31m+     normalizedName.startsWith('generate_race_ranking_') ||[39m
[31m+     normalizedName.startsWith('generate_race_prize_') ||[39m
[31m+     normalizedName === 'sync_race_stage_points_from_stage_json_v1'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if ([39m
[31m+     RACE_DETAIL_FORBIDDEN_ENGINE_RPC_NAMES.has(normalizedName) ||[39m
[31m+     looksLikeForbiddenEngineMutation[39m
[31m+   ) {[39m
[31m+     throw new Error([39m
[31m+       `RaceDetailPage is read-only. Forbidden race-engine RPC blocked: ${normalizedName}`[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ type ViewerTeamComparableRow = {[39m
[31m+   team_id?: string | null[39m
[31m+   club_id?: string | null[39m
[31m+   teamId?: string | null[39m
[31m+   clubId?: string | null[39m
[31m+   race_team_entry_id?: string | null[39m
[31m+   team?: { id?: string | null } | null[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type ViewerTeamIdSource =[39m
[31m+   | string[39m
[31m+   | null[39m
[31m+   | undefined[39m
[31m+   | Array<string | null | undefined>[39m
[31m+   | Set<string>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getViewerTeamId(currentClubId?: string | null): string {[39m
[31m+   return currentClubId ?? DEFAULT_CURRENT_CLUB_ID[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeViewerTeamIds([39m
[31m+   viewerTeamIds?: ViewerTeamIdSource[39m
[31m+ ): Set<string> {[39m
[31m+   const rawValues =[39m
[31m+     viewerTeamIds instanceof Set[39m
[31m+       ? Array.from(viewerTeamIds)[39m
[31m+       : Array.isArray(viewerTeamIds)[39m
[31m+         ? viewerTeamIds[39m
[31m+         : [viewerTeamIds][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return new Set([39m
[31m+     rawValues[39m
[31m+       .map((value) => value?.trim())[39m
[31m+       .filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value))[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getViewerTeamIds([39m
[31m+   currentClubId?: string | null,[39m
[31m+   viewerClubFamilyIds?: Array<string | null | undefined>[39m
[31m+ ): string[] {[39m
[31m+   return Array.from([39m
[31m+     normalizeViewerTeamIds([[39m
[31m+       currentClubId ?? DEFAULT_CURRENT_CLUB_ID,[39m
[31m+       ...(viewerClubFamilyIds ?? []),[39m
[31m+     ])[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getComparableTeamIds(row: ViewerTeamComparableRow): string[] {[39m
[31m+   return Array.from([39m
[31m+     normalizeViewerTeamIds([[39m
[31m+       row.team_id,[39m
[31m+       row.club_id,[39m
[31m+       row.teamId,[39m
[31m+       row.clubId,[39m
[31m+       row.race_team_entry_id,[39m
[31m+       row.team?.id,[39m
[31m+     ])[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function isViewerTeamRow([39m
[31m+   row: ViewerTeamComparableRow,[39m
[31m+   viewerTeamIds?: ViewerTeamIdSource[39m
[31m+ ): boolean {[39m
[31m+   const viewerIds = normalizeViewerTeamIds(viewerTeamIds)[39m
[31m+   if (viewerIds.size === 0) return false[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return getComparableTeamIds(row).some((rowTeamId) => viewerIds.has(rowTeamId))[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function viewerTeamRowClass([39m
[31m+   row: ViewerTeamComparableRow,[39m
[31m+   viewerTeamIds?: ViewerTeamIdSource[39m
[31m+ ): string {[39m
[31m+   return isViewerTeamRow(row, viewerTeamIds)[39m
[31m+     ? VIEWER_TEAM_ROW_HIGHLIGHT_CLASS[39m
[31m+     : 'bg-white'[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+   title: string[39m
[31m+   description?: string[39m
[31m+   defaultOpen?: boolean[39m
[31m+   children: React.ReactNode[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const [open, setOpen] = useState(defaultOpen)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <section className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm">[39m
[31m+       <button[39m
[31m+         type="button"[39m
[31m+         onClick={() => setOpen((value) => !value)}[39m
[31m+         className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-4 px-6 py-5 text-left"[39m
[31m+       >[39m
[31m+         <div>[39m
[31m+           <div className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+             {eyebrow}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+           <h3 className="mt-1 text-lg font-semibold text-slate-950">{title}</h3>[39m
[31m+           {description ? ([39m
[31m+             <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">{description}</p>[39m
[31m+           ) : null}[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <span className="rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600">[39m
[31m+           {open ? 'Hide' : 'Show'}[39m
[31m+         </span>[39m
[31m+       </button>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {open ? <div className="border-t border-slate-100 p-6">{children}</div> : null}[39m
[31m+     </section>[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function isUuid(value: unknown): value is string {[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     typeof value === 'string' &&[39m
[31m+     /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test([39m
[31m+       value,[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function extractUuidFromText(value: unknown): string | null {[39m
[31m+   if (typeof value !== 'string') return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const match = value.match([39m
[31m+     /[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}/i,[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return isUuid(match?.[0]) ? match[0] : null[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function useRaceIdFromRoute(): string | null {[39m
[31m+   const params = useParams()[39m
[31m+   const location = useLocation()[39m
[31m+   const [searchParams] = useSearchParams()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const candidates = [[39m
[31m+     params.raceId,[39m
[31m+     searchParams.get('raceId'),[39m
[31m+     location.pathname,[39m
[31m+     location.search,[39m
[31m+     location.hash,[39m
[31m+   ][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {[39m
[31m+     candidates.push([39m
[31m+       window.location.pathname,[39m
[31m+       window.location.search,[39m
[31m+       window.location.hash,[39m
[31m+       window.location.href,[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (const candidate of candidates) {[39m
[31m+     if (isUuid(candidate)) return candidate[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const extracted = extractUuidFromText(candidate)[39m
[31m+     if (extracted) return extracted[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return null[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatShortDate(value?: string | null): string {[39m
[31m+   if (!value) return '—'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const date = new Date(`${value}T00:00:00`)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return value[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return date.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {[39m
[31m+     month: 'short',[39m
[31m+     day: 'numeric',[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeCountryCode(code?: string | null): string | null {[39m
[31m+   if (!code) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const normalized = code.trim().toUpperCase()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (normalized === 'UK') return 'GB'[39m
[31m+   if (!/^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(normalized)) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return normalized[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getFlagImageUrl(code?: string | null): string | null {[39m
[31m+   const normalized = normalizeCountryCode(code)[39m
[31m+   if (!normalized) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return `https://flagcdn.com/w40/${normalized.toLowerCase()}.png`[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+     setHasError(false)[39m

[31m+   if (!flagUrl || !normalized || hasError) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <span[39m
[31m+         className="inline-block h-4 w-6 shrink-0 rounded-sm border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 align-middle"[39m
[31m+         title={normalized ?? 'Unknown country'}[39m
[31m+         aria-label={normalized ?? 'Unknown country'}[39m
[31m+       />[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <img[39m
[31m+       src={flagUrl}[39m
[31m+       alt={normalized}[39m
[31m+       title={normalized}[39m
[31m+       className="inline-block h-4 w-6 shrink-0 rounded-sm border border-slate-200 object-cover align-middle"[39m
[31m+       loading="lazy"[39m
[31m+       onError={() => setHasError(true)}[39m
[31m+     />[39m
[31m+   )[39m

[31m+ function getTeamInitials(name?: string | null): string {[39m
[31m+   const cleanName = name?.trim()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!cleanName) return 'TM'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const words = cleanName[39m
[31m+     .split(/\s+/)[39m
[31m+     .filter(Boolean)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (words.length === 1) {[39m
[31m+     return words[0].slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return `${words[0][0] ?? ''}${words[1][0] ?? ''}`.toUpperCase()[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+   return team.club_name?.trim() || team.team_name_snapshot?.trim() || 'Team'[39m
[31m+ }[39m
