[31m+                           <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-semibold">[39m
[31m+                             {isFinished ? formatRaceClock(row.elapsed_seconds) : '—'}[39m
[31m+                           </td>[39m
[31m+                           <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right text-slate-600">[39m
[31m+                             {isFinished[39m
[31m+                               ? row.rank === 1[39m
[31m+                                 ? 'Leader'[39m
[31m+                                 : gapSeconds === 0[39m
[31m+                                   ? 's.t.'[39m
[31m+                                   : gapSeconds !== null[39m
[31m+                                     ? `+${formatGapValue(gapSeconds)}`[39m
[31m+                                     : '—'[39m
[31m+                               : '—'}[39m
[31m+                           </td>[39m
[31m+                           <td className="px-3 py-3 font-semibold text-slate-700">[39m

[31m+                       )[39m
[31m+                     })}[39m
[31m+                   </tbody>[39m
[31m+                 </table>[39m
[31m+               )}[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+ function RaceClassificationTable({[39m
[31m+   rows,[39m
[31m+   view,[39m
[31m+   participantTeams,[39m
[31m+   currentClubId,[39m
[31m+   viewerClubFamilyIds,[39m
[31m+   onOpenTeamProfile,[39m
[31m+   onOpenRiderProfile,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   rows: RaceClassificationRow[][39m
[31m+   view: ClassificationView[39m
[31m+   participantTeams: RaceParticipantTeam[][39m
[31m+   currentClubId?: string | null[39m
[31m+   viewerClubFamilyIds?: string[][39m
[31m+   onOpenTeamProfile: (teamId: string) => void[39m
[31m+   onOpenRiderProfile: (riderId: string) => void[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   if (rows.length === 0) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl bg-white p-4 text-sm text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+         No classification data available for this view.[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const isPointsView = view === 'points' || view === 'mountain'[39m
[31m+   const columnCount = isPointsView ? 4 : 5[39m
[31m+   const viewerTeamId = getViewerTeamId(currentClubId)[39m
[31m+   const viewerTeamIds = getViewerTeamIds(viewerTeamId, viewerClubFamilyIds)[39m
[31m+   const userRiderIds = getUserRiderIdSet(participantTeams, viewerTeamIds)[39m
[31m+   const participantRiderById = new Map([39m
[31m+     participantTeams.flatMap((team) =>[39m
[31m+       team.riders.map([39m
[31m+         (rider) => [rider.rider_id, rider] as const[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const { topRows, extraUserRows } = buildTopRowsWithUserExtras([39m
[31m+     rows,[39m
[31m+     (row) => {[39m
[31m+       if (row.entity_type === 'team') {[39m
[31m+         return isViewerTeamRow(row, viewerTeamIds)[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return Boolean([39m
[31m+         (row.rider_id && userRiderIds.has(row.rider_id)) ||[39m
[31m+           isViewerTeamRow(row, viewerTeamIds)[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     },[39m
[31m+     15[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const getFullClassificationRiderName = (row: RaceClassificationRow): string => {[39m
[31m+     const participantRider = row.rider_id[39m
[31m+       ? participantRiderById.get(row.rider_id)[39m
[31m+       : null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       participantRider?.rider_full_name?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       row.display_name_snapshot?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       participantRider?.rider_name_snapshot?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       '—'[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const renderLinkedRiderName = (row: RaceClassificationRow) => {[39m
[31m+     const label = getFullClassificationRiderName(row)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (!row.rider_id) {[39m
[31m+       return <span className={RESULT_RIDER_NAME_ONE_LINE_CLASS}>{label}</span>[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <button[39m
[31m+         type="button"[39m
[31m+         onClick={() => onOpenRiderProfile(row.rider_id as string)}[39m
[31m+         className={RESULT_RIDER_NAME_ONE_LINE_CLASS}[39m
[31m+         title={label}[39m
[31m+       >[39m
[31m+         {label}[39m
[31m+       </button>[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const renderLinkedTeamName = (teamId?: string | null, label?: string | null) => ([39m
[31m+     <ResultTeamJerseyCell[39m
[31m+       teamId={teamId}[39m
[31m+       teamName={label}[39m
[31m+       participantTeams={participantTeams}[39m
[31m+       onOpenTeamProfile={onOpenTeamProfile}[39m
[31m+     />[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const renderRow = (row: RaceClassificationRow) => ([39m
[31m+     <tr[39m
[31m+       key={`${row.classification_type}-${row.entity_type}-${row.rank}-${row.rider_id ?? row.team_id ?? row.display_name_snapshot}`}[39m
[31m+       className={`${viewerTeamRowClass(row, viewerTeamIds)} border-b border-slate-100`}[39m
[31m+     >[39m
[31m+       <td className="px-3 py-3 font-semibold text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+         {row.rank ?? '—'}[39m
[31m+       </td>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <td className="px-3 py-3 font-medium text-slate-900 whitespace-nowrap">[39m
[31m+         {row.entity_type === 'team'[39m
[31m+           ? renderLinkedTeamName(row.team_id, row.display_name_snapshot)[39m
[31m+           : renderLinkedRiderName(row)}[39m
[31m+       </td>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <td className="max-w-0 px-2 py-1.5 text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+         {row.entity_type === 'team'[39m
[31m+           ? '—'[39m
[31m+           : renderLinkedTeamName(row.team_id, row.team_name_snapshot)}[39m
[31m+       </td>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-semibold text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+         {isPointsView[39m
[31m+           ? formatResultPoints(row.points)[39m
[31m+           : formatRaceClock(row.total_time_seconds)}[39m
[31m+       </td>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {!isPointsView ? ([39m
[31m+         <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+           {formatClassificationGap(row.gap_seconds)}[39m
[31m+         </td>[39m
[31m+       ) : null}[39m
[31m+     </tr>[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="mt-4 overflow-x-auto rounded-xl bg-white">[39m
[31m+       <table className="min-w-full table-fixed text-sm">[39m
[31m+         <colgroup>[39m
[31m+           <col className="w-[8%]" />[39m
[31m+           <col className={isPointsView ? 'w-[40%]' : 'w-[37%]'} />[39m
[31m+           <col className={isPointsView ? 'w-[35%]' : 'w-[32%]'} />[39m
[31m+           <col className={isPointsView ? 'w-[17%]' : 'w-[16%]'} />[39m
[31m+           {!isPointsView ? <col className="w-[7%]" /> : null}[39m
[31m+         </colgroup>[39m
[31m+         <thead>[39m
[31m+           <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 text-left text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+             <th className="px-3 py-3">#</th>[39m
[31m+             <th className="px-3 py-3">{view === 'team' ? 'Team' : 'Rider'}</th>[39m
[31m+             <th className="px-3 py-3">Team</th>[39m
[31m+             <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right">[39m
[31m+               {isPointsView ? 'Points' : 'Time'}[39m
[31m+             </th>[39m
[31m+             {!isPointsView ? ([39m
[31m+               <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right">Gap</th>[39m
[31m+             ) : null}[39m
[31m+           </tr>[39m
[31m+         </thead>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <tbody>[39m
[31m+           {topRows.map(renderRow)}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           {extraUserRows.length > 0 ? ([39m
[31m+             <EllipsisTableRow colSpan={columnCount} />[39m
[31m+           ) : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           {extraUserRows.map(renderRow)}[39m
[31m+         </tbody>[39m
[31m+       </table>[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function StageResultsTable({[39m
[31m+   rows,[39m
[31m+   participantTeams,[39m
[31m+   classificationRows,[39m
[31m+   currentClubId,[39m
[31m+   viewerClubFamilyIds,[39m
[31m+   onOpenTeamProfile,[39m
[31m+   onOpenRiderProfile,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   rows: RaceStageResultRow[][39m
[31m+   participantTeams: RaceParticipantTeam[][39m
[31m+   classificationRows?: RaceClassificationRow[][39m
[31m+   currentClubId?: string | null[39m
[31m+   viewerClubFamilyIds?: string[][39m
[31m+   onOpenTeamProfile: (teamId: string) => void[39m
[31m+   onOpenRiderProfile: (riderId: string) => void[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   if (rows.length === 0) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl bg-white p-4 text-sm text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+         No stage result data available.[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const participantRiderById = new Map([39m
[31m+     participantTeams.flatMap((team) =>[39m
[31m+       team.riders.map([39m
[31m+         (rider) => [rider.rider_id, rider] as const[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const classificationRiderNameById = new Map<string, string>()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (const classificationRow of classificationRows ?? []) {[39m
[31m+     const riderId = classificationRow.rider_id?.trim()[39m
[31m+     const displayName = classificationRow.display_name_snapshot?.trim()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (!riderId || !displayName) continue[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const existingName = classificationRiderNameById.get(riderId)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     /*[39m
[31m+      * Stage-result rows often only contain short snapshots such as[39m
[31m+      * "G. Peeters". The classification payload, however, already has[39m
[31m+      * the full display name for the same rider on the same race/stage.[39m
[31m+      * Prefer that full-name source so non-user riders are not stuck with[39m
[31m+      * initial-only names in the Stage Results table.[39m
[31m+      */[39m
[31m+     if (!existingName || displayName.length > existingName.length) {[39m
[31m+       classificationRiderNameById.set(riderId, displayName)[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function getFullStageResultRiderName([39m
[31m+     row: RaceStageResultRow[39m
[31m+   ): string {[39m
[31m+     const participantRider = row.rider_id[39m
[31m+       ? participantRiderById.get(row.rider_id)[39m
[31m+       : null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const classificationFullName = row.rider_id[39m
[31m+       ? classificationRiderNameById.get(row.rider_id)[39m
[31m+       : null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       classificationFullName?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       row.full_name?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       row.rider_full_name?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       participantRider?.rider_full_name?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       row.display_name?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       row.rider_name?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       participantRider?.rider_name_snapshot?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       row.rider_name_snapshot?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       '—'[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const sortedRows = sortRankedRows(rows)[39m
[31m+   const winnerElapsedSeconds = (() => {[39m
[31m+     const winner = sortedRows.find([39m
[31m+       (row) => row.elapsed_seconds !== null && row.elapsed_seconds !== undefined[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     const parsed = Number(winner?.elapsed_seconds)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null[39m
[31m+   })()[39m
[31m+   const viewerTeamId = getViewerTeamId(currentClubId)[39m
[31m+   const viewerTeamIds = getViewerTeamIds(viewerTeamId, viewerClubFamilyIds)[39m
[31m+   const userRiderIds = getUserRiderIdSet(participantTeams, viewerTeamIds)[39m
[31m+   const { topRows, extraUserRows } = buildTopRowsWithUserExtras([39m
[31m+     rows,[39m
[31m+     (row) =>[39m
[31m+       Boolean([39m
[31m+         (row.rider_id && userRiderIds.has(row.rider_id)) ||[39m
[31m+           isViewerTeamRow(row, viewerTeamIds)[39m
[31m+       ),[39m
[31m+     15[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const renderLinkedStageResultRiderName = (row: RaceStageResultRow) => {[39m
[31m+     const label = getFullStageResultRiderName(row)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (!row.rider_id) {[39m
[31m+       return <span className={RESULT_RIDER_NAME_ONE_LINE_CLASS}>{label}</span>[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <button[39m
[31m+         type="button"[39m
[31m+         onClick={() => onOpenRiderProfile(row.rider_id as string)}[39m
[31m+         className={RESULT_RIDER_NAME_ONE_LINE_CLASS}[39m
[31m+         title={label}[39m

[31m+         {label}[39m
[31m+       </button>[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m

[31m+     <ResultTeamJerseyCell[39m
[31m+       teamId={row.team_id}[39m
[31m+       teamName={row.team_name_snapshot}[39m
[31m+       participantTeams={participantTeams}[39m
[31m+       onOpenTeamProfile={onOpenTeamProfile}[39m
[31m+     />[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const renderRow = (row: RaceStageResultRow) => ([39m
[31m+     <tr[39m
[31m+       key={`${row.rank}-${row.rider_id}`}[39m
[31m+       className={`${viewerTeamRowClass(row, viewerTeamIds)} border-b border-slate-100`}[39m

[31m+         {row.rank ?? '—'}[39m
[31m+       </td>[39m
[31m+[39m

[31m+         {renderLinkedStageResultRiderName(row)}[39m
[31m+       </td>[39m
[31m+[39m

[31m+         {renderLinkedStageResultTeamName(row)}[39m

[31m+           {formatStageResultTime(row, winnerElapsedSeconds)}[39m

[31m+           <col className="w-[8%]" />[39m
[31m+           <col className="w-[44%]" />[39m
[31m+           <col className="w-[36%]" />[39m
[31m+           <col className="w-[12%]" />[39m
[31m+         </colgroup>[39m
[31m+         <thead>[39m
[31m+           <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 text-left text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+             <th className="px-3 py-3">#</th>[39m
[31m+             <th className="px-3 py-3">Rider</th>[39m
[31m+             <th className="px-3 py-3">Team</th>[39m
[31m+             <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right">Time</th>[39m
[31m+           </tr>[39m
[31m+         </thead>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <tbody>[39m
[31m+           {topRows.map(renderRow)}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           {extraUserRows.length > 0 ? <EllipsisTableRow colSpan={4} /> : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           {extraUserRows.map(renderRow)}[39m
[31m+         </tbody>[39m
[31m+       </table>[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <button[39m
[31m+         type="button"[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+ type BackendStageProfilePoint = {[39m
[31m+   km: number[39m
[31m+   elevation: number[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type TerrainReplaySegment = {[39m
[31m+   startKm: number[39m
[31m+   endKm: number[39m
[31m+   distanceKm: number[39m
[31m+   climbMultiplier: number[39m
[31m+   weightedDistance: number[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type TerrainReplayTimingModel = {[39m
[31m+   distanceKm: number[39m
[31m+   totalWeightedDistance: number[39m
[31m+   durationFactor: number[39m
[31m+   segments: TerrainReplaySegment[][39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getTerrainReplayClimbMultiplier(gradientPercent: number): number {[39m
[31m+   if (!Number.isFinite(gradientPercent) || gradientPercent <= 0.5) return 1[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   /*[39m
[31m+    * Flat and downhill sections keep the normal replay movement speed.[39m
[31m+    * Positive gradients consume more replay time, so the leader marker visibly[39m
[31m+    * slows on climbs without changing any authoritative race-engine result.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   return Math.min(3, 1 + (gradientPercent - 0.5) * 0.15)[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildTerrainReplayTimingModel([39m
[31m+   points: BackendStageProfilePoint[],[39m
[31m+   distanceKm: number[39m
[31m+ ): TerrainReplayTimingModel {[39m
[31m+   const safeDistanceKm = Math.max(1, Number(distanceKm) || 1)[39m
[31m+   const normalized = points[39m
[31m+     .map((point) => ({[39m
[31m+       km: Math.max(0, Math.min(safeDistanceKm, Number(point.km) || 0)),[39m
[31m+       elevation: Number(point.elevation) || 0,[39m
[31m+     }))[39m
[31m+     .sort((left, right) => left.km - right.km)[39m
[31m+     .filter([39m
[31m+       (point, index, rows) =>[39m
[31m+         index === 0 || Math.abs(point.km - rows[index - 1].km) > 0.000001[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (normalized.length === 0) {[39m
[31m+     normalized.push([39m
[31m+       { km: 0, elevation: 0 },[39m
[31m+       { km: safeDistanceKm, elevation: 0 }[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   } else {[39m
[31m+     if (normalized[0].km > 0) {[39m
[31m+       normalized.unshift({ km: 0, elevation: normalized[0].elevation })[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const last = normalized[normalized.length - 1][39m
[31m+     if (last.km < safeDistanceKm) {[39m
[31m+       normalized.push({ km: safeDistanceKm, elevation: last.elevation })[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const segments: TerrainReplaySegment[] = [][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (let index = 1; index < normalized.length; index += 1) {[39m
[31m+     const previous = normalized[index - 1][39m
[31m+     const next = normalized[index][39m
[31m+     const segmentDistanceKm = Math.max(0, next.km - previous.km)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (segmentDistanceKm <= 0) continue[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const gradientPercent =[39m
[31m+       ((next.elevation - previous.elevation) / (segmentDistanceKm * 1000)) *[39m
[31m+       100[39m
[31m+     const climbMultiplier = getTerrainReplayClimbMultiplier(gradientPercent)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     segments.push({[39m
[31m+       startKm: previous.km,[39m
[31m+       endKm: next.km,[39m
[31m+       distanceKm: segmentDistanceKm,[39m
[31m+       climbMultiplier,[39m
[31m+       weightedDistance: segmentDistanceKm * climbMultiplier,[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (segments.length === 0) {[39m
[31m+     segments.push({[39m
[31m+       startKm: 0,[39m
[31m+       endKm: safeDistanceKm,[39m
[31m+       distanceKm: safeDistanceKm,[39m
[31m+       climbMultiplier: 1,[39m
[31m+       weightedDistance: safeDistanceKm,[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const totalWeightedDistance = segments.reduce([39m
[31m+     (sum, segment) => sum + segment.weightedDistance,[39m
[31m+     0[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     distanceKm: safeDistanceKm,[39m
[31m+     totalWeightedDistance: Math.max(safeDistanceKm, totalWeightedDistance),[39m
[31m+     durationFactor: Math.max(1, totalWeightedDistance / safeDistanceKm),[39m
[31m+     segments,[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getTerrainAwareDistanceProgressFraction([39m
[31m+   elapsedFraction: number,[39m
[31m+   model: TerrainReplayTimingModel[39m
[31m+ ): number {[39m
[31m+   const normalizedElapsed = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, elapsedFraction))[39m
[31m+   const targetWeightedDistance =[39m
[31m+     normalizedElapsed * model.totalWeightedDistance[39m
[31m+   let completedWeightedDistance = 0[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (const segment of model.segments) {[39m
[31m+     const segmentEnd =[39m
[31m+       completedWeightedDistance + segment.weightedDistance[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (targetWeightedDistance <= segmentEnd) {[39m
[31m+       const segmentFraction = Math.max([39m
[31m+         0,[39m
[31m+         Math.min([39m
[31m+           1,[39m
[31m+           (targetWeightedDistance - completedWeightedDistance) /[39m
[31m+             Math.max(segment.weightedDistance, 0.000001)[39m
[31m+         )[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+       const currentKm =[39m
[31m+         segment.startKm + segment.distanceKm * segmentFraction[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return Math.max([39m
[31m+         0,[39m
[31m+         Math.min(1, currentKm / Math.max(model.distanceKm, 1))[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     completedWeightedDistance = segmentEnd[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return 1[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getTerrainAwareElapsedProgressFractionForDistance([39m
[31m+   distanceFraction: number,[39m
[31m+   model: TerrainReplayTimingModel[39m
[31m+ ): number {[39m
[31m+   const normalizedDistance = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, distanceFraction))[39m
[31m+   const targetKm = normalizedDistance * model.distanceKm[39m
[31m+   let completedWeightedDistance = 0[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (const segment of model.segments) {[39m
[31m+     if (targetKm >= segment.endKm) {[39m
[31m+       completedWeightedDistance += segment.weightedDistance[39m
[31m+       continue[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (targetKm <= segment.startKm) break[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const segmentDistanceCompleted = targetKm - segment.startKm[39m
[31m+     completedWeightedDistance +=[39m
[31m+       segmentDistanceCompleted * segment.climbMultiplier[39m
[31m+     break[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return Math.max([39m
[31m+     0,[39m
[31m+     Math.min([39m
[31m+       1,[39m
[31m+       completedWeightedDistance /[39m
[31m+         Math.max(model.totalWeightedDistance, 0.000001)[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type StageRouteMarker = {[39m
[31m+   type: string[39m
[31m+   km: number[39m
[31m+   label: string[39m
[31m+   category?: string | null[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ type StageProfileDetailItem = Record<string, JsonValue>[39m

[31m+ function normalizeStageProfilePoint(value: unknown): BackendStageProfilePoint | null {[39m
[31m+   const point = getRecord(value)[39m
[31m+   const km = Number(point.km)[39m
[31m+   const elevation = Number(point.elevation ?? point.elevation_m)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!Number.isFinite(km) || !Number.isFinite(elevation)) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return { km, elevation }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeStageRouteMarker(value: unknown): StageRouteMarker | null {[39m
[31m+   const marker = getRecord(value)[39m
[31m+   const km = Number(marker.km)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!Number.isFinite(km)) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const categoryValue =[39m
[31m+     typeof marker.category === 'string' && marker.category.trim()[39m
[31m+       ? marker.category.trim()[39m
[31m+       : typeof marker.kom_category === 'string' && marker.kom_category.trim()[39m
[31m+         ? marker.kom_category.trim()[39m
[31m+         : typeof marker.climb_category === 'string' && marker.climb_category.trim()[39m
[31m+           ? marker.climb_category.trim()[39m
[31m+           : null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     type: typeof marker.type === 'string' ? marker.type.toLowerCase() : 'marker',[39m
[31m+     km,[39m
[31m+     label:[39m
[31m+       typeof marker.label === 'string' && marker.label.trim()[39m
[31m+         ? marker.label[39m
[31m+         : typeof marker.type === 'string'[39m
[31m+           ? humanizeCode(marker.type)[39m
[31m+           : 'Marker',[39m
[31m+     category: categoryValue,[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function normalizeStageProfileDetailPayload(value: unknown): StageProfileDetailPayload {[39m
[31m+   const record = getRecord(value)[39m
[31m+   const terrainSplit = getRecord(record.terrain_split)[39m
[31m+   const stageWeather = getRecord(record.stage_weather)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     stage_id: typeof record.stage_id === 'string' ? record.stage_id : '',[39m
[31m+     race_id: typeof record.race_id === 'string' ? record.race_id : '',[39m
[31m+     stage_number: Number.isFinite(Number(record.stage_number)) ? Number(record.stage_number) : 0,[39m
[31m+     stage_title: typeof record.stage_title === 'string' ? record.stage_title : null,[39m
[31m+     route_label: typeof record.route_label === 'string' ? record.route_label : null,[39m
[31m+     stage_summary: typeof record.stage_summary === 'string' ? record.stage_summary : null,[39m
[31m+     weather_summary: typeof record.weather_summary === 'string' ? record.weather_summary : null,[39m
[31m+     weather_snapshot: getRecord(record.weather_snapshot) as JsonObject,[39m
[31m+     stage_weather: Object.keys(stageWeather).length[39m
[31m+       ? (stageWeather as JsonObject)[39m
[31m+       : null,[39m
[31m+     phase9_preparation: (() => {[39m
[31m+       const phase9Preparation = getRecord([39m
[31m+         record.phase9_preparation ?? record.phase9Preparation[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+       return Object.keys(phase9Preparation).length[39m
[31m+         ? (phase9Preparation as JsonObject)[39m
[31m+         : null[39m
[31m+     })(),[39m
[31m+     distance_km: Number.isFinite(Number(record.distance_km)) ? Number(record.distance_km) : null,[39m
[31m+     elevation_gain_m: Number.isFinite(Number(record.elevation_gain_m))[39m
[31m+       ? Number(record.elevation_gain_m)[39m
[31m+       : null,[39m
[31m+     terrain_type: typeof record.terrain_type === 'string' ? record.terrain_type : null,[39m
[31m+     profile_type: typeof record.profile_type === 'string' ? record.profile_type : null,[39m
[31m+     terrain_split: Object.keys(terrainSplit).length[39m
[31m+       ? {[39m
[31m+           flat: Number.isFinite(Number(terrainSplit.flat)) ? Number(terrainSplit.flat) : 0,[39m
[31m+           hilly: Number.isFinite(Number(terrainSplit.hilly)) ? Number(terrainSplit.hilly) : 0,[39m
[31m+           mountain: Number.isFinite(Number(terrainSplit.mountain)) ? Number(terrainSplit.mountain) : 0,[39m
[31m+           cobbled: Number.isFinite(Number(terrainSplit.cobbled)) ? Number(terrainSplit.cobbled) : 0,[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       : null,[39m
[31m+     profile_points: arrayOrEmpty<unknown>(record.profile_points)[39m
[31m+       .map(normalizeStageProfilePoint)[39m
[31m+       .filter((point): point is BackendStageProfilePoint => point !== null)[39m
[31m+       .sort((a, b) => a.km - b.km),[39m
[31m+     route_markers: arrayOrEmpty<unknown>(record.route_markers)[39m
[31m+       .map(normalizeStageRouteMarker)[39m
[31m+       .filter((marker): marker is StageRouteMarker => marker !== null)[39m
[31m+       .sort((a, b) => a.km - b.km),[39m
[31m+     intermediate_sprints: arrayOrEmpty<StageProfileDetailItem>(record.intermediate_sprints),[39m
[31m+     mountain_climbs: arrayOrEmpty<StageProfileDetailItem>(record.mountain_climbs),[39m
[31m+     has_profile: Boolean(record.has_profile),[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function formatProfileDetailValue(value: JsonValue | number | string | null | undefined): string {[39m
[31m+   if (value === null || value === undefined) return '—'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (Array.isArray(value)) {[39m
[31m+     return value.length ? value.map((entry) => formatProfileDetailValue(entry)).join(' / ') : '—'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (typeof value === 'object') {[39m
[31m+     const entries = Object.entries(value as Record<string, JsonValue>)[39m
[31m+     return entries.length[39m
[31m+       ? entries.map(([key, entryValue]) => `${humanizeCode(key)}: ${formatProfileDetailValue(entryValue)}`).join(' · ')[39m
[31m+       : '—'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return String(value)[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatPointsSchemeLabel(value: JsonValue | undefined): string {[39m
[31m+   if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length === 0) return '—'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return value.map((entry) => formatProfileDetailValue(entry)).join(' / ')[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function hasConfiguredPointValues(value: JsonValue | undefined): boolean {[39m
[31m+   return Array.isArray(value) && value.length > 0[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function getProfileDetailNumber([39m
[31m+   item: StageProfileDetailItem | null | undefined,[39m
[31m+   key: string[39m
[31m+ ): number | null {[39m
[31m+   const value = item?.[key][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (typeof value !== 'number' && typeof value !== 'string') return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return asNumber(value)[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getProfileDetailBoolean([39m
[31m+   item: StageProfileDetailItem | null | undefined,[39m
[31m+   key: string[39m
[31m+ ): boolean {[39m
[31m+   const value = item?.[key][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (typeof value === 'boolean') return value[39m
[31m+   if (typeof value === 'number') return value === 1[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (typeof value === 'string') {[39m
[31m+     const normalized = value.trim().toLowerCase()[39m
[31m+     return normalized === 'true' || normalized === '1' || normalized === 'yes'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return false[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ const isSameKm = (a: unknown, b: unknown) =>[39m
[31m+   Math.abs(Number(a) - Number(b)) < 0.11[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getFinishClimb([39m
[31m+   mountainClimbs: StageProfileDetailItem[],[39m
[31m+   finishKm: number | null[39m
[31m+ ): StageProfileDetailItem | null {[39m
[31m+   const markedFinishClimb = mountainClimbs.find((climb) =>[39m
[31m+     getProfileDetailBoolean(climb, 'is_finish_climb')[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (markedFinishClimb) return markedFinishClimb[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (finishKm === null) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     mountainClimbs.find((climb) => {[39m
[31m+       const climbKm = getProfileDetailNumber(climb, 'km')[39m
[31m+       return climbKm !== null && Math.abs(climbKm - finishKm) <= 0.2[39m
[31m+     }) ?? null[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function StageFinishPointCard({[39m
[31m+   isMountainFinish,[39m
[31m+   finishKm,[39m
[31m+   finishPoint,[39m
[31m+   finishClimb,[39m
[31m+   suppressTimeBonuses = false,[39m
[31m+   allowDefaultFinishPoints = true,[39m
[31m+   defaultFinishPointsScheme = DEFAULT_FINISH_POINTS_SCHEME,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   isMountainFinish: boolean[39m
[31m+   finishKm: number | string | null | undefined[39m
[31m+   finishPoint?: RaceStagePoint | null[39m
[31m+   finishClimb?: StageProfileDetailItem | null[39m
[31m+   suppressTimeBonuses?: boolean[39m
[31m+   allowDefaultFinishPoints?: boolean[39m
[31m+   defaultFinishPointsScheme?: JsonValue[][39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const configuredFinishBonuses = finishPoint?.time_bonus_seconds[39m
[31m+   const finishPointBonuses = suppressTimeBonuses[39m
[31m+     ? [][39m
[31m+     : hasConfiguredPointValues(configuredFinishBonuses)[39m
[31m+       ? configuredFinishBonuses[39m
[31m+       : DEFAULT_FINISH_TIME_BONUSES[39m
[31m+   const configuredFinishPoints = finishPoint?.points_scheme[39m
[31m+   const finishPoints = allowDefaultFinishPoints[39m
[31m+     ? hasConfiguredPointValues(configuredFinishPoints)[39m
[31m+       ? configuredFinishPoints[39m
[31m+       : defaultFinishPointsScheme[39m
[31m+     : configuredFinishPoints ?? [][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (isMountainFinish) {[39m
[31m+     const climbName = formatProfileDetailValue(finishClimb?.['name'])[39m
[31m+     const category = formatProfileDetailValue(finishClimb?.['category'])[39m
[31m+     const lengthKm = formatProfileDetailValue(finishClimb?.['length_km'])[39m
[31m+     const avgGradient = formatProfileDetailValue(finishClimb?.['avg_gradient'])[39m
[31m+     const titleDetails = [climbName, category][39m
[31m+       .filter((value) => value && value !== '—')[39m
[31m+       .join(' · ')[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className="flex w-full items-start justify-between gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50/60 px-4 py-3 text-sm">[39m
[31m+         <div className="min-w-0">[39m
[31m+           <div className="font-semibold text-slate-950">[39m
[31m+             {titleDetails ? `🏁 Mountain finish · ${titleDetails}` : '🏁 Mountain finish'}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-1 text-slate-600">[39m
[31m+             km {formatProfileDetailValue(finishKm)}[39m
[31m+             {lengthKm !== '—' ? ` · ${lengthKm} km` : ''}[39m
[31m+             {avgGradient !== '—' ? ` at ${avgGradient}%` : ''}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <div className="min-w-[260px] text-right text-slate-600">[39m
[31m+           <div>[39m
[31m+             <span className="font-medium text-slate-500">Mountain classification: </span>[39m
[31m+             {formatPointsSchemeLabel(finishClimb?.['points_scheme'])}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           {hasConfiguredPointValues(finishPointBonuses) ? ([39m
[31m+             <div className="mt-1">[39m
[31m+               <span className="font-medium text-slate-500">GC time bonuses: </span>[39m
[31m+               {formatPointsSchemeLabel(finishPointBonuses)}[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+           ) : null}[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="flex w-full items-start justify-between gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-green-200 bg-green-50/60 px-4 py-3 text-sm">[39m
[31m+       <div className="min-w-0">[39m
[31m+         <div className="font-semibold text-slate-950">🏁 Finish sprint</div>[39m
[31m+         <div className="mt-1 text-slate-600">km {formatProfileDetailValue(finishKm)}</div>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <div className="min-w-[260px] text-right text-slate-600">[39m
[31m+         {hasConfiguredPointValues(finishPoints) ? ([39m
[31m+           <div>[39m
[31m+             <span className="font-medium text-slate-500">Points classification finish: </span>[39m
[31m+             {formatPointsSchemeLabel(finishPoints)}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         ) : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         {hasConfiguredPointValues(finishPointBonuses) ? ([39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-1">[39m
[31m+             <span className="font-medium text-slate-500">GC time bonuses: </span>[39m
[31m+             {formatPointsSchemeLabel(finishPointBonuses)}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m

[31m+ function getClimbCategoryLabel([39m
[31m+   marker: StageRouteMarker,[39m
[31m+   mountainClimbs: StageProfileDetailItem[][39m
[31m+ ): string {[39m
[31m+   const matchingClimb = mountainClimbs.find((climb) => {[39m
[31m+     const climbKm = getProfileDetailNumber(climb, 'km')[39m
[31m+     return climbKm !== null && isSameKm(climbKm, marker.km)[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+   const climbCategory = formatProfileDetailValue(matchingClimb?.['category'])[39m
[31m+   const category =[39m
[31m+     climbCategory && climbCategory !== '—'[39m
[31m+       ? climbCategory[39m
[31m+       : marker.category?.trim()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (category) {[39m
[31m+     const normalizedCategory = category.toUpperCase()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (normalizedCategory === 'HC') return 'HC'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const categoryMatch = category.match(/^cat(?:egory)?\s*(HC|\d+)$/i)[39m
[31m+     if (categoryMatch) {[39m
[31m+       const rawCategory = categoryMatch[1].toUpperCase()[39m
[31m+       return rawCategory === 'HC' ? 'HC' : `Cat ${rawCategory}`[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (/^\d+$/.test(category)) return `Cat ${category}`[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return category[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const label = marker.label?.trim() ?? ''[39m
[31m+   const catMatch = label.match(/(?:cat(?:egory)?\s*)?(HC|[1-4])\b/i)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!catMatch) return 'KOM'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const rawCategory = catMatch[1].toUpperCase()[39m
[31m+   return rawCategory === 'HC' ? 'HC' : `Cat ${rawCategory}`[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildStageProfileChartMarkers([39m
[31m+   markers: StageRouteMarker[],[39m
[31m+   mountainClimbs: StageProfileDetailItem[] = [][39m
[31m+ ): StageProfileChartMarker[] {[39m
[31m+   let sprintCount = 0[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return markers[39m
[31m+     .filter((marker) => {[39m
[31m+       const type = marker.type?.toLowerCase()[39m
[31m+       return STAGE_PROFILE_CHART_MARKER_TYPES.has(type ?? '')[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+     .map((marker) => {[39m
[31m+       const chartType = getNormalizedChartMarkerType(marker)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (chartType === 'start') {[39m
[31m+         return { ...marker, chartType, chartLabel: 'Start' }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (chartType === 'finish') {[39m
[31m+         return { ...marker, chartType, chartLabel: 'Finish' }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (chartType === 'sprint') {[39m
[31m+         sprintCount += 1[39m
[31m+         return { ...marker, chartType, chartLabel: `Sprint ${sprintCount}` }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return { ...marker, chartType, chartLabel: getClimbCategoryLabel(marker, mountainClimbs) }[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type StageProfileReplayEntityMarker = {[39m
[31m+   id: string[39m
[31m+   label: string[39m
[31m+   progressPercent: number[39m
[31m+   startOrder: number[39m
[31m+   highlighted?: boolean[39m
[31m+   topLabel?: string | null[39m
[31m+   topLabelColor?: string[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type StageProfileAuxiliaryMarker = {[39m
[31m+   id: string[39m
[31m+   km: number[39m
[31m+   label: string[39m
[31m+   color?: string[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function StageProfileChart({[39m
[31m+   points,[39m
[31m+   markers,[39m
[31m+   distanceKm,[39m
[31m+   terrainType,[39m
[31m+   mountainClimbs = [],[39m
[31m+   replayProgressPercent = null,[39m
[31m+   replayEntityMarkers = [],[39m
[31m+   replayEntityMarkerStyle = 'badge',[39m
[31m+   auxiliaryMarkers = [],[39m
[31m+   compact = false,[39m
[31m+   roadReplayCompactUi = false,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   points: BackendStageProfilePoint[][39m
[31m+   markers: StageRouteMarker[][39m
[31m+   distanceKm: number[39m
[31m+   terrainType?: string | null[39m
[31m+   mountainClimbs?: StageProfileDetailItem[][39m
[31m+   replayProgressPercent?: number | null[39m
[31m+   replayEntityMarkers?: StageProfileReplayEntityMarker[][39m
[31m+   replayEntityMarkerStyle?: 'badge' | 'line'[39m
[31m+   auxiliaryMarkers?: StageProfileAuxiliaryMarker[][39m
[31m+   compact?: boolean[39m
[31m+   roadReplayCompactUi?: boolean[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const chartInstanceId = useId().replace(/:/g, '')[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!points.length || !distanceKm) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className="rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 px-4 py-8 text-sm text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+         Stage profile chart is not available yet.[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const normalizedPoints: StageProfilePoint[] = points.map((point) => ({[39m
[31m+     km: Number(point.km),[39m
[31m+     elevation_m: Number(point.elevation),[39m
[31m+   }))[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const width = compact ? 1000 : 920[39m
[31m+   const height = compact ? 242 : 320[39m
[31m+   const padding = compact[39m
[31m+     ? { top: 34, right: 18, bottom: 42, left: 64 }[39m
[31m+     : { top: 38, right: 18, bottom: 52, left: 70 }[39m
[31m+   const safeDistanceKm = Math.max(1, Number(distanceKm))[39m
[31m+   const innerHeight = height - padding.top - padding.bottom[39m
[31m+   const innerWidth = width - padding.left - padding.right[39m
[31m+   const pathPayload = buildStageProfilePath([39m
[31m+     normalizedPoints,[39m
[31m+     width,[39m
[31m+     height,[39m
[31m+     padding,[39m
[31m+     terrainType[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!pathPayload) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className="rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 px-4 py-8 text-sm text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+         Stage profile chart is not available yet.[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const parsed = JSON.parse(pathPayload) as {[39m
[31m+     linePath: string[39m
[31m+     areaPath: string[39m
[31m+     coordinates: Array<{ x: number; y: number; km: number; elevation_m: number }>[39m
[31m+     minElevation: number[39m
[31m+     maxElevation: number[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const rawTickValues = getElevationTickValues(parsed.minElevation, parsed.maxElevation)[39m
[31m+   const targetLineCount = 5[39m
[31m+   const stepIndex = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(rawTickValues.length / targetLineCount))[39m
[31m+   const tickValues = rawTickValues.filter((_, index) => index % stepIndex === 0)[39m
[31m+   const minKm = 0[39m
[31m+   const maxKm = safeDistanceKm[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const xForKm = (km: number) => {[39m
[31m+     const clampedKm = Math.max(minKm, Math.min(maxKm, Number(km)))[39m
[31m+     return padding.left + ((clampedKm - minKm) / Math.max(maxKm - minKm, 1)) * innerWidth[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const yForElevation = (elevation: number) =>[39m
[31m+     padding.top +[39m
[31m+     innerHeight -[39m
[31m+     ((Number(elevation) - parsed.minElevation) / Math.max(parsed.maxElevation - parsed.minElevation, 1)) *[39m
[31m+       innerHeight[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const filteredChartMarkers = buildStageProfileChartMarkers(markers, mountainClimbs)[39m
[31m+   const chartMarkers = filteredChartMarkers.length[39m
[31m+     ? filteredChartMarkers[39m
[31m+     : buildStageProfileChartMarkers([[39m
[31m+         { type: 'start', km: 0, label: 'Start' },[39m
[31m+         { type: 'finish', km: safeDistanceKm, label: 'Finish' },[39m
[31m+       ])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const replayProgressFraction =[39m
[31m+     replayProgressPercent === null[39m
[31m+       ? null[39m
[31m+       : Math.max(0, Math.min(1, replayProgressPercent / 100))[39m
[31m+   const replayProgressKm =[39m
[31m+     replayProgressFraction === null[39m
[31m+       ? null[39m
[31m+       : safeDistanceKm * replayProgressFraction[39m
[31m+   const progressTrailGradientId = `stage-progress-trail-gradient-${chartInstanceId}`[39m
[31m+   const progressAreaGradientId = `stage-progress-area-gradient-${chartInstanceId}`[39m
[31m+   const profileAboveMaskId = `stage-profile-above-mask-${chartInstanceId}`[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const getProfileElevationAtKm = (km: number): number => {[39m
[31m+     const coordinates = [...parsed.coordinates].sort([39m
[31m+       (left, right) => left.km - right.km[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (coordinates.length === 0) return parsed.minElevation[39m
[31m+     if (km <= coordinates[0].km) return coordinates[0].elevation_m[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     for (let index = 1; index < coordinates.length; index += 1) {[39m
[31m+       const previous = coordinates[index - 1][39m
[31m+       const next = coordinates[index][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (km > next.km) continue[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const distance = Math.max(0.001, next.km - previous.km)[39m
[31m+       const fraction = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (km - previous.km) / distance))[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return ([39m
[31m+         previous.elevation_m +[39m
[31m+         (next.elevation_m - previous.elevation_m) * fraction[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return coordinates[coordinates.length - 1].elevation_m[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const replayProgressX =[39m
[31m+     replayProgressKm === null ? null : xForKm(replayProgressKm)[39m
[31m+   const replayProgressY =[39m
[31m+     replayProgressKm === null[39m
[31m+       ? null[39m
[31m+       : yForElevation(getProfileElevationAtKm(replayProgressKm))[39m
[31m+   const activeReplayEntityMarkers = replayEntityMarkers[39m
[31m+     .map((marker) => {[39m
[31m+       const progressFraction = Math.max([39m
[31m+         0,[39m
[31m+         Math.min(1, Number(marker.progressPercent) / 100)[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+       const km = safeDistanceKm * progressFraction[39m
[31m+       return {[39m
[31m+         ...marker,[39m
[31m+         km,[39m
[31m+         x: xForKm(km),[39m
[31m+         y: yForElevation(getProfileElevationAtKm(km)),[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+     .filter((marker) => marker.progressPercent > 0 && marker.progressPercent < 100)[39m
[31m+   const activeAuxiliaryMarkers = auxiliaryMarkers[39m
[31m+     .map((marker) => ({[39m
[31m+       ...marker,[39m
[31m+       x: xForKm(Number(marker.km)),[39m
[31m+       color: marker.color ?? '#16a34a',[39m
[31m+     }))[39m
[31m+     .filter((marker) => marker.km > 0 && marker.km < safeDistanceKm)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const progressTrailPath = (() => {[39m
[31m+     if (replayProgressKm === null || replayProgressKm <= 0) return ''[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const sourceCoordinates = [...parsed.coordinates].sort([39m
[31m+       (left, right) => left.km - right.km[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     const trailCoordinates = sourceCoordinates.filter([39m
[31m+       (point) => point.km < replayProgressKm - 0.000001[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     trailCoordinates.push({[39m
[31m+       x: xForKm(replayProgressKm),[39m
[31m+       y: yForElevation(getProfileElevationAtKm(replayProgressKm)),[39m
[31m+       km: replayProgressKm,[39m
[31m+       elevation_m: getProfileElevationAtKm(replayProgressKm),[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (trailCoordinates.length === 0) return ''[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return trailCoordinates.reduce((path, point, index) => {[39m
[31m+       if (index === 0) return `M ${point.x} ${point.y}`[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const previous = trailCoordinates[index - 1][39m
[31m+       const controlX = (previous.x + point.x) / 2[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return `${path} C ${controlX} ${previous.y}, ${controlX} ${point.y}, ${point.x} ${point.y}`[39m
[31m+     }, '')[39m
[31m+   })()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const progressCompletedAreaPath = (() => {[39m
[31m+     if ([39m
[31m+       replayProgressKm === null ||[39m
[31m+       replayProgressKm <= 0 ||[39m
[31m+       replayProgressX === null ||[39m
[31m+       replayProgressY === null[39m
[31m+     ) {[39m
[31m+       return ''[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const sourceCoordinates = [...parsed.coordinates].sort([39m
[31m+       (left, right) => left.km - right.km[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     const completedTerrainCoordinates = sourceCoordinates.filter([39m
[31m+       (point) => point.km < replayProgressKm - 0.000001[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     completedTerrainCoordinates.push({[39m
[31m+       x: replayProgressX,[39m
[31m+       y: replayProgressY,[39m
[31m+       km: replayProgressKm,[39m
[31m+       elevation_m: getProfileElevationAtKm(replayProgressKm),[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (completedTerrainCoordinates.length === 0) return ''[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const terrainReturnPath = [...completedTerrainCoordinates][39m
[31m+       .reverse()[39m
[31m+       .map((point) => `L ${point.x} ${point.y}`)[39m
[31m+       .join(' ')[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return [[39m
[31m+       `M ${padding.left} ${padding.top}`,[39m
[31m+       `L ${replayProgressX} ${padding.top}`,[39m
[31m+       `L ${replayProgressX} ${replayProgressY}`,[39m
[31m+       terrainReturnPath,[39m
[31m+       `L ${padding.left} ${padding.top}`,[39m
[31m+       'Z',[39m
[31m+     ].join(' ')[39m
[31m+   })()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white">[39m
[31m+       <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${height}`} className="h-auto w-full">[39m
[31m+         <defs>[39m
[31m+           <mask id={profileAboveMaskId} maskUnits="userSpaceOnUse">[39m
[31m+             <rect x="0" y="0" width={width} height={height} fill="white" />[39m
[31m+             <path d={parsed.areaPath} fill="black" />[39m
[31m+           </mask>[39m
[31m+         </defs>[39m
[31m+         {replayProgressX !== null ? ([39m
[31m+           <defs>[39m
[31m+             <linearGradient[39m
[31m+               id={progressTrailGradientId}[39m
[31m+               gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse"[39m
[31m+               x1={padding.left}[39m
[31m+               y1="0"[39m
[31m+               x2={Math.max(padding.left + 1, replayProgressX)}[39m
[31m+               y2="0"[39m
[31m+             >[39m
[31m+               <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#2563eb" stopOpacity="0.14" />[39m
[31m+               <stop offset="40%" stopColor="#2563eb" stopOpacity="0.34" />[39m
[31m+               <stop offset="78%" stopColor="#2563eb" stopOpacity="0.72" />[39m
[31m+               <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#2563eb" stopOpacity="1" />[39m
[31m+             </linearGradient>[39m
[31m+             <linearGradient[39m
[31m+               id={progressAreaGradientId}[39m
[31m+               gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse"[39m
[31m+               x1={padding.left}[39m
[31m+               y1="0"[39m
[31m+               x2={Math.max(padding.left + 1, replayProgressX)}[39m
[31m+               y2="0"[39m
[31m+             >[39m
[31m+               <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#2563eb" stopOpacity="0.035" />[39m
[31m+               <stop offset="34%" stopColor="#2563eb" stopOpacity="0.075" />[39m
[31m+               <stop offset="70%" stopColor="#2563eb" stopOpacity="0.15" />[39m
[31m+               <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#2563eb" stopOpacity="0.27" />[39m
[31m+             </linearGradient>[39m
[31m+           </defs>[39m
[31m+         ) : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         {tickValues.map((tick) => {[39m
[31m+           const y = yForElevation(tick)[39m
[31m+           return ([39m
[31m+             <g key={`tick-${tick}`}>[39m
[31m+               <line[39m
[31m+                 x1={padding.left}[39m
[31m+                 y1={y}[39m
[31m+                 x2={width - padding.right}[39m
[31m+                 y2={y}[39m
[31m+                 stroke="#e2e8f0"[39m
[31m+                 strokeWidth="1"[39m
[31m+               />[39m
[31m+               <text[39m
[31m+                 x={padding.left - 12}[39m
[31m+                 y={y + 4}[39m
[31m+                 textAnchor="end"[39m
[31m+                 fontSize={roadReplayCompactUi ? '9' : '12'}[39m
[31m+                 fill="#64748b"[39m
[31m+               >[39m
[31m+                 {tick} m[39m
[31m+               </text>[39m
[31m+             </g>[39m
[31m+           )[39m
[31m+         })}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         {progressCompletedAreaPath ? ([39m
[31m+           <path[39m
[31m+             d={progressCompletedAreaPath}[39m
[31m+             fill={`url(#${progressAreaGradientId})`}[39m
[31m+             pointerEvents="none"[39m
[31m+           />[39m
[31m+         ) : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <path d={parsed.areaPath} fill="rgba(250, 204, 21, 0.55)" />[39m
[31m+         <path d={parsed.linePath} fill="none" stroke="#334155" strokeWidth="3" />[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         {replayProgressX !== null && replayProgressY !== null ? ([39m
[31m+           <g aria-label={`Replay progress ${Math.round(replayProgressPercent ?? 0)} percent`}>[39m
[31m+             {progressTrailPath ? ([39m
[31m+               <path[39m
[31m+                 d={progressTrailPath}[39m
[31m+                 fill="none"[39m
[31m+                 stroke={`url(#${progressTrailGradientId})`}[39m
[31m+                 strokeWidth={compact ? 3.25 : 4}[39m
[31m+                 strokeLinecap="round"[39m
[31m+                 strokeLinejoin="round"[39m
[31m+               />[39m
[31m+             ) : null}[39m
[31m+             <line[39m
[31m+               x1={replayProgressX}[39m
[31m+               y1={padding.top}[39m
[31m+               x2={replayProgressX}[39m
[31m+               y2={replayProgressY}[39m
[31m+               stroke="#2563eb"[39m
[31m+               strokeWidth={compact ? 2.25 : 3}[39m
[31m+               strokeLinecap="butt"[39m
[31m+             />[39m
[31m+           </g>[39m
[31m+         ) : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         {activeReplayEntityMarkers.map((marker) => {[39m
[31m+           const highlighted = marker.highlighted === true[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           if (replayEntityMarkerStyle === 'line') {[39m
[31m+             return ([39m
[31m+               <g[39m
[31m+                 key={`replay-entity-${marker.id}`}[39m
[31m+                 aria-label={`${marker.label}, start order ${marker.startOrder}, ${marker.km.toFixed(1)} kilometres`}[39m
[31m+               >[39m
[31m+                 <g mask={`url(#${profileAboveMaskId})`}>[39m
[31m+                   {highlighted ? ([39m
[31m+                     <rect[39m
[31m+                       x={marker.x - (compact ? 7 : 8)}[39m
[31m+                       y={padding.top}[39m
[31m+                       width={compact ? 14 : 16}[39m
[31m+                       height={innerHeight}[39m
[31m+                       fill="#2563eb"[39m
[31m+                       opacity="0.08"[39m
[31m+                     />[39m
[31m+                   ) : null}[39m
[31m+                   <line[39m
[31m+                     x1={marker.x}[39m
[31m+                     y1={padding.top}[39m
[31m+                     x2={marker.x}[39m
[31m+                     y2={height - padding.bottom}[39m
[31m+                     stroke={highlighted ? '#2563eb' : '#60a5fa'}[39m
[31m+                     strokeWidth={highlighted ? (compact ? 2.8 : 3.2) : (compact ? 1.4 : 1.8)}[39m
[31m+                     strokeLinecap="round"[39m
[31m+                   />[39m
[31m+                 </g>[39m
[31m+                 {marker.topLabel ? ([39m
[31m+                   <g>[39m
[31m+                     <rect[39m
[31m+                       x={marker.x - (compact ? 18 : 22)}[39m
[31m+                       y={Math.max(padding.top + 2, marker.y - (compact ? 22 : 26))}[39m
[31m+                       width={compact ? 36 : 44}[39m
[31m+                       height={compact ? 16 : 18}[39m
[31m+                       rx={compact ? 8 : 9}[39m
[31m+                       fill="white"[39m
[31m+                       stroke={marker.topLabelColor ?? '#cbd5e1'}[39m
[31m+                       strokeWidth="1"[39m
[31m+                       opacity="0.98"[39m
[31m+                     />[39m
[31m+                     <text[39m
[31m+                       x={marker.x}[39m
[31m+                       y={Math.max(padding.top + 13, marker.y - (compact ? 11 : 13))}[39m
[31m+                       textAnchor="middle"[39m
[31m+                       fontSize={compact ? '8' : '9'}[39m
[31m+                       fontWeight="800"[39m
[31m+                       fill={marker.topLabelColor ?? '#0f172a'}[39m
[31m+                     >[39m
[31m+                       {marker.topLabel}[39m
[31m+                     </text>[39m
[31m+                   </g>[39m
[31m+                 ) : null}[39m
[31m+               </g>[39m
[31m+             )[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           return ([39m
[31m+             <g[39m
[31m+               key={`replay-entity-${marker.id}`}[39m
[31m+               aria-label={`${marker.label}, start order ${marker.startOrder}, ${marker.km.toFixed(1)} kilometres`}[39m
[31m+             >[39m
[31m+               <circle[39m
[31m+                 cx={marker.x}[39m
[31m+                 cy={marker.y}[39m
[31m+                 r={compact ? 9 : 10}[39m
[31m+                 fill="#0f172a"[39m
[31m+                 stroke="white"[39m
[31m+                 strokeWidth="2"[39m
[31m+               />[39m
[31m+               <text[39m
[31m+                 x={marker.x}[39m
[31m+                 y={marker.y + 3}[39m
[31m+                 textAnchor="middle"[39m
[31m+                 fontSize={marker.startOrder >= 100 ? '6.5' : marker.startOrder >= 10 ? '7.5' : '8.5'}[39m
[31m+                 fontWeight="800"[39m
[31m+                 fill="white"[39m
[31m+               >[39m
[31m+                 {marker.startOrder}[39m
[31m+               </text>[39m
[31m+             </g>[39m
[31m+           )[39m
[31m+         })}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         {replayEntityMarkerStyle === 'line' ? ([39m
[31m+           <path[39m
[31m+             d={parsed.linePath}[39m
[31m+             fill="none"[39m
[31m+             stroke="#334155"[39m
[31m+             strokeWidth="3"[39m
[31m+             pointerEvents="none"[39m
[31m+           />[39m
[31m+         ) : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         {activeAuxiliaryMarkers.map((marker) => ([39m
[31m+           <g key={`aux-marker-${marker.id}`} aria-label={`${marker.label} at ${marker.km.toFixed(1)} kilometres`}>[39m
[31m+             <line[39m
[31m+               x1={marker.x}[39m
[31m+               y1={padding.top}[39m
[31m+               x2={marker.x}[39m
[31m+               y2={height - padding.bottom}[39m
[31m+               stroke={marker.color}[39m
[31m+               strokeDasharray="5 4"[39m
[31m+               strokeWidth="2"[39m
[31m+             />[39m
[31m+             <rect[39m
[31m+               x={marker.x - 34}[39m
[31m+               y={padding.top - 24}[39m
[31m+               width="68"[39m
[31m+               height="20"[39m
[31m+               rx="10"[39m
[31m+               fill={marker.color}[39m
[31m+             />[39m
[31m+             <text[39m
[31m+               x={marker.x}[39m
[31m+               y={padding.top - 10}[39m
[31m+               textAnchor="middle"[39m
[31m+               fontSize="10"[39m
[31m+               fontWeight="700"[39m
[31m+               fill="white"[39m
[31m+             >[39m
[31m+               {marker.label}[39m
[31m+             </text>[39m
[31m+           </g>[39m
[31m+         ))}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         {chartMarkers.map((marker, index) => {[39m
[31m+           const x = xForKm(Number(marker.km))[39m
[31m+           const markerType = marker.chartType[39m
[31m+           const isFinish = markerType === 'finish'[39m
[31m+           const isSprint = markerType === 'sprint'[39m
[31m+           const isKom =[39m
[31m+             markerType === 'kom' ||[39m
[31m+             markerType === 'climb' ||[39m
[31m+             markerType === 'mountain_climb'[39m
[31m+           const fill = isFinish ? '#2563eb' : isSprint ? '#22c55e' : isKom ? '#ef4444' : '#64748b'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           return ([39m
[31m+             <g key={`${marker.type}-${marker.km}-${index}`}>[39m
[31m+               <line[39m
[31m+                 x1={x}[39m
[31m+                 y1={padding.top}[39m
[31m+                 x2={x}[39m
[31m+                 y2={height - padding.bottom}[39m
[31m+                 stroke={fill}[39m
[31m+                 strokeDasharray="4 4"[39m
[31m+                 strokeWidth={roadReplayCompactUi ? '1.1' : '1.5'}[39m
[31m+               />[39m
[31m+               <rect[39m
[31m+                 x={x - (roadReplayCompactUi ? 22 : 28)}[39m
[31m+                 y={padding.top - (roadReplayCompactUi ? 20 : 24)}[39m
[31m+                 width={roadReplayCompactUi ? 44 : 56}[39m
[31m+                 height={roadReplayCompactUi ? 16 : 20}[39m
[31m+                 rx={roadReplayCompactUi ? 8 : 10}[39m
[31m+                 fill={fill}[39m
[31m+               />[39m
[31m+               <text[39m
[31m+                 x={x}[39m
[31m+                 y={padding.top - (roadReplayCompactUi ? 9 : 10)}[39m
[31m+                 textAnchor="middle"[39m
[31m+                 fontSize={roadReplayCompactUi ? '8' : '10'}[39m
[31m+                 fontWeight="700"[39m
[31m+                 fill="white"[39m
[31m+               >[39m
[31m+                 {marker.chartLabel}[39m
[31m+               </text>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+               <text[39m
[31m+                 x={x}[39m
[31m+                 y={height - 14}[39m
[31m+                 textAnchor="middle"[39m
[31m+                 fontSize={roadReplayCompactUi ? '9' : '12'}[39m
[31m+                 fontWeight="700"[39m
[31m+                 fill="#334155"[39m
[31m+               >[39m
[31m+                 {Number(marker.km).toFixed(Number(marker.km) % 1 === 0 ? 0 : 1)} km[39m
[31m+               </text>[39m
[31m+             </g>[39m
[31m+           )[39m
[31m+         })}[39m
[31m+       </svg>[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
