[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeUniversalStageRole(value: unknown): RiderStageRole {[39m
[31m+   const normalized = String(value ?? 'free_role').trim().toLowerCase()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const aliases: Record<string, RiderStageRole> = {[39m
[31m+     leader: 'team_leader_gc',[39m
[31m+     team_leader: 'team_leader_gc',[39m
[31m+     gc_leader: 'team_leader_gc',[39m
[31m+     protected: 'protected_rider',[39m
[31m+     domestique: 'helper_domestique',[39m
[31m+     helper: 'helper_domestique',[39m
[31m+     leadout: 'lead_out_rider',[39m
[31m+     lead_out: 'lead_out_rider',[39m
[31m+     breakaway: 'breakaway_rider',[39m
[31m+     mountain_helper: 'mountain_domestique',[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const resolved = aliases[normalized] ?? normalized[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return UNIVERSAL_STAGE_ROLE_SET.has(resolved)[39m
[31m+     ? (resolved as RiderStageRole)[39m
[31m+     : 'free_role'[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeUniversalStageFormat(stage: RaceStage): StageFormat {[39m
[31m+   const raw = `${stage.stage_format ?? ''} ${stage.terrain_type ?? ''}`[39m
[31m+     .trim()[39m
[31m+     .toLowerCase()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (raw.includes('team_time_trial')) return 'team_time_trial'[39m
[31m+   if (raw.includes('pair_time_trial')) return 'pair_time_trial'[39m
[31m+   if (raw.includes('individual_time_trial') || raw === 'time_trial') {[39m
[31m+     return 'individual_time_trial'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (raw.includes('prologue')) return 'prologue'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return 'road_race'[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeUniversalTerrainType([39m
[31m+   stage: RaceStage,[39m
[31m+   stageFormat: StageFormat[39m
[31m+ ): TerrainType {[39m
[31m+   if (stageFormat === 'individual_time_trial') return 'individual_time_trial'[39m
[31m+   if (stageFormat === 'team_time_trial' || stageFormat === 'pair_time_trial') {[39m
[31m+     return 'team_time_trial'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (stageFormat === 'prologue') return 'prologue'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const normalized = String(stage.terrain_type ?? 'flat').trim().toLowerCase()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (normalized === 'hilly') return 'hilly'[39m
[31m+   if (normalized === 'mountain') return 'mountain'[39m
[31m+   if (normalized === 'cobbled') return 'cobbled'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return 'flat'[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeUniversalFinishType([39m
[31m+   stage: RaceStage,[39m
[31m+   stageFormat: StageFormat,[39m
[31m+   terrainType: TerrainType[39m
[31m+ ): FinishType {[39m
[31m+   if (stageFormat === 'individual_time_trial') return 'time_trial_finish'[39m
[31m+   if (stageFormat === 'team_time_trial' || stageFormat === 'pair_time_trial') {[39m
[31m+     return 'team_time_trial_finish'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (stageFormat === 'prologue') return 'prologue_finish'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const hint = `${stage.finish_type ?? ''} ${stage.profile_type ?? ''}`[39m
[31m+     .trim()[39m
[31m+     .toLowerCase()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (stage.is_summit_finish || hint.includes('summit') || hint.includes('mountain')) {[39m
[31m+     return 'summit_finish'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+   if (hint.includes('uphill')) return 'uphill_finish'[39m
[31m+   if (terrainType === 'cobbled' || hint.includes('cobbl')) return 'cobbled_finish'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return 'flat_finish'[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeUniversalSprintZoneKm([39m
[31m+   stage: RaceStage,[39m
[31m+   stageFormat: StageFormat,[39m
[31m+   finishType: FinishType[39m
[31m+ ): number {[39m
[31m+   if ([39m
[31m+     stageFormat !== 'road_race' ||[39m
[31m+     finishType !== 'flat_finish' ||[39m
[31m+     stage.is_summit_finish[39m
[31m+   ) {[39m
[31m+     return 0[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const rules = getRecord(stage.rules_snapshot)[39m
[31m+   const metadata = getRecord(stage.metadata)[39m
[31m+   const candidates = [[39m
[31m+     rules.sprint_zone_km,[39m
[31m+     rules.sprintZoneKm,[39m
[31m+     rules.three_km_rule_km,[39m
[31m+     rules.final_incident_time_protection_km,[39m
[31m+     metadata.sprint_zone_km,[39m
[31m+     metadata.sprintZoneKm,[39m
[31m+   ][39m
[31m+   for (const candidate of candidates) {[39m
[31m+     const numeric = Number(candidate)[39m
[31m+     if (Number.isFinite(numeric) && numeric >= 0 && numeric <= 5) {[39m
[31m+       return numeric[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   // Current UCI-style default for an eligible bunch-sprint stage. Organiser[39m
[31m+   // extensions can be stored in the already-existing rules_snapshot/metadata.[39m
[31m+   return 3[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildUniversalTerrainPercentages([39m
[31m+   stage: RaceStage,[39m
[31m+   profile: StageProfileDetailPayload | null,[39m
[31m+   terrainType: TerrainType[39m
[31m+ ) {[39m
[31m+   const raw = {[39m
[31m+     flat: universalNumber(profile?.terrain_split?.flat ?? stage.flat_pct, 0),[39m
[31m+     hilly: universalNumber(profile?.terrain_split?.hilly ?? stage.hilly_pct, 0),[39m
[31m+     mountain: universalNumber([39m
[31m+       profile?.terrain_split?.mountain ?? stage.mountain_pct,[39m
[31m+       0[39m
[31m+     ),[39m
[31m+     cobbled: universalNumber(profile?.terrain_split?.cobbled ?? stage.cobbled_pct, 0),[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   let total = raw.flat + raw.hilly + raw.mountain + raw.cobbled[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!Number.isFinite(total) || total <= 0) {[39m
[31m+     raw.flat = terrainType === 'flat' ? 100 : 0[39m
[31m+     raw.hilly = terrainType === 'hilly' ? 100 : 0[39m
[31m+     raw.mountain = terrainType === 'mountain' ? 100 : 0[39m
[31m+     raw.cobbled = terrainType === 'cobbled' ? 100 : 0[39m
[31m+     total = 100[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const normalized = {[39m
[31m+     flat: Number(((raw.flat / total) * 100).toFixed(6)),[39m
[31m+     hilly: Number(((raw.hilly / total) * 100).toFixed(6)),[39m
[31m+     mountain: Number(((raw.mountain / total) * 100).toFixed(6)),[39m
[31m+     cobbled: Number(((raw.cobbled / total) * 100).toFixed(6)),[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const normalizedTotal =[39m
[31m+     normalized.flat + normalized.hilly + normalized.mountain + normalized.cobbled[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   normalized.flat = Number((normalized.flat + (100 - normalizedTotal)).toFixed(6))[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return normalized[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildUniversalProfilePoints([39m
[31m+   profile: StageProfileDetailPayload | null,[39m
[31m+   distanceKm: number[39m
[31m+ ) {[39m
[31m+   const rawPoints = (profile?.profile_points ?? [])[39m
[31m+     .map((point) => ({[39m
[31m+       km: universalClamp(universalNumber(point.km, 0), 0, distanceKm),[39m
[31m+       elevationM: universalNumber(point.elevation, 0),[39m
[31m+     }))[39m
[31m+     .sort((left, right) => left.km - right.km)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const byKm = new Map<number, { km: number; elevationM: number }>()[39m
[31m+   rawPoints.forEach((point) => byKm.set(point.km, point))[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const points = [...byKm.values()].sort((left, right) => left.km - right.km)[39m
[31m+   const firstElevation = points[0]?.elevationM ?? 0[39m
[31m+   const lastElevation = points[points.length - 1]?.elevationM ?? firstElevation[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (points[0]?.km !== 0) points.unshift({ km: 0, elevationM: firstElevation })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (points[points.length - 1]?.km !== distanceKm) {[39m
[31m+     points.push({ km: distanceKm, elevationM: lastElevation })[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (points.length < 2) {[39m
[31m+     return [[39m
[31m+       { km: 0, elevationM: 0 },[39m
[31m+       { km: distanceKm, elevationM: 0 },[39m
[31m+     ][39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return points[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function universalNumberArray(value: unknown): number[] {[39m
[31m+   if (Array.isArray(value)) {[39m
[31m+     return value[39m
[31m+       .map((entry) => Number(entry))[39m
[31m+       .filter((entry) => Number.isFinite(entry) && entry >= 0)[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim()) {[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       return universalNumberArray(JSON.parse(value))[39m
[31m+     } catch {[39m
[31m+       const parsed = Number(value)[39m
[31m+       return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed >= 0 ? [parsed] : [][39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const parsed = Number(value)[39m
[31m+   return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed >= 0 ? [parsed] : [][39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getUniversalProfileItemValue([39m
[31m+   item: StageProfileDetailItem,[39m
[31m+   keys: readonly string[][39m
[31m+ ): JsonValue | undefined {[39m
[31m+   for (const key of keys) {[39m
[31m+     const value = item[key][39m
[31m+     if (value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== '') return value[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return undefined[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getUniversalProfileItemString([39m
[31m+   item: StageProfileDetailItem,[39m
[31m+   keys: readonly string[][39m
[31m+ ): string | null {[39m
[31m+   const value = getUniversalProfileItemValue(item, keys)[39m
[31m+   return typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() ? value.trim() : null[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getUniversalProfileItemNumber([39m
[31m+   item: StageProfileDetailItem,[39m
[31m+   keys: readonly string[][39m
[31m+ ): number | null {[39m
[31m+   const value = getUniversalProfileItemValue(item, keys)[39m
[31m+   const parsed = Number(value)[39m
[31m+   return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getUniversalProfileItemBoolean([39m
[31m+   item: StageProfileDetailItem,[39m
[31m+   keys: readonly string[][39m
[31m+ ): boolean {[39m
[31m+   const value = getUniversalProfileItemValue(item, keys)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (typeof value === 'boolean') return value[39m
[31m+   if (typeof value === 'number') return value === 1[39m
[31m+   if (typeof value === 'string') {[39m
[31m+     return ['true', '1', 'yes'].includes(value.trim().toLowerCase())[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return false[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getUniversalProfileItemNumberArray([39m
[31m+   item: StageProfileDetailItem,[39m
[31m+   keys: readonly string[][39m
[31m+ ): JsonValue[] {[39m
[31m+   const value = getUniversalProfileItemValue(item, keys)[39m
[31m+   return universalNumberArray(value)[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildUniversalStagePointDefinitions([39m
[31m+   stage: RaceStage,[39m
[31m+   profile: StageProfileDetailPayload | null,[39m
[31m+   distanceKm: number[39m
[31m+ ): RaceStagePoint[] {[39m
[31m+   const safeDistanceKm = Math.max(1, Number(distanceKm) || 1)[39m
[31m+   const validTypes = new Set([[39m
[31m+     'START',[39m
[31m+     'INTERMEDIATE_SPRINT',[39m
[31m+     'KOM',[39m
[31m+     'BONUS_SPRINT',[39m
[31m+     'FINISH',[39m
[31m+   ])[39m
[31m+   const validKomCategories = new Set(['HC', '1', '2', '3', '4'])[39m
[31m+   const definitions: RaceStagePoint[] = [][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const normalizePointType = (value: unknown): RaceStagePoint['point_type'] | null => {[39m
[31m+     const normalized = String(value ?? '').trim().toUpperCase()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (validTypes.has(normalized)) return normalized[39m
[31m+     if (['SPRINT', 'INTERMEDIATE', 'INTERMEDIATE SPRINT'].includes(normalized)) {[39m
[31m+       return 'INTERMEDIATE_SPRINT'[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     if (['BONUS', 'BONUS SPRINT'].includes(normalized)) return 'BONUS_SPRINT'[39m
[31m+     if (['CLIMB', 'MOUNTAIN_CLIMB', 'MOUNTAIN CLIMB'].includes(normalized)) {[39m
[31m+       return 'KOM'[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return null[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const normalizeKomCategory = (value: unknown): RaceStagePoint['kom_category'] => {[39m
[31m+     const normalized = String(value ?? '').trim().toUpperCase().replace(/^CAT(?:EGORY)?\s*/i, '')[39m
[31m+     return validKomCategories.has(normalized)[39m
[31m+       ? (normalized as 'HC' | '1' | '2' | '3' | '4')[39m
[31m+       : null[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const addDefinition = (candidate: RaceStagePoint) => {[39m
[31m+     const pointType = normalizePointType(candidate.point_type)[39m
[31m+     if (!pointType) return[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const km = universalClamp([39m
[31m+       universalNumber([39m
[31m+         candidate.km_from_start,[39m
[31m+         candidate.is_finish_point || pointType === 'FINISH' ? safeDistanceKm : 0[39m
[31m+       ),[39m
[31m+       0,[39m
[31m+       safeDistanceKm[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     const normalizedCandidate: RaceStagePoint = {[39m
[31m+       ...candidate,[39m
[31m+       id:[39m
[31m+         candidate.id?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+         `${stage.id}:${pointType.toLowerCase()}:${km.toFixed(3)}`,[39m
[31m+       stage_id: stage.id,[39m
[31m+       point_type: pointType,[39m
[31m+       km_from_start: km,[39m
[31m+       kom_category:[39m
[31m+         pointType === 'KOM'[39m
[31m+           ? normalizeKomCategory(candidate.kom_category)[39m
[31m+           : null,[39m
[31m+       points_scheme: universalNumberArray(candidate.points_scheme),[39m
[31m+       time_bonus_seconds: universalNumberArray(candidate.time_bonus_seconds),[39m
[31m+       is_finish_point: Boolean([39m
[31m+         candidate.is_finish_point || pointType === 'FINISH'[39m
[31m+       ),[39m
[31m+       sort_order: universalNumber(candidate.sort_order, definitions.length),[39m
[31m+       metadata: candidate.metadata ?? {},[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const existingIndex = definitions.findIndex((existing) => {[39m
[31m+       const sameId =[39m
[31m+         Boolean(existing.id) &&[39m
[31m+         Boolean(normalizedCandidate.id) &&[39m
[31m+         existing.id === normalizedCandidate.id[39m
[31m+       const sameLocation =[39m
[31m+         String(existing.point_type).toUpperCase() === pointType &&[39m
[31m+         Math.abs(Number(existing.km_from_start) - km) < 0.11[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return sameId || sameLocation[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (existingIndex < 0) {[39m
[31m+       definitions.push(normalizedCandidate)[39m
[31m+       return[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const existing = definitions[existingIndex][39m
[31m+     definitions[existingIndex] = {[39m
[31m+       ...normalizedCandidate,[39m
[31m+       ...existing,[39m
[31m+       id: existing.id || normalizedCandidate.id,[39m
[31m+       name: existing.name?.trim() ? existing.name : normalizedCandidate.name,[39m
[31m+       kom_category:[39m
[31m+         existing.kom_category ?? normalizedCandidate.kom_category,[39m
[31m+       points_scheme:[39m
[31m+         existing.points_scheme && existing.points_scheme.length > 0[39m
[31m+           ? existing.points_scheme[39m
[31m+           : normalizedCandidate.points_scheme,[39m
[31m+       time_bonus_seconds:[39m
[31m+         existing.time_bonus_seconds && existing.time_bonus_seconds.length > 0[39m
[31m+           ? existing.time_bonus_seconds[39m
[31m+           : normalizedCandidate.time_bonus_seconds,[39m
[31m+       metadata: {[39m
[31m+         ...(normalizedCandidate.metadata ?? {}),[39m
[31m+         ...(existing.metadata ?? {}),[39m
[31m+       },[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   ;(stage.points ?? []).forEach((point) => addDefinition(point))[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const sprintItems: StageProfileDetailItem[] =[39m
[31m+     profile?.intermediate_sprints?.length[39m
[31m+       ? profile.intermediate_sprints[39m
[31m+       : (stage.intermediate_sprints_json ?? []).map([39m
[31m+           (item) => item as unknown as StageProfileDetailItem[39m
[31m+         )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   sprintItems.forEach((item, index) => {[39m
[31m+     const km = getUniversalProfileItemNumber(item, ['km_from_start', 'km'])[39m
[31m+     if (km === null) return[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const explicitType = getUniversalProfileItemString(item, [[39m
[31m+       'point_type',[39m
[31m+       'type',[39m
[31m+     ])[39m
[31m+     const pointType =[39m
[31m+       normalizePointType(explicitType) ??[39m
[31m+       (getUniversalProfileItemBoolean(item, ['is_bonus_sprint', 'bonus'])[39m
[31m+         ? 'BONUS_SPRINT'[39m
[31m+         : 'INTERMEDIATE_SPRINT')[39m
[31m+     const number = getUniversalProfileItemNumber(item, ['number', 'sort_order'])[39m
[31m+     const configuredName = getUniversalProfileItemString(item, ['name', 'label'])[39m
[31m+     const pointId = getUniversalProfileItemString(item, [[39m
[31m+       'point_id',[39m
[31m+       'stage_point_id',[39m
[31m+       'id',[39m
[31m+     ])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     addDefinition({[39m
[31m+       id:[39m
[31m+         pointId ??[39m
[31m+         `${stage.id}:profile-sprint:${index + 1}:${km.toFixed(3)}`,[39m
[31m+       stage_id: stage.id,[39m
[31m+       point_type: pointType,[39m
[31m+       km_from_start: km,[39m
[31m+       name:[39m
[31m+         configuredName ??[39m
[31m+         `${pointType === 'BONUS_SPRINT' ? 'Bonus sprint' : 'Sprint'} ${number ?? index + 1}`,[39m
[31m+       kom_category: null,[39m
[31m+       points_scheme: getUniversalProfileItemNumberArray(item, [[39m
[31m+         'points_scheme',[39m
[31m+         'point_scheme',[39m
[31m+         'points',[39m
[31m+       ]),[39m
[31m+       time_bonus_seconds: getUniversalProfileItemNumberArray(item, [[39m
[31m+         'time_bonus_seconds',[39m
[31m+         'bonus_seconds',[39m
[31m+         'bonuses',[39m
[31m+       ]),[39m
[31m+       is_finish_point: false,[39m
[31m+       sort_order:[39m
[31m+         getUniversalProfileItemNumber(item, ['sort_order', 'number']) ??[39m
[31m+         index + 1,[39m
[31m+       metadata: {[39m
[31m+         source: 'stage_profile_intermediate_sprints',[39m
[31m+       },[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const climbItems: StageProfileDetailItem[] =[39m
[31m+     profile?.mountain_climbs?.length[39m
[31m+       ? profile.mountain_climbs[39m
[31m+       : (stage.mountain_climbs_json ?? []).map([39m
[31m+           (item) => item as unknown as StageProfileDetailItem[39m
[31m+         )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   climbItems.forEach((item, index) => {[39m
[31m+     const km = getUniversalProfileItemNumber(item, ['km_from_start', 'km'])[39m
[31m+     if (km === null) return[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const pointId = getUniversalProfileItemString(item, [[39m
[31m+       'point_id',[39m
[31m+       'stage_point_id',[39m
[31m+       'id',[39m
[31m+     ])[39m
[31m+     const category = getUniversalProfileItemString(item, [[39m
[31m+       'kom_category',[39m
[31m+       'category',[39m
[31m+       'climb_category',[39m
[31m+     ])[39m
[31m+     const configuredName = getUniversalProfileItemString(item, ['name', 'label'])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     addDefinition({[39m
[31m+       id:[39m
[31m+         pointId ??[39m
[31m+         `${stage.id}:profile-kom:${index + 1}:${km.toFixed(3)}`,[39m
[31m+       stage_id: stage.id,[39m
[31m+       point_type: 'KOM',[39m
[31m+       km_from_start: km,[39m
[31m+       name: configuredName ?? `KOM ${index + 1}`,[39m
[31m+       kom_category: normalizeKomCategory(category),[39m
[31m+       points_scheme: getUniversalProfileItemNumberArray(item, [[39m
[31m+         'points_scheme',[39m
[31m+         'point_scheme',[39m
[31m+         'points',[39m
[31m+       ]),[39m
[31m+       time_bonus_seconds: getUniversalProfileItemNumberArray(item, [[39m
[31m+         'time_bonus_seconds',[39m
[31m+         'bonus_seconds',[39m
[31m+         'bonuses',[39m
[31m+       ]),[39m
[31m+       is_finish_point: false,[39m
[31m+       sort_order:[39m
[31m+         getUniversalProfileItemNumber(item, ['sort_order', 'number']) ??[39m
[31m+         sprintItems.length + index + 1,[39m
[31m+       metadata: {[39m
[31m+         source: 'stage_profile_mountain_climbs',[39m
[31m+         isFinishClimb: getUniversalProfileItemBoolean(item, [[39m
[31m+           'is_finish_climb',[39m
[31m+         ]),[39m
[31m+       },[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   ;(profile?.route_markers ?? []).forEach((marker, index) => {[39m
[31m+     const pointType = normalizePointType(marker.type)[39m
[31m+     if (!pointType) return[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     addDefinition({[39m
[31m+       id: `${stage.id}:profile-marker:${pointType.toLowerCase()}:${marker.km.toFixed(3)}`,[39m
[31m+       stage_id: stage.id,[39m
[31m+       point_type: pointType,[39m
[31m+       km_from_start: marker.km,[39m
[31m+       name: marker.label,[39m
[31m+       kom_category: normalizeKomCategory(marker.category),[39m
[31m+       points_scheme: [],[39m
[31m+       time_bonus_seconds: [],[39m
[31m+       is_finish_point: pointType === 'FINISH',[39m
[31m+       sort_order: sprintItems.length + climbItems.length + index + 1,[39m
[31m+       metadata: {[39m
[31m+         source: 'stage_profile_route_markers',[39m
[31m+       },[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   addDefinition({[39m
[31m+     id: `${stage.id}:start`,[39m
[31m+     stage_id: stage.id,[39m
[31m+     point_type: 'START',[39m
[31m+     km_from_start: 0,[39m
[31m+     name: 'Start',[39m
[31m+     kom_category: null,[39m
[31m+     points_scheme: [],[39m
[31m+     time_bonus_seconds: [],[39m
[31m+     is_finish_point: false,[39m
[31m+     sort_order: -1,[39m
[31m+     metadata: { source: 'shadow_adapter_required_boundary' },[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const stageFormat = normalizeUniversalStageFormat(stage)[39m
[31m+   const fallbackFinishPoints =[39m
[31m+     stageFormat === 'team_time_trial' || stageFormat === 'pair_time_trial'[39m
[31m+       ? [][39m
[31m+       : stageFormat === 'individual_time_trial' || stageFormat === 'prologue'[39m
[31m+         ? universalNumberArray(DEFAULT_TIME_TRIAL_FINISH_POINTS_SCHEME)[39m
[31m+         : universalNumberArray(DEFAULT_FINISH_POINTS_SCHEME)[39m
[31m+   const fallbackFinishBonuses =[39m
[31m+     stageFormat === 'road_race'[39m
[31m+       ? universalNumberArray(DEFAULT_FINISH_TIME_BONUSES)[39m
[31m+       : [][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   addDefinition({[39m
[31m+     id: `${stage.id}:finish`,[39m
[31m+     stage_id: stage.id,[39m
[31m+     point_type: 'FINISH',[39m
[31m+     km_from_start: safeDistanceKm,[39m
[31m+     name: 'Finish',[39m
[31m+     kom_category: null,[39m
[31m+     points_scheme: fallbackFinishPoints,[39m
[31m+     time_bonus_seconds: fallbackFinishBonuses,[39m
[31m+     is_finish_point: true,[39m
[31m+     sort_order: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,[39m
[31m+     metadata: {[39m
[31m+       source: 'shadow_adapter_required_boundary',[39m
[31m+       fallbackFinishAwardsApplied: true,[39m
[31m+     },[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const orderedDefinitions = definitions.sort([39m
[31m+     (left, right) =>[39m
[31m+       Number(left.km_from_start) - Number(right.km_from_start) ||[39m
[31m+       Number(left.sort_order) - Number(right.sort_order) ||[39m
[31m+       left.id.localeCompare(right.id)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return orderedDefinitions.map((point, index) => ({[39m
[31m+     ...point,[39m
[31m+     sort_order: index,[39m
[31m+     metadata: {[39m
[31m+       ...(point.metadata ?? {}),[39m
[31m+       sourceSortOrder: point.sort_order,[39m
[31m+       normalizedStageWideSortOrder: index,[39m
[31m+     },[39m
[31m+   }))[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildUniversalStagePoints([39m
[31m+   stage: RaceStage,[39m
[31m+   profile: StageProfileDetailPayload | null,[39m
[31m+   distanceKm: number[39m
[31m+ ) {[39m
[31m+   const validKomCategories = new Set(['HC', '1', '2', '3', '4'])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return buildUniversalStagePointDefinitions(stage, profile, distanceKm).map([39m
[31m+     (point, index) => {[39m
[31m+       const pointType = String(point.point_type).toUpperCase() as[39m
[31m+         | 'START'[39m
[31m+         | 'INTERMEDIATE_SPRINT'[39m
[31m+         | 'KOM'[39m
[31m+         | 'BONUS_SPRINT'[39m
[31m+         | 'FINISH'[39m
[31m+       const rawCategory = String(point.kom_category ?? '').trim().toUpperCase()[39m
[31m+       const komCategory =[39m
[31m+         pointType === 'KOM'[39m
[31m+           ? validKomCategories.has(rawCategory)[39m
[31m+             ? (rawCategory as 'HC' | '1' | '2' | '3' | '4')[39m
[31m+             : '4'[39m
[31m+           : null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return {[39m
[31m+         pointId: point.id || `${stage.id}:point:${index}`,[39m
[31m+         stageId: stage.id,[39m
[31m+         pointType,[39m
[31m+         kmFromStart: universalClamp([39m
[31m+           universalNumber([39m
[31m+             point.km_from_start,[39m
[31m+             point.is_finish_point ? distanceKm : 0[39m
[31m+           ),[39m
[31m+           0,[39m
[31m+           distanceKm[39m
[31m+         ),[39m
[31m+         name: universalNullableString(point.name),[39m
[31m+         komCategory,[39m
[31m+         pointsScheme: universalNumberArray(point.points_scheme),[39m
[31m+         timeBonusSeconds: universalNumberArray(point.time_bonus_seconds),[39m
[31m+         isFinishPoint: Boolean([39m
[31m+           point.is_finish_point || pointType === 'FINISH'[39m
[31m+         ),[39m
[31m+         sortOrder: universalNumber(point.sort_order, index),[39m
[31m+         metadata: {[39m
[31m+           ...(point.metadata ?? {}),[39m
[31m+           shadowAdapterFallbackKomCategory:[39m
[31m+             pointType === 'KOM' && !validKomCategories.has(rawCategory),[39m
[31m+         } as Record<string, unknown>,[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getUniversalParticipantRiderLookup(participantTeams: RaceParticipantTeam[]) {[39m
[31m+   const lookup = new Map<[39m
[31m+     string,[39m
[31m+     { rider: RaceParticipantRider; team: RaceParticipantTeam }[39m
[31m+   >()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   participantTeams.forEach((team) => {[39m
[31m+     team.riders.forEach((rider) => {[39m
[31m+       if (rider.rider_id) lookup.set(rider.rider_id, { rider, team })[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return lookup[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+         flat: overall,[39m
[31m+         endurance: overall,[39m
[31m+         recovery: overall,[39m
[31m+         resistance: overall,[39m
[31m+         race_iq: overall,[39m
[31m+         teamwork: overall,[39m

[31m+ function phase9PreparationRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {[39m
[31m+   const record = getRecord(value)[39m
[31m+   const nested = getRecord([39m
[31m+     record.phase9_preparation ??[39m
[31m+       record.phase9Preparation ??[39m
[31m+       record.preparation_snapshot ??[39m
[31m+       record.preparationSnapshot[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   return Object.keys(nested).length > 0 ? nested : record[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function phase9PreparationSection([39m
[31m+   source: Record<string, unknown>,[39m
[31m+   camelKey: string,[39m
[31m+   snakeKey: string[39m
[31m+ ): JsonObject {[39m
[31m+   return getRecord(source[camelKey] ?? source[snakeKey]) as JsonObject[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function mergePhase9JsonObjects([39m
[31m+   target: JsonObject,[39m
[31m+   source: JsonObject[39m
[31m+ ): JsonObject {[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     ...target,[39m
[31m+     ...source,[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildUniversalPhase9PreparationInput([39m
[31m+   stage: RaceStage,[39m
[31m+   profile: StageProfileDetailPayload | null,[39m
[31m+   riderRows: readonly UniversalStageRiderInputRow[],[39m
[31m+   productionPayload: UniversalPhase9ProductionPayload | null[39m
[31m+ ): UniversalPreparationInput {[39m
[31m+   const stageRules = phase9PreparationRecord(stage.rules_snapshot)[39m
[31m+   const stageMetadata = phase9PreparationRecord(stage.metadata)[39m
[31m+   const profilePreparation = phase9PreparationRecord([39m
[31m+     profile?.phase9_preparation[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const sources = [stageRules, stageMetadata, profilePreparation].filter([39m
[31m+     (source) => Object.keys(source).length > 0[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   let equipment: JsonObject = {}[39m
[31m+   let staff: JsonObject = {}[39m
[31m+   let assets: JsonObject = {}[39m
[31m+   let raceSupplies: JsonObject = {}[39m
[31m+   let standardizedBonuses: JsonObject = {}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   sources.forEach((source) => {[39m
[31m+     equipment = mergePhase9JsonObjects([39m
[31m+       equipment,[39m
[31m+       phase9PreparationSection(source, 'equipment', 'equipment')[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     staff = mergePhase9JsonObjects([39m
[31m+       staff,[39m
[31m+       phase9PreparationSection(source, 'staff', 'staff')[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     assets = mergePhase9JsonObjects([39m
[31m+       assets,[39m
[31m+       phase9PreparationSection(source, 'assets', 'assets')[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     raceSupplies = mergePhase9JsonObjects([39m
[31m+       raceSupplies,[39m
[31m+       phase9PreparationSection(source, 'raceSupplies', 'race_supplies')[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     standardizedBonuses = mergePhase9JsonObjects([39m
[31m+       standardizedBonuses,[39m
[31m+       phase9PreparationSection([39m
[31m+         source,[39m
[31m+         'standardizedBonuses',[39m
[31m+         'standardized_bonuses'[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const existingTeams = getRecord(standardizedBonuses.teams)[39m
[31m+   const normalizedTeams: JsonObject = { ...(existingTeams as JsonObject) }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   riderRows.forEach((row) => {[39m
[31m+     const snapshots = [[39m
[31m+       row.bonus_snapshot_json,[39m
[31m+       row.rider_stage_snapshot_json,[39m
[31m+       row.rider_snapshot_json,[39m
[31m+     ][39m
[31m+     for (const snapshotValue of snapshots) {[39m
[31m+       const snapshot = getRecord(snapshotValue)[39m
[31m+       const teamModifiers = getRecord([39m
[31m+         snapshot.phase9_team_modifiers ??[39m
[31m+           snapshot.phase9TeamModifiers ??[39m
[31m+           snapshot.universal_phase9_team_modifiers[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+       if (Object.keys(teamModifiers).length === 0) continue[39m
[31m+       normalizedTeams[row.team_id] = {[39m
[31m+         ...getRecord(normalizedTeams[row.team_id]),[39m
[31m+         ...teamModifiers,[39m
[31m+       } as JsonObject[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (Object.keys(normalizedTeams).length > 0) {[39m
[31m+     standardizedBonuses = {[39m
[31m+       ...standardizedBonuses,[39m
[31m+       teams: normalizedTeams,[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (productionPayload) {[39m
[31m+     equipment = mergePhase9JsonObjects([39m
[31m+       equipment,[39m
[31m+       productionPayload.preparation.equipment as JsonObject[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     staff = mergePhase9JsonObjects([39m
[31m+       staff,[39m
[31m+       productionPayload.preparation.staff as JsonObject[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     assets = mergePhase9JsonObjects([39m
[31m+       assets,[39m
[31m+       productionPayload.preparation.assets as JsonObject[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     raceSupplies = mergePhase9JsonObjects([39m
[31m+       raceSupplies,[39m
[31m+       productionPayload.preparation.raceSupplies as JsonObject[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     standardizedBonuses = {[39m
[31m+       ...standardizedBonuses,[39m
[31m+       ...productionPayload.preparation.standardizedBonuses,[39m
[31m+       teams: {[39m
[31m+         ...getRecord(standardizedBonuses.teams),[39m
[31m+         ...getRecord([39m
[31m+           productionPayload.preparation.standardizedBonuses.teams[39m
[31m+         ),[39m
[31m+       },[39m
[31m+       productionDiagnostics: productionPayload.diagnostics,[39m
[31m+       productionSource:[39m
[31m+         productionPayload.source ?? 'race_engine_get_stage_phase9_inputs_v1',[39m
[31m+       productionModelVersion: productionPayload.modelVersion,[39m
[31m+     } as JsonObject[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     equipment,[39m
[31m+     staff,[39m
[31m+     assets,[39m
[31m+     raceSupplies,[39m
[31m+     standardizedBonuses,[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildUniversalRaceEngineInput({[39m
[31m+   race,[39m
[31m+   stage,[39m
[31m+   profile,[39m
[31m+   participantTeams,[39m
[31m+   riderInputRows,[39m
[31m+   phaseCommandRows,[39m
[31m+   phase9ProductionPayload,[39m
[31m+   shadowMode,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   race: Race[39m
[31m+   stage: RaceStage[39m
[31m+   profile: StageProfileDetailPayload | null[39m
[31m+   participantTeams: RaceParticipantTeam[][39m
[31m+   riderInputRows: UniversalStageRiderInputRow[][39m
[31m+   phaseCommandRows: UniversalStagePhaseCommandRow[][39m
[31m+   phase9ProductionPayload: UniversalPhase9ProductionPayload | null[39m
[31m+   shadowMode: UniversalShadowMode[39m
[31m+ }): UniversalRaceEngineInput {[39m
[31m+   const distanceKm = Math.max([39m
[31m+     1,[39m
[31m+     universalNumber(profile?.distance_km ?? stage.distance_km, 1)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const stageFormat = normalizeUniversalStageFormat(stage)[39m
[31m+   const terrainType = normalizeUniversalTerrainType(stage, stageFormat)[39m
[31m+   const finishType = normalizeUniversalFinishType(stage, stageFormat, terrainType)[39m
[31m+   const sprintZoneKm = normalizeUniversalSprintZoneKm([39m
[31m+     stage,[39m
[31m+     stageFormat,[39m
[31m+     finishType[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const participantLookup = getUniversalParticipantRiderLookup(participantTeams)[39m
[31m+   const commandByRiderId = new Map([39m
[31m+     phaseCommandRows.map((row) => [row.rider_id, row] as const)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const phase9ModifierByRiderId = new Map([39m
[31m+     (phase9ProductionPayload?.riderModifiers ?? []).map([39m
[31m+       (row) => [row.rider_id, row] as const[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const riderRows = riderInputRows.filter([39m
[31m+     (row) => row.rider_id?.trim() && row.team_id?.trim()[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const rowsByTeamId = new Map<string, UniversalStageRiderInputRow[]>()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   riderRows.forEach((row) => {[39m
[31m+     const existing = rowsByTeamId.get(row.team_id) ?? [][39m
[31m+     existing.push(row)[39m
[31m+     rowsByTeamId.set(row.team_id, existing)[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const teams = [...rowsByTeamId.entries()].map(([teamId, rows]) => {[39m
[31m+     const firstRow = rows[0][39m
[31m+     const participantTeam = getResultParticipantTeam([39m
[31m+       participantTeams,[39m
[31m+       teamId,[39m
[31m+       firstRow?.team_name[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       participantTeamId: participantTeam?.id ?? teamId,[39m
[31m+       teamId,[39m
[31m+       clubId: participantTeam?.club_id ?? teamId,[39m
[31m+       participatingClubId:[39m
[31m+         participantTeam?.participating_club_id ?? participantTeam?.club_id ?? teamId,[39m
[31m+       ownerClubId: participantTeam?.owner_club_id ?? null,[39m
[31m+       parentClubId: participantTeam?.parent_club_id ?? null,[39m
[31m+       raceTeamEntryId: participantTeam?.race_team_entry_id ?? null,[39m
[31m+       clubType: participantTeam?.club_type ?? null,[39m
[31m+       acceptedRiderIds: rows.map((row) => row.rider_id),[39m
[31m+       snapshot: {[39m
[31m+         teamName: firstRow?.team_name ?? (participantTeam ? getParticipantTeamName(participantTeam) : null),[39m
[31m+         countryCode:[39m
[31m+           participantTeam?.country_code ?? participantTeam?.country_code_snapshot ?? null,[39m
[31m+         clubTier: participantTeam?.club_tier ?? null,[39m
[31m+         worldTier: participantTeam?.world_tier ?? null,[39m
[31m+         logoUrl: participantTeam?.logo_url_snapshot ?? null,[39m
[31m+         jerseyUrl: participantTeam?.jersey_url_snapshot ?? null,[39m
[31m+         metadata: {[39m
[31m+           shadowInputSource: 'race_engine_get_stage_rider_inputs_v1',[39m
[31m+           phase9PreparationSource:[39m
[31m+             phase9ProductionPayload?.modelVersion ?? null,[39m
[31m+         },[39m
[31m+       },[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const riders = riderRows.map((row) => {[39m
[31m+     const participant = participantLookup.get(row.rider_id)[39m
[31m+     const phase9Modifier = phase9ModifierByRiderId.get(row.rider_id)[39m
[31m+     const availabilityStatus = normalizeUniversalAvailability([39m
[31m+       row.availability_status[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     const snapshots = [[39m
[31m+       row.bonus_snapshot_json,[39m

[31m+ function universalGroupLabel(groupCode: string): string {[39m
[31m+   switch (groupCode) {[39m
[31m+     case 'breakaway':[39m
[31m+       return 'Breakaway'[39m
[31m+     case 'main_peloton':[39m
[31m+       return 'Main peloton'[39m
[31m+     case 'front_group':[39m
[31m+       return 'Front group'[39m
[31m+     case 'main_group':[39m
[31m+       return 'Main group'[39m
[31m+     case 'chasing_group':[39m
[31m+       return 'Chasing group'[39m
[31m+     case 'dropped_group':[39m
[31m+       return 'Dropped group'[39m
[31m+     case 'winning_group':[39m
[31m+       return 'Winning group'[39m
[31m+     case 'front_chase_group':[39m
[31m+       return 'Front chase group'[39m
[31m+     case 'main_finish_group':[39m
[31m+       return 'Main finish group'[39m
[31m+     case 'late_group':[39m
[31m+       return 'Late group'[39m
[31m+     case 'front_favourites':[39m
[31m+       return 'Front favourites'[39m
[31m+     case 'reduced_peloton':[39m
[31m+       return 'Reduced peloton'[39m
[31m+     case 'time_limit_group':[39m
[31m+       return 'Time-limit group'[39m
[31m+     case 'individual_time_unit':[39m
[31m+       return 'Individual time'[39m
[31m+     case 'team_time_unit':[39m
[31m+       return 'Team time'[39m
[31m+     default:[39m
[31m+       return humanizeCode(groupCode)[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function getUniversalReplayDurationSeconds([39m
[31m+   result: UniversalRaceEngineResult[39m
[31m+ ): number {[39m
[31m+   const finalCheckpoint = result.replayTimeline.checkpoints.find([39m
[31m+     (checkpoint) =>[39m
[31m+       checkpoint.checkpointId === result.replayTimeline.finalCheckpointId[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const maximumFinishTime =[39m
[31m+     finalCheckpoint?.riderStates.reduce([39m
[31m+       (maximum, row) =>[39m
[31m+         Math.max(maximum, Number(row.officialTimeSeconds ?? 0)),[39m
[31m+       0[39m
[31m+     ) ?? 0[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return maximumFinishTime > 0 ? maximumFinishTime : 4 * 3600[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getUniversalReplayFramePair([39m
[31m+   frames: readonly UniversalReplayCheckpoint[],[39m
[31m+   progress: number[39m
[31m+ ): {[39m
[31m+   previous: UniversalReplayCheckpoint | null[39m
[31m+   next: UniversalReplayCheckpoint | null[39m
[31m+   fraction: number[39m
[31m+ } {[39m
[31m+   if (frames.length === 0) {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       previous: null,[39m
[31m+       next: null,[39m
[31m+       fraction: 0,[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const normalizedProgress = universalClamp(progress, 0, 1)[39m
[31m+   let previousIndex = 0[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (let index = 0; index < frames.length; index += 1) {[39m
[31m+     const frame = frames[index][39m
[31m+     if (!frame) continue[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (frame.raceProgress.fraction <= normalizedProgress + 0.000001) {[39m
[31m+       previousIndex = index[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const previous = frames[previousIndex] ?? frames[0] ?? null[39m
[31m+   const next = frames[Math.min(frames.length - 1, previousIndex + 1)] ?? previous[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!previous || !next || previous === next) {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       previous,[39m
[31m+       next,[39m
[31m+       fraction: 0,[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const previousProgress = previous.raceProgress.fraction[39m
[31m+   const nextProgress = next.raceProgress.fraction[39m
[31m+   const fraction =[39m
[31m+     nextProgress > previousProgress[39m
[31m+       ? universalClamp([39m
[31m+           (normalizedProgress - previousProgress) /[39m
[31m+             (nextProgress - previousProgress),[39m
[31m+           0,[39m
[31m+           1[39m
[31m+         )[39m
[31m+       : 0[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     previous,[39m
[31m+     next,[39m
[31m+     fraction,[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function haveSameUniversalReplayGroupLineage([39m
[31m+   currentGroup: UniversalReplayCheckpoint['groups'][number] | null,[39m
[31m+   nextGroup: UniversalReplayCheckpoint['groups'][number] | null[39m
[31m+ ): boolean {[39m
[31m+   if (!currentGroup || !nextGroup) return false[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   // Group identity is stable when the authoritative physical group code and[39m
[31m+   // display code are stable. Rider membership may legitimately change at an[39m
[31m+   // exact incident/rejoin checkpoint without creating a different peloton or[39m
[31m+   // breakaway lineage. Requiring identical rider arrays freezes the displayed[39m
[31m+   // gap across precisely those incident intervals.[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     currentGroup.groupCode === nextGroup.groupCode &&[39m
[31m+     currentGroup.displayCode === nextGroup.displayCode[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function interpolateStableUniversalReplayGapSeconds([39m
[31m+   currentGapSeconds: number,[39m
[31m+   nextGapSeconds: number,[39m
[31m+   fraction: number[39m
[31m+ ): number {[39m
[31m+   return Math.max([39m
[31m+     0,[39m
[31m+     currentGapSeconds +[39m
[31m+       (nextGapSeconds - currentGapSeconds) * universalClamp(fraction, 0, 1)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getUniversalReplayGroupBadge(displayCode: string): string {[39m
[31m+   return displayCode || 'P'[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getUniversalReplayGroupBadgeClass([39m
[31m+   displayCode: string,[39m
[31m+   colorKey: string[39m
[31m+ ): string {[39m
[31m+   if (colorKey === 'peloton_blue' || displayCode === 'P') {[39m
[31m+     return 'bg-blue-600'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (colorKey.includes('breakaway') || displayCode.startsWith('B')) {[39m
[31m+     return 'bg-emerald-500'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (colorKey.includes('front') || displayCode.startsWith('F')) {[39m
[31m+     return 'bg-yellow-500'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if ([39m
[31m+     colorKey.includes('chasing') ||[39m
[31m+     colorKey.includes('dropped') ||[39m
[31m+     colorKey.includes('time_limit') ||[39m
[31m+     displayCode.startsWith('C')[39m
[31m+   ) {[39m
[31m+     return 'bg-orange-600'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return 'bg-red-500'[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildUniversalReplayPointResults([39m
[31m+   stagePoints: RaceStagePoint[],[39m
[31m+   input: UniversalRaceEngineInput,[39m
[31m+   checkpoint: UniversalReplayCheckpoint | null,[39m
[31m+   result: UniversalRaceEngineResult[39m
[31m+ ): RacePointResultRow[] {[39m
[31m+   if (!checkpoint) return [][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const riderById = new Map([39m
[31m+     input.riders.map((rider) => [rider.riderId, rider] as const)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const teamById = new Map([39m
[31m+     input.teams.map((team) => [team.teamId, team] as const)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const stagePointById = new Map([39m
[31m+     stagePoints.map((point) => [point.id, point] as const)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const rows: RacePointResultRow[] = [][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   checkpoint.intermediateResults.forEach((event) => {[39m
[31m+     const stagePoint = stagePointById.get(event.pointId)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     event.rankings.forEach((ranking) => {[39m
[31m+       const rider = riderById.get(ranking.riderId)[39m
[31m+       const team = teamById.get(ranking.teamId)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       rows.push({[39m
[31m+         point_id: event.pointId,[39m
[31m+         point_type: event.pointType,[39m
[31m+         point_name:[39m
[31m+           event.pointName ??[39m
[31m+           stagePoint?.name ??[39m
[31m+           humanizeCode(event.pointType),[39m
[31m+         km_from_start: event.kmFromStart,[39m
[31m+         kom_category: stagePoint?.kom_category ?? null,[39m
[31m+         sort_order: stagePoint?.sort_order ?? event.eventOrder,[39m
[31m+         rank: ranking.rank,[39m
[31m+         rider_id: ranking.riderId,[39m
[31m+         team_id: ranking.teamId,[39m
[31m+         rider_name_snapshot:[39m
[31m+           rider?.snapshot.displayName ?? ranking.riderId,[39m
[31m+         team_name_snapshot:[39m
[31m+           team?.snapshot.teamName ?? ranking.teamId,[39m
[31m+         points_awarded: ranking.pointsAwarded,[39m
[31m+         bonus_seconds_awarded: ranking.bonusSecondsAwarded,[39m
[31m+       })[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const phase4 = result.roadRaceResolution.phase4Finish[39m
[31m+   const finishPoint =[39m
[31m+     stagePoints.find([39m
[31m+       (point) =>[39m
[31m+         String(point.point_type ?? '').toUpperCase() === 'FINISH'[39m
[31m+     ) ?? null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if ([39m
[31m+     checkpoint.finalResultsVisible &&[39m
[31m+     phase4 &&[39m
[31m+     finishPoint &&[39m
[31m+     result.finishResolution.complete[39m
[31m+   ) {[39m
[31m+     const phase4AwardsByRank = new Map([39m
[31m+       phase4.finish.rankings.map([39m
[31m+         (ranking) =>[39m
[31m+           [[39m
[31m+             ranking.rank,[39m
[31m+             {[39m
[31m+               pointsAwarded: ranking.pointsAwarded,[39m
[31m+               bonusSecondsAwarded: ranking.bonusSecondsAwarded,[39m
[31m+             },[39m
[31m+           ] as const[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     checkpoint.riderStates[39m
[31m+       .filter([39m
[31m+         (official) =>[39m
[31m+           official.status === 'finished' &&[39m
[31m+           official.finishRank !== null[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+       .forEach((official) => {[39m
[31m+         const awards = phase4AwardsByRank.get(official.finishRank as number)[39m
[31m+         if ([39m
[31m+           !awards ||[39m
[31m+           (awards.pointsAwarded <= 0 &&[39m
[31m+             awards.bonusSecondsAwarded <= 0)[39m
[31m+         ) {[39m
[31m+           return[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         const rider = riderById.get(official.riderId)[39m
[31m+         const team = teamById.get(official.teamId)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         rows.push({[39m
[31m+           point_id: finishPoint.id,[39m
[31m+           point_type: 'FINISH',[39m
[31m+           point_name: finishPoint.name ?? 'Finish',[39m
[31m+           km_from_start: finishPoint.km_from_start,[39m
[31m+           kom_category: null,[39m
[31m+           sort_order: finishPoint.sort_order,[39m
[31m+           rank: official.finishRank,[39m
[31m+           rider_id: official.riderId,[39m
[31m+           team_id: official.teamId,[39m
[31m+           rider_name_snapshot:[39m
[31m+             rider?.snapshot.displayName ?? official.riderId,[39m
[31m+           team_name_snapshot:[39m
[31m+             team?.snapshot.teamName ?? official.teamId,[39m
[31m+           points_awarded: awards.pointsAwarded,[39m
[31m+           bonus_seconds_awarded: awards.bonusSecondsAwarded,[39m
[31m+         })[39m
[31m+       })[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return rows.sort([39m
[31m+     (left, right) =>[39m
[31m+       Number(left.sort_order ?? 999) -[39m
[31m+         Number(right.sort_order ?? 999) ||[39m
[31m+       Number(left.km_from_start ?? 0) -[39m
[31m+         Number(right.km_from_start ?? 0) ||[39m
[31m+       Number(left.rank ?? 999) -[39m
[31m+         Number(right.rank ?? 999)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildUniversalShadowStageResults([39m
[31m+   input: UniversalRaceEngineInput,[39m
[31m+   result: UniversalRaceEngineResult,[39m
[31m+   pointResults: readonly RacePointResultRow[][39m
[31m+ ): RaceStageResultRow[] {[39m
[31m+   if (!result.finishResolution.complete) {[39m
[31m+     throw new Error([39m
[31m+       'The universal finish resolution is incomplete and cannot be displayed.'[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const officialResults = result.finishResolution.classification[39m
[31m+   if (officialResults.length === 0) return [][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const riderById = new Map([39m
[31m+     input.riders.map((rider) => [rider.riderId, rider] as const)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const teamById = new Map([39m
[31m+     input.teams.map((team) => [team.teamId, team] as const)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const phase4FinishByRank = new Map([39m
[31m+     result.roadRaceResolution.phase4Finish?.finish.rankings.map([39m
[31m+       (ranking) => [ranking.rank, ranking] as const[39m
[31m+     ) ?? [][39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const pointTotalsByRiderId = new Map<[39m
[31m+     string,[39m
[31m+     {[39m
[31m+       finishPoints: number[39m
[31m+       sprintPoints: number[39m
[31m+       mountainPoints: number[39m
[31m+       bonusSeconds: number[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   >()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   pointResults.forEach((row) => {[39m
[31m+     if (!row.rider_id) return[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const totals = pointTotalsByRiderId.get(row.rider_id) ?? {[39m
[31m+       finishPoints: 0,[39m
[31m+       sprintPoints: 0,[39m
[31m+       mountainPoints: 0,[39m
[31m+       bonusSeconds: 0,[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     const pointType = String(row.point_type ?? '').toUpperCase()[39m
[31m+     const awardedPoints = Number(row.points_awarded ?? 0)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (pointType === 'FINISH') totals.finishPoints += awardedPoints[39m
[31m+     else if (pointType === 'KOM') totals.mountainPoints += awardedPoints[39m
[31m+     else totals.sprintPoints += awardedPoints[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     totals.bonusSeconds += Number(row.bonus_seconds_awarded ?? 0)[39m
[31m+     pointTotalsByRiderId.set(row.rider_id, totals)[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return officialResults.map((official) => {[39m
[31m+     const rider = riderById.get(official.riderId)[39m
[31m+     const team = teamById.get(official.teamId)[39m
[31m+     const phase4Finish =[39m
[31m+       official.rank === null[39m
[31m+         ? null[39m
[31m+         : phase4FinishByRank.get(official.rank) ?? null[39m
[31m+     const totals = pointTotalsByRiderId.get(official.riderId) ?? {[39m
[31m+       finishPoints: phase4Finish?.pointsAwarded ?? 0,[39m
[31m+       sprintPoints: 0,[39m
[31m+       mountainPoints: 0,[39m
[31m+       bonusSeconds: phase4Finish?.bonusSecondsAwarded ?? 0,[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       rank: official.rank,[39m
[31m+       rider_id: official.riderId,[39m
[31m+       team_id: official.teamId,[39m
[31m+       rider_name_snapshot:[39m
[31m+         rider?.snapshot.displayName ?? official.riderId,[39m
[31m+       team_name_snapshot:[39m
[31m+         team?.snapshot.teamName ?? official.teamId,[39m
[31m+       elapsed_seconds: official.officialTimeSeconds,[39m
[31m+       gap_seconds: official.gapSeconds,[39m
[31m+       bonus_seconds:[39m
[31m+         official.status === 'finished' ? totals.bonusSeconds : 0,[39m
[31m+       penalty_seconds: 0,[39m
[31m+       finish_points:[39m
[31m+         official.status === 'finished' ? totals.finishPoints : 0,[39m
[31m+       sprint_points: totals.sprintPoints,[39m
[31m+       mountain_points: totals.mountainPoints,[39m
[31m+       status: official.status,[39m
[31m+       full_name: rider?.snapshot.displayName ?? official.riderId,[39m
[31m+       rider_country_code: rider?.snapshot.countryCode ?? null,[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildUniversalShadowClassifications([39m
[31m+   input: UniversalRaceEngineInput,[39m
[31m+   stageRows: readonly RaceStageResultRow[],[39m
[31m+   participantTeams: readonly RaceParticipantTeam[][39m
[31m+ ): RaceClassificationRow[] {[39m
[31m+   const participantRiderById = new Map([39m
[31m+     participantTeams.flatMap((team) =>[39m
[31m+       team.riders.map((rider) => [rider.rider_id, rider] as const)[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const teamById = new Map([39m
[31m+     input.teams.map((team) => [team.teamId, team] as const)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const adjustedTime = (row: RaceStageResultRow) =>[39m
[31m+     Math.max([39m
[31m+       0,[39m
[31m+       Number(row.elapsed_seconds ?? 0) -[39m
[31m+         Number(row.bonus_seconds ?? 0) +[39m
[31m+         Number(row.penalty_seconds ?? 0)[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   const baseRiderRow = ([39m
[31m+     row: RaceStageResultRow,[39m
[31m+     classificationType: ClassificationView,[39m
[31m+     rank: number,[39m
[31m+     totalTimeSeconds: number | null,[39m
[31m+     gapSeconds: number | null,[39m
[31m+     points: number | null[39m
[31m+   ): RaceClassificationRow => ({[39m
[31m+     classification_type: classificationType,[39m
[31m+     entity_type: 'rider',[39m
[31m+     rank,[39m
[31m+     previous_rank: null,[39m
[31m+     rider_id: row.rider_id,[39m
[31m+     team_id: row.team_id,[39m
[31m+     display_name_snapshot:[39m
[31m+       row.full_name ?? row.rider_name_snapshot ?? row.rider_id,[39m
[31m+     team_name_snapshot: row.team_name_snapshot,[39m
[31m+     total_time_seconds: totalTimeSeconds,[39m
[31m+     gap_seconds: gapSeconds,[39m
[31m+     points,[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const classifications: RaceClassificationRow[] = [][39m
[31m+   const classifiedStageRows = stageRows.filter([39m
[31m+     (row) =>[39m
[31m+       row.status === 'finished' &&[39m
[31m+       row.rank !== null &&[39m
[31m+       row.elapsed_seconds !== null[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const generalRows = [...classifiedStageRows].sort([39m
[31m+     (left, right) =>[39m
[31m+       adjustedTime(left) - adjustedTime(right) ||[39m
[31m+       Number(left.rank ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) -[39m
[31m+         Number(right.rank ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const generalLeaderTime = generalRows.length > 0[39m
[31m+     ? adjustedTime(generalRows[0])[39m
[31m+     : 0[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   generalRows.forEach((row, index) => {[39m
[31m+     const time = adjustedTime(row)[39m
[31m+     classifications.push([39m
[31m+       baseRiderRow([39m
[31m+         row,[39m
[31m+         'general',[39m
[31m+         index + 1,[39m
[31m+         time,[39m
[31m+         time - generalLeaderTime,[39m
[31m+         null[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const buildPointClassification = ([39m
[31m+     type: 'points' | 'mountain',[39m
[31m+     getPoints: (row: RaceStageResultRow) => number[39m
[31m+   ) => {[39m
[31m+     const rows = [...classifiedStageRows][39m
[31m+       .map((row) => ({ row, points: getPoints(row) }))[39m
[31m+       .filter((entry) => entry.points > 0)[39m
[31m+       .sort([39m
[31m+         (left, right) =>[39m
[31m+           right.points - left.points ||[39m
[31m+           Number(left.row.rank ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) -[39m
[31m+             Number(right.row.rank ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     rows.forEach((entry, index) => {[39m
[31m+       classifications.push([39m
[31m+         baseRiderRow([39m
[31m+           entry.row,[39m
[31m+           type,[39m
[31m+           index + 1,[39m
[31m+           null,[39m
[31m+           null,[39m
[31m+           entry.points[39m
[31m+         )[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   buildPointClassification([39m
[31m+     'points',[39m
[31m+     (row) => Number(row.finish_points ?? 0) + Number(row.sprint_points ?? 0)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   buildPointClassification([39m
[31m+     'mountain',[39m
[31m+     (row) => Number(row.mountain_points ?? 0)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const youngRows = generalRows.filter((row) =>[39m
[31m+     row.rider_id[39m
[31m+       ? participantRiderById.get(row.rider_id)?.is_young_rider === true[39m
[31m+       : false[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const youngLeaderTime = youngRows.length > 0 ? adjustedTime(youngRows[0]) : 0[39m
[31m+   youngRows.forEach((row, index) => {[39m
[31m+     const time = adjustedTime(row)[39m
[31m+     classifications.push([39m
[31m+       baseRiderRow([39m
[31m+         row,[39m
[31m+         'young',[39m
[31m+         index + 1,[39m
[31m+         time,[39m
[31m+         time - youngLeaderTime,[39m
[31m+         null[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const teamTimes = new Map<string, number[]>()[39m
[31m+   classifiedStageRows.forEach((row) => {[39m
[31m+     if (!row.team_id) return[39m
[31m+     const values = teamTimes.get(row.team_id) ?? [][39m
[31m+     values.push(adjustedTime(row))[39m
[31m+     teamTimes.set(row.team_id, values)[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+   const rankedTeams = [...teamTimes.entries()][39m
[31m+     .map(([teamId, times]) => ({[39m
[31m+       teamId,[39m
[31m+       totalTime: [...times][39m
[31m+         .sort((left, right) => left - right)[39m
[31m+         .slice(0, 3)[39m
[31m+         .reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0),[39m
[31m+     }))[39m
[31m+     .sort([39m
[31m+       (left, right) =>[39m
[31m+         left.totalTime - right.totalTime ||[39m
[31m+         left.teamId.localeCompare(right.teamId)[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   const teamLeaderTime = rankedTeams[0]?.totalTime ?? 0[39m
[31m+   rankedTeams.forEach((entry, index) => {[39m
[31m+     const team = teamById.get(entry.teamId)[39m
[31m+     classifications.push({[39m
[31m+       classification_type: 'team',[39m
[31m+       entity_type: 'team',[39m
[31m+       rank: index + 1,[39m
[31m+       previous_rank: null,[39m
[31m+       rider_id: null,[39m
[31m+       team_id: entry.teamId,[39m
[31m+       display_name_snapshot: team?.snapshot.teamName ?? entry.teamId,[39m
[31m+       team_name_snapshot: team?.snapshot.teamName ?? entry.teamId,[39m
[31m+       total_time_seconds: entry.totalTime,[39m
[31m+       gap_seconds: entry.totalTime - teamLeaderTime,[39m
[31m+       points: null,[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return classifications[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function UniversalRaceReplayPage({[39m
[31m+   race,[39m
[31m+   stage,[39m
[31m+   participantTeams,[39m
[31m+   onClose,[39m
[31m+   onShadowPreview,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   race: Race[39m
[31m+   stage: RaceStage[39m
[31m+   participantTeams: RaceParticipantTeam[][39m
[31m+   onClose: () => void[39m
[31m+   onShadowPreview?: (preview: RaceStageResultsOverride) => void[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m

[31m+             ? 'New leader at the time check'[39m

[31m+           description: isNewBest[39m
[31m+             ? `${unit.label} sets the new best midpoint time: ${formatRaceClock(splitTime)}. Live check: ${liveTopThree}.`[39m
[31m+             : `${unit.label} reaches the midpoint in ${formatRaceClock(splitTime)} · +${formatGapValue(splitGap)}. Live check: ${liveTopThree}.`,[39m
[31m+         })[39m
[31m+       })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     let bestFinishSoFar: number | null = null[39m
[31m+     const finishArrivals: Array<{ label: string; time: number }> = [][39m
[31m+     enrichedUnits[39m
[31m+       .filter((unit) => unit.finalTimeSeconds !== null)[39m
[31m+       .slice()[39m
[31m+       .sort([39m
[31m+         (left, right) =>[39m
[31m+           ((left.startOrder - 1) * timeTrialReplayPresentation.visualStartIntervalSeconds +[39m
[31m+             timeTrialReplayPresentation.rideWindowSeconds) -[39m
[31m+             ((right.startOrder - 1) * timeTrialReplayPresentation.visualStartIntervalSeconds +[39m
[31m+               timeTrialReplayPresentation.rideWindowSeconds) ||[39m
[31m+           left.startOrder - right.startOrder[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+       .forEach((unit) => {[39m
[31m+         const finishTime = Number(unit.finalTimeSeconds ?? 0)[39m
[31m+         const finishGap =[39m
[31m+           bestFinishSoFar === null[39m
[31m+             ? 0[39m
[31m+             : Math.max(0, finishTime - bestFinishSoFar)[39m
[31m+         const isNewLeader = bestFinishSoFar === null || finishTime < bestFinishSoFar[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         finishArrivals.push({ label: unit.label, time: finishTime })[39m
[31m+         finishArrivals.sort([39m
[31m+           (left, right) => left.time - right.time || left.label.localeCompare(right.label)[39m
[31m+         )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         if (isNewLeader) bestFinishSoFar = finishTime[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         const currentLeaderTime = finishArrivals[0]?.time ?? finishTime[39m
[31m+         const livePlace =[39m
[31m+           finishArrivals.findIndex([39m
[31m+             (entry) => entry.label === unit.label && entry.time === finishTime[39m
[31m+           ) + 1[39m
[31m+         const liveTopThree = finishArrivals[39m
[31m+           .slice(0, 3)[39m
[31m+           .map((entry, index) =>[39m
[31m+             `${index + 1}. ${entry.label} ${[39m
[31m+               index === 0[39m
[31m+                 ? '0s'[39m
[31m+                 : `+${formatGapValue(entry.time - currentLeaderTime)}`[39m
[31m+             }`[39m
[31m+           )[39m
[31m+           .join(' · ')[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         commentary.push({[39m
[31m+           id: `${unit.id}:finish`,[39m
[31m+           progress: 1,[39m
[31m+           kilometre: input.stage.distanceKm,[39m
[31m+           raceSecond:[39m
[31m+             (unit.startOrder - 1) *[39m
[31m+               timeTrialReplayPresentation.visualStartIntervalSeconds +[39m
[31m+             timeTrialReplayPresentation.rideWindowSeconds,[39m
[31m+           title: isNewLeader[39m
[31m+             ? 'New leader at the finish'[39m
[31m+             : 'Rider finishes',[39m
[31m+           description: isNewLeader[39m
[31m+             ? `${unit.label} stops the clock in ${formatRaceClock(finishTime)} and takes the live lead. Live finish: ${liveTopThree}.`[39m
[31m+             : `${unit.label} finishes in ${formatRaceClock(finishTime)}, live place ${livePlace}, +${formatGapValue(finishTime - currentLeaderTime)}. Live finish: ${liveTopThree}.`,[39m
[31m+         })[39m
[31m+       })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const stateOrder = {[39m
[31m+       finished: 0,[39m
[31m+       on_course: 1,[39m
[31m+       waiting: 2,[39m
[31m+     } as const[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const orderedUnits = enrichedUnits.slice().sort((left, right) => {[39m
[31m+       if (left.state === 'finished' && right.state === 'finished') {[39m
[31m+         return ([39m
[31m+           Number(left.liveRank ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) -[39m
[31m+             Number(right.liveRank ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) ||[39m
[31m+           left.startOrder - right.startOrder[39m
[31m+         )[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (left.state !== right.state) {[39m
[31m+         return stateOrder[left.state] - stateOrder[right.state][39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (left.state === 'on_course' && right.state === 'on_course') {[39m

[31m+           right.courseProgressFraction - left.courseProgressFraction ||[39m
[31m+           left.startOrder - right.startOrder[39m
[31m+         )[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return left.startOrder - right.startOrder[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       splitDistanceKm,[39m
[31m+       units: orderedUnits,[39m
[31m+       splitStandings,[39m
[31m+       commentary: commentary.sort([39m
[31m+         (left, right) =>[39m
[31m+           right.raceSecond - left.raceSecond ||[39m
[31m+           right.kilometre - left.kilometre ||[39m
[31m+           right.id.localeCompare(left.id)[39m
[31m+       ),[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }, [[39m
[31m+     input,[39m
[31m+     isIndividualTimeTrialReplay,[39m
[31m+     isTeamTimeTrialReplay,[39m
[31m+     isTimeTrialReplay,[39m
[31m+     participantRiderLookup,[39m

[31m+   ])[39m
[31m+[39m

[31m+       timeTrialReplayContext.units[39m

[31m+   const commentary = useMemo((): UniversalShadowCommentaryItem[] => {[39m
[31m+     if (!input || !result) return [][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const riderNames = new Map([39m
[31m+       input.riders.map([39m
[31m+         (rider) =>[39m

[31m+             rider.riderId,[39m

[31m+             teamNames.get(teamId) ?? teamId[39m

[31m+ function RaceStageProfilePanel({[39m
[31m+   selectedStageId,[39m

[31m+   selectedStage,[39m
[31m+   race,[39m

[31m+   currentClubId,[39m
[31m+   viewerClubFamilyIds,[39m
[31m+   participantTeams,[39m

[31m+   selectedStageId: string | null[39m
[31m+   classificationResultsStageId: string | null[39m
[31m+   selectedStage: RaceStage | null[39m
[31m+   race: Race | null[39m
[31m+   currentGameDate: string | null[39m
[31m+   currentClubId?: string | null[39m
[31m+   viewerClubFamilyIds?: string[][39m
[31m+   participantTeams: RaceParticipantTeam[][39m

[31m+   onOpenReplay: (stage: RaceStage) => void[39m

[31m+   const [profile, setProfile] = useState<StageProfileDetailPayload | null>(null)[39m
[31m+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)[39m
[31m+   const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (!selectedStageId) {[39m
[31m+       setProfile(null)[39m
[31m+       setLoading(false)[39m
[31m+       setErrorMessage(null)[39m
[31m+       return[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     let cancelled = false[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     async function loadProfile() {[39m
[31m+       setLoading(true)[39m
[31m+       setErrorMessage(null)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const { data, error } = await raceDetailReadRpc('get_race_stage_profile_detail_v1', {[39m
[31m+         p_stage_id: selectedStageId,[39m
[31m+       })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (cancelled) return[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (error) {[39m
[31m+         setProfile(null)[39m
[31m+         setErrorMessage(error.message)[39m
[31m+         setLoading(false)[39m
[31m+         return[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       setProfile(normalizeStageProfileDetailPayload(data))[39m
[31m+       setLoading(false)[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     loadProfile()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return () => {[39m
[31m+       cancelled = true[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }, [selectedStageId])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (loading) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm">[39m
[31m+         <div className="text-sm text-slate-500">Loading stage profile…</div>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (errorMessage) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className="rounded-3xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 p-6 text-sm text-rose-700">[39m
[31m+         {errorMessage}[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!profile || !profile.has_profile) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm">[39m
[31m+         <div className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+           Stage profile[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+         <div className="mt-4 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 px-4 py-8 text-sm text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+           Stage profile data is not available yet.[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const profileTerrainSplit: RaceTerrainSplit = profile.terrain_split ?? DEFAULT_TERRAIN_SPLIT[39m
[31m+   const isTimeTrialProfileStage = isTimeTrialLikeStage(selectedStage)[39m
[31m+   const isTeamTimeTrialProfileStage = isTeamTimeTrialLikeStage(selectedStage)[39m
[31m+   const allowSmallTimeTrialFinishPoints =[39m
[31m+     isPrologueOrIndividualTimeTrialStage(selectedStage)[39m
[31m+   const finishPoint = (selectedStage?.points ?? []).find((point) => point.point_type === 'FINISH')[39m
[31m+   const finishMarker = (profile.route_markers ?? []).find([39m
[31m+     (marker) => marker.type.toLowerCase() === 'finish'[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const finishPointRecord = finishPoint ? getRecord(finishPoint) : {}[39m
[31m+   const finishPointMetadata = getRecord(finishPointRecord.metadata)[39m
[31m+   const finishPointType = [[39m
[31m+     finishPointRecord.finish_type,[39m
[31m+     finishPointMetadata.finish_type,[39m
[31m+     selectedStage?.finish_type,[39m
[31m+   ][39m
[31m+     .find((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string')[39m
[31m+     ?.toLowerCase()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const mountainClimbs = profile.mountain_climbs ?? [][39m
[31m+   const fallbackFinishKm =[39m
[31m+     asNumber([39m
[31m+       finishPoint?.km_from_start ??[39m
[31m+         (finishPointRecord.km as number | string | null | undefined)[39m
[31m+     ) ??[39m
[31m+     asNumber(finishMarker?.km) ??[39m
[31m+     profile.distance_km[39m
[31m+   const stageFinishKm = Number(selectedStage?.distance_km ?? profile.distance_km)[39m
[31m+   const finishKm = Number.isFinite(stageFinishKm) ? stageFinishKm : fallbackFinishKm[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const hasMountainFinish = mountainClimbs.some((climb) =>[39m
[31m+     isSameKm(climb.km, finishKm)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const visibleMountainClimbs = mountainClimbs.filter((climb) => {[39m
[31m+     if (!hasMountainFinish) return true[39m
[31m+     return !isSameKm(climb.km, finishKm)[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const finishClimb = hasMountainFinish[39m
[31m+     ? mountainClimbs.find((climb) => isSameKm(climb.km, finishKm)) ?? null[39m

[31m+   const finishClimbCategory = formatProfileDetailValue(finishClimb?.['category']).toLowerCase()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const finishIsMountain = Boolean([39m
[31m+     hasMountainFinish ||[39m
[31m+       selectedStage?.is_summit_finish ||[39m
[31m+       finishPointType?.includes('mountain') ||[39m
[31m+       finishClimb ||[39m
[31m+       finishClimbCategory.includes('cat')[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const finishPointHasConfiguredPoints = hasConfiguredPointValues([39m
[31m+     finishPoint?.points_scheme[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const shouldShowFinishCard = isTeamTimeTrialProfileStage[39m
[31m+     ? false[39m
[31m+     : isTimeTrialProfileStage[39m
[31m+       ? allowSmallTimeTrialFinishPoints || finishPointHasConfiguredPoints[39m
[31m+       : Boolean([39m
[31m+           finishPoint || finishMarker || profile.distance_km !== null || selectedStage?.finish_city[39m
[31m+         )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const stagePoints = (isTimeTrialProfileStage[39m
[31m+     ? [][39m
[31m+     : [[39m
[31m+         ...(profile.intermediate_sprints ?? []).map((sprint, index) => ({[39m
[31m+           ...sprint,[39m
[31m+           pointType: 'sprint' as const,[39m
[31m+           sortKm: toKmNumber(sprint.km),[39m

[31m+           sortKm: toKmNumber(climb.km),[39m
[31m+           sortIndex: index,[39m
[31m+         })),[39m
[31m+       ][39m
[31m+   ).sort((a, b) => {[39m
[31m+     if (a.sortKm !== b.sortKm) return a.sortKm - b.sortKm[39m
[31m+     return a.sortIndex - b.sortIndex[39m
[31m+   })[39m

[31m+   function FinishSprintCard() {[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <StageFinishPointCard[39m
[31m+         isMountainFinish={finishIsMountain}[39m
[31m+         finishKm={finishKm}[39m
[31m+         finishPoint={finishPoint}[39m
[31m+         finishClimb={finishClimb}[39m
[31m+         suppressTimeBonuses={isTimeTrialProfileStage}[39m
[31m+         allowDefaultFinishPoints={!isTeamTimeTrialProfileStage}[39m
[31m+         defaultFinishPointsScheme={[39m
[31m+           allowSmallTimeTrialFinishPoints[39m
[31m+             ? DEFAULT_TIME_TRIAL_FINISH_POINTS_SCHEME[39m
[31m+             : DEFAULT_FINISH_POINTS_SCHEME[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       />[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_360px]">[39m
[31m+       <div className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm">[39m
[31m+         <div className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+           Stage profile[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <div className="mt-4">[39m
[31m+           <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 xl:flex-row xl:items-start xl:justify-between">[39m
[31m+             <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">[39m
[31m+               <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-slate-950">[39m
[31m+                 {profile.stage_title ?? `Stage ${profile.stage_number}`}[39m
[31m+               </h3>[39m
[31m+               <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">{profile.route_label ?? 'Route TBD'}</p>[39m
[31m+               {profile.stage_summary ? ([39m
[31m+                 <p className="mt-3 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">[39m
[31m+                   {profile.stage_summary}[39m
[31m+                 </p>[39m
[31m+               ) : null}[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             <div className="grid min-w-[280px] grid-cols-2 gap-x-8 gap-y-3 xl:pt-1">[39m
[31m+               <div>[39m
[31m+                 <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">Distance</div>[39m
[31m+                 <div className="mt-1 font-semibold text-slate-950">[39m
[31m+                   {formatKm(profile.distance_km)}[39m
[31m+                 </div>[39m
[31m+               </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+               <div>[39m
[31m+                 <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">Terrain</div>[39m
[31m+                 <div className="mt-1 font-semibold text-slate-950">[39m
[31m+                   {profile.terrain_type ? humanizeCode(profile.terrain_type) : '—'}[39m
[31m+                 </div>[39m
[31m+               </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+               <div>[39m
[31m+                 <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">Profile</div>[39m
[31m+                 <div className="mt-1 font-semibold text-slate-950">[39m
[31m+                   {profile.profile_type ? humanizeCode(profile.profile_type) : '—'}[39m
[31m+                 </div>[39m
[31m+               </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+               <div>[39m
[31m+                 <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">Elevation</div>[39m
[31m+                 <div className="mt-1 font-semibold text-slate-950">[39m

[31m+               </div>[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m

[31m+           <StageProfileChart[39m

[31m+             distanceKm={Number(profile.distance_km ?? 0)}[39m

[31m+             mountainClimbs={profile.mountain_climbs ?? []}[39m

[31m+ export default function RaceDetailPage({[39m

[31m+   onBack,[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+   function getRaceDetailReturnState(): RaceDetailReturnState | null {[39m
[31m+     return location.state as RaceDetailReturnState | null[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function getStoredRaceProfileReturnState() {[39m
[31m+     if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const rawValue = window.sessionStorage.getItem(RACE_PROFILE_RETURN_STORAGE_KEY)[39m
[31m+       if (!rawValue) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return JSON.parse(rawValue) as {[39m
[31m+         returnTo?: string[39m
[31m+         restoreScrollX?: number[39m
[31m+         restoreScrollY?: number[39m
[31m+         returnRaceId?: string[39m
[31m+         raceInfoExpanded?: boolean[39m
[31m+         raceInfoTab?: RaceInfoTab[39m
