[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function isCurrentRaceDetailReturnPath(value?: string | null): boolean {[39m
[31m+     if (!value) return false[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const baseUrl =[39m
[31m+         typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.origin : 'http://localhost'[39m
[31m+       const url = new URL(value, baseUrl)[39m
[31m+       const normalizedValue = url.pathname + url.search + url.hash[39m
[31m+       const currentValue = location.pathname + location.search + location.hash[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return normalizedValue === currentValue[39m
[31m+     } catch {[39m
[31m+       return value === location.pathname + location.search + location.hash[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function isValidRaceDetailSourceReturnState([39m
[31m+     state?: RaceDetailReturnState | null[39m
[31m+   ): state is RaceDetailReturnState {[39m
[31m+     if (!state?.returnTo) return false[39m
[31m+     if (state.from === 'race_detail') return false[39m
[31m+     if (isCurrentRaceDetailReturnPath(state.returnTo)) return false[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return true[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function getStoredRaceDetailSourceReturnState(): RaceDetailReturnState | null {[39m
[31m+     if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const rawValue = window.sessionStorage.getItem([39m
[31m+         RACE_DETAIL_SOURCE_RETURN_STORAGE_KEY[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+       if (!rawValue) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const storedState = JSON.parse(rawValue) as RaceDetailReturnState[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if ([39m
[31m+         raceId &&[39m
[31m+         storedState.sourceRaceId &&[39m
[31m+         storedState.sourceRaceId !== raceId[39m
[31m+       ) {[39m

[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (!isValidRaceDetailSourceReturnState(storedState)) return null[39m

[31m+       return storedState[39m
[31m+     } catch {[39m
[31m+       return null[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function saveRaceDetailSourceReturnState([39m
[31m+     state?: RaceDetailReturnState | null[39m
[31m+   ): void {[39m
[31m+     if (typeof window === 'undefined') return[39m
[31m+     if (!isValidRaceDetailSourceReturnState(state)) return[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     window.sessionStorage.setItem([39m
[31m+       RACE_DETAIL_SOURCE_RETURN_STORAGE_KEY,[39m
[31m+       JSON.stringify({[39m
[31m+         ...state,[39m
[31m+         sourceRaceId: raceId ?? state.returnRaceId,[39m
[31m+         createdAtMs: Date.now(),[39m
[31m+       })[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function clearStoredRaceDetailSourceReturnState(): void {[39m
[31m+     if (typeof window === 'undefined') return[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     window.sessionStorage.removeItem(RACE_DETAIL_SOURCE_RETURN_STORAGE_KEY)[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function getSafeRaceDetailSourceReturnState(): RaceDetailReturnState | null {[39m
[31m+     const state = getRaceDetailReturnState()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (isValidRaceDetailSourceReturnState(state)) return state[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return getStoredRaceDetailSourceReturnState()[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function saveRaceProfileReturnState(state: {[39m
[31m+     returnTo?: string[39m
[31m+     returnScrollX?: number[39m
[31m+     returnScrollY?: number[39m
[31m+     returnRaceId?: string[39m
[31m+     raceInfoExpanded?: boolean[39m
[31m+     raceInfoTab?: RaceInfoTab[39m
[31m+   }) {[39m
[31m+     if (typeof window === 'undefined') return[39m

[31m+   function getRaceActionErrorMessage(value: unknown): string {[39m
[31m+     if (!value) return 'Race action failed.'[39m
[31m+     if (typeof value === 'string') return value[39m
[31m+     if (typeof value === 'object' && 'message' in value) {[39m
[31m+       const message = (value as { message?: unknown }).message[39m
[31m+       if (typeof message === 'string' && message.trim()) return message[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return 'Race action failed.'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function getRaceApplicationQuoteErrorMessage(value: unknown): string {[39m
[31m+     if (!value) return 'Could not load application preview.'[39m
[31m+     if (typeof value === 'string') return value[39m
[31m+     if (typeof value === 'object') {[39m
[31m+       const record = value as { message?: unknown; error?: unknown }[39m
[31m+       if (typeof record.message === 'string' && record.message.trim()) return record.message[39m
[31m+       if (typeof record.error === 'string' && record.error.trim()) return record.error[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return 'Could not load application preview.'[39m
[31m+   }[39m

[31m+     return `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(parsed)))}%`[39m

[31m+     const parsed = Number(value)[39m

[31m+     return `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(parsed)))}%`[39m
[31m+   }[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (quote.existing_application_status === 'accepted') {[39m
[31m+       return 'Your team is already accepted for this race.'[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (quote.existing_application_status === 'applied') {[39m
[31m+       return 'Your team already has an application submitted for this race.'[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (quote.can_apply === false) {[39m
[31m+       return quote.message ?? 'You cannot apply for this race right now.'[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return 'Review your application preview before submitting.'[39m
[31m+   }[39m

[31m+   async function loadRaceApplicationQuote(): Promise<void> {[39m
[31m+     if (!race?.id) return[39m

[31m+       },[39m
[31m+     })[39m

[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const result = (data ?? {}) as RaceApplicationQuote[39m

[31m+     if (result.success === false) {[39m
[31m+       setApplicationQuote(result)[39m

[31m+         result.error ?? result.message ?? 'Could not load application preview.'[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+       setApplicationQuoteLoading(false)[39m
[31m+       return[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     setApplicationQuote(result)[39m
[31m+     setApplicationQuoteLoading(false)[39m
[31m+   }[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeViewerTeamIds([39m
[31m+   viewerTeamIds?: ViewerTeamIdSource[39m
[31m+ ): Set<string> {[39m
[31m+   const rawValues =[39m
[31m+     viewerTeamIds instanceof Set[39m
[31m+       ? Array.from(viewerTeamIds)[39m
[31m+       : Array.isArray(viewerTeamIds)[39m
[31m+         ? viewerTeamIds[39m
[31m+         : [viewerTeamIds][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return new Set([39m
[31m+     rawValues[39m
[31m+       .map((value) => value?.trim())[39m
[31m+       .filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value))[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getViewerTeamIds([39m
[31m+   currentClubId?: string | null,[39m
[31m+   viewerClubFamilyIds?: Array<string | null | undefined>[39m
[31m+ ): string[] {[39m
[31m+   return Array.from([39m
[31m+     normalizeViewerTeamIds([[39m
[31m+       currentClubId ?? DEFAULT_CURRENT_CLUB_ID,[39m
[31m+       ...(viewerClubFamilyIds ?? []),[39m
[31m+     ])[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getComparableTeamIds(row: ViewerTeamComparableRow): string[] {[39m
[31m+   return Array.from([39m
[31m+     normalizeViewerTeamIds([[39m
[31m+       row.team_id,[39m
[31m+       row.club_id,[39m
[31m+       row.teamId,[39m
[31m+       row.clubId,[39m
[31m+       row.race_team_entry_id,[39m
[31m+       row.team?.id,[39m
[31m+     ])[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function isViewerTeamRow([39m
[31m+   row: ViewerTeamComparableRow,[39m
[31m+   viewerTeamIds?: ViewerTeamIdSource[39m
[31m+ ): boolean {[39m
[31m+   const viewerIds = normalizeViewerTeamIds(viewerTeamIds)[39m
[31m+   if (viewerIds.size === 0) return false[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return getComparableTeamIds(row).some((rowTeamId) => viewerIds.has(rowTeamId))[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+ function isUuid(value: unknown): value is string {[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     typeof value === 'string' &&[39m
[31m+     /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test([39m
[31m+       value,[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function extractUuidFromText(value: unknown): string | null {[39m
[31m+   if (typeof value !== 'string') return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const match = value.match([39m
[31m+     /[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}/i,[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return isUuid(match?.[0]) ? match[0] : null[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function useRaceIdFromRoute(): string | null {[39m
[31m+   const params = useParams()[39m
[31m+   const location = useLocation()[39m
[31m+   const [searchParams] = useSearchParams()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const candidates = [[39m
[31m+     params.raceId,[39m
[31m+     searchParams.get('raceId'),[39m
[31m+     location.pathname,[39m
[31m+     location.search,[39m
[31m+     location.hash,[39m
[31m+   ][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {[39m
[31m+     candidates.push([39m
[31m+       window.location.pathname,[39m
[31m+       window.location.search,[39m
[31m+       window.location.hash,[39m
[31m+       window.location.href,[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (const candidate of candidates) {[39m
[31m+     if (isUuid(candidate)) return candidate[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const extracted = extractUuidFromText(candidate)[39m
[31m+     if (extracted) return extracted[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return null[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function formatShortDate(value?: string | null): string {[39m
[31m+   if (!value) return '—'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const date = new Date(`${value}T00:00:00`)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return value[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return date.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {[39m
[31m+     month: 'short',[39m
[31m+     day: 'numeric',[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeCountryCode(code?: string | null): string | null {[39m
[31m+   if (!code) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const normalized = code.trim().toUpperCase()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (normalized === 'UK') return 'GB'[39m
[31m+   if (!/^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(normalized)) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return normalized[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function getFlagImageUrl(code?: string | null): string | null {[39m
[31m+   const normalized = normalizeCountryCode(code)[39m
[31m+   if (!normalized) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return `https://flagcdn.com/w40/${normalized.toLowerCase()}.png`[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+     return ([39m

[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <img[39m
[31m+       src={flagUrl}[39m
[31m+       alt={normalized}[39m
[31m+       title={normalized}[39m
[31m+       className="inline-block h-4 w-6 shrink-0 rounded-sm border border-slate-200 object-cover align-middle"[39m
[31m+       loading="lazy"[39m
[31m+       onError={() => setHasError(true)}[39m

[31m+ function getTeamInitials(name?: string | null): string {[39m
[31m+   const cleanName = name?.trim()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!cleanName) return 'TM'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const words = cleanName[39m
[31m+     .split(/\s+/)[39m
[31m+     .filter(Boolean)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (words.length === 1) {[39m
[31m+     return words[0].slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return `${words[0][0] ?? ''}${words[1][0] ?? ''}`.toUpperCase()[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getParticipantTeamName(team: RaceParticipantTeam): string {[39m
[31m+   return team.club_name?.trim() || team.team_name_snapshot?.trim() || 'Team'[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeResultTeamLookupName(value?: string | null): string {[39m
[31m+   return value?.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').toLowerCase() ?? ''[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ const ORPHAN_RESULT_TEAM_GENERIC_JERSEY_URL = DEFAULT_TEAM_JERSEY_URL[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getResultParticipantTeam([39m
[31m+   participantTeams: RaceParticipantTeam[],[39m
[31m+   teamId?: string | null,[39m
[31m+   teamName?: string | null[39m
[31m+ ): RaceParticipantTeam | null {[39m
[31m+   const normalizedTeamId = teamId?.trim() ?? ''[39m
[31m+   const normalizedTeamName = normalizeResultTeamLookupName(teamName)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (normalizedTeamId) {[39m
[31m+     const teamById = participantTeams.find((team) =>[39m
[31m+       [[39m
[31m+         team.id,[39m
[31m+         team.team_id,[39m
[31m+         team.club_id,[39m
[31m+         team.owner_club_id,[39m
[31m+         team.participating_club_id,[39m
[31m+         team.parent_club_id,[39m
[31m+         team.race_team_entry_id,[39m
[31m+       ][39m
[31m+         .map((value) => value?.trim())[39m
[31m+         .filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value))[39m
[31m+         .includes(normalizedTeamId)[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (teamById) return teamById[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!normalizedTeamName) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     participantTeams.find((team) =>[39m
[31m+       [[39m
[31m+         getParticipantTeamName(team),[39m
[31m+         team.club_name,[39m
[31m+         team.team_name_snapshot,[39m
[31m+       ][39m
[31m+         .map((value) => normalizeResultTeamLookupName(value))[39m
[31m+         .filter(Boolean)[39m
[31m+         .includes(normalizedTeamName)[39m
[31m+     ) ?? null[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function ResultTeamJerseyCell({[39m
[31m+   teamId,[39m
[31m+   teamName,[39m
[31m+   participantTeams,[39m
[31m+   onOpenTeamProfile,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   teamId?: string | null[39m
[31m+   teamName?: string | null[39m
[31m+   participantTeams: RaceParticipantTeam[][39m
[31m+   onOpenTeamProfile: (teamId: string) => void[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const participantTeam = getResultParticipantTeam([39m
[31m+     participantTeams,[39m
[31m+     teamId,[39m
[31m+     teamName[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const isOrphanResultTeam =[39m
[31m+     !participantTeam && Boolean(teamId?.trim() || teamName?.trim())[39m
[31m+   const resolvedTeamName =[39m
[31m+     teamName?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+     (participantTeam ? getParticipantTeamName(participantTeam) : '') ||[39m
[31m+     '—'[39m
[31m+   /*[39m
[31m+    * Result rows can carry a race-entry id, a snapshot team id or the real[39m
[31m+    * club id. A profile link is allowed only after the row resolves to a team[39m
[31m+    * from the official Teams & riders participant list. Never trust the raw[39m
[31m+    * result team_id as a profile destination on its own.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   const resolvedTeamId = participantTeam[39m
[31m+     ? participantTeam.participating_club_id?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       participantTeam.club_id?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       participantTeam.owner_club_id?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       participantTeam.team_id?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       participantTeam.id?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       participantTeam.parent_club_id?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       null[39m
[31m+     : null[39m
[31m+   /*[39m
[31m+    * Defensive fallback for old/test race data: a result can reference a team[39m
[31m+    * that is not present in the official Teams & riders participant list.[39m
[31m+    * Such a row gets the neutral generic jersey and deliberately receives no[39m
[31m+    * team-profile link, even when the result contains a raw team_id.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   const preferredJerseyUrl =[39m
[31m+     participantTeam?.jersey_url_snapshot?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+     (isOrphanResultTeam || participantTeam[39m
[31m+       ? ORPHAN_RESULT_TEAM_GENERIC_JERSEY_URL[39m
[31m+       : null)[39m
[31m+   const teamCellTitle = isOrphanResultTeam[39m
[31m+     ? `${resolvedTeamName} · profile unavailable because this team is not in the race participant list`[39m
[31m+     : resolvedTeamName[39m
[31m+   const [jerseyUrl, setJerseyUrl] = useState<string | null>([39m
[31m+     preferredJerseyUrl[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     setJerseyUrl(preferredJerseyUrl)[39m
[31m+   }, [preferredJerseyUrl])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!jerseyUrl) {[39m
[31m+     if (!resolvedTeamId) {[39m
[31m+       return ([39m
[31m+         <span className={RESULT_TEAM_NAME_TRUNCATE_CLASS} title={teamCellTitle}>[39m
[31m+           {resolvedTeamName}[39m
[31m+         </span>[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <button[39m
[31m+         type="button"[39m
[31m+         onClick={() => onOpenTeamProfile(resolvedTeamId)}[39m
[31m+         className={`${RESULT_TEAM_NAME_TRUNCATE_CLASS} text-slate-600 transition hover:text-slate-950`}[39m
[31m+         title={teamCellTitle}[39m
[31m+       >[39m
[31m+         {resolvedTeamName}[39m
[31m+       </button>[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const jerseyPreview = ([39m
[31m+     <>[39m
[31m+       <img[39m
[31m+         src={jerseyUrl}[39m
[31m+         alt=""[39m
[31m+         aria-hidden="true"[39m
[31m+         className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 h-full w-full scale-[5] object-contain opacity-95 transition-transform duration-500 ease-out group-hover:scale-[5.2] group-focus-visible:scale-[5.2]"[39m
[31m+         style={{[39m
[31m+           objectPosition: '50% 37%',[39m
[31m+           transformOrigin: '50% 37%',[39m
[31m+         }}[39m
[31m+         loading="lazy"[39m
[31m+         referrerPolicy="no-referrer"[39m
[31m+         onError={() => {[39m
[31m+           setJerseyUrl((current) =>[39m
[31m+             current && current !== ORPHAN_RESULT_TEAM_GENERIC_JERSEY_URL[39m
[31m+               ? ORPHAN_RESULT_TEAM_GENERIC_JERSEY_URL[39m
[31m+               : null[39m
[31m+           )[39m
[31m+         }}[39m
[31m+       />[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <span className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-b from-white/5 via-transparent to-slate-950/5" />[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <span className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 right-0 w-[38%] bg-gradient-to-l from-white via-white/95 to-transparent transition-all duration-500 ease-out group-hover:w-[90%] group-focus-visible:w-[90%]" />[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <span className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 left-[10%] right-0 flex translate-x-3 items-center justify-end px-3 text-right text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 opacity-0 transition-all duration-500 ease-out group-hover:translate-x-0 group-hover:opacity-100 group-focus-visible:translate-x-0 group-focus-visible:opacity-100">[39m
[31m+         <span className="block max-w-full truncate">{resolvedTeamName}</span>[39m
[31m+       </span>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <span className="sr-only">{resolvedTeamName}</span>[39m
[31m+     </>[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const sharedClassName =[39m
[31m+     'group relative block h-9 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white text-left shadow-sm outline-none transition duration-300 hover:border-slate-300 hover:shadow-md focus-visible:border-sky-400 focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-sky-200'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!resolvedTeamId) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className={`${sharedClassName} cursor-default`} title={teamCellTitle}>[39m
[31m+         {jerseyPreview}[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <button[39m
[31m+       type="button"[39m
[31m+       onClick={() => onOpenTeamProfile(resolvedTeamId)}[39m
[31m+       className={sharedClassName}[39m
[31m+       title={teamCellTitle}[39m
[31m+       aria-label={`Open ${resolvedTeamName} team profile`}[39m
[31m+     >[39m
[31m+       {jerseyPreview}[39m
[31m+     </button>[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function parseDateOnly(value?: string | null): Date | null {[39m
[31m+   if (!value) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const date = new Date(`${value}T00:00:00`)[39m
[31m+   if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return date[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatDateOnly(date: Date): string {[39m
[31m+   const year = date.getFullYear()[39m
[31m+   const month = `${date.getMonth() + 1}`.padStart(2, '0')[39m
[31m+   const day = `${date.getDate()}`.padStart(2, '0')[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return `${year}-${month}-${day}`[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function addDaysToDateOnly(value: string | null | undefined, days: number): string | null {[39m
[31m+   const startDate = parseDateOnly(value)[39m
[31m+   if (!startDate) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const nextDate = new Date(startDate)[39m
[31m+   nextDate.setDate(nextDate.getDate() + days)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return formatDateOnly(nextDate)[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStageDateOrFallback(stage: RaceStage, race: Race | null): string | null {[39m
[31m+   const existingStageDate = stage.stage_date?.trim()[39m
[31m+   if (existingStageDate) return existingStageDate[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const stageNumber = Number(stage.stage_number)[39m
[31m+   if (!Number.isFinite(stageNumber) || stageNumber < 1) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return addDaysToDateOnly(race?.start_date, stageNumber - 1)[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function hydrateStageDates(race: Race | null, stages: RaceStage[]): RaceStage[] {[39m
[31m+   return stages.map((stage) => {[39m
[31m+     const stageDate = getStageDateOrFallback(stage, race)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return stageDate && stageDate !== stage.stage_date[39m
[31m+       ? { ...stage, stage_date: stageDate }[39m
[31m+       : stage[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStageForCurrentGameDate([39m
[31m+   race: Race | null,[39m
[31m+   stages: RaceStage[],[39m
[31m+   currentGameDateValue: string | null | undefined[39m
[31m+ ): RaceStage | null {[39m
[31m+   if (stages.length === 0) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const hydratedStages = hydrateStageDates([39m
[31m+     race,[39m
[31m+     [...stages].sort([39m
[31m+       (a, b) => Number(a.stage_number) - Number(b.stage_number)[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const currentDate = parseDateOnly(currentGameDateValue)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!currentDate) return hydratedStages[0] ?? null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const exactStage = hydratedStages.find((stage) => {[39m
[31m+     const stageDate = parseDateOnly(stage.stage_date)[39m
[31m+     return stageDate?.getTime() === currentDate.getTime()[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (exactStage) return exactStage[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const firstUpcomingStage = hydratedStages.find((stage) => {[39m
[31m+     const stageDate = parseDateOnly(stage.stage_date)[39m
[31m+     return stageDate ? stageDate > currentDate : false[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (firstUpcomingStage) return firstUpcomingStage[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return hydratedStages[hydratedStages.length - 1] ?? null[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function startOfDay(value: string | null | undefined): Date | null {[39m
[31m+   if (!value) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const date = new Date(value)[39m
[31m+   if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   date.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0)[39m
[31m+   return date[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function shouldShowStageWeather([39m
[31m+   stageDateValue: string | null | undefined,[39m
[31m+   currentGameDateValue: string | null | undefined[39m
[31m+ ): boolean {[39m
[31m+   const stageDate = startOfDay(stageDateValue)[39m
[31m+   const currentGameDate = startOfDay(currentGameDateValue)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!stageDate || !currentGameDate) return false[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const revealDate = new Date(stageDate)[39m
[31m+   revealDate.setDate(revealDate.getDate() - 7)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return currentGameDate >= revealDate[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function differenceInDays(a: Date, b: Date): number {[39m
[31m+   const left = new Date(a.getFullYear(), a.getMonth(), a.getDate()).getTime()[39m
[31m+   const right = new Date(b.getFullYear(), b.getMonth(), b.getDate()).getTime()[39m
[31m+   return Math.round((left - right) / 86400000)[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ const GAME_MONTH_LENGTH = 30[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ const GAME_MONTH_NAMES = [[39m
[31m+   'January',[39m
[31m+   'February',[39m
[31m+   'March',[39m
[31m+   'April',[39m
[31m+   'May',[39m
[31m+   'June',[39m
[31m+   'July',[39m
[31m+   'August',[39m
[31m+   'September',[39m
[31m+   'October',[39m
[31m+   'November',[39m
[31m+   'December',[39m
[31m+ ][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ const GAME_MONTH_SHORT_NAMES = [[39m
[31m+   'Jan',[39m
[31m+   'Feb',[39m
[31m+   'Mar',[39m
[31m+   'Apr',[39m
[31m+   'May',[39m
[31m+   'Jun',[39m
[31m+   'Jul',[39m
[31m+   'Aug',[39m
[31m+   'Sep',[39m
[31m+   'Oct',[39m
[31m+   'Nov',[39m
[31m+   'Dec',[39m
[31m+ ][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getGameDatePartsFromCanonical([39m
[31m+   canonicalDate: string,[39m
[31m+   currentMonthStart: Date,[39m
[31m+   currentSeasonNumber: number,[39m
[31m+   currentMonthNumber: number[39m
[31m+ ) {[39m
[31m+   const target = parseDateOnly(canonicalDate)[39m
[31m+   if (!target) {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       seasonNumber: currentSeasonNumber,[39m
[31m+       monthNumber: currentMonthNumber,[39m
[31m+       dayNumber: 1,[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const diff = differenceInDays(target, currentMonthStart)[39m
[31m+   const monthOffset = Math.floor(diff / GAME_MONTH_LENGTH)[39m
[31m+   const absoluteMonthIndex =[39m
[31m+     (currentSeasonNumber - 1) * 12 + (currentMonthNumber - 1) + monthOffset[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const seasonNumber = Math.floor(absoluteMonthIndex / 12) + 1[39m
[31m+   const monthNumber = ((absoluteMonthIndex % 12) + 12) % 12 + 1[39m
[31m+   const dayNumber = diff - monthOffset * GAME_MONTH_LENGTH + 1[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     seasonNumber,[39m
[31m+     monthNumber,[39m
[31m+     dayNumber,[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatGameDateDisplay([39m
[31m+   seasonNumber: number,[39m
[31m+   monthNumber: number,[39m
[31m+   dayNumber: number[39m
[31m+ ): string {[39m
[31m+   const monthName = GAME_MONTH_NAMES[monthNumber - 1] ?? `Month ${monthNumber}`[39m
[31m+   return `Season ${seasonNumber} - ${monthName} ${dayNumber}`[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getGameMonthShortName(monthNumber: number): string {[39m
[31m+   return GAME_MONTH_SHORT_NAMES[monthNumber - 1] ?? `M${monthNumber}`[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatCompactGameDateDisplay([39m
[31m+   seasonNumber: number,[39m
[31m+   monthNumber: number,[39m
[31m+   dayNumber: number[39m
[31m+ ): string {[39m
[31m+   return `S${seasonNumber} · ${getGameMonthShortName(monthNumber)} ${String(dayNumber).padStart(2, '0')}`[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getWeekdayShortName(date: Date): string {[39m
[31m+   return date.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday: 'short' })[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ const BASE_GAME_SEASON_YEAR = 2000[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getGameDatePartsFromStoredRaceDate([39m
[31m+   canonicalDate?: string | null[39m
[31m+ ): GameDateParts | null {[39m
[31m+   const date = parseDateOnly(canonicalDate)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!date) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     seasonNumber: Math.max(1, date.getFullYear() - BASE_GAME_SEASON_YEAR + 1),[39m
[31m+     monthNumber: date.getMonth() + 1,[39m
[31m+     dayNumber: date.getDate(),[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatRaceDateRangeLabel([39m
[31m+   race: Race | null,[39m
[31m+   currentMonthStart: Date | null,[39m
[31m+   currentSeasonNumber: number,[39m
[31m+   currentMonthNumber: number[39m
[31m+ ): string {[39m
[31m+   void currentMonthStart[39m
[31m+   void currentSeasonNumber[39m
[31m+   void currentMonthNumber[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!race) return 'Race dates: —'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const startParts = getGameDatePartsFromStoredRaceDate(race.start_date)[39m
[31m+   const endParts = getGameDatePartsFromStoredRaceDate(race.end_date ?? race.start_date)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!startParts || !endParts) return 'Race dates: —'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const startLabel = formatCompactGameDateDisplay([39m
[31m+     startParts.seasonNumber,[39m
[31m+     startParts.monthNumber,[39m
[31m+     startParts.dayNumber[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const endLabel = formatCompactGameDateDisplay([39m
[31m+     endParts.seasonNumber,[39m
[31m+     endParts.monthNumber,[39m
[31m+     endParts.dayNumber[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const sameDay =[39m
[31m+     startParts.seasonNumber === endParts.seasonNumber &&[39m
[31m+     startParts.monthNumber === endParts.monthNumber &&[39m
[31m+     startParts.dayNumber === endParts.dayNumber[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return sameDay ? `Race date: ${startLabel}` : `Race dates: ${startLabel} → ${endLabel}`[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatRaceHeaderHostLine([39m
[31m+   race: Race | null,[39m
[31m+   currentMonthStart: Date | null,[39m
[31m+   currentSeasonNumber: number,[39m
[31m+   currentMonthNumber: number[39m
[31m+ ): string {[39m
[31m+   const raceDateLabel = formatRaceDateRangeLabel([39m
[31m+     race,[39m
[31m+     currentMonthStart,[39m
[31m+     currentSeasonNumber,[39m
[31m+     currentMonthNumber[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const host = race?.host_city?.trim()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return host ? `${raceDateLabel} — ${host}` : raceDateLabel[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type GameDateParts = {[39m
[31m+   seasonNumber: number[39m
[31m+   monthNumber: number[39m
[31m+   dayNumber: number[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeGameDateParts(parts: GameDateParts): GameDateParts {[39m
[31m+   const rawOrdinal = getGameDateOrdinal(parts)[39m
[31m+   return getGameDatePartsFromOrdinal(rawOrdinal)[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getGameDateOrdinal(parts: GameDateParts): number {[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     (parts.seasonNumber - 1) * 12 * GAME_MONTH_LENGTH +[39m
[31m+     (parts.monthNumber - 1) * GAME_MONTH_LENGTH +[39m
[31m+     (parts.dayNumber - 1)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getGameDatePartsFromOrdinal(ordinal: number): GameDateParts {[39m
[31m+   const monthIndex = Math.floor(ordinal / GAME_MONTH_LENGTH)[39m
[31m+   const dayNumber = ordinal - monthIndex * GAME_MONTH_LENGTH + 1[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     seasonNumber: Math.floor(monthIndex / 12) + 1,[39m
[31m+     monthNumber: ((monthIndex % 12) + 12) % 12 + 1,[39m
[31m+     dayNumber,[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function subtractGameDays(parts: GameDateParts, days: number): GameDateParts {[39m
[31m+   return getGameDatePartsFromOrdinal(getGameDateOrdinal(parts) - days)[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getCurrentGameDateParts([39m
[31m+   currentSeasonNumber: number,[39m
[31m+   currentMonthNumber: number,[39m
[31m+   currentDayNumber: number[39m
[31m+ ): GameDateParts {[39m
[31m+   return normalizeGameDateParts({[39m
[31m+     seasonNumber: currentSeasonNumber,[39m
[31m+     monthNumber: currentMonthNumber,[39m
[31m+     dayNumber: currentDayNumber,[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getRaceApplicationOpenParts(raceStartParts: GameDateParts): GameDateParts {[39m
[31m+   if (raceStartParts.monthNumber >= 4) {[39m
[31m+     return subtractGameDays(raceStartParts, 90)[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     seasonNumber: raceStartParts.seasonNumber,[39m
[31m+     monthNumber: 1,[39m
[31m+     dayNumber: 1,[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getRaceApplicationWindowParts([39m
[31m+   race: Race | null,[39m
[31m+   currentMonthStart: Date | null,[39m
[31m+   currentSeasonNumber: number,[39m
[31m+   currentMonthNumber: number[39m
[31m+ ): { openParts: GameDateParts; closeParts: GameDateParts; startParts: GameDateParts } | null {[39m
[31m+   if (!race || !currentMonthStart) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const startParts = getGameDatePartsFromCanonical([39m
[31m+     race.start_date,[39m
[31m+     currentMonthStart,[39m
[31m+     currentSeasonNumber,[39m
[31m+     currentMonthNumber[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     openParts: getRaceApplicationOpenParts(startParts),[39m
[31m+     closeParts: startParts,[39m
[31m+     startParts,[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatApplicationWindowDate(parts?: GameDateParts | null): string {[39m
[31m+   if (!parts) return '—'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return formatGameDateDisplay(parts.seasonNumber, parts.monthNumber, parts.dayNumber)[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getMonthStartFromGameDate(currentGameDate: string, currentDayNumber: number): Date {[39m
[31m+   const current = parseDateOnly(currentGameDate) ?? new Date()[39m
[31m+   const next = new Date(current)[39m
[31m+   next.setDate(next.getDate() - (currentDayNumber - 1))[39m
[31m+   return next[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function asNumber(value: number | string | null | undefined): number | null {[39m
[31m+   if (value === null || value === undefined) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const parsed = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function toKmNumber(value: unknown): number {[39m
[31m+   const n = Number(value)[39m
[31m+   return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatKm(value: number | string | null | undefined): string {[39m
[31m+   const parsed = asNumber(value)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (parsed === null) return '—'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return `${parsed.toFixed(parsed % 1 === 0 ? 0 : 1)} km`[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatPct(value: number | string | null | undefined): string {[39m
[31m+   const parsed = asNumber(value)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (parsed === null) return '0%'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return `${parsed.toFixed(0)}%`[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatMeters(value?: number | null): string {[39m
[31m+   if (value === null || value === undefined) return '—'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return `${value.toLocaleString()} m`[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function humanizeCode(value?: string | null): string {[39m
[31m+   if (!value) return '—'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return value[39m
[31m+     .replace(/_/g, ' ')[39m
[31m+     .replace(/\b\w/g, (char) => char.toUpperCase())[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatRiderRole(role?: string | null): string {[39m
[31m+   if (!role) return 'Role —'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return humanizeCode(role)[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function hasWeather(stage: RaceStage): boolean {[39m
[31m+   const weather = stage.weather_snapshot ?? {}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return Object.keys(weather).length > 0 && weather.source !== 'missing_country_code'[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getRaceWeatherCancellationStatus(race?: Race | null): string | null {[39m
[31m+   const metadata = race?.metadata ?? {}[39m
[31m+   const value = metadata.weather_cancellation_status[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() !== ''[39m
[31m+     ? value.trim()[39m
[31m+     : null[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getRaceWeatherCanceledStageCount(race?: Race | null): number {[39m
[31m+   const metadata = race?.metadata ?? {}[39m
[31m+   const value = metadata.weather_cancelled_stage_count[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)) return value[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() !== '') {[39m
[31m+     const parsed = Number(value)[39m
[31m+     return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return 0[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getRaceWeatherTotalStageCount(race?: Race | null): number {[39m
[31m+   const metadata = race?.metadata ?? {}[39m
[31m+   const value = metadata.weather_total_stage_count[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)) return value[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() !== '') {[39m
[31m+     const parsed = Number(value)[39m
[31m+     return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return Number(race?.stage_count ?? 0)[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function isRaceAllWeatherCanceled(race?: Race | null): boolean {[39m
[31m+   const metadata = race?.metadata ?? {}[39m
[31m+   const explicitValue = metadata.weather_all_stages_cancelled[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (typeof explicitValue === 'boolean') return explicitValue[39m
[31m+   if (typeof explicitValue === 'string') return explicitValue.toLowerCase() === 'true'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return getRaceWeatherCancellationStatus(race) === 'all_stages_weather_cancelled'[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function isRacePartlyWeatherCanceled(race?: Race | null): boolean {[39m
[31m+   return getRaceWeatherCancellationStatus(race) === 'partly_weather_cancelled'[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getRaceWeatherCancellationDisplayStatus(race?: Race | null): string | null {[39m
[31m+   if (isRaceAllWeatherCanceled(race)) return 'Race canceled'[39m
[31m+   if (isRacePartlyWeatherCanceled(race)) return 'Weather affected'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return null[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function isStageWeatherCanceled(stage?: RaceStage | null): boolean {[39m
[31m+   return stage?.weather_cancelled === true[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getWeatherCancellationReasonLabel(reason?: string | null): string {[39m
[31m+   switch (reason) {[39m
[31m+     case 'snow':[39m
[31m+       return 'Snow'[39m
[31m+     case 'temperature_below_5c':[39m
[31m+       return 'Average temperature below 5°C'[39m
[31m+     default:[39m
[31m+       return reason ? humanizeCode(reason) : 'Unsafe weather'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStageWeatherCancellationReasonLabel(stage?: RaceStage | null): string {[39m
[31m+   return getWeatherCancellationReasonLabel(stage?.weather_cancellation_reason ?? null)[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStageWeatherCancellationRiskReason(stage?: RaceStage | null): string | null {[39m
[31m+   if (!stage || !hasWeather(stage)) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const finalDecisionStatus = String([39m
[31m+     stage.metadata?.weather_final_decision_status ?? ''[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+     .trim()[39m
[31m+     .toLowerCase()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   // A forecast can remain cold/snowy after the 24h race-organization check has[39m
[31m+   // explicitly cleared the stage. Do not keep showing "cancellation likely"[39m
[31m+   // once the authoritative final decision says the stage may proceed.[39m
[31m+   if (finalDecisionStatus === 'cleared') return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const weather = stage.weather_snapshot ?? {}[39m
[31m+   const conditionText = String([39m
[31m+     weather.condition ??[39m
[31m+       weather.condition_label ??[39m
[31m+       weather.label ??[39m
[31m+       weather.name ??[39m
[31m+       ''[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+     .trim()[39m
[31m+     .toLowerCase()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const avgTemp = asNumber([39m
[31m+     (weather.avg_temp_c ??[39m
[31m+       weather.average_temp_c ??[39m
[31m+       weather.temperature_c ??[39m
[31m+       weather.temp_c) as number | string | null | undefined[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (conditionText === 'snow' || conditionText.includes('snow')) {[39m
[31m+     return 'snow'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (avgTemp !== null && avgTemp < 5) {[39m
[31m+     return 'temperature_below_5c'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return null[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStageWeatherDecisionText(stage?: RaceStage | null): string {[39m
[31m+   if (isStageWeatherCanceled(stage)) {[39m
[31m+     return 'The stage has already been canceled by the race engine.'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!stage || !hasWeather(stage)) {[39m
[31m+     return 'Weather is not generated yet, so no cancellation decision can be made.'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return 'Cancellation is decided automatically 24 in-game hours before the stage start, using the generated stage weather. Snow or an average temperature below 5°C cancels the stage.'[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getWeatherCancellationNoticeText(stage?: RaceStage | null, race?: Race | null): string {[39m
[31m+   if (!stage) {[39m
[31m+     if (isRaceAllWeatherCanceled(race)) {[39m
[31m+       return 'The race was canceled due to weather. No race result was generated.'[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return 'This race has weather cancellation metadata.'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const reason = getStageWeatherCancellationReasonLabel(stage)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (race?.is_stage_race) {[39m
[31m+     return `Stage ${stage.stage_number} was canceled due to weather (${reason}). No results, points, prize money, fatigue or replay were generated for this stage. The stage race continues with the next runnable stage.`[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return `This one-day race was canceled due to weather (${reason}). No results, points, prize money, fatigue or replay were generated.`[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function WeatherCancellationNotice({[39m
[31m+   stage,[39m
[31m+   race,[39m
[31m+   compact = false,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   stage?: RaceStage | null[39m
[31m+   race?: Race | null[39m
[31m+   compact?: boolean[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const raceStatus = getRaceWeatherCancellationStatus(race)[39m
[31m+   const shouldRender =[39m
[31m+     isStageWeatherCanceled(stage) ||[39m
[31m+     raceStatus === 'all_stages_weather_cancelled' ||[39m
[31m+     raceStatus === 'partly_weather_cancelled'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!shouldRender) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const title = isStageWeatherCanceled(stage)[39m
[31m+     ? 'Stage canceled due to weather'[39m
[31m+     : raceStatus === 'all_stages_weather_cancelled'[39m
[31m+       ? 'Race canceled due to weather'[39m
[31m+       : 'Race partly canceled by weather'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div[39m
[31m+       className={[[39m
[31m+         'rounded-2xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-900',[39m
[31m+         compact ? 'px-3 py-2 text-xs' : 'px-4 py-3 text-sm',[39m
[31m+       ].join(' ')}[39m
[31m+     >[39m
[31m+       <div className="font-semibold">{title}</div>[39m
[31m+       <div className={compact ? 'mt-1 leading-5' : 'mt-1 leading-6'}>[39m
[31m+         {getWeatherCancellationNoticeText(stage, race)}[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function StageWeatherRiskNotice({ stage }: { stage: RaceStage }) {[39m
[31m+   if (isStageWeatherCanceled(stage)) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const riskReason = getStageWeatherCancellationRiskReason(stage)[39m
[31m+   if (!riskReason) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="mt-4 rounded-2xl border border-orange-200 bg-orange-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-orange-800">[39m
[31m+       <div className="font-semibold">[39m
[31m+         Weather cancellation likely: {getWeatherCancellationReasonLabel(riskReason)}[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+       <div className="mt-1 leading-6">[39m
[31m+         This is only a warning before the lock point. The final cancellation decision is made automatically 24 in-game hours before stage start.[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+ function canApplyForRace([39m
[31m+   applicationsStatus?: string | null,[39m
[31m+   existingApplicationStatus?: string | null,[39m
[31m+   raceStatus?: string | null[39m
[31m+ ): boolean {[39m
[31m+   const normalizedRaceStatus = raceStatus?.toLowerCase() ?? null[39m
[31m+   const normalizedEntryStatus = existingApplicationStatus?.toLowerCase() ?? null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if ([39m
[31m+     normalizedRaceStatus === 'active' ||[39m
[31m+     normalizedRaceStatus === 'completed' ||[39m
[31m+     normalizedRaceStatus === 'archived' ||[39m
[31m+     normalizedRaceStatus === 'cancelled'[39m
[31m+   ) {[39m
[31m+     return false[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (applicationsStatus !== 'open') return false[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return !normalizedEntryStatus || normalizedEntryStatus === 'withdrawn'[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getTeamRaceEntryStatusLabel(status?: string | null): string | null {[39m
[31m+   switch (status?.toLowerCase()) {[39m

[31m+     case 'application_submitted':[39m
[31m+     case 'application submitted':[39m
[31m+     case 'pending':[39m
[31m+       return 'Application submitted'[39m
[31m+     case 'accepted':[39m
[31m+       return 'Accepted'[39m
[31m+     case 'declined':[39m
[31m+       return 'Declined'[39m
[31m+     case 'withdrawn':[39m
[31m+       return 'Withdrawn'[39m
[31m+     case 'missed_startlist':[39m
[31m+       return 'Missed startlist'[39m
[31m+     case 'cancelled':[39m
[31m+       return 'Canceled'[39m
[31m+     default:[39m
[31m+       return null[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function isPendingRaceApplicationStatus(status?: string | null): boolean {[39m
[31m+   const normalized = status?.toLowerCase().trim() ?? ''[39m

[31m+     normalized === 'applied' ||[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStageDateLabel([39m
[31m+   stage: RaceStage,[39m
[31m+   race: Race | null,[39m
[31m+   currentMonthStart: Date | null,[39m
[31m+   currentSeasonNumber: number,[39m
[31m+   currentMonthNumber: number[39m
[31m+ ): string {[39m
[31m+   void currentMonthStart[39m
[31m+   void currentSeasonNumber[39m
[31m+   void currentMonthNumber[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   let stageDate = stage.stage_date[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!stageDate && race?.start_date && stage.stage_number) {[39m
[31m+     stageDate = addDaysToDateOnly(race.start_date, Number(stage.stage_number) - 1)[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const stageDateObject = parseDateOnly(stageDate)[39m
[31m+   const parts = getGameDatePartsFromStoredRaceDate(stageDate)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!stageDateObject || !parts) return '—'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const weekdayLabel = getWeekdayShortName(stageDateObject)[39m
[31m+   const monthLabel = getGameMonthShortName(parts.monthNumber)[39m
[31m+   const dayLabel = String(parts.dayNumber).padStart(2, '0')[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return `S${parts.seasonNumber} · ${weekdayLabel} · ${monthLabel} ${dayLabel}`[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatTimeLabelFromParts([39m
[31m+   hourValue?: number | string | null,[39m
[31m+   minuteValue?: number | string | null[39m
[31m+ ): string | null {[39m
[31m+   const hour = asNumber(hourValue)[39m
[31m+   const minute = asNumber(minuteValue)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (hour === null || minute === null) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return `${String(hour).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(minute).padStart(2, '0')}`[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStageStartTimeLabel(stage: RaceStage, race: Race | null): string | null {[39m
[31m+   const storedStageLabel = stage.planned_start_time_label?.trim()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (storedStageLabel) return storedStageLabel[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const stageTimeLabel = formatTimeLabelFromParts([39m
[31m+     stage.planned_start_hour_number,[39m
[31m+     stage.planned_start_minute[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (stageTimeLabel) return stageTimeLabel[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const stageNumber = Number(stage.stage_number)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (stageNumber === 1) {[39m
[31m+     const storedRaceLabel = race?.planned_start_time_label?.trim()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (storedRaceLabel) return storedRaceLabel[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return formatTimeLabelFromParts([39m
[31m+       race?.planned_start_hour_number,[39m
[31m+       race?.planned_start_minute[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return null[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function getStageDateTimeLabel([39m
[31m+   stage: RaceStage,[39m

[31m+ function formatStageRoute(stage: RaceStage): string {[39m

[31m+   if (routeLabel) return routeLabel[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+ type StageProfilePoint = {[39m
[31m+   km: number[39m
[31m+   elevation_m: number[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getTerrainMinimumVerticalSpanMeters(terrainType: string | null | undefined): number {[39m
[31m+   switch (terrainType) {[39m
[31m+     case 'mountain':[39m
[31m+       return 1400[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     case 'hilly':[39m
[31m+       return 800[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     case 'cobbled':[39m
[31m+       return 600[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     case 'individual_time_trial':[39m
[31m+     case 'team_time_trial':[39m
[31m+     case 'prologue':[39m
[31m+     case 'flat':[39m
[31m+     default:[39m
[31m+       return 500[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getNiceElevationAxisBounds([39m
[31m+   points: StageProfilePoint[],[39m
[31m+   terrainType: string | null | undefined[39m
[31m+ ): { minElevation: number; maxElevation: number } {[39m
[31m+   const rawMin = Math.min(...points.map((point) => point.elevation_m))[39m
[31m+   const rawMax = Math.max(...points.map((point) => point.elevation_m))[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const dataSpan = Math.max(rawMax - rawMin, 1)[39m
[31m+   const minimumSpan = getTerrainMinimumVerticalSpanMeters(terrainType)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const targetSpan = Math.max(dataSpan * 1.25, minimumSpan)[39m
[31m+   const midpoint = (rawMin + rawMax) / 2[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const minElevation = Math.max(0, Math.floor((midpoint - targetSpan / 2) / 100) * 100)[39m
[31m+   const maxElevation = Math.ceil((midpoint + targetSpan / 2) / 100) * 100[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     minElevation,[39m
[31m+     maxElevation: Math.max(maxElevation, minElevation + 100),[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getElevationTickValues(minElevation: number, maxElevation: number): number[] {[39m
[31m+   const values: number[] = [][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (let value = maxElevation; value >= minElevation; value -= 100) {[39m
[31m+     values.push(value)[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return values[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildStageProfilePath([39m
[31m+   points: StageProfilePoint[],[39m
[31m+   width: number,[39m
[31m+   height: number,[39m
[31m+   padding: { top: number; right: number; bottom: number; left: number },[39m
[31m+   terrainType: string | null | undefined[39m
[31m+ ) {[39m
[31m+   if (points.length < 2) return ''[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const innerWidth = width - padding.left - padding.right[39m
[31m+   const innerHeight = height - padding.top - padding.bottom[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const minKm = Math.min(...points.map((point) => point.km))[39m
[31m+   const maxKm = Math.max(...points.map((point) => point.km))[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const { minElevation, maxElevation } = getNiceElevationAxisBounds(points, terrainType)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const kmSpan = Math.max(maxKm - minKm, 1)[39m
[31m+   const elevationSpan = Math.max(maxElevation - minElevation, 1)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const coordinates = points.map((point) => {[39m
[31m+     const x = padding.left + ((point.km - minKm) / kmSpan) * innerWidth[39m
[31m+     const y =[39m
[31m+       padding.top +[39m
[31m+       innerHeight -[39m
[31m+       ((point.elevation_m - minElevation) / elevationSpan) * innerHeight[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return { x, y, km: point.km, elevation_m: point.elevation_m }[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const linePath = coordinates.reduce((path, point, index) => {[39m
[31m+     if (index === 0) {[39m
[31m+       return `M ${point.x} ${point.y}`[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const previous = coordinates[index - 1][39m
[31m+     const controlX = (previous.x + point.x) / 2[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return `${path} C ${controlX} ${previous.y}, ${controlX} ${point.y}, ${point.x} ${point.y}`[39m
[31m+   }, '')[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const areaPath = [[39m
[31m+     linePath,[39m
[31m+     `L ${coordinates[coordinates.length - 1].x} ${height - padding.bottom}`,[39m
[31m+     `L ${coordinates[0].x} ${height - padding.bottom}`,[39m
[31m+     'Z',[39m
[31m+   ].join(' ')[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return JSON.stringify({[39m
[31m+     linePath,[39m
[31m+     areaPath,[39m
[31m+     coordinates,[39m
[31m+     minElevation,[39m
[31m+     maxElevation,[39m
[31m+     minKm,[39m
[31m+     maxKm,[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ /*[39m
[31m+  * Visual-only gap scaling for the profile replay.[39m
[31m+  *[39m
[31m+  * This does not change race data, standings, timing, or backend groups.[39m
[31m+  * It only prevents groups with real gaps like +1:18 from being drawn[39m
[31m+  * almost on top of the front group.[39m
[31m+  */[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getRoadGroupVisualGapKm(gapSeconds: number, currentKm: number, maxKm: number): number {[39m
[31m+   if (!Number.isFinite(gapSeconds) || gapSeconds <= 0) return 0[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   /*[39m
[31m+    * Visual-only road gap spacing.[39m
[31m+    * The database km_marker stays unchanged. This only separates markers on the[39m
[31m+    * stage profile so a B1/P group with +30–40s does not render as one dot.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   const rawGapKm = gapSeconds * 0.035[39m
[31m+   const minimumVisibleGapKm =[39m
[31m+     gapSeconds >= 90 ? 2.25 :[39m
[31m+     gapSeconds >= 45 ? 1.45 :[39m
[31m+     gapSeconds >= 20 ? 0.9 :[39m
[31m+     0.35[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const cappedGapKm = Math.min(8, Math.max(minimumVisibleGapKm, rawGapKm))[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   /*[39m
[31m+    * Near the start, do not push the group fully outside the visible profile.[39m
[31m+    * Keep at least a small part of the actual progress visible.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   const earlyRaceCap = currentKm < 8 ? Math.max(0.25, currentKm * 0.65) : cappedGapKm[39m
[31m+   const safeGapKm = Math.min(cappedGapKm, earlyRaceCap)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return Math.max(0, Math.min(safeGapKm, Math.max(0, maxKm)))[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getRoadGroupProfileKmFromGap({[39m
[31m+   actualKm,[39m
[31m+   leaderKm,[39m
[31m+   gapSeconds,[39m
[31m+   avgSpeedKmh,[39m
[31m+   previousGroupKm,[39m
[31m+   maxKm,[39m
[31m+   backendNormalized = false,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   actualKm: number[39m
[31m+   leaderKm: number[39m
[31m+   gapSeconds: number[39m
[31m+   avgSpeedKmh?: number[39m
[31m+   previousGroupKm?: number | null[39m
[31m+   maxKm: number[39m
[31m+   backendNormalized?: boolean[39m
[31m+ }): number {[39m
[31m+   if (!Number.isFinite(actualKm)) return 0[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   /*[39m
[31m+    * V13 visual-only profile spacing.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * Backend v12 now keeps rider gaps, km movement, Peloton identity, and[39m
[31m+    * internal group span stable. The remaining problem is visual: a group with[39m
[31m+    * +10 to +25 minutes can still look too close to the leader if the profile[39m
[31m+    * marker trusts backend km too much or caps the visible offset too tightly.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * This function does not rewrite race data. It only places the dot on the[39m
[31m+    * stage profile so the marker distance better matches the displayed time gap.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   if (!Number.isFinite(gapSeconds) || gapSeconds <= 0) {[39m
[31m+     return Math.max(0, Math.min(maxKm, actualKm))[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const speedKmh = Math.max(22, Math.min(50, Number(avgSpeedKmh ?? 38)))[39m
[31m+   const physicalGapKm = (gapSeconds * speedKmh) / 3600[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const minimumVisibleGapKm =[39m
[31m+     gapSeconds >= 1500 ? 14.0 :[39m
[31m+     gapSeconds >= 1200 ? 11.5 :[39m
[31m+     gapSeconds >= 900 ? 9.0 :[39m
[31m+     gapSeconds >= 600 ? 6.5 :[39m
[31m+     gapSeconds >= 420 ? 4.8 :[39m
[31m+     gapSeconds >= 300 ? 3.5 :[39m
[31m+     gapSeconds >= 180 ? 2.2 :[39m
[31m+     gapSeconds >= 90 ? 1.2 :[39m
[31m+     gapSeconds >= 30 ? 0.5 :[39m
[31m+     0.15[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const maximumVisibleGapKm = Math.max([39m
[31m+     0.4,[39m
[31m+     Math.min([39m
[31m+       // Keep the dot on the visible profile but allow very large gaps to look[39m
[31m+       // genuinely far behind, especially around 90–140 km.[39m
[31m+       Math.max(0.4, leaderKm - 0.35),[39m
[31m+       gapSeconds >= 1500 ? 24.0 :[39m
[31m+       gapSeconds >= 1200 ? 20.0 :[39m
[31m+       gapSeconds >= 900 ? 16.0 :[39m
[31m+       gapSeconds >= 600 ? 12.0 :[39m
[31m+       gapSeconds >= 420 ? 9.0 :[39m
[31m+       gapSeconds >= 300 ? 7.0 :[39m
[31m+       gapSeconds >= 180 ? 5.0 :[39m
[31m+       gapSeconds >= 90 ? 3.2 :[39m
[31m+       gapSeconds >= 30 ? 1.8 :[39m
[31m+       0.8[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const gapKm = Math.min([39m
[31m+     maximumVisibleGapKm,[39m
[31m+     Math.max(minimumVisibleGapKm, physicalGapKm)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   let displayKm = leaderKm - gapKm[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (previousGroupKm !== null && previousGroupKm !== undefined) {[39m
[31m+     // Maintain visual order and prevent groups with similar marker positions[39m
[31m+     // from drawing on top of each other.[39m
[31m+     displayKm = Math.min(displayKm, previousGroupKm - 0.28)[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return Math.max(0, Math.min(maxKm, displayKm))[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function isTimeTrialLikeStage([39m
[31m+   stage: RaceStage | null | undefined[39m
[31m+ ): boolean {[39m
[31m+   if (!stage) return false[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const stageFormat = String([39m
[31m+     (stage as RaceStage & { stage_format?: string | null }).stage_format ?? ''[39m
[31m+   ).toLowerCase()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const values = [[39m
[31m+     stageFormat,[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+ function renderScheme(value: unknown): string {[39m
[31m+   if (value === null || value === undefined) return '—'[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (Array.isArray(value)) {[39m
[31m+     return value.length ? value.map(String).join(' / ') : '—'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (typeof value === 'object') {[39m
[31m+     return Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>)[39m
[31m+       .map(([key, entryValue]) => `${humanizeCode(key)}: ${renderScheme(entryValue)}`)[39m
[31m+       .join(' · ')[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return String(value)[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {[39m
[31m+   if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return {}[39m
[31m+   return value as Record<string, unknown>[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function arrayOrEmpty<T>(value: unknown): T[] {[39m
[31m+   return Array.isArray(value) ? (value as T[]) : [][39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeRaceResultsPayload(value: unknown): RaceResultsViewPayload {[39m
[31m+   const record = getRecord(value)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     race_id: typeof record.race_id === 'string' ? record.race_id : null,[39m
[31m+     stage_id: typeof record.stage_id === 'string' ? record.stage_id : null,[39m
[31m+     stage_results: arrayOrEmpty<RaceStageResultRow>(record.stage_results),[39m
[31m+     point_results: arrayOrEmpty<RacePointResultRow>(record.point_results),[39m
[31m+     classifications: arrayOrEmpty<RaceClassificationRow>(record.classifications),[39m
[31m+     leader_snapshot: getRecord(record.leader_snapshot),[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatRaceClock(seconds?: number | null): string {[39m
[31m+   if (seconds === null || seconds === undefined || Number.isNaN(Number(seconds))) {[39m
[31m+     return '—'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const total = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(seconds)))[39m
[31m+   const hours = Math.floor(total / 3600)[39m
[31m+   const minutes = Math.floor((total % 3600) / 60)[39m
[31m+   const secs = total % 60[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return `${hours}:${String(minutes).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(secs).padStart(2, '0')}`[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatPreciseRaceClock(seconds?: number | null): string {[39m
[31m+   if (seconds === null || seconds === undefined || Number.isNaN(Number(seconds))) {[39m
[31m+     return '—'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const totalMilliseconds = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(seconds) * 1000))[39m
[31m+   const wholeSeconds = Math.floor(totalMilliseconds / 1000)[39m
[31m+   const milliseconds = totalMilliseconds % 1000[39m
[31m+   const hours = Math.floor(wholeSeconds / 3600)[39m
[31m+   const minutes = Math.floor((wholeSeconds % 3600) / 60)[39m
[31m+   const secs = wholeSeconds % 60[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return `${hours}:${String(minutes).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(secs).padStart(2, '0')}.${String(milliseconds).padStart(3, '0')}`[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatTerrainModelLabel(value: string): string {[39m
[31m+   return value.length === 0[39m
[31m+     ? value[39m
[31m+     : `${value.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}${value.slice(1)}`[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatSignedTerrainValue(value: number, digits = 1): string {[39m
[31m+   const prefix = value > 0 ? '+' : ''[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return `${prefix}${value.toFixed(digits)}`[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatGapValue(seconds?: number | null): string {[39m
[31m+   if (seconds === null || seconds === undefined || Number.isNaN(Number(seconds))) {[39m
[31m+     return '—'[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const total = Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(seconds)))[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (total === 0) return '0s'[39m
[31m+   if (total < 60) return `${total}s`[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const minutes = Math.floor(total / 60)[39m
[31m+   const secs = total % 60[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}:${String(secs).padStart(2, '0')}`[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return formatRaceClock(total)[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatStageGap(seconds?: number | null): string {[39m
[31m+   if (seconds === null || seconds === undefined) return '—'[39m
[31m+   if (Number(seconds) === 0) return 's.t.'[39m
[31m+   return `+${formatGapValue(seconds)}`[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatClassificationGap(seconds?: number | null): string {[39m
[31m+   if (seconds === null || seconds === undefined) return '—'[39m
[31m+   if (Number(seconds) === 0) return 'Leader'[39m
[31m+   return `+${formatGapValue(seconds)}`[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatResultPoints(points?: number | null): string {[39m

[31m+   return String(points)[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function sortRankedRows<T extends { rank: number | null }>(rows: T[]): T[] {[39m
[31m+   return [...rows].sort((a, b) => {[39m
[31m+     const rankA = a.rank ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER[39m
[31m+     const rankB = b.rank ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER[39m
[31m+     return rankA - rankB[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function getStageResultStatusReason(row: RaceStageResultRow): string {[39m
[31m+   const record = row as unknown as Record<string, unknown>[39m
[31m+   const metadata = getRecord(record.metadata)[39m
[31m+   const candidates = [[39m
[31m+     record.status_reason,[39m

[31m+     record.disqualification_reason,[39m
[31m+     record.withdrawal_reason,[39m
[31m+     record.dnf_reason,[39m

[31m+     metadata.disqualification_reason,[39m
[31m+     metadata.withdrawal_reason,[39m
[31m+     metadata.dnf_reason,[39m
[31m+   ][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (const candidate of candidates) {[39m
[31m+     if (typeof candidate === 'string' && candidate.trim()) return candidate.trim()[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m

[31m+ }[39m

[31m+[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+   const parsed = Number(value)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : 0[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     points:[39m
[31m+       getPositiveNumber(row.finish_points) +[39m
[31m+       getPositiveNumber(row.sprint_points),[39m
[31m+     bonusSeconds: getPositiveNumber(row.bonus_seconds),[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type StagePointAggregateSeed = Omit<AggregatedStagePointResultRow, 'rank'> & {[39m
[31m+   bestSourceRank: number[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStagePointAggregateKey([39m
[31m+   riderId?: string | null,[39m
[31m+   teamId?: string | null,[39m
[31m+   riderName?: string | null,[39m
[31m+   teamName?: string | null[39m
[31m+ ): string {[39m
[31m+   return [[39m
[31m+     riderId || 'no-rider-id',[39m
[31m+     teamId || 'no-team-id',[39m
[31m+     riderName || 'no-rider-name',[39m
[31m+     teamName || 'no-team-name',[39m
[31m+   ].join('|')[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function addStagePointAggregateSeed([39m
[31m+   map: Map<string, StagePointAggregateSeed>,[39m
[31m+   entry: {[39m
[31m+     rider_id: string | null[39m
[31m+     team_id: string | null[39m
[31m+     rider_name_snapshot: string | null[39m
[31m+     team_name_snapshot: string | null[39m
[31m+     points_awarded: number[39m
[31m+     bonus_seconds_awarded: number[39m
[31m+     source_rank: number | null[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ ) {[39m
[31m+   if (entry.points_awarded <= 0 && entry.bonus_seconds_awarded <= 0) return[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const key = getStagePointAggregateKey([39m
[31m+     entry.rider_id,[39m
[31m+     entry.team_id,[39m
[31m+     entry.rider_name_snapshot,[39m
[31m+     entry.team_name_snapshot[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const existing = map.get(key)[39m
[31m+   const sourceRank = entry.source_rank ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!existing) {[39m
[31m+     map.set(key, {[39m
[31m+       rider_id: entry.rider_id,[39m
[31m+       team_id: entry.team_id,[39m
[31m+       rider_name_snapshot: entry.rider_name_snapshot,[39m
[31m+       team_name_snapshot: entry.team_name_snapshot,[39m
[31m+       points_awarded: entry.points_awarded,[39m
[31m+       bonus_seconds_awarded: entry.bonus_seconds_awarded,[39m
[31m+       bestSourceRank: sourceRank,[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+     return[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   existing.points_awarded += entry.points_awarded[39m
[31m+   existing.bonus_seconds_awarded += entry.bonus_seconds_awarded[39m
[31m+   existing.bestSourceRank = Math.min(existing.bestSourceRank, sourceRank)[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function rankStagePointAggregates([39m
[31m+   rows: StagePointAggregateSeed[][39m
[31m+ ): AggregatedStagePointResultRow[] {[39m
[31m+   const sortedRows = [...rows].sort((a, b) => {[39m
[31m+     if (b.points_awarded !== a.points_awarded) {[39m
[31m+       return b.points_awarded - a.points_awarded[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (b.bonus_seconds_awarded !== a.bonus_seconds_awarded) {[39m
[31m+       return b.bonus_seconds_awarded - a.bonus_seconds_awarded[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (a.bestSourceRank !== b.bestSourceRank) {[39m
[31m+       return a.bestSourceRank - b.bestSourceRank[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return String(a.rider_name_snapshot ?? '').localeCompare([39m
[31m+       String(b.rider_name_snapshot ?? '')[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   let previousScore: string | null = null[39m
[31m+   let previousRank = 0[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return sortedRows.map((row, index) => {[39m
[31m+     const score = `${row.points_awarded}|${row.bonus_seconds_awarded}`[39m
[31m+     const rank = score === previousScore ? previousRank : index + 1[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     previousScore = score[39m
[31m+     previousRank = rank[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       rank,[39m
[31m+       rider_id: row.rider_id,[39m
[31m+       team_id: row.team_id,[39m
[31m+       rider_name_snapshot: row.rider_name_snapshot,[39m
[31m+       team_name_snapshot: row.team_name_snapshot,[39m
[31m+       points_awarded: row.points_awarded,[39m
[31m+       bonus_seconds_awarded: row.bonus_seconds_awarded,[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function aggregateStagePointRowsFromStageResults([39m
[31m+   rows: RaceStageResultRow[],[39m
[31m+   view: StagePointAggregateView[39m
[31m+ ): AggregatedStagePointResultRow[] {[39m
[31m+   const map = new Map<string, StagePointAggregateSeed>()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   sortRankedRows(rows).forEach((row) => {[39m
[31m+     const totals = getStageResultPointTotals(row, view)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     addStagePointAggregateSeed(map, {[39m
[31m+       rider_id: row.rider_id,[39m
[31m+       team_id: row.team_id,[39m
[31m+       rider_name_snapshot: row.rider_name_snapshot,[39m
[31m+       team_name_snapshot: row.team_name_snapshot,[39m
[31m+       points_awarded: totals.points,[39m
[31m+       bonus_seconds_awarded: totals.bonusSeconds,[39m
[31m+       source_rank: row.rank,[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return rankStagePointAggregates(Array.from(map.values()))[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function aggregateStagePointRowsFromPointGates([39m
[31m+   rows: RacePointResultRow[],[39m
[31m+   view: StagePointAggregateView[39m
[31m+ ): AggregatedStagePointResultRow[] {[39m
[31m+   const map = new Map<string, StagePointAggregateSeed>()[39m
[31m+   const pointTypes =[39m
[31m+     view === 'mountain'[39m
[31m+       ? ['KOM'][39m
[31m+       : ['FINISH', 'INTERMEDIATE_SPRINT', 'BONUS_SPRINT'][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   rows[39m
[31m+     .filter((row) => pointTypes.includes(row.point_type ?? ''))[39m
[31m+     .forEach((row) => {[39m
[31m+       addStagePointAggregateSeed(map, {[39m
[31m+         rider_id: row.rider_id,[39m
[31m+         team_id: row.team_id,[39m
[31m+         rider_name_snapshot: row.rider_name_snapshot,[39m
[31m+         team_name_snapshot: row.team_name_snapshot,[39m
[31m+         points_awarded: getPositiveNumber(row.points_awarded),[39m
[31m+         bonus_seconds_awarded:[39m
[31m+           view === 'sprint' ? getPositiveNumber(row.bonus_seconds_awarded) : 0,[39m
[31m+         source_rank: row.rank,[39m
[31m+       })[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return rankStagePointAggregates(Array.from(map.values()))[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildAggregatedStagePointRows([39m
[31m+   stageRows: RaceStageResultRow[],[39m
[31m+   pointGateRows: RacePointResultRow[],[39m
[31m+   view: StagePointAggregateView[39m
[31m+ ): AggregatedStagePointResultRow[] {[39m
[31m+   const fromPointGates =[39m
[31m+     aggregateStagePointRowsFromPointGates([39m
[31m+       pointGateRows,[39m
[31m+       view[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (fromPointGates.length > 0) {[39m
[31m+     return fromPointGates[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return aggregateStagePointRowsFromStageResults([39m
[31m+     stageRows,[39m
[31m+     view[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStageResultGapSeconds([39m
[31m+   row: RaceStageResultRow,[39m
[31m+   winnerElapsedSeconds: number | null[39m
[31m+ ): number | null {[39m
[31m+   if (row.gap_seconds !== null && row.gap_seconds !== undefined) {[39m
[31m+     const parsedGap = Number(row.gap_seconds)[39m
[31m+     return Number.isFinite(parsedGap) ? Math.max(0, parsedGap) : null[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if ([39m
[31m+     winnerElapsedSeconds !== null &&[39m
[31m+     row.elapsed_seconds !== null &&[39m
[31m+     row.elapsed_seconds !== undefined[39m
[31m+   ) {[39m
[31m+     const elapsed = Number(row.elapsed_seconds)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (Number.isFinite(elapsed)) {[39m
[31m+       return Math.max(0, elapsed - winnerElapsedSeconds)[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return null[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatStageResultTime([39m
[31m+   row: RaceStageResultRow,[39m
[31m+   winnerElapsedSeconds: number | null[39m
[31m+ ): string {[39m
[31m+   if (row.rank === 1) return formatRaceClock(row.elapsed_seconds)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const gapSeconds = getStageResultGapSeconds(row, winnerElapsedSeconds)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (gapSeconds === 0) return 's.t.'[39m
[31m+   if (gapSeconds !== null) return `+${formatGapValue(gapSeconds)}`[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return formatRaceClock(row.elapsed_seconds)[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function getUserParticipantTeams([39m
[31m+   participantTeams: RaceParticipantTeam[],[39m
[31m+   viewerTeamIds?: ViewerTeamIdSource[39m
[31m+ ): RaceParticipantTeam[] {[39m
[31m+   const viewerIds = normalizeViewerTeamIds(viewerTeamIds)[39m
[31m+   if (viewerIds.size === 0) return [][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return participantTeams.filter((team) => isViewerTeamRow(team, viewerIds))[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function getUserParticipantTeam([39m
[31m+   participantTeams: RaceParticipantTeam[],[39m
[31m+   viewerTeamIds?: ViewerTeamIdSource[39m

[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getUserRiderIdSet([39m
[31m+   participantTeams: RaceParticipantTeam[],[39m
[31m+   viewerTeamIds?: ViewerTeamIdSource[39m
[31m+ ): Set<string> {[39m
[31m+   const userTeams = getUserParticipantTeams(participantTeams, viewerTeamIds)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return new Set([39m
[31m+     userTeams[39m
[31m+       .flatMap((team) => team.riders)[39m
[31m+       .map((rider) => rider.rider_id)[39m
[31m+       .filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value))[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildTopRowsWithUserExtras<T extends { rank: number | null }>([39m
[31m+   rows: T[],[39m
[31m+   isUserRow: (row: T) => boolean,[39m
[31m+   limit = 15[39m
[31m+ ): { topRows: T[]; extraUserRows: T[] } {[39m
[31m+   const sortedRows = sortRankedRows(rows)[39m
[31m+   const topRows = sortedRows.slice(0, limit)[39m
[31m+   const extraUserRows = sortedRows.slice(limit).filter(isUserRow)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return { topRows, extraUserRows }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function getLeaderSnapshot(race: Race): Record<string, unknown> {[39m
[31m+   const raceRecord = race as unknown as Record<string, unknown>[39m
[31m+   const direct = getRecord(raceRecord.leaders_snapshot)[39m
[31m+   const metadata = getRecord(raceRecord.metadata)[39m
[31m+   const fromMetadata = getRecord(metadata.leaders_snapshot)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return Object.keys(direct).length > 0 ? direct : fromMetadata[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getLeaderRow([39m
[31m+   snapshot: Record<string, unknown>,[39m
[31m+   key: string[39m
[31m+ ): { name: string; team?: string; value?: string } | null {[39m
[31m+   const row = getRecord(snapshot[key])[39m
[31m+   const name = typeof row.name === 'string' ? row.name : ''[39m
[31m+   const team = typeof row.team === 'string' ? row.team : ''[39m
[31m+   const value = typeof row.value === 'string' ? row.value : ''[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!name && !team && !value) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return { name, team, value }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
