[31m+ function getLogoStringFromUnknown(value: unknown): string | null {[39m
[31m+   if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim()) return value.trim()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)) {[39m
[31m+     const record = value as Record<string, unknown>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     for (const key of TEAM_LOGO_NESTED_FIELD_KEYS) {[39m
[31m+       const nestedValue = record[key][39m
[31m+       if (typeof nestedValue === 'string' && nestedValue.trim()) {[39m
[31m+         return nestedValue.trim()[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return null[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getPublicStorageLogoUrl(bucket: string, path: string): string | null {[39m
[31m+   const cleanBucket = bucket.trim().replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '')[39m
[31m+   const cleanPath = path.trim().replace(/^\/+/, '')[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!cleanBucket || !cleanPath) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const { data } = supabase.storage.from(cleanBucket).getPublicUrl(cleanPath)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return data.publicUrl || null[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeTeamLogoUrl(value?: string | null): string | null {[39m
[31m+   const rawValue = value?.trim()[39m
[31m+   if (!rawValue) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (/^(https?:\/\/|data:image\/|blob:)/i.test(rawValue)) return rawValue[39m
[31m+   if (rawValue.startsWith('//')) return `https:${rawValue}`[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const storageMatch = rawValue.match([39m
[31m+     /\/storage\/v1\/object\/public\/([^/?#]+)\/([^?#]+)/i[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (storageMatch) {[39m
[31m+     return getPublicStorageLogoUrl([39m
[31m+       decodeURIComponent(storageMatch[1]),[39m
[31m+       decodeURIComponent(storageMatch[2])[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const cleanValue = rawValue[39m
[31m+     .replace(/^public\//i, '')[39m
[31m+     .replace(/^\/+/, '')[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const [possibleBucket, ...pathParts] = cleanValue.split('/')[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (possibleBucket && pathParts.length > 0 && TEAM_LOGO_STORAGE_BUCKETS.includes(possibleBucket)) {[39m
[31m+     return getPublicStorageLogoUrl(possibleBucket, pathParts.join('/'))[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return rawValue[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getTeamLogoUrlFromRecord(record: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {[39m
[31m+   for (const key of TEAM_LOGO_FIELD_KEYS) {[39m
[31m+     const rawLogoValue = getLogoStringFromUnknown(record[key])[39m
[31m+     const logoUrl = normalizeTeamLogoUrl(rawLogoValue)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (logoUrl) return logoUrl[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return null[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeTeamJerseyColor([39m
[31m+   value: unknown,[39m
[31m+   fallback: string[39m
[31m+ ): string {[39m
[31m+   return typeof value === 'string' && /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(value.trim())[39m
[31m+     ? value.trim()[39m
[31m+     : fallback[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getGenericTeamJerseyDataUrl([39m
[31m+   record: Record<string, unknown>,[39m
[31m+   nestedRecords: Record<string, unknown>[][39m
[31m+ ): string | null {[39m
[31m+   const configRecord = nestedRecords.find((nestedRecord) => {[39m
[31m+     const mode = getStringField(nestedRecord, ['mode', 'type', 'kind'])[39m
[31m+     return mode?.trim().toLowerCase() === 'generic'[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!configRecord) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const primaryColor = normalizeTeamJerseyColor([39m
[31m+     configRecord.primary_color ??[39m
[31m+       configRecord.primaryColor ??[39m
[31m+       record.primary_color ??[39m
[31m+       record.primaryColor,[39m
[31m+     '#2563eb'[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const secondaryColor = normalizeTeamJerseyColor([39m
[31m+     configRecord.secondary_color ??[39m
[31m+       configRecord.secondaryColor ??[39m
[31m+       record.secondary_color ??[39m
[31m+       record.secondaryColor,[39m
[31m+     '#f8fafc'[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+   const accentColor = normalizeTeamJerseyColor([39m
[31m+     configRecord.accent_color ??[39m
[31m+       configRecord.accentColor ??[39m
[31m+       record.accent_color ??[39m
[31m+       record.accentColor,[39m
[31m+     secondaryColor[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const svg = `[39m
[31m+     <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 512 512">[39m
[31m+       <defs>[39m
[31m+         <linearGradient id="body" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">[39m
[31m+           <stop offset="0" stop-color="${primaryColor}"/>[39m
[31m+           <stop offset="1" stop-color="${accentColor}"/>[39m
[31m+         </linearGradient>[39m
[31m+         <linearGradient id="shine" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">[39m
[31m+           <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.05"/>[39m
[31m+           <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.32"/>[39m
[31m+           <stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.03"/>[39m
[31m+         </linearGradient>[39m
[31m+       </defs>[39m
[31m+       <path d="M176 72 224 44h64l48 28 102 53-46 106-58-27v258H178V204l-58 27-46-106 102-53Z" fill="url(#body)"/>[39m
[31m+       <path d="M224 44c6 37 58 37 64 0l48 28c-23 52-137 52-160 0l48-28Z" fill="${secondaryColor}"/>[39m
[31m+       <path d="M178 228h156v54H178z" fill="${secondaryColor}" opacity="0.94"/>[39m
[31m+       <path d="M178 282h156v18H178z" fill="${accentColor}" opacity="0.95"/>[39m
[31m+       <path d="M120 125 74 125l46 106 58-27v-76Z" fill="${secondaryColor}" opacity="0.92"/>[39m
[31m+       <path d="M392 125h46l-46 106-58-27v-76Z" fill="${secondaryColor}" opacity="0.92"/>[39m
[31m+       <path d="M207 78h98v384h-98z" fill="url(#shine)" opacity="0.55"/>[39m
[31m+     </svg>[39m
[31m+   `.trim()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return `data:image/svg+xml;charset=UTF-8,${encodeURIComponent(svg)}`[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getTeamJerseyUrlFromRecord(record: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {[39m
[31m+   const nestedRecords = TEAM_JERSEY_NESTED_RECORD_KEYS[39m
[31m+     .map((key) => getRecord(record[key]))[39m
[31m+     .filter((nestedRecord) => Object.keys(nestedRecord).length > 0)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (const candidateRecord of [record, ...nestedRecords]) {[39m
[31m+     for (const key of TEAM_JERSEY_FIELD_KEYS) {[39m
[31m+       const rawJerseyValue = getLogoStringFromUnknown(candidateRecord[key])[39m
[31m+       const jerseyUrl = normalizeTeamLogoUrl(rawJerseyValue)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (jerseyUrl) return jerseyUrl[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   /*[39m
[31m+    * The customization page can save a generated kit as[39m
[31m+    * team_kits.config = { mode: 'generic', imageSrc: null }.[39m
[31m+    * In that case there is no stored bitmap URL, so create a lightweight[39m
[31m+    * deterministic SVG from the saved club/kit colors.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   return getGenericTeamJerseyDataUrl(record, nestedRecords)[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getRaceParticipantTeamLogoUrl([39m
[31m+   row: RaceParticipantTeamViewRow,[39m
[31m+   club: Record<string, unknown>[39m
[31m+ ): string | null {[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     getTeamLogoUrlFromRecord(row as unknown as Record<string, unknown>) ??[39m
[31m+     getTeamLogoUrlFromRecord(club)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeBoolean(value: boolean | string | null | undefined): boolean | null {[39m
[31m+   if (typeof value === 'boolean') return value[39m
[31m+   if (typeof value !== 'string') return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const normalized = value.trim().toLowerCase()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (['true', 't', 'yes', 'y', '1'].includes(normalized)) return true[39m
[31m+   if (['false', 'f', 'no', 'n', '0'].includes(normalized)) return false[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return null[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeRaceParticipantRiderRow([39m
[31m+   row: RaceParticipantRiderViewRow,[39m
[31m+   fallbackTeamId?: string | null,[39m
[31m+   fallbackRaceId?: string | null,[39m
[31m+   fallbackTeamName?: string | null,[39m
[31m+   fallbackCountryCode?: string | null[39m
[31m+ ): RaceParticipantRider | null {[39m
[31m+   const riderId = row.rider_id ?? row.id[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!riderId) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const startNumber =[39m
[31m+     asNumber(row.start_number) ?? asNumber(row.race_number) ?? asNumber(row.bib_number)[39m
[31m+   const overall =[39m
[31m+     asNumber(row.overall_snapshot) ?? asNumber(row.overall) ?? asNumber(row.overall_rating)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     id: row.id ?? riderId,[39m
[31m+     race_id: row.race_id ?? fallbackRaceId ?? '',[39m
[31m+     team_id: row.team_id ?? row.club_id ?? fallbackTeamId ?? '',[39m
[31m+     rider_id: riderId,[39m
[31m+     rider_name_snapshot:[39m
[31m+       row.rider_name_snapshot ?? row.rider_name ?? row.full_name ?? row.name ?? null,[39m
[31m+     rider_full_name: row.full_name ?? row.name ?? row.rider_name ?? null,[39m
[31m+     first_name: row.first_name ?? null,[39m
[31m+     last_name: row.last_name ?? null,[39m
[31m+     display_name: row.display_name ?? row.rider_name ?? row.full_name ?? row.name ?? null,[39m
[31m+     team_name_snapshot: row.team_name_snapshot ?? fallbackTeamName ?? null,[39m
[31m+     country_code_snapshot:[39m
[31m+       row.country_code_snapshot ?? row.country_code ?? fallbackCountryCode ?? null,[39m
[31m+     age_snapshot: asNumber(row.age_snapshot) ?? asNumber(row.age),[39m
[31m+     is_young_rider: row.is_young_rider ?? null,[39m
[31m+     start_number: startNumber === null ? null : Math.round(startNumber),[39m
[31m+     role_snapshot: row.role_snapshot ?? row.rider_type ?? row.rider_role ?? row.role ?? null,[39m
[31m+     overall_snapshot: overall,[39m
[31m+     can_view_exact_overall: normalizeBoolean(row.can_view_exact_overall),[39m
[31m+     overall_range_label: row.overall_range_label ?? row.overall_label ?? null,[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getEmbeddedRiderRows(row: RaceParticipantTeamViewRow): unknown[] {[39m
[31m+   if (Array.isArray(row.riders)) return row.riders[39m
[31m+   if (Array.isArray(row.participant_riders)) return row.participant_riders[39m
[31m+   if (Array.isArray(row.assigned_riders)) return row.assigned_riders[39m
[31m+   if (Array.isArray(row.riders_json)) return row.riders_json[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return [][39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getParticipantRiderLeaderPriority(rider: RaceParticipantRider): number {[39m
[31m+   const role = rider.role_snapshot?.toLowerCase().trim() ?? ''[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if ([39m
[31m+     role === 'leader' ||[39m
[31m+     role === 'team leader' ||[39m
[31m+     role === 'team_leader' ||[39m
[31m+     role === 'gc leader' ||[39m
[31m+     role === 'gc_leader' ||[39m
[31m+     role === 'captain' ||[39m
[31m+     role === 'race captain' ||[39m
[31m+     role.includes('leader') ||[39m
[31m+     role.includes('captain')[39m
[31m+   ) {[39m
[31m+     return 0[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return 1[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function sortParticipantRiders(riders: RaceParticipantRider[]): RaceParticipantRider[] {[39m
[31m+   return [...riders].sort((a, b) => {[39m
[31m+     const leaderPriorityA = getParticipantRiderLeaderPriority(a)[39m
[31m+     const leaderPriorityB = getParticipantRiderLeaderPriority(b)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (leaderPriorityA !== leaderPriorityB) {[39m
[31m+       return leaderPriorityA - leaderPriorityB[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const overallA = asNumber(a.overall_snapshot) ?? 0[39m
[31m+     const overallB = asNumber(b.overall_snapshot) ?? 0[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (overallA !== overallB) {[39m
[31m+       return overallB - overallA[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const numberA = a.start_number ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER[39m
[31m+     const numberB = b.start_number ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (numberA !== numberB) return numberA - numberB[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return String(a.rider_name_snapshot ?? '').localeCompare([39m
[31m+       String(b.rider_name_snapshot ?? '')[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getParticipantTeamTierOrder(team: RaceParticipantTeam): number {[39m
[31m+   const tier = team.club_tier?.toLowerCase().replace(/[\s_-]+/g, '') ?? ''[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (tier.includes('world')) return 1[39m
[31m+   if (tier.includes('pro')) return 2[39m
[31m+   if (tier.includes('continental')) return 3[39m
[31m+   if (tier.includes('amateur')) return 4[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return 99[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getParticipantTeamRankValue(team: RaceParticipantTeam): number {[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     asNumber(team.competition_rank) ??[39m
[31m+     asNumber(team.ranking_snapshot) ??[39m
[31m+     Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getParticipantTeamPointsValue(team: RaceParticipantTeam): number {[39m
[31m+   return asNumber(team.competition_points) ?? 0[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getParticipantTeamWorldTierValue(team: RaceParticipantTeam): number {[39m
[31m+   const parsed = asNumber(team.world_tier)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (parsed !== null) return parsed[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const digits = team.world_tier?.match(/\d+/)?.[0][39m
[31m+   const parsedDigits = digits ? Number(digits) : null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return Number.isFinite(parsedDigits) ? Number(parsedDigits) : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function compareParticipantTeamsByRaceOrder([39m
[31m+   left: RaceParticipantTeam,[39m
[31m+   right: RaceParticipantTeam[39m
[31m+ ): number {[39m
[31m+   const tierA = getParticipantTeamTierOrder(left)[39m
[31m+   const tierB = getParticipantTeamTierOrder(right)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (tierA !== tierB) return tierA - tierB[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const rankA = getParticipantTeamRankValue(left)[39m
[31m+   const rankB = getParticipantTeamRankValue(right)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (rankA !== rankB) return rankA - rankB[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const pointsA = getParticipantTeamPointsValue(left)[39m
[31m+   const pointsB = getParticipantTeamPointsValue(right)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (pointsA !== pointsB) return pointsB - pointsA[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const worldTierA = getParticipantTeamWorldTierValue(left)[39m
[31m+   const worldTierB = getParticipantTeamWorldTierValue(right)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (worldTierA !== worldTierB) return worldTierA - worldTierB[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return getParticipantTeamName(left).localeCompare(getParticipantTeamName(right))[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildParticipantTeamsForRaceDisplay([39m
[31m+   teams: RaceParticipantTeam[][39m
[31m+ ): RaceParticipantTeam[] {[39m
[31m+   return [...teams][39m
[31m+     .sort(compareParticipantTeamsByRaceOrder)[39m
[31m+     .map((team, teamIndex) => {[39m
[31m+       const baseStartNumber = teamIndex * 10 + 1[39m
[31m+       const riders = sortParticipantRiders(team.riders).map((rider, riderIndex) => ({[39m
[31m+         ...rider,[39m
[31m+         display_start_number: baseStartNumber + riderIndex,[39m
[31m+       }))[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return {[39m
[31m+         ...team,[39m
[31m+         riders,[39m
[31m+         assigned_riders_count: riders.length,[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeRaceParticipantTeamViewRow([39m
[31m+   row: RaceParticipantTeamViewRow[39m
[31m+ ): RaceParticipantTeam | null {[39m
[31m+   const club = getJoinedClubRecord(row)[39m
[31m+   const joinedClubId = getStringField(club, ['id', 'club_id', 'team_id'])[39m
[31m+   const raceTeamEntryId = row.race_team_entry_id ?? row.id ?? null[39m
[31m+   const ownerClubId = row.owner_club_id ?? row.club_id ?? joinedClubId ?? null[39m
[31m+   const participatingClubId = row.participating_club_id ?? row.team_id ?? ownerClubId ?? null[39m
[31m+   const clubId = participatingClubId ?? ownerClubId ?? null[39m
[31m+   const rawTeamId = participatingClubId ?? row.team_id ?? clubId ?? raceTeamEntryId[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!rawTeamId) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const teamId = String(rawTeamId)[39m
[31m+   const normalizedClubId = clubId ? String(clubId) : null[39m
[31m+   const normalizedOwnerClubId = ownerClubId ? String(ownerClubId) : null[39m
[31m+   const normalizedParticipatingClubId = participatingClubId ? String(participatingClubId) : null[39m
[31m+   const normalizedRaceTeamEntryId = raceTeamEntryId ? String(raceTeamEntryId) : null[39m
[31m+   const clubName =[39m
[31m+     row.club_name ??[39m
[31m+     row.team_name_snapshot ??[39m
[31m+     getStringField(club, ['name', 'club_name', 'display_name', 'team_name']) ??[39m
[31m+     null[39m
[31m+   const countryCode =[39m
[31m+     row.country_code ??[39m
[31m+     row.country_code_snapshot ??[39m
[31m+     getStringField(club, ['country_code', 'country']) ??[39m
[31m+     null[39m
[31m+   const clubTier = row.club_tier ?? getStringField(club, ['club_tier', 'tier']) ?? null[39m
[31m+   const logoUrl = getRaceParticipantTeamLogoUrl(row, club)[39m
[31m+   const raceId = row.race_id ?? ''[39m
[31m+   const embeddedRiders = getEmbeddedRiderRows(row)[39m
[31m+     .map((riderRow) =>[39m
[31m+       normalizeRaceParticipantRiderRow([39m
[31m+         riderRow as RaceParticipantRiderViewRow,[39m
[31m+         teamId,[39m
[31m+         raceId,[39m
[31m+         clubName,[39m
[31m+         countryCode[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     .filter((rider): rider is RaceParticipantRider => rider !== null)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     id: normalizedRaceTeamEntryId ?? teamId,[39m
[31m+     race_id: raceId,[39m
[31m+     team_id: teamId,[39m
[31m+     club_id: normalizedClubId,[39m
[31m+     owner_club_id: normalizedOwnerClubId,[39m
[31m+     participating_club_id: normalizedParticipatingClubId,[39m
[31m+     parent_club_id:[39m
[31m+       row.parent_club_id ?? getStringField(club, ['parent_club_id']) ?? null,[39m
[31m+     club_type:[39m
[31m+       row.club_type ?? getStringField(club, ['club_type']) ?? null,[39m
[31m+     race_team_entry_id: normalizedRaceTeamEntryId,[39m
[31m+     status: row.status ?? 'accepted',[39m
[31m+     club_name: clubName,[39m
[31m+     country_code: countryCode,[39m
[31m+     club_tier: clubTier,[39m
[31m+     world_tier:[39m
[31m+       row.world_tier === null || row.world_tier === undefined[39m
[31m+         ? getStringField(club, ['world_tier'])[39m
[31m+         : String(row.world_tier),[39m
[31m+     assigned_riders_count: asNumber(row.assigned_riders_count),[39m
[31m+     team_name_snapshot: clubName,[39m
[31m+     logo_url_snapshot: logoUrl,[39m
[31m+     jersey_url_snapshot:[39m
[31m+       getTeamJerseyUrlFromRecord(row as unknown as Record<string, unknown>) ??[39m
[31m+       getTeamJerseyUrlFromRecord(club),[39m
[31m+     country_code_snapshot: countryCode,[39m
[31m+     ranking_snapshot:[39m
[31m+       asNumber(row.ranking_snapshot) ?? asNumber(club.ranking as number | string | null),[39m
[31m+     competition_display:[39m
[31m+       row.competition_display ??[39m
[31m+       getStringField(club, ['competition_display', 'division_name', 'league_name']) ??[39m
[31m+       undefined,[39m
[31m+     competition_rank: asNumber(row.competition_rank) ?? null,[39m
[31m+     competition_points: asNumber(row.competition_points) ?? null,[39m
[31m+     division_key: row.division_key ?? getStringField(club, ['division_key']) ?? undefined,[39m
[31m+     riders: sortParticipantRiders(embeddedRiders),[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeRaceParticipantTeamViewRows(rows: unknown): RaceParticipantTeam[] {[39m
[31m+   if (!Array.isArray(rows)) return [][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return rows[39m
[31m+     .map((row) => normalizeRaceParticipantTeamViewRow(row as RaceParticipantTeamViewRow))[39m
[31m+     .filter((team): team is RaceParticipantTeam => team !== null)[39m
[31m+     .sort((a, b) =>[39m
[31m+       String(getParticipantTeamName(a)).localeCompare(String(getParticipantTeamName(b)))[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getParticipantTeamLookupIds(team: RaceParticipantTeam): string[] {[39m
[31m+   return Array.from([39m
[31m+     new Set([39m
[31m+       [[39m
[31m+         team.participating_club_id,[39m
[31m+         team.club_id,[39m
[31m+         team.owner_club_id,[39m
[31m+         team.parent_club_id,[39m
[31m+         team.team_id,[39m
[31m+         team.id,[39m
[31m+         team.race_team_entry_id,[39m
[31m+       ][39m
[31m+         .map((value) => value?.trim())[39m
[31m+         .filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value))[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function isDevelopingParticipantTeam(team: RaceParticipantTeam): boolean {[39m
[31m+   const clubType = team.club_type?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? ''[39m
[31m+   const participatingClubId = team.participating_club_id?.trim() ?? ''[39m
[31m+   const ownerClubId = team.owner_club_id?.trim() ?? ''[39m
[31m+   const parentClubId = team.parent_club_id?.trim() ?? ''[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     clubType === 'developing' ||[39m
[31m+     Boolean([39m
[31m+       participatingClubId &&[39m
[31m+         ownerClubId &&[39m
[31m+         participatingClubId !== ownerClubId &&[39m
[31m+         (!parentClubId || parentClubId === ownerClubId)[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ /*[39m
[31m+  * Developing/U23 squads are part of the parent organization and intentionally[39m
[31m+  * use the First Team's visual identity. Keep the U23 club id for riders,[39m
[31m+  * results, highlighting and profile navigation, but resolve logo/kit assets[39m
[31m+  * from the parent/owner club first.[39m
[31m+  */[39m
[31m+ function getParticipantTeamAssetLookupIds([39m
[31m+   team: RaceParticipantTeam[39m
[31m+ ): string[] {[39m
[31m+   const ownAssetIds = [[39m
[31m+     team.participating_club_id,[39m
[31m+     team.club_id,[39m
[31m+     team.team_id,[39m
[31m+     team.id,[39m
[31m+     team.race_team_entry_id,[39m
[31m+   ][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const organizationAssetIds = [[39m
[31m+     team.parent_club_id,[39m
[31m+     team.owner_club_id,[39m
[31m+   ][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const orderedIds = isDevelopingParticipantTeam(team)[39m
[31m+     ? [...organizationAssetIds, ...ownAssetIds][39m
[31m+     : [...ownAssetIds, ...organizationAssetIds][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return Array.from([39m
[31m+     new Set([39m
[31m+       orderedIds[39m
[31m+         .map((value) => value?.trim())[39m
[31m+         .filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value))[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getUniqueParticipantTeamIds(teams: RaceParticipantTeam[]): string[] {[39m
[31m+   return Array.from([39m
[31m+     new Set([39m
[31m+       teams.flatMap((team) => [[39m
[31m+         ...getParticipantTeamLookupIds(team),[39m
[31m+         ...getParticipantTeamAssetLookupIds(team),[39m
[31m+       ])[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getLogoRecordLookupIds(record: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {[39m
[31m+   return Array.from([39m
[31m+     new Set([39m
[31m+       ['id', 'club_id', 'team_id'][39m
[31m+         .map((key) => getStringField(record, [key]))[39m
[31m+         .filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value))[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getTeamAssetRowPriority(record: Record<string, unknown>): number {[39m
[31m+   const activeValue = record.is_active ?? record.active[39m
[31m+   const activeScore = activeValue === true ? 200 : activeValue === false ? 0 : 100[39m
[31m+   const name = getStringField(record, ['name', 'kit_name', 'jersey_name'])[39m
[31m+     ?.trim()[39m
[31m+     .toLowerCase()[39m
[31m+   const homeScore = name === 'home' || name === 'default' ? 20 : 0[39m
[31m+   const updatedAtRaw = getStringField(record, [[39m
[31m+     'updated_at',[39m
[31m+     'generated_at',[39m
[31m+     'created_at',[39m
[31m+   ])[39m
[31m+   const updatedAt = updatedAtRaw ? Date.parse(updatedAtRaw) : 0[39m
[31m+   const recencyScore = Number.isFinite(updatedAt)[39m
[31m+     ? Math.max(0, Math.min(19, Math.floor(updatedAt / 100000000000)))[39m
[31m+     : 0[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return activeScore + homeScore + recencyScore[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function mergeParticipantTeamLogoUrls([39m
[31m+   teams: RaceParticipantTeam[],[39m
[31m+   logoRows: unknown[39m
[31m+ ): RaceParticipantTeam[] {[39m
[31m+   if (!Array.isArray(logoRows) || logoRows.length === 0) return teams[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const recordsById = new Map<string, Record<string, unknown>>()[39m
[31m+   const sortedRows = [...logoRows].sort((left, right) => {[39m
[31m+     const leftRecord = getRecord(left)[39m
[31m+     const rightRecord = getRecord(right)[39m
[31m+     const priorityDiff =[39m
[31m+       getTeamAssetRowPriority(leftRecord) - getTeamAssetRowPriority(rightRecord)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (priorityDiff !== 0) return priorityDiff[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const leftUpdatedAt = Date.parse([39m
[31m+       getStringField(leftRecord, ['updated_at', 'generated_at', 'created_at']) ?? ''[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+     const rightUpdatedAt = Date.parse([39m
[31m+       getStringField(rightRecord, ['updated_at', 'generated_at', 'created_at']) ?? ''[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return (Number.isFinite(leftUpdatedAt) ? leftUpdatedAt : 0) -[39m
[31m+       (Number.isFinite(rightUpdatedAt) ? rightUpdatedAt : 0)[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   sortedRows.forEach((logoRow) => {[39m
[31m+     const record = getRecord(logoRow)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     getLogoRecordLookupIds(record).forEach((lookupId) => {[39m
[31m+       recordsById.set(lookupId, record)[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return teams.map((team) => {[39m
[31m+     const assetRecords = getParticipantTeamAssetLookupIds(team)[39m
[31m+       .map((lookupId) => recordsById.get(lookupId))[39m
[31m+       .filter([39m
[31m+         (record): record is Record<string, unknown> =>[39m
[31m+           Boolean(record)[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     /*[39m
[31m+      * Resolve logo and jersey independently. A clubs row can contain a logo[39m
[31m+      * while the actual jersey lives in team_kits.config or an AI preview row.[39m
[31m+      * Stopping at the first existing record caused U23 teams to miss the[39m
[31m+      * parent jersey even though that jersey had been loaded.[39m
[31m+      */[39m
[31m+     const liveLogoUrl =[39m
[31m+       assetRecords[39m
[31m+         .map((record) => getTeamLogoUrlFromRecord(record))[39m
[31m+         .find((value): value is string => Boolean(value)) ?? null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const liveJerseyUrl =[39m
[31m+       assetRecords[39m
[31m+         .map((record) => getTeamJerseyUrlFromRecord(record))[39m
[31m+         .find((value): value is string => Boolean(value)) ?? null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if ([39m
[31m+       (!liveLogoUrl || liveLogoUrl === team.logo_url_snapshot) &&[39m
[31m+       (!liveJerseyUrl || liveJerseyUrl === team.jersey_url_snapshot)[39m
[31m+     ) {[39m
[31m+       return team[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       ...team,[39m
[31m+       logo_url_snapshot: liveLogoUrl || team.logo_url_snapshot,[39m
[31m+       jersey_url_snapshot: liveJerseyUrl || team.jersey_url_snapshot,[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ async function loadParticipantTeamLogos([39m
[31m+   teams: RaceParticipantTeam[],[39m
[31m+   raceId?: string | null[39m
[31m+ ): Promise<RaceParticipantTeam[]> {[39m
[31m+   const teamIds = getUniqueParticipantTeamIds(teams)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (teamIds.length === 0) return teams[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   let teamsWithLogos = teams[39m
[31m+   let clubRows: Record<string, unknown>[] = [][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const { data: clubData, error: clubError } = await supabase[39m
[31m+     .from('clubs')[39m
[31m+     .select('*')[39m
[31m+     .in('id', teamIds)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (clubError) {[39m
[31m+     console.warn('Could not load participant club logos:', clubError.message)[39m
[31m+   } else {[39m
[31m+     clubRows = (clubData ?? []).map((row) => getRecord(row))[39m
[31m+     teamsWithLogos = mergeParticipantTeamLogoUrls(teamsWithLogos, clubRows)[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   /*[39m
[31m+    * Race-entry snapshots remain a useful historical fallback, but current[39m
[31m+    * live kit sources below are allowed to override them.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   if (raceId) {[39m
[31m+     const { data: entryData, error: entryError } = await supabase[39m
[31m+       .from('race_team_entries')[39m
[31m+       .select('*')[39m
[31m+       .eq('race_id', raceId)[39m
[31m+       .in('club_id', teamIds)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (entryError) {[39m
[31m+       console.warn('Could not load race entry team logos:', entryError.message)[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       teamsWithLogos = mergeParticipantTeamLogoUrls(teamsWithLogos, entryData)[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   /*[39m
[31m+    * Do not use maybeSingle/single here. Some AI clubs have several preview[39m
[31m+    * generations. The merger deterministically prefers an active/latest row,[39m
[31m+    * and still uses the newest available preview when no row is flagged active.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   const { data: aiKitData, error: aiKitError } = await supabase[39m
[31m+     .from('ai_team_kit_previews')[39m
[31m+     .select('*')[39m
[31m+     .in('club_id', teamIds)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (aiKitError) {[39m
[31m+     console.warn('Could not load participant AI jersey previews:', aiKitError.message)[39m
[31m+   } else {[39m
[31m+     teamsWithLogos = mergeParticipantTeamLogoUrls(teamsWithLogos, aiKitData)[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   /*[39m
[31m+    * User-created and later customized jerseys are stored in team_kits.config,[39m
[31m+    * not necessarily as a direct clubs.jersey_url column. Load every matching[39m
[31m+    * kit row and let the preferred home/active/latest row win.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * teamIds includes the parent/owner club of every Developing Team. The asset[39m
[31m+    * merger then prefers that parent record for U23 squads, so both squads use[39m
[31m+    * the same organization logo and home kit without changing U23 identity.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   const { data: teamKitData, error: teamKitError } = await supabase[39m
[31m+     .from('team_kits')[39m
[31m+     .select('*')[39m
[31m+     .in('team_id', teamIds)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (teamKitError) {[39m
[31m+     console.warn('Could not load participant custom team kits:', teamKitError.message)[39m
[31m+   } else {[39m
[31m+     const clubRecordById = new Map<string, Record<string, unknown>>()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     clubRows.forEach((clubRecord) => {[39m
[31m+       getLogoRecordLookupIds(clubRecord).forEach((lookupId) => {[39m
[31m+         clubRecordById.set(lookupId, clubRecord)[39m
[31m+       })[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const enrichedTeamKitRows = (teamKitData ?? []).map((teamKitRow) => {[39m
[31m+       const kitRecord = getRecord(teamKitRow)[39m
[31m+       const teamId = getStringField(kitRecord, ['team_id', 'club_id'])[39m
[31m+       const clubRecord = teamId ? clubRecordById.get(teamId) : null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return {[39m
[31m+         ...(clubRecord ?? {}),[39m
[31m+         ...kitRecord,[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     teamsWithLogos = mergeParticipantTeamLogoUrls([39m
[31m+       teamsWithLogos,[39m
[31m+       enrichedTeamKitRows[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return teamsWithLogos[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type ClubNameLookupRow = {[39m
[31m+   id: string[39m
[31m+   country_code?: string | null[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type ClubDisplayNameLookupRow = {[39m
[31m+   club_id: string[39m
[31m+   display_name: string | null[39m
[31m+   original_name?: string | null[39m
[31m+   full_display_name?: string | null[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getParticipantTeamIdentityLookupIds(team: RaceParticipantTeam): string[] {[39m
[31m+   return Array.from([39m
[31m+     new Set([39m
[31m+       [team.participating_club_id, team.club_id, team.owner_club_id, team.team_id, team.id][39m
[31m+         .map((value) => value?.trim())[39m
[31m+         .filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value))[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getFirstMappedValue<T>(ids: string[], map: Map<string, T>): T | null {[39m
[31m+   for (const id of ids) {[39m
[31m+     const value = map.get(id)[39m
[31m+     if (value !== undefined) return value[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return null[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ async function loadParticipantTeamDisplayNames([39m
[31m+   clubIds: string[][39m
[31m+ ): Promise<Map<string, string>> {[39m
[31m+   if (clubIds.length === 0) return new Map()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const { data, error } = await raceDetailReadRpc('get_club_display_names_v1', {[39m
[31m+     p_club_ids: clubIds,[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (error) {[39m
[31m+     console.warn('Could not load participant team display names:', error.message)[39m
[31m+     return new Map()[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const displayNameByClubId = new Map<string, string>()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (const row of (data ?? []) as ClubDisplayNameLookupRow[]) {[39m
[31m+     const clubId = row.club_id?.trim()[39m
[31m+     const displayName = row.display_name?.trim()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (clubId && displayName) {[39m
[31m+       displayNameByClubId.set(clubId, displayName)[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return displayNameByClubId[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function addTeamIdToSet(teamIds: Set<string>, teamId?: string | null) {[39m
[31m+   const normalized = teamId?.trim()[39m
[31m+   if (normalized) teamIds.add(normalized)[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getDisplayNameForTeamId([39m
[31m+   teamId: string | null | undefined,[39m
[31m+   displayNameByClubId: Map<string, string>[39m
[31m+ ): string | null {[39m
[31m+   const normalized = teamId?.trim()[39m
[31m+   if (!normalized) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return displayNameByClubId.get(normalized) ?? null[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ async function hydrateRaceResultsPayloadDisplayNames([39m
[31m+   payload: RaceResultsViewPayload[39m
[31m+ ): Promise<RaceResultsViewPayload> {[39m
[31m+   const teamIds = new Set<string>()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   payload.stage_results.forEach((row) => addTeamIdToSet(teamIds, row.team_id))[39m
[31m+   payload.point_results.forEach((row) => addTeamIdToSet(teamIds, row.team_id))[39m
[31m+   payload.classifications.forEach((row) => addTeamIdToSet(teamIds, row.team_id))[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (teamIds.size === 0) return payload[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const displayNameByClubId = await loadParticipantTeamDisplayNames(Array.from(teamIds))[39m
[31m+   if (displayNameByClubId.size === 0) return payload[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     ...payload,[39m
[31m+     stage_results: payload.stage_results.map((row) => {[39m
[31m+       const displayName = getDisplayNameForTeamId(row.team_id, displayNameByClubId)[39m
[31m+       return displayName ? { ...row, team_name_snapshot: displayName } : row[39m
[31m+     }),[39m
[31m+     point_results: payload.point_results.map((row) => {[39m
[31m+       const displayName = getDisplayNameForTeamId(row.team_id, displayNameByClubId)[39m
[31m+       return displayName ? { ...row, team_name_snapshot: displayName } : row[39m
[31m+     }),[39m
[31m+     classifications: payload.classifications.map((row) => {[39m
[31m+       const displayName = getDisplayNameForTeamId(row.team_id, displayNameByClubId)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (!displayName) return row[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return {[39m
[31m+         ...row,[39m
[31m+         team_name_snapshot: displayName,[39m
[31m+         display_name_snapshot:[39m
[31m+           row.entity_type === 'team' ? displayName : row.display_name_snapshot,[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }),[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ async function hydrateRacePointResultRowsDisplayNames([39m
[31m+   rows: RacePointResultRow[][39m
[31m+ ): Promise<RacePointResultRow[]> {[39m
[31m+   const teamIds = new Set<string>()[39m
[31m+   rows.forEach((row) => addTeamIdToSet(teamIds, row.team_id))[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (teamIds.size === 0) return rows[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const displayNameByClubId = await loadParticipantTeamDisplayNames(Array.from(teamIds))[39m
[31m+   if (displayNameByClubId.size === 0) return rows[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return rows.map((row) => {[39m
[31m+     const displayName = getDisplayNameForTeamId(row.team_id, displayNameByClubId)[39m
[31m+     return displayName ? { ...row, team_name_snapshot: displayName } : row[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ async function hydrateParticipantTeamCurrentNames([39m
[31m+   teams: RaceParticipantTeam[][39m
[31m+ ): Promise<RaceParticipantTeam[]> {[39m
[31m+   const clubIds = Array.from([39m
[31m+     new Set(teams.flatMap((team) => getParticipantTeamIdentityLookupIds(team)))[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (clubIds.length === 0) return teams[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const [{ data: clubData, error: clubError }, displayNameByClubId] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+     supabase[39m
[31m+       .from('clubs')[39m
[31m+       .select('id, country_code')[39m
[31m+       .in('id', clubIds),[39m
[31m+     loadParticipantTeamDisplayNames(clubIds),[39m
[31m+   ])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (clubError) {[39m
[31m+     console.warn('Could not load current club countries for race participants:', clubError.message)[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const clubsById = new Map<string, ClubNameLookupRow>()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (const row of (clubData ?? []) as ClubNameLookupRow[]) {[39m
[31m+     if (row.id) clubsById.set(row.id, row)[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return teams.map((team) => {[39m
[31m+     const lookupIds = getParticipantTeamIdentityLookupIds(team)[39m
[31m+     const club = getFirstMappedValue(lookupIds, clubsById)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const currentName = getFirstMappedValue(lookupIds, displayNameByClubId) || getParticipantTeamName(team)[39m
[31m+     const currentCountryCode = club?.country_code?.trim() || team.country_code || team.country_code_snapshot[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       ...team,[39m
[31m+       club_name: currentName,[39m
[31m+       team_name_snapshot: currentName,[39m
[31m+       country_code: currentCountryCode,[39m
[31m+       country_code_snapshot: currentCountryCode,[39m
[31m+       riders: team.riders.map((rider) => ({[39m
[31m+         ...rider,[39m
[31m+         team_name_snapshot: currentName,[39m
[31m+       })),[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeRaceParticipantRiderRows(rows: unknown): RaceParticipantRider[] {[39m
[31m+   if (!Array.isArray(rows)) return [][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return sortParticipantRiders([39m
[31m+     rows[39m
[31m+       .map((row) => normalizeRaceParticipantRiderRow(row as RaceParticipantRiderViewRow))[39m
[31m+       .filter((rider): rider is RaceParticipantRider => rider !== null)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type RiderNameLookupRow = {[39m
[31m+   id: string[39m
[31m+   first_name?: string | null[39m
[31m+   last_name?: string | null[39m
[31m+   display_name?: string | null[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getFullRiderNameFromLookup(row?: RiderNameLookupRow | null): string | null {[39m
[31m+   if (!row) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const firstName = row.first_name?.trim() ?? ''[39m
[31m+   const lastName = row.last_name?.trim() ?? ''[39m
[31m+   const combinedName = `${firstName} ${lastName}`.trim()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (combinedName) return combinedName[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return row.display_name?.trim() || null[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getRaceParticipantRiderDisplayName(rider: RaceParticipantRider): string {[39m
[31m+   const firstName = rider.first_name?.trim() ?? ''[39m
[31m+   const lastName = rider.last_name?.trim() ?? ''[39m
[31m+   const fullNameFromParts = `${firstName} ${lastName}`.trim()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     fullNameFromParts ||[39m
[31m+     rider.rider_full_name?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+     rider.rider_name_snapshot?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+     rider.display_name?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+     'Unnamed rider'[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ async function hydrateParticipantRiderFullNames([39m
[31m+   riderRows: RaceParticipantRider[][39m
[31m+ ): Promise<RaceParticipantRider[]> {[39m
[31m+   const riderIds = Array.from([39m
[31m+     new Set([39m
[31m+       riderRows[39m
[31m+         .map((rider) => rider.rider_id?.trim())[39m
[31m+         .filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value))[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (riderIds.length === 0) return riderRows[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const { data, error } = await supabase[39m
[31m+     .from('riders')[39m
[31m+     .select('id, first_name, last_name, display_name')[39m
[31m+     .in('id', riderIds)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (error) {[39m
[31m+     console.warn('Could not load full rider names for race participants:', error.message)[39m
[31m+     return riderRows[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const namesByRiderId = new Map<string, string>()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (const row of (data ?? []) as RiderNameLookupRow[]) {[39m
[31m+     const fullName = getFullRiderNameFromLookup(row)[39m
[31m+     if (row.id && fullName) namesByRiderId.set(row.id, fullName)[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const lookupByRiderId = new Map<string, RiderNameLookupRow>()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (const row of (data ?? []) as RiderNameLookupRow[]) {[39m
[31m+     if (row.id) lookupByRiderId.set(row.id, row)[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return riderRows.map((rider) => {[39m
[31m+     const lookup = lookupByRiderId.get(rider.rider_id) ?? null[39m
[31m+     const fullName = lookup ? getFullRiderNameFromLookup(lookup) : null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (!fullName && !lookup) return rider[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       ...rider,[39m
[31m+       first_name: lookup?.first_name ?? rider.first_name ?? null,[39m
[31m+       last_name: lookup?.last_name ?? rider.last_name ?? null,[39m
[31m+       display_name: fullName ?? rider.display_name ?? null,[39m
[31m+       rider_name_snapshot: fullName ?? rider.rider_name_snapshot,[39m
[31m+       rider_full_name: fullName ?? rider.rider_full_name ?? null,[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ async function hydrateStageResultFullNames([39m
[31m+   stageRows: RaceStageResultRow[][39m
[31m+ ): Promise<RaceStageResultRow[]> {[39m
[31m+   const riderIds = Array.from([39m
[31m+     new Set([39m
[31m+       stageRows[39m
[31m+         .map((row) => row.rider_id?.trim())[39m
[31m+         .filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value))[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (riderIds.length === 0) return stageRows[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const { data, error } = await supabase[39m
[31m+     .from('riders')[39m
[31m+     .select('id, first_name, last_name, display_name')[39m
[31m+     .in('id', riderIds)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (error) {[39m
[31m+     console.warn('Could not load full rider names for stage results:', error.message)[39m
[31m+     return stageRows[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const namesByRiderId = new Map<string, string>()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (const row of (data ?? []) as RiderNameLookupRow[]) {[39m
[31m+     const fullName = getFullRiderNameFromLookup(row)[39m
[31m+     if (row.id && fullName) namesByRiderId.set(row.id, fullName)[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return stageRows.map((row) => {[39m
[31m+     const fullName = row.rider_id ? namesByRiderId.get(row.rider_id) ?? null : null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (!fullName) return row[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       ...row,[39m
[31m+       full_name: fullName,[39m
[31m+       rider_full_name: fullName,[39m
[31m+       display_name: fullName,[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function attachRidersToParticipantTeams([39m
[31m+   teams: RaceParticipantTeam[],[39m
[31m+   riderRows: RaceParticipantRider[][39m
[31m+ ): RaceParticipantTeam[] {[39m
[31m+   const ridersByTeamId = new Map<string, RaceParticipantRider[]>()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (const rider of riderRows ?? []) {[39m
[31m+     const lookupIds = Array.from([39m
[31m+       new Set([39m
[31m+         [rider.team_id][39m
[31m+           .map((value) => value?.trim())[39m
[31m+           .filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value))[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     for (const lookupId of lookupIds) {[39m
[31m+       const teamRiders = ridersByTeamId.get(lookupId) ?? [][39m
[31m+       teamRiders.push(rider)[39m
[31m+       ridersByTeamId.set(lookupId, teamRiders)[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const matchedRiderIds = new Set<string>()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const teamsWithRiders = teams.map((team) => {[39m
[31m+     const lookupIds = Array.from([39m
[31m+       new Set([39m
[31m+         [[39m
[31m+           team.participating_club_id,[39m
[31m+           team.club_id,[39m
[31m+           team.owner_club_id,[39m
[31m+           team.team_id,[39m
[31m+           team.id,[39m
[31m+           team.race_team_entry_id,[39m
[31m+         ][39m
[31m+           .map((value) => value?.trim())[39m
[31m+           .filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value))[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const matchedRidersById = new Map<string, RaceParticipantRider>()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     for (const lookupId of lookupIds) {[39m
[31m+       const matchedRiders = ridersByTeamId.get(lookupId) ?? [][39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       for (const rider of matchedRiders) {[39m
[31m+         matchedRidersById.set(rider.id ?? rider.rider_id, rider)[39m
[31m+         matchedRiderIds.add(rider.id ?? rider.rider_id)[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const currentTeamName = getParticipantTeamName(team)[39m
[31m+     const riders = sortParticipantRiders([39m
[31m+       Array.from(matchedRidersById.values()).map((rider) => ({[39m
[31m+         ...rider,[39m
[31m+         team_name_snapshot: currentTeamName,[39m
[31m+       }))[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       ...team,[39m
[31m+       club_name: currentTeamName,[39m
[31m+       team_name_snapshot: currentTeamName,[39m
[31m+       riders,[39m
[31m+       assigned_riders_count: riders.length,[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const missingRiders = (riderRows ?? []).filter([39m
[31m+     (rider) => !matchedRiderIds.has(rider.id ?? rider.rider_id)[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const sortTeamsByRaceOrder = ([39m
[31m+     participantTeams: RaceParticipantTeam[][39m
[31m+   ): RaceParticipantTeam[] =>[39m
[31m+     [...participantTeams].sort(compareParticipantTeamsByRaceOrder)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (missingRiders.length === 0) return sortTeamsByRaceOrder(teamsWithRiders)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const missingRidersByTeamId = new Map<string, RaceParticipantRider[]>()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (const rider of missingRiders) {[39m
[31m+     const teamKey =[39m
[31m+       rider.team_id?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       rider.team_name_snapshot?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       `unknown-team-${rider.race_id || 'race'}`[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const teamRiders = missingRidersByTeamId.get(teamKey) ?? [][39m
[31m+     teamRiders.push(rider)[39m
[31m+     missingRidersByTeamId.set(teamKey, teamRiders)[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const syntheticTeams: RaceParticipantTeam[] = Array.from([39m
[31m+     missingRidersByTeamId.entries()[39m
[31m+   ).map(([teamKey, teamRiders]) => {[39m
[31m+     const firstRider = teamRiders[0][39m
[31m+     const teamName =[39m
[31m+       firstRider?.team_name_snapshot?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+       'Race team'[39m
[31m+     const teamId = firstRider?.team_id?.trim() || teamKey[39m
[31m+     const raceId = firstRider?.race_id ?? teams[0]?.race_id ?? ''[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       id: teamId,[39m
[31m+       race_id: raceId,[39m
[31m+       team_id: teamId,[39m
[31m+       club_id: isUuid(teamId) ? teamId : null,[39m
[31m+       owner_club_id: isUuid(teamId) ? teamId : null,[39m
[31m+       participating_club_id: isUuid(teamId) ? teamId : null,[39m
[31m+       parent_club_id: null,[39m
[31m+       club_type: null,[39m
[31m+       race_team_entry_id: null,[39m
[31m+       status: 'accepted',[39m
[31m+       club_name: teamName,[39m
[31m+       country_code: null,[39m
[31m+       club_tier: null,[39m
[31m+       world_tier: null,[39m
[31m+       assigned_riders_count: teamRiders.length,[39m
[31m+       team_name_snapshot: teamName,[39m
[31m+       logo_url_snapshot: null,[39m
[31m+       jersey_url_snapshot: null,[39m
[31m+       country_code_snapshot: null,[39m
[31m+       ranking_snapshot: null,[39m
[31m+       competition_display: 'Race participant',[39m
[31m+       competition_rank: null,[39m
[31m+       competition_points: null,[39m
[31m+       division_key: null,[39m
[31m+       riders: sortParticipantRiders([39m
[31m+         teamRiders.map((rider) => ({[39m
[31m+           ...rider,[39m
[31m+           team_name_snapshot: teamName,[39m
[31m+         }))[39m
[31m+       ),[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return sortTeamsByRaceOrder([...teamsWithRiders, ...syntheticTeams])[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function formatCompetitionName(value?: string | number | null): string | null {[39m
[31m+   if (value === null || value === undefined) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const raw = String(value).trim()[39m
[31m+   if (!raw) return null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const normalized = raw.toLowerCase().replace(/[-_\s]+/g, '')[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   switch (normalized) {[39m
[31m+     case 'worldteam':[39m
[31m+     case 'worldtour':[39m
[31m+       return 'World Team'[39m
[31m+     case 'proteam':[39m
[31m+       return 'Pro Team'[39m
[31m+     case 'proteama':[39m
[31m+       return 'Pro Team A'[39m
[31m+     case 'proteamb':[39m
[31m+       return 'Pro Team B'[39m
[31m+     case 'proteams':[39m
[31m+       return 'Pro Team S'[39m
[31m+     case 'continental':[39m
[31m+     case 'continentalteam':[39m
[31m+       return 'Continental Team'[39m
[31m+     case 'development':[39m
[31m+     case 'developmentteam':[39m
[31m+       return 'Development Team'[39m
[31m+     case 'amateur':[39m
[31m+     case 'amateurteam':[39m
[31m+       return 'Amateur Team'[39m
[31m+     default:[39m
[31m+       return raw[39m
[31m+         .replace(/_/g, ' ')[39m
[31m+         .replace(/-/g, ' ')[39m
[31m+         .replace(/\b\w/g, (char) => char.toUpperCase())[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getParticipantCompetitionLabel(team: RaceParticipantTeam): string {[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     team.competition_display?.trim() ||[39m
[31m+     formatCompetitionName(team.club_tier) ||[39m
[31m+     formatCompetitionName(team.world_tier) ||[39m
[31m+     'Competition —'[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getRiderOverallDisplay(rider: RaceParticipantRider): string {[39m
[31m+   const overall = asNumber(rider.overall_snapshot)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (rider.can_view_exact_overall && overall !== null) {[39m
[31m+     return `OVR ${Math.round(overall)}`[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return rider.overall_range_label ?? 'OVR —'[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatPendingApplicationNumber(value?: number | null): string {[39m
[31m+   const parsed = asNumber(value)[39m
[31m+   return parsed === null ? '—' : parsed.toLocaleString()[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatPendingApplicationChance(value?: number | null): string {[39m
[31m+   const parsed = asNumber(value)[39m
[31m+   return parsed === null ? '—' : `${Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(100, parsed)))}%`[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getPendingApplicationChanceBarWidth(value?: number | null): string {[39m
[31m+   const parsed = asNumber(value)[39m
[31m+   if (parsed === null) return '0%'[39m
[31m+   return `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, parsed))}%`[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m

[31m+ }) {[39m

[31m+           <div className="mt-1 text-xs font-semibold text-sky-700">[39m
[31m+             {quote.chance_label ?? 'Application estimate'}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <div className="mt-4 h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-white">[39m
[31m+         <div[39m
[31m+           className="h-full rounded-full bg-sky-600"[39m
[31m+           style={{ width: getPendingApplicationChanceBarWidth(quote.estimated_acceptance_chance_pct) }}[39m
[31m+         />[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-4">[39m
[31m+         <div className="rounded-2xl bg-white px-4 py-3 shadow-sm ring-1 ring-sky-100">[39m
[31m+           <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">Applied teams</div>[39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-1 font-bold text-slate-950">[39m
[31m+             {formatPendingApplicationNumber(quote.applied_teams ?? quote.submitted_application_teams)}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <div className="rounded-2xl bg-white px-4 py-3 shadow-sm ring-1 ring-sky-100">[39m
[31m+           <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">Already accepted</div>[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+ function usePublishedRaceStageIds([39m
[31m+   stages: RaceStage[][39m
[31m+ ): string[] {[39m
[31m+   const stageIds = useMemo([39m
[31m+     () => stages.map((stage) => stage.id),[39m
[31m+     [stages][39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const stageIdsKey = stageIds.join('|')[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const [[39m
[31m+     publishedStageIds,[39m
[31m+     setPublishedStageIds,[39m
[31m+   ] = useState<string[]>([])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (stageIds.length === 0) {[39m
[31m+       setPublishedStageIds((current) =>[39m
[31m+         current.length === 0 ? current : [][39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+       return[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     let cancelled = false[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     async function loadPublishedStages() {[39m
[31m+       const results = await Promise.all([39m
[31m+         stageIds.map(async (stageId) => {[39m
[31m+           const { data, error } =[39m
[31m+             await raceDetailReadRpc([39m
[31m+               'get_race_stage_live_state_v1',[39m
[31m+               {[39m
[31m+                 p_stage_id: stageId,[39m
[31m+               }[39m
[31m+             )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           if (error) {[39m
[31m+             console.error([39m
[31m+               `Could not load live state for stage ${stageId}:`,[39m
[31m+               error[39m
[31m+             )[39m
[31m+             return null[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           const value = Array.isArray(data)[39m
[31m+             ? data[0][39m
[31m+             : data[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           const liveState =[39m
[31m+             value &&[39m
[31m+             typeof value === 'object'[39m
[31m+               ? (value as RaceStageLiveState)[39m
[31m+               : null[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           return liveState?.results_visible === true[39m
[31m+             ? stageId[39m
[31m+             : null[39m
[31m+         })[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (cancelled) return[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const nextPublishedStageIds =[39m
[31m+         results.filter([39m
[31m+           (stageId): stageId is string =>[39m
[31m+             Boolean(stageId)[39m
[31m+         )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       /*[39m
[31m+        * Keep the existing array reference when the publication[39m
[31m+        * state has not changed.[39m
[31m+        *[39m
[31m+        * This prevents the results effects from restarting every[39m
[31m+        * five seconds.[39m
[31m+        */[39m
[31m+       setPublishedStageIds([39m
[31m+         (currentPublishedStageIds) => {[39m
[31m+           const unchanged =[39m
[31m+             currentPublishedStageIds.length ===[39m
[31m+               nextPublishedStageIds.length &&[39m
[31m+             currentPublishedStageIds.every([39m
[31m+               (stageId, index) =>[39m
[31m+                 stageId ===[39m
[31m+                 nextPublishedStageIds[index][39m
[31m+             )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           return unchanged[39m
[31m+             ? currentPublishedStageIds[39m
[31m+             : nextPublishedStageIds[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     void loadPublishedStages()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const interval = window.setInterval([39m
[31m+       () => {[39m
[31m+         void loadPublishedStages()[39m
[31m+       },[39m
[31m+       5000[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return () => {[39m
[31m+       cancelled = true[39m
[31m+       window.clearInterval(interval)[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }, [stageIdsKey])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return publishedStageIds[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function RaceResultsHub({[39m
[31m+   race,[39m
[31m+   stages,[39m
[31m+   participantTeams,[39m
[31m+   participantsLoading,[39m
[31m+   participantsError,[39m
[31m+   currentClubId,[39m
[31m+   viewerClubFamilyIds,[39m
[31m+   teamEntryStatus,[39m
[31m+   onOpenTeamProfile,[39m
[31m+   onOpenRiderProfile,[39m
[31m+   restoreRaceInformationOpen = false,[39m
[31m+   restoreRaceInformationTab,[39m
[31m+   stageResultsOverride = null,[39m
[31m+   engineTestModeLabel = null,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   race: Race[39m

[31m+   participantTeams: RaceParticipantTeam[][39m
[31m+   participantsLoading: boolean[39m
[31m+   participantsError: string | null[39m
[31m+   currentClubId?: string | null[39m
[31m+   viewerClubFamilyIds?: string[][39m
[31m+   teamEntryStatus?: string | null[39m
[31m+   onOpenTeamProfile: (teamId: string, context?: { raceInfoExpanded?: boolean; raceInfoTab?: RaceInfoTab }) => void[39m
[31m+   onOpenRiderProfile: (riderId: string, context?: { raceInfoExpanded?: boolean; raceInfoTab?: RaceInfoTab }) => void[39m
[31m+   restoreRaceInformationOpen?: boolean[39m
[31m+   restoreRaceInformationTab?: RaceInfoTab[39m
[31m+   stageResultsOverride?: RaceStageResultsOverride | null[39m
[31m+   engineTestModeLabel?: string | null[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<RaceInfoTab>(restoreRaceInformationTab ?? 'participants')[39m
[31m+   const raceInformationSectionRef = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null)[39m
[31m+   const [classificationView, setClassificationView] =[39m
[31m+     useState<ClassificationView>('general')[39m
[31m+   const [stageId, setStageId] = useState<string>(stages[0]?.id ?? '')[39m
[31m+   const [stageResultView, setStageResultView] =[39m
[31m+     useState<StageResultView>('stage_general')[39m
[31m+   const [isExpanded, setIsExpanded] = useState(Boolean(restoreRaceInformationOpen))[39m
[31m+   const [fullStandingModal, setFullStandingModal] =[39m
[31m+     useState<'race' | 'stage' | null>(null)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const [classificationPayload, setClassificationPayload] =[39m
[31m+     useState<RaceResultsViewPayload | null>(null)[39m
[31m+   const [classificationLoading, setClassificationLoading] = useState(false)[39m
[31m+   const [classificationError, setClassificationError] = useState<string | null>(null)[39m
[31m+   const [[39m
[31m+     availableClassificationStageIds,[39m
[31m+     setAvailableClassificationStageIds,[39m
[31m+   ] = useState<string[]>([])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const [stageResultsPayload, setStageResultsPayload] =[39m
[31m+     useState<RaceResultsViewPayload | null>(null)[39m
[31m+   const [stagePointResults, setStagePointResults] =[39m
[31m+     useState<RacePointResultRow[]>([])[39m
[31m+   const [stageResultsLoading, setStageResultsLoading] = useState(false)[39m
[31m+   const [stageResultsError, setStageResultsError] = useState<string | null>(null)[39m
[31m+   const [inlineApplicationQuote, setInlineApplicationQuote] = useState<RaceApplicationQuote | null>(null)[39m
[31m+   const [inlineApplicationQuoteLoading, setInlineApplicationQuoteLoading] = useState(false)[39m
[31m+   const [inlineApplicationQuoteError, setInlineApplicationQuoteError] = useState<string | null>(null)[39m
[31m+   const [raceFavorites, setRaceFavorites] = useState<RaceFavoriteRow[]>([])[39m
[31m+   const [raceFavoritesLoading, setRaceFavoritesLoading] = useState(false)[39m
[31m+   const [raceFavoritesError, setRaceFavoritesError] = useState<string | null>(null)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const publishedStageIds =[39m
[31m+     usePublishedRaceStageIds(stages)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const publishedStageIdSet = useMemo([39m
[31m+     () => new Set(publishedStageIds),[39m
[31m+     [publishedStageIds][39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const publishedStages = useMemo([39m
[31m+     () =>[39m
[31m+       [...stages][39m
[31m+         .filter([39m
[31m+           (stage) =>[39m
[31m+             publishedStageIdSet.has(stage.id) ||[39m
[31m+             isStageWeatherCanceled(stage) ||[39m
[31m+             stageResultsOverride?.stageId === stage.id[39m
[31m+         )[39m
[31m+         .sort([39m
[31m+           (left, right) =>[39m
[31m+             Number(left.stage_number) -[39m
[31m+             Number(right.stage_number)[39m
[31m+         ),[39m
[31m+     [stages, publishedStageIdSet, stageResultsOverride][39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const normalizedRaceStatus =[39m
[31m+     race.status?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? ''[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const raceHasStarted =[39m
[31m+     publishedStages.length > 0 ||[39m
[31m+     [[39m
[31m+       'active',[39m
[31m+       'completed',[39m
[31m+       'finished',[39m
[31m+       'archived',[39m
[31m+     ].includes(normalizedRaceStatus)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (!restoreRaceInformationOpen) return[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     setIsExpanded(true)[39m
[31m+     setActiveTab(restoreRaceInformationTab ?? 'participants')[39m
[31m+   }, [restoreRaceInformationOpen, restoreRaceInformationTab])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const openProfileContext = useMemo([39m
[31m+     () => ({[39m
[31m+       raceInfoExpanded: true,[39m
[31m+       raceInfoTab: activeTab,[39m
[31m+     }),[39m
[31m+     [activeTab][39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function openTeamProfileFromRaceInfo(teamId: string) {[39m
[31m+     onOpenTeamProfile(teamId, openProfileContext)[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function openRiderProfileFromRaceInfo(riderId: string) {[39m
[31m+     onOpenRiderProfile(riderId, openProfileContext)[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function toggleRaceInformation() {[39m
[31m+     setIsExpanded((currentValue) => {[39m
[31m+       const nextValue = !currentValue[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       /*[39m
[31m+        * Before the race starts:[39m
[31m+        *   Teams & riders opens first.[39m
[31m+        *[39m
[31m+        * Once the race starts:[39m
[31m+        *   Results opens first whenever the card is expanded.[39m
[31m+        */[39m
[31m+       if (nextValue) {[39m
[31m+         setActiveTab([39m
[31m+           raceHasStarted[39m
[31m+             ? 'results'[39m
[31m+             : 'participants'[39m
[31m+         )[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return nextValue[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function handleRaceInformationTabChange(nextTab: RaceInfoTab) {[39m
[31m+     setActiveTab(nextTab)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {[39m
[31m+       raceInformationSectionRef.current?.scrollIntoView({[39m
[31m+         behavior: 'smooth',[39m
[31m+         block: 'start',[39m
[31m+       })[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (publishedStages.length === 0) {[39m
[31m+       setStageId('')[39m
[31m+       return[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const selectedStageIsPublished =[39m
[31m+       publishedStages.some([39m
[31m+         (stage) => stage.id === stageId[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (!selectedStageIsPublished) {[39m
[31m+       /*[39m
[31m+        * Default to the latest published stage.[39m
[31m+        */[39m
[31m+       setStageId([39m
[31m+         publishedStages[[39m
[31m+           publishedStages.length - 1[39m
[31m+         ].id[39m
[31m+       )[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }, [publishedStages, stageId])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const selectedStage =[39m
[31m+     publishedStages.find([39m
[31m+       (stage) => stage.id === stageId[39m
[31m+     ) ??[39m
[31m+     publishedStages[[39m
[31m+       publishedStages.length - 1[39m
[31m+     ] ??[39m
[31m+     null[39m
[31m+   const selectedStageIsTimeTrialLike =[39m
[31m+     isTimeTrialLikeStage(selectedStage)[39m
[31m+   const selectedStageIsTeamTimeTrialLike =[39m
[31m+     isTeamTimeTrialLikeStage(selectedStage)[39m
[31m+   const selectedStageAllowsSprintPointView =[39m
[31m+     !selectedStageIsTeamTimeTrialLike[39m
[31m+   const selectedStageWeatherCanceled = isStageWeatherCanceled(selectedStage)[39m
[31m+   const raceAllStagesWeatherCanceled = isRaceAllWeatherCanceled(race)[39m
[31m+   const raceHasWeatherCancellation =[39m
[31m+     raceAllStagesWeatherCanceled || isRacePartlyWeatherCanceled(race)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const viewerTeamId = getViewerTeamId(currentClubId)[39m
[31m+   const viewerTeamIds = getViewerTeamIds(viewerTeamId, viewerClubFamilyIds)[39m
[31m+   const effectiveEntryStatus = teamEntryStatus ?? race.existing_application_status ?? null[39m
[31m+   const showPendingApplicationInfo =[39m
[31m+     activeTab === 'participants' &&[39m
[31m+     isPendingRaceApplicationStatus(effectiveEntryStatus) &&[39m
[31m+     !participantsLoading &&[39m
[31m+     !participantsError &&[39m
[31m+     participantTeams.length === 0 &&[39m
[31m+     !isRaceStartlistLocked(race.status)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (!race.id || !isUuid(race.id)) {[39m
[31m+       setRaceFavorites([])[39m
[31m+       setRaceFavoritesError(null)[39m
[31m+       setRaceFavoritesLoading(false)[39m
[31m+       return[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     let cancelled = false[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     async function loadRaceFavorites() {[39m
[31m+       setRaceFavoritesLoading(true)[39m
[31m+       setRaceFavoritesError(null)[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const { data, error } = await raceDetailReadRpc('get_race_favorites_v1', {[39m
[31m+         p_race_id: race.id,[39m
[31m+         p_limit: 5,[39m
[31m+       })[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (cancelled) return[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (error) {[39m
[31m+         console.warn('Could not load race favorites:', error.message)[39m
[31m+         setRaceFavorites([])[39m
[31m+         setRaceFavoritesError(error.message)[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         setRaceFavorites(((data ?? []) as RaceFavoriteRow[]).slice(0, 5))[39m
[31m+         setRaceFavoritesError(null)[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       setRaceFavoritesLoading(false)[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     void loadRaceFavorites()[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return () => {[39m
[31m+       cancelled = true[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }, [race.id])[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if ([39m
[31m+       !isExpanded ||[39m
[31m+       !race.id ||[39m
[31m+       activeTab !== 'results'[39m
[31m+     ) {[39m
[31m+       setAvailableClassificationStageIds([])[39m
[31m+       return[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     let cancelled = false[39m
