[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getPreparationStageWeatherRiskReason(stage: unknown): string | null {[39m
[31m+   const record = asRecord(stage);[39m
[31m+   const weather = firstNonEmptyRecord([39m
[31m+     record.weather_snapshot,[39m
[31m+     record.weather_json,[39m
[31m+     record.weather_snapshot_json,[39m
[31m+     asRecord(record.metadata).weather_snapshot,[39m
[31m+     asRecord(record.metadata).weather,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (Object.keys(weather).length === 0) return null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const conditionText = String([39m
[31m+     weather.condition ??[39m
[31m+       weather.condition_label ??[39m
[31m+       weather.label ??[39m
[31m+       weather.name ??[39m
[31m+       weather.summary ??[39m
[31m+       "",[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+     .trim()[39m
[31m+     .toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const avgTemp = normalizeNumericValue([39m
[31m+     weather.avg_temp_c ??[39m
[31m+       weather.average_temp_c ??[39m
[31m+       weather.temperature_c ??[39m
[31m+       weather.temp_c,[39m
[31m+     Number.NaN,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (conditionText === "snow" || conditionText.includes("snow")) {[39m
[31m+     return "snow";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (Number.isFinite(avgTemp) && avgTemp < 5) {[39m
[31m+     return "temperature_below_5c";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return null;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function WeatherCancellationPreparationNotice({[39m
[31m+   race,[39m
[31m+   stage,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   race?: unknown;[39m
[31m+   stage?: unknown;[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const raceStatus = getWeatherCancellationStatusFromRace(race);[39m
[31m+   const stageCanceled = isPreparationStageWeatherCanceled(stage);[39m
[31m+   const shouldRender =[39m
[31m+     stageCanceled ||[39m
[31m+     raceStatus === "all_stages_weather_cancelled" ||[39m
[31m+     raceStatus === "partly_weather_cancelled";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!shouldRender) return null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const title = stageCanceled[39m
[31m+     ? "Stage canceled due to weather"[39m
[31m+     : raceStatus === "all_stages_weather_cancelled"[39m
[31m+       ? "Race canceled due to weather"[39m
[31m+       : "Race partly canceled by weather";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const reason = getPreparationWeatherCancellationReasonLabel([39m
[31m+     getPreparationStageWeatherCancellationReason(stage),[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const body = stageCanceled[39m
[31m+     ? `This stage was canceled by the race engine (${reason}). Stage Plans are locked because no result, points, prize money, fatigue or replay will be generated for this stage.`[39m
[31m+     : raceStatus === "all_stages_weather_cancelled"[39m
[31m+       ? "This race was canceled due to weather. Race preparation is no longer needed for this race."[39m
[31m+       : "At least one stage in this race was canceled due to weather. Remaining uncanceled stages can continue normally.";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="rounded-2xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-900">[39m
[31m+       <div className="font-semibold">{title}</div>[39m
[31m+       <div className="mt-1 leading-6">{body}</div>[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function WeatherCancellationRiskPreparationNotice({[39m
[31m+   stage,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   stage: unknown;[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   if (isPreparationStageWeatherCanceled(stage)) return null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const riskReason = getPreparationStageWeatherRiskReason(stage);[39m
[31m+   if (!riskReason) return null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-orange-200 bg-orange-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-5 text-orange-800">[39m
[31m+       <div className="font-semibold">[39m
[31m+         Weather cancellation likely:{" "}[39m
[31m+         {getPreparationWeatherCancellationReasonLabel(riskReason)}[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+       <div>[39m
[31m+         Current forecast is below the safety threshold. Final decision 24[39m
[31m+         in-game hours before start.[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getRaceLifecycleLabel(status?: string | null) {[39m
[31m+   switch (status) {[39m
[31m+     case "completed":[39m
[31m+       return "Race finished";[39m
[31m+     case "active":[39m
[31m+       return "Race active";[39m
[31m+     case "scheduled":[39m
[31m+       return "Scheduled";[39m
[31m+     case "cancelled":[39m
[31m+       return "Canceled";[39m
[31m+     default:[39m
[31m+       return status ? titleFromSnake(status) : "Scheduled";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function statusClass(status?: string) {[39m
[31m+   switch (status) {[39m
[31m+     case "weather_cancelled":[39m
[31m+     case "cancelled":[39m
[31m+       return "bg-red-100 text-red-800 ring-1 ring-red-200";[39m
[31m+     case "completed":[39m
[31m+     case "archived":[39m
[31m+       return "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 ring-1 ring-slate-200";[39m
[31m+     case "race_plan_open":[39m
[31m+     case "draft":[39m
[31m+       return "bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 ring-1 ring-yellow-200";[39m
[31m+     case "submitted":[39m
[31m+     case "accepted":[39m
[31m+       return "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800";[39m
[31m+     case "locked":[39m
[31m+       return "bg-slate-200 text-slate-800";[39m
[31m+     case "not_created":[39m
[31m+       return "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700";[39m
[31m+     case "deadline_reached":[39m
[31m+     case "missed_startlist":[39m
[31m+     case "declined":[39m
[31m+       return "bg-red-100 text-red-800";[39m
[31m+     default:[39m
[31m+       return "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getRacePlanStatusLabel(status?: string) {[39m
[31m+   switch (status) {[39m
[31m+     case "weather_cancelled":[39m
[31m+     case "cancelled":[39m
[31m+       return "Race canceled";[39m
[31m+     case "completed":[39m
[31m+     case "archived":[39m
[31m+       return "Race Finished";[39m
[31m+     case "missed_startlist":[39m
[31m+       return "Not Participating";[39m
[31m+     case "draft":[39m
[31m+     case "race_plan_open":[39m
[31m+       return "Race Plan Open";[39m
[31m+     case "submitted":[39m
[31m+       return "Race Plan Submitted";[39m
[31m+     case "locked":[39m
[31m+     case "sent_to_engine":[39m
[31m+       return "Race Active";[39m
[31m+     case "deadline_reached":[39m
[31m+       return "Rider Deadline Reached";[39m
[31m+     case "not_created":[39m
[31m+       return "Race Plan Not Open";[39m
[31m+     default:[39m
[31m+       return status ? titleFromSnake(status) : "Race Plan Not Open";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getRacePlanUiStatus({[39m
[31m+   raceStatus,[39m
[31m+   prepStatus,[39m
[31m+   isPackageTooEarly,[39m
[31m+   isPackageDeadlinePassed,[39m
[31m+   packageSubmitted,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   raceStatus: string;[39m
[31m+   prepStatus: string;[39m
[31m+   isPackageTooEarly: boolean;[39m
[31m+   isPackageDeadlinePassed: boolean;[39m
[31m+   packageSubmitted: boolean;[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   if (raceStatus === "missed_startlist" || prepStatus === "missed_startlist") {[39m
[31m+     return "missed_startlist";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (packageSubmitted) {[39m
[31m+     return "submitted";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (isPackageDeadlinePassed) {[39m
[31m+     return "deadline_reached";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (isPackageTooEarly) {[39m
[31m+     return "not_created";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if ([39m
[31m+     raceStatus === "draft" ||[39m
[31m+     prepStatus === "draft" ||[39m
[31m+     raceStatus === "not_created"[39m
[31m+   ) {[39m
[31m+     return "race_plan_open";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return raceStatus || prepStatus || "race_plan_open";[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function titleFromSnake(value: string) {[39m
[31m+   return value[39m
[31m+     .split("_")[39m
[31m+     .filter(Boolean)[39m
[31m+     .map((part) => part.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + part.slice(1))[39m
[31m+     .join(" ");[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeAvailabilityStatus(value: unknown): string {[39m
[31m+   return String(value ?? "")[39m
[31m+     .trim()[39m
[31m+     .toLowerCase()[39m
[31m+     .replace(/[\s-]+/g, "_");[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getRiderAvailabilityStatus(rider: JsonRecord): string {[39m
[31m+   return normalizeAvailabilityStatus([39m
[31m+     rider.availability_status ??[39m
[31m+       rider.medical_status ??[39m
[31m+       rider.health_status ??[39m
[31m+       rider.fitness_status ??[39m
[31m+       "fit",[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function isRiderMedicallyUnavailable(rider: JsonRecord): boolean {[39m
[31m+   const availabilityStatus = getRiderAvailabilityStatus(rider);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if ([39m
[31m+     rider.is_injured === true ||[39m
[31m+     rider.injured === true ||[39m
[31m+     rider.has_injury === true[39m
[31m+   ) {[39m
[31m+     return true;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if ([39m
[31m+     availabilityStatus === "" ||[39m
[31m+     availabilityStatus === "fit" ||[39m
[31m+     availabilityStatus === "available" ||[39m
[31m+     availabilityStatus === "not_fully_fit" ||[39m
[31m+     availabilityStatus === "partly_fit" ||[39m
[31m+     availabilityStatus === "tired" ||[39m
[31m+     availabilityStatus === "fatigued"[39m
[31m+   ) {[39m
[31m+     return false;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return [[39m
[31m+     "injured",[39m
[31m+     "injury",[39m
[31m+     "sick",[39m
[31m+     "ill",[39m
[31m+     "illness",[39m
[31m+     "cold",[39m
[31m+     "flu",[39m
[31m+     "unavailable",[39m
[31m+     "not_available",[39m
[31m+     "medical_unavailable",[39m
[31m+     "medical_blocked",[39m
[31m+     "recovering_from_injury",[39m
[31m+     "rehab",[39m
[31m+   ].includes(availabilityStatus);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatAvailabilityStatusLabel(value: string): string {[39m
[31m+   if (!value || value === "fit") return "Fit";[39m
[31m+   if (value === "not_fully_fit") return "Not fully fit";[39m
[31m+   return titleFromSnake(value);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatRiderMedicalUnavailableReason(rider: JsonRecord): string | null {[39m
[31m+   if (!isRiderMedicallyUnavailable(rider)) return null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const status = getRiderAvailabilityStatus(rider);[39m
[31m+   const label = formatAvailabilityStatusLabel(status);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return `${label}: cannot be selected for this race.`;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function isRacePackageSubmitted(status?: string | null) {[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     status === "submitted" || status === "locked" || status === "sent_to_engine"[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getAcceptedRacePreparationState([39m
[31m+   row: AcceptedRacePreparationRow,[39m
[31m+   currentGameDate?: string,[39m
[31m+ ) {[39m
[31m+   const rowRecord = asRecord(row);[39m
[31m+   const raceRecord = asRecord(rowRecord.race);[39m
[31m+   const preparationRecord = asRecord(rowRecord.preparation);[39m
[31m+   const entryRulesRecord = asRecord(rowRecord.entry_rules);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const raceStatus = String(raceRecord.status ?? "").toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const packageStatus = String([39m
[31m+     rowRecord.race_package_status ??[39m
[31m+       rowRecord.preparation_status ??[39m
[31m+       preparationRecord.status ??[39m
[31m+       "",[39m
[31m+   ).toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const startlistStatus = String([39m
[31m+     rowRecord.startlist_status ?? preparationRecord.startlist_status ?? "",[39m
[31m+   ).toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const entryStatus = String([39m
[31m+     rowRecord.status ??[39m
[31m+       rowRecord.entry_status ??[39m
[31m+       asRecord(rowRecord.entry).status ??[39m
[31m+       "",[39m
[31m+   ).toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const preparationMetadata = asRecord(preparationRecord.metadata);[39m
[31m+   const missedStartlist =[39m
[31m+     entryStatus === "missed_startlist" ||[39m
[31m+     packageStatus === "missed_startlist" ||[39m
[31m+     startlistStatus === "missed_startlist" ||[39m
[31m+     preparationMetadata.missed_startlist === true ||[39m
[31m+     String(preparationMetadata.display_status ?? "").toLowerCase() ===[39m
[31m+       "missed_startlist";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   /*[39m
[31m+    * Important:[39m
[31m+    * The accepted-races card must prefer the repaired race_preparations[39m
[31m+    * deadline over the default race-start-minus-N fallback. Repaired rows can[39m
[31m+    * have a temporary rider_submission_deadline_on that is later than the[39m
[31m+    * original race_entry_rules deadline.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   const setupWindowOpensOn =[39m
[31m+     rowRecord.setup_window_opens_on ??[39m
[31m+     preparationRecord.setup_window_opens_on ??[39m
[31m+     entryRulesRecord.setup_window_opens_on;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const riderSubmissionDeadlineOn =[39m
[31m+     rowRecord.rider_submission_deadline_on ??[39m
[31m+     preparationRecord.rider_submission_deadline_on ??[39m
[31m+     entryRulesRecord.rider_submission_deadline_on ??[39m
[31m+     entryRulesRecord.rider_submission_deadline;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const racePreparationId =[39m
[31m+     rowRecord.race_preparation_id ?? preparationRecord.id ?? null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const currentTime = parseGameDateTime(currentGameDate);[39m
[31m+   const opensTime = parseGameDateTime(setupWindowOpensOn);[39m
[31m+   const deadlineTime = parseGameDateTime(riderSubmissionDeadlineOn);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const isDeadlinePassed =[39m
[31m+     currentTime !== null && deadlineTime !== null && currentTime > deadlineTime;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const isRacePlanOpenByDate =[39m
[31m+     currentTime !== null &&[39m
[31m+     opensTime !== null &&[39m
[31m+     deadlineTime !== null &&[39m
[31m+     currentTime >= opensTime &&[39m
[31m+     currentTime <= deadlineTime;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const isDraftRacePreparation =[39m
[31m+     Boolean(racePreparationId) &&[39m
[31m+     (packageStatus === "draft" ||[39m
[31m+       startlistStatus === "draft" ||[39m
[31m+       packageStatus === "race_plan_open");[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (isRaceAllWeatherCanceledInPreparation(raceRecord)) {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       label: "Race canceled",[39m
[31m+       className: "bg-red-100 text-red-800 ring-1 ring-red-200",[39m
[31m+       racePlanEnabled: false,[39m
[31m+       stagePlansEnabled: false,[39m
[31m+       missedStartlist: false,[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if ([39m
[31m+     raceStatus === "cancelled" ||[39m
[31m+     raceStatus === "canceled" ||[39m
[31m+     raceStatus === "weather_cancelled"[39m
[31m+   ) {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       label: "Race canceled",[39m
[31m+       className: "bg-red-100 text-red-800 ring-1 ring-red-200",[39m
[31m+       racePlanEnabled: false,[39m
[31m+       stagePlansEnabled: false,[39m
[31m+       missedStartlist: false,[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (missedStartlist) {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       label: "Not Participating",[39m
[31m+       className: "bg-red-100 text-red-800 ring-1 ring-red-200",[39m
[31m+       racePlanEnabled: false,[39m
[31m+       stagePlansEnabled: false,[39m
[31m+       missedStartlist: true,[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (raceStatus === "completed" || raceStatus === "archived") {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       label: "Race Finished",[39m
[31m+       className: "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700",[39m
[31m+       racePlanEnabled: false,[39m
[31m+       stagePlansEnabled: false,[39m
[31m+       missedStartlist: false,[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (raceStatus === "active") {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       label: "Race Active",[39m
[31m+       className: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700",[39m
[31m+       racePlanEnabled: false,[39m
[31m+       stagePlansEnabled: isRacePackageSubmitted(packageStatus),[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (packageStatus === "submitted") {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       label: "Stage Plans Open",[39m
[31m+       className: "bg-blue-100 text-blue-700",[39m
[31m+       racePlanEnabled: false,[39m
[31m+       stagePlansEnabled: true,[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (packageStatus === "locked" || packageStatus === "sent_to_engine") {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       label: "All Set",[39m
[31m+       className: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700",[39m
[31m+       racePlanEnabled: false,[39m
[31m+       stagePlansEnabled: true,[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (isDraftRacePreparation || packageStatus === "draft") {[39m
[31m+     if (isDeadlinePassed) {[39m
[31m+       return {[39m
[31m+         label: "Rider Deadline Reached",[39m
[31m+         className: "bg-red-100 text-red-800",[39m
[31m+         racePlanEnabled: false,[39m
[31m+         stagePlansEnabled: false,[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       label: "Race Plan Open",[39m
[31m+       className: statusClass("race_plan_open"),[39m
[31m+       racePlanEnabled: true,[39m
[31m+       stagePlansEnabled: false,[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (isRacePlanOpenByDate) {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       label: "Race Plan Open",[39m
[31m+       className: statusClass("race_plan_open"),[39m
[31m+       racePlanEnabled: true,[39m
[31m+       stagePlansEnabled: false,[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (currentTime !== null && opensTime !== null && currentTime < opensTime) {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       label: "Race Plan Not Open",[39m
[31m+       className: "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700",[39m
[31m+       racePlanEnabled: false,[39m
[31m+       stagePlansEnabled: false,[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (isDeadlinePassed) {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       label: "Rider Deadline Reached",[39m
[31m+       className: "bg-red-100 text-red-800",[39m
[31m+       racePlanEnabled: false,[39m
[31m+       stagePlansEnabled: false,[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     label: "Scheduled",[39m
[31m+     className: "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700",[39m
[31m+     racePlanEnabled: false,[39m
[31m+     stagePlansEnabled: false,[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+     setSelectedStaffIds((current) => {[39m
[31m+       const next = current.filter((id) => !blockedStaffIds.has(id));[39m
[31m+       return next.length === current.length ? current : next;[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     setSelectedAssets((current) => {[39m
[31m+       let changed = false;[39m
[31m+       const next = { ...current };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       raceAssetKeys.forEach((assetKey) => {[39m
[31m+         const assetId = current[assetKey];[39m
[31m+         if (assetId && blockedAssetIds.has(assetId)) {[39m
[31m+           next[assetKey] = "";[39m
[31m+           changed = true;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return changed ? next : current;[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }, [[39m
[31m+     blockedAssetIds,[39m
[31m+     blockedRiderIds,[39m
[31m+     blockedStaffIds,[39m
[31m+     canEdit,[39m
[31m+     medicallyUnavailableRiderIds,[39m
[31m+   ]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const selectedRaceLifecycleStatus = getText(race, "status")[39m
[31m+     .trim()[39m
[31m+     .toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const selectedRaceCancelled =[39m
[31m+     selectedRaceLifecycleStatus === "cancelled" ||[39m
[31m+     selectedRaceLifecycleStatus === "canceled" ||[39m
[31m+     selectedRaceLifecycleStatus === "weather_cancelled";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const selectedRaceFinished =[39m
[31m+     selectedRaceLifecycleStatus === "completed" ||[39m
[31m+     selectedRaceLifecycleStatus === "archived";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const selectedRaceClosed = selectedRaceCancelled || selectedRaceFinished;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const stagePlansOpen =[39m
[31m+     packageSubmitted &&[39m
[31m+     !selectedRaceAllWeatherCanceled &&[39m
[31m+     !selectedRaceClosed;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const racePlanUiStatus =[39m
[31m+     selectedRaceAllWeatherCanceled || selectedRaceCancelled[39m
[31m+       ? "cancelled"[39m
[31m+       : selectedRaceFinished[39m
[31m+         ? "completed"[39m
[31m+         : getRacePlanUiStatus({[39m
[31m+             raceStatus,[39m
[31m+             prepStatus,[39m
[31m+             isPackageTooEarly,[39m
[31m+             isPackageDeadlinePassed,[39m
[31m+             packageSubmitted,[39m
[31m+           });[39m

[31m+   const minRiders = getNumber(entryRules, "min_riders_per_team");[39m
[31m+   const maxRiders = getNumber(entryRules, "max_riders_per_team");[39m
[31m+[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+   const riderSelectionTooFew = minRiders > 0 && selectedRiderCount < minRiders;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const riderSelectionTooMany = maxRiders > 0 && selectedRiderCount > maxRiders;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const riderSelectionValid = !riderSelectionTooFew && !riderSelectionTooMany;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const tacticalPlannerSelectionValid = isDevelopingTeamSelected[39m
[31m+     ? effectiveTacticalPlannerChoice === "u23_head_coach"[39m
[31m+       ? Boolean(selectedU23HeadCoachId)[39m
[31m+       : Boolean(selectedStaffByRole.sport_director)[39m
[31m+     : Boolean(selectedStaffByRole.sport_director);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   /*[39m
[31m+    * Missing race staff is an incomplete-plan warning, not a reason to disable[39m
[31m+    * Save or Submit. The submit confirmation already allows the manager to[39m
[31m+    * continue with missing staff and assets.[39m
[31m+    *[39m
[31m+    * Keep only one blocking planner case: a Developing Team explicitly set to[39m

[31m+    * choice cannot be persisted safely.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   const u23PlannerChoiceIncomplete =[39m
[31m+     isDevelopingTeamSelected &&[39m
[31m+     effectiveTacticalPlannerChoice === "u23_head_coach" &&[39m
[31m+     !selectedU23HeadCoachId;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const canSaveRacePlan =[39m
[31m+     canEdit && !riderSelectionTooMany && !u23PlannerChoiceIncomplete;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const canSubmitRacePlan =[39m
[31m+     canEdit && riderSelectionValid && !u23PlannerChoiceIncomplete;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const selectedSupportStaffCount = Object.keys(supportStaffRoleLabels).filter([39m
[31m+     (roleType) => Boolean(selectedStaffByRole[roleType]),[39m
[31m+   ).length;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const selectedPlannerCount = tacticalPlannerSelectionValid ? 1 : 0;[39m
[31m+   const selectedStaffCount = selectedSupportStaffCount + selectedPlannerCount;[39m
[31m+   const maxStaffSlots = Object.keys(staffRoleLabels).length;[39m
[31m+   const selectedAssetCount =[39m
[31m+     Object.values(cleanSelectedAssets).filter(Boolean).length;[39m
[31m+   const maxAssetSlots = raceAssetKeys.length;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const submitPlanWarnings = [[39m
[31m+     !tacticalPlannerSelectionValid[39m
[31m+       ? isDevelopingTeamSelected[39m
[31m+         ? "Choose either a Sport Director or a U23 Head Coach."[39m
[31m+         : "Select a Sport Director."[39m
[31m+       : null,[39m
[31m+     maxRiders > 0 && selectedRiderCount < maxRiders[39m
[31m+       ? `Maximum riders allowed: ${maxRiders}. You selected: ${selectedRiderCount}.`[39m
[31m+       : null,[39m
[31m+     maxStaffSlots > 0 && selectedStaffCount < maxStaffSlots[39m
[31m+       ? `Maximum race staff slots: ${maxStaffSlots}. You selected: ${selectedStaffCount}.`[39m
[31m+       : null,[39m
[31m+     maxAssetSlots > 0 && selectedAssetCount < maxAssetSlots[39m
[31m+       ? `Maximum race asset slots: ${maxAssetSlots}. You selected: ${selectedAssetCount}.`[39m
[31m+       : null,[39m
[31m+   ].filter(Boolean) as string[];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const hasSubmitPlanWarnings = submitPlanWarnings.length > 0;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (!payload || !canEdit) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {[39m
[31m+       setQuoteRefreshing(true);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       quoteRacePreparation(payload)[39m
[31m+         .then((result) => {[39m
[31m+           console.log("Race Plan live quote payload", payload);[39m
[31m+           console.log("Race Plan live quote result", result);[39m
[31m+           console.log([39m
[31m+             "Race Plan standardized bonus",[39m
[31m+             asRecord(result).standardized_bonus,[39m
[31m+           );[39m
[31m+           setQuote(result);[39m
[31m+         })[39m
[31m+         .catch((error) => {[39m
[31m+           console.error("Failed to refresh Race Plan quote", error);[39m
[31m+         })[39m
[31m+         .finally(() => {[39m
[31m+           setQuoteRefreshing(false);[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+     }, 500);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);[39m
[31m+   }, [payload, canEdit]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (!loading && activeTab === "stagePlans" && !stagePlansOpen) {[39m
[31m+       setActiveTab("racePackage");[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }, [activeTab, loading, stagePlansOpen]);[39m

[31m+   async function applyContext([39m
[31m+     context: RacePreparationTarget,[39m
[31m+     currentClubId: UUID | null = clubId,[39m
[31m+   ) {[39m
[31m+     setTarget(context);[39m
[31m+     setQuote(null);[39m
[31m+     setPendingParticipatingClubId(null);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const contextRaceId = getText(context.race, "id");[39m
[31m+     setSelectedRaceId(contextRaceId || null);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const prepId = context.preparation?.id[39m
[31m+       ? String(context.preparation.id)[39m
[31m+       : null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const savedParticipatingClubId =[39m
[31m+       getText(context.preparation, "participating_club_id") ||[39m
[31m+       getText(context.entry, "participating_club_id");[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const nextParticipatingClubId =[39m
[31m+       currentClubId && isUuid(savedParticipatingClubId)[39m
[31m+         ? savedParticipatingClubId[39m
[31m+         : currentClubId;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     setParticipatingClubId(nextParticipatingClubId);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     let nextSquadIsDeveloping = false;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (currentClubId) {[39m
[31m+       const [squadOptionResult, selectableResult] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         loadRacePreparationSquadOptions(currentClubId),[39m
[31m+         loadRacePreparationSelectableData([39m
[31m+           currentClubId,[39m
[31m+           contextRaceId || null,[39m
[31m+           prepId,[39m
[31m+           nextParticipatingClubId,[39m
[31m+         ),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       setSquadOptions(squadOptionResult);[39m
[31m+       setSelectableData(selectableResult);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const contextSquad = squadOptionResult.find([39m
[31m+         (option) => option.id === nextParticipatingClubId,[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       nextSquadIsDeveloping =[39m
[31m+         contextSquad?.club_type === "developing" &&[39m
[31m+         contextSquad.parent_club_id === currentClubId;[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       setSquadOptions([]);[39m
[31m+       setSelectableData(null);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (prepId) {[39m
[31m+       const draft = await loadExistingRacePreparationDraft(prepId);[39m
[31m+       setSelectedRiderIds(draft.riderIds);[39m
[31m+       setSelectedStaffIds(draft.staffIds);[39m
[31m+       setSelectedAssets({[39m
[31m+         ...createEmptySelectedAssets(),[39m
[31m+         ...draft.assetAssignments,[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if ([39m
[31m+         nextSquadIsDeveloping &&[39m
[31m+         draft.tacticalPlannerChoice === "u23_head_coach" &&[39m
[31m+         draft.u23HeadCoachId[39m
[31m+       ) {[39m
[31m+         setTacticalPlannerChoice("u23_head_coach");[39m
[31m+         setSelectedU23HeadCoachId(draft.u23HeadCoachId);[39m
[31m+         setU23AutomationEnabled(draft.u23AutomationEnabled);[39m
[31m+       } else {[39m
[31m+         setTacticalPlannerChoice("sport_director");[39m
[31m+         setSelectedU23HeadCoachId(null);[39m
[31m+         setU23AutomationEnabled(false);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     } else {[39m
[31m+       setSelectedRiderIds([]);[39m
[31m+       setSelectedStaffIds([]);[39m
[31m+       setTacticalPlannerChoice("sport_director");[39m
[31m+       setSelectedU23HeadCoachId(null);[39m
[31m+       setU23AutomationEnabled(false);[39m
[31m+       setSelectedAssets(createEmptySelectedAssets());[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m

[31m+   async function applyNoVisibleAcceptedRaceState([39m

[31m+     setTacticalPlannerChoice("sport_director");[39m
[31m+     setSelectedU23HeadCoachId(null);[39m

[31m+   async function loadPage(preferredRaceId?: UUID | null) {[39m
[31m+     setLoading(true);[39m
[31m+     setErrorMessage(null);[39m
[31m+     setMessage(null);[39m
[31m+     setQuote(null);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const resolvedClubId = await resolveCurrentClubId();[39m
[31m+       setClubId(resolvedClubId);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const rawAcceptedResult =[39m
[31m+         await loadAcceptedRacePreparations(resolvedClubId);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       /*[39m
[31m+        * The first pass does not need the game date to remove cancelled races.[39m
[31m+        * This prevents a stale cancelled race from becoming the default target.[39m
[31m+        */[39m
[31m+       const provisionallyVisibleResult =[39m
[31m+         filterAcceptedRacePreparations(rawAcceptedResult);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const preferredRaceIsVisible = Boolean([39m
[31m+         preferredRaceId &&[39m
[31m+           provisionallyVisibleResult.some([39m
[31m+             (row) => row.race_id === preferredRaceId,[39m
[31m+           ),[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const selectedRaceIsVisible = Boolean([39m
[31m+         selectedRaceId &&[39m
[31m+           provisionallyVisibleResult.some([39m
[31m+             (row) => row.race_id === selectedRaceId,[39m
[31m+           ),[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       let raceToLoad = preferredRaceIsVisible[39m
[31m+         ? preferredRaceId![39m
[31m+         : selectedRaceIsVisible[39m
[31m+           ? selectedRaceId![39m
[31m+           : provisionallyVisibleResult[0]?.race_id ?? null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (!raceToLoad) {[39m
[31m+         await applyNoVisibleAcceptedRaceState(resolvedClubId);[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       let context = await loadRacePreparationContext([39m
[31m+         resolvedClubId,[39m
[31m+         raceToLoad,[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       /*[39m
[31m+        * The selected context contains the authoritative current game date.[39m
[31m+        * Use it for the three-day retention rule for completed races.[39m
[31m+        */[39m
[31m+       const visibleAcceptedResult = filterAcceptedRacePreparations([39m
[31m+         rawAcceptedResult,[39m
[31m+         context.current_game_date,[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if ([39m
[31m+         !visibleAcceptedResult.some((row) => row.race_id === raceToLoad)[39m
[31m+       ) {[39m
[31m+         raceToLoad = visibleAcceptedResult[0]?.race_id ?? null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         if (!raceToLoad) {[39m
[31m+           await applyNoVisibleAcceptedRaceState(resolvedClubId);[39m
[31m+           return;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         context = await loadRacePreparationContext([39m
[31m+           resolvedClubId,[39m
[31m+           raceToLoad,[39m
[31m+         );[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       setAcceptedRaces(visibleAcceptedResult);[39m
[31m+       await applyContext(context, resolvedClubId);[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+       setErrorMessage([39m
[31m+         error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to load page.",[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setLoading(false);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m

[31m+   async function selectRace(raceIdToSelect: UUID, nextTab: RacePreparationTab) {[39m
[31m+     if (!clubId) return;[39m
[31m+[39m

[31m+     setParticipatingClubId(clubId);[39m
[31m+     setPendingParticipatingClubId(null);[39m
[31m+     setSelectedRiderIds([]);[39m
[31m+     setSelectedStaffIds([]);[39m
[31m+     setTacticalPlannerChoice("sport_director");[39m
[31m+     setSelectedU23HeadCoachId(null);[39m
[31m+     setU23AutomationEnabled(false);[39m
[31m+     setSelectedAssets(createEmptySelectedAssets());[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const context = await loadRacePreparationContext(clubId, raceIdToSelect);[39m
[31m+       await applyContext(context, clubId);[39m

[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m

[31m+       setActionLoading(false);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m

[31m+   async function refreshSelectedRace() {[39m
[31m+     if (!clubId || !raceId) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const [rawAcceptedResult, context] = await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+       loadAcceptedRacePreparations(clubId),[39m
[31m+       loadRacePreparationContext(clubId, raceId),[39m
[31m+     ]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const visibleAcceptedResult = filterAcceptedRacePreparations([39m
[31m+       rawAcceptedResult,[39m
[31m+       context.current_game_date,[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     setAcceptedRaces(visibleAcceptedResult);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if ([39m
[31m+       !visibleAcceptedResult.some((row) => row.race_id === raceId)[39m
[31m+     ) {[39m
[31m+       const fallbackRaceId = visibleAcceptedResult[0]?.race_id ?? null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (!fallbackRaceId) {[39m
[31m+         await applyNoVisibleAcceptedRaceState(clubId);[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const fallbackContext = await loadRacePreparationContext([39m
[31m+         clubId,[39m
[31m+         fallbackRaceId,[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       await applyContext(fallbackContext, clubId);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     await applyContext(context, clubId);[39m
[31m+   }[39m

[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     const tabFromUrl = normalizeRacePreparationTab(searchParams.get("tab"));[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+     // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps[39m
[31m+   }, []);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   async function applyParticipatingClub(nextParticipatingClubId: UUID) {[39m
[31m+     if ([39m
[31m+       !clubId ||[39m
[31m+       !raceId ||[39m
[31m+       !canEdit ||[39m
[31m+       nextParticipatingClubId === participatingClubId[39m
[31m+     ) {[39m
[31m+       setPendingParticipatingClubId(null);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     setActionLoading(true);[39m
[31m+     setErrorMessage(null);[39m
[31m+     setMessage(null);[39m
[31m+     setQuote(null);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     /*[39m
[31m+      * Remove the old squad riders immediately so the First Squad[39m
[31m+      * roster is not displayed while the Developing Team roster is[39m
[31m+      * loading.[39m
[31m+      */[39m
[31m+     setSelectedRiderIds([]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     setSelectableData((current) => {[39m
[31m+       if (!current) return current;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return {[39m
[31m+         ...current,[39m
[31m+         riders: [],[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const prepId = preparation?.id ? String(preparation.id) : null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const selectableResult = await loadRacePreparationSelectableData([39m
[31m+         clubId,[39m
[31m+         raceId,[39m
[31m+         prepId,[39m
[31m+         nextParticipatingClubId,[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       setParticipatingClubId(nextParticipatingClubId);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       /*[39m
[31m+        * Replace the rider pool with the selected squad.[39m
[31m+        *[39m
[31m+        * Shared club resources stay attached to the main club.[39m
[31m+        */[39m
[31m+       setSelectableData((current) => {[39m
[31m+         if (!current) {[39m
[31m+           return selectableResult;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         return {[39m
[31m+           ...current,[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           riders: selectableResult.riders,[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           blockedResources: selectableResult.blockedResources,[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           /*[39m
[31m+            * These are still returned from the main club, but keep[39m
[31m+            * the existing selections and displayed resource pools.[39m
[31m+            */[39m
[31m+           staff: selectableResult.staff,[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           assets: selectableResult.assets,[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           supplies: selectableResult.supplies,[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           equipmentPresets: selectableResult.equipmentPresets,[39m
[31m+         };[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       setPendingParticipatingClubId(null);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const nextOption = squadOptions.find([39m
[31m+         (option) => option.id === nextParticipatingClubId,[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       setTacticalPlannerChoice("sport_director");[39m
[31m+       setSelectedU23HeadCoachId(null);[39m
[31m+       setU23AutomationEnabled(false);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       setMessage([39m
[31m+         nextOption[39m
[31m+           ? `Competing squad changed to ${nextOption.name}.`[39m
[31m+           : "Competing squad changed.",[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+       /*[39m
[31m+        * Restore the currently selected squad roster if loading the[39m
[31m+        * requested squad fails.[39m
[31m+        */[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         const prepId = preparation?.id ? String(preparation.id) : null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         const restoredResult = await loadRacePreparationSelectableData([39m
[31m+           clubId,[39m
[31m+           raceId,[39m
[31m+           prepId,[39m
[31m+           participatingClubId ?? clubId,[39m
[31m+         );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         setSelectableData(restoredResult);[39m
[31m+       } catch (restoreError) {[39m
[31m+         console.error("Failed to restore current squad riders:", restoreError);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       setErrorMessage([39m
[31m+         error instanceof Error[39m
[31m+           ? error.message[39m
[31m+           : "Failed to change competing squad.",[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setActionLoading(false);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m

[31m+   function requestParticipatingClubChange(nextParticipatingClubId: UUID) {[39m
[31m+     if (!canEdit || nextParticipatingClubId === participatingClubId) {[39m
[31m+       return;[39m

[31m+       setPendingParticipatingClubId(nextParticipatingClubId);[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+     void applyParticipatingClub(nextParticipatingClubId);[39m
[31m+   }[39m

[31m+     if (isUuid(directId)) {[39m

[31m+       asRecord(refreshedContext.preparation).id ?? "",[39m
[31m+     );[39m

[31m+   async function handleSubmit() {[39m
[31m+     if (!riderSelectionValid) {[39m
[31m+       setErrorMessage([39m
[31m+         `Select ${minRiders}–${maxRiders} riders before submitting the Race Plan.`,[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (u23PlannerChoiceIncomplete) {[39m
[31m+       setErrorMessage([39m
[31m+         "Select a U23 Head Coach or switch the tactical planner back to Sport Director before submitting the Race Plan.",[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (!raceId || !clubId || !payload) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     setActionLoading(true);[39m
[31m+     setErrorMessage(null);[39m
[31m+     setMessage(null);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       let savedRacePreparationId = String(asRecord(preparation).id ?? "");[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (canEdit) {[39m
[31m+         const saveResult = await saveRacePreparationDraft(payload);[39m
[31m+         savedRacePreparationId =[39m
[31m+           (await resolveRacePreparationIdAfterSave(saveResult)) ?? "";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         if (savedRacePreparationId) {[39m
[31m+           await persistPendingU23PlannerChoice(savedRacePreparationId);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const result = await submitRacePreparation({[39m
[31m+         race_id: raceId,[39m
[31m+         club_id: clubId,[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const submittedRacePreparationId = String([39m
[31m+         result.race_preparation_id ??[39m
[31m+           savedRacePreparationId ??[39m
[31m+           asRecord(preparation).id ??[39m
[31m+           "",[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       let u23ActivationMessage = "";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if ([39m
[31m+         isDevelopingTeamSelected &&[39m
[31m+         effectiveTacticalPlannerChoice === "u23_head_coach"[39m
[31m+       ) {[39m
[31m+         if (!selectedU23HeadCoachId) {[39m
[31m+           throw new Error([39m
[31m+             "The Race Plan was submitted, but no U23 Head Coach was selected.",[39m
[31m+           );[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         if (!isUuid(submittedRacePreparationId)) {[39m
[31m+           throw new Error([39m
[31m+             "The Race Plan was submitted, but its preparation ID could not be resolved for U23 automation.",[39m
[31m+           );[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         const automationResult = await setU23StagePlanAutomation({[39m
[31m+           racePreparationId: submittedRacePreparationId,[39m
[31m+           enabled: true,[39m
[31m+           plannerStaffId: selectedU23HeadCoachId,[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         const initialGeneration = asRecord(automationResult.initial_generation);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         if (String(initialGeneration.status ?? "") === "error") {[39m
[31m+           throw new Error([39m
[31m+             String([39m
[31m+               initialGeneration.message ??[39m
[31m+                 "The Race Plan was submitted, but the U23 Head Coach could not generate the first Stage Plan.",[39m
[31m+             ),[39m
[31m+           );[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         setU23AutomationEnabled(Boolean(automationResult.is_enabled));[39m
[31m+         u23ActivationMessage = Boolean(initialGeneration.applied)[39m
[31m+           ? " The U23 Head Coach generated the first eligible Stage Plan."[39m
[31m+           : " U23 automation is active.";[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       setMessage([39m
[31m+         `${String([39m
[31m+           result.message ?? "Race Plan submitted successfully.",[39m
[31m+         )}${u23ActivationMessage}`,[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       await refreshSelectedRace();[39m
[31m+       setActiveTab("stagePlans");[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+       setErrorMessage([39m
[31m+         error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to submit race plan.",[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setActionLoading(false);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function requestSubmitRacePlan() {[39m

[31m+   function toggleRider(riderId: UUID) {[39m
[31m+     if (!canEdit) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (blockedRiderIds.has(riderId)) {[39m
[31m+       setErrorMessage([39m
[31m+         "This rider is already assigned to an overlapping submitted race.",[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const medicalUnavailableReason = medicallyUnavailableRiderMap.get(riderId);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (medicalUnavailableReason) {[39m
[31m+       setErrorMessage(medicalUnavailableReason);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     setSelectedRiderIds((current) => {[39m
[31m+       const currentClean = current.filter([39m
[31m+         (id) =>[39m
[31m+           !blockedRiderIds.has(id) && !medicallyUnavailableRiderIds.has(id),[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (currentClean.includes(riderId)) {[39m
[31m+         setErrorMessage(null);[39m
[31m+         return currentClean.filter((id) => id !== riderId);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (maxRiders > 0 && currentClean.length >= maxRiders) {[39m
[31m+         setErrorMessage(`You can select at most ${maxRiders} riders.`);[39m
[31m+         return currentClean;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       setErrorMessage(null);[39m
[31m+       return [...currentClean, riderId];[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function setStaffForRole(roleType: string, staffId: UUID | "") {[39m
[31m+     if (!canEdit) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (staffId && blockedStaffIds.has(staffId)) {[39m
[31m+       setErrorMessage([39m
[31m+         "This staff member is already assigned to an overlapping submitted race.",[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const staffInRole = new Set([39m
[31m+       (selectableData?.staff ?? [])[39m
[31m+         .filter((staff) => staff.role_type === roleType)[39m
[31m+         .map((staff) => staff.id),[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     setErrorMessage(null);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     setSelectedStaffIds((current) => {[39m
[31m+       const withoutThisRole = current.filter((id) => {[39m
[31m+         return !staffInRole.has(id) && !blockedStaffIds.has(id);[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return staffId ? [...withoutThisRole, staffId] : withoutThisRole;[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (roleType === "sport_director" && isDevelopingTeamSelected && staffId) {[39m
[31m+       setTacticalPlannerChoice("sport_director");[39m
[31m+       setSelectedU23HeadCoachId(null);[39m
[31m+       setU23AutomationEnabled(false);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function selectTacticalPlanner(choice: "sport_director" | "u23_head_coach") {[39m
[31m+     if (!canEdit || !isDevelopingTeamSelected) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     setTacticalPlannerChoice(choice);[39m
[31m+     setErrorMessage(null);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (choice === "u23_head_coach") {[39m
[31m+       setStaffForRole("sport_director", "");[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     setSelectedU23HeadCoachId(null);[39m
[31m+     setU23AutomationEnabled(false);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function selectU23HeadCoach(staffId: UUID | "") {[39m
[31m+     if (!canEdit || !isDevelopingTeamSelected) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (staffId && blockedStaffIds.has(staffId)) {[39m
[31m+       setErrorMessage([39m

[31m+       );[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m

[31m+     setTacticalPlannerChoice("u23_head_coach");[39m
[31m+     setSelectedU23HeadCoachId(staffId || null);[39m
[31m+     setU23AutomationEnabled(false);[39m

[31m+   function updateSelectedAsset(assetKey: RacePrepAssetKey, assetId: UUID | "") {[39m

[31m+   actionLoading: boolean;[39m
[31m+   onPrepareRace: (raceId: UUID) => void;[39m
[31m+   onOpenStages: (raceId: UUID) => void;[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   if (acceptedRaces.length === 0) {[39m
[31m+     return <EmptyCard message="No accepted races found for this club." />;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <section className="rounded-2xl border bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">[39m
[31m+       <div className="mb-4">[39m
[31m+         <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900">Accepted Races</h2>[39m
[31m+         <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">[39m
[31m+           Confirmed participations. The status shows what can be done now for[39m
[31m+           Race Plan and Stage Plans.[39m
[31m+         </p>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <div className="space-y-3">[39m
[31m+         {acceptedRaces.map((row) => {[39m
[31m+           const selected = selectedRaceId === row.race_id;[39m
[31m+           const race = row.race;[39m
[31m+           const prepState = getAcceptedRacePreparationState([39m
[31m+             row,[39m
[31m+             currentGameDate,[39m
[31m+           );[39m
[31m+           const isMissedStartlist = Boolean([39m
[31m+             (prepState as { missedStartlist?: boolean }).missedStartlist,[39m
[31m+           );[39m
[31m+           const raceWeatherStatus = getWeatherCancellationStatusFromRace(race);[39m
[31m+           const raceAllWeatherCanceled =[39m
[31m+             isRaceAllWeatherCanceledInPreparation(race);[39m
[31m+           const racePartlyWeatherCanceled =[39m
[31m+             isRacePartlyWeatherCanceledInPreparation(race);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           const raceClass =[39m
[31m+             String([39m
[31m+               row.entry_rules?.race_class_code ??[39m
[31m+                 race.race_class_code ??[39m
[31m+                 race.category ??[39m
[31m+                 "—",[39m
[31m+             ) || "—";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           const raceTypeLabel = row.stage_count > 1 ? "Stage Race" : "One Day";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           const startParts = parseDateParts(race.start_date);[39m
[31m+           const endParts = parseDateParts(race.end_date);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           const startDay = startParts[39m
[31m+             ? `${String(startParts.day).padStart(2, "0")} ${[39m
[31m+                 monthLabels[startParts.month - 1][39m
[31m+               }`[39m
[31m+             : "—";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           const endDay = endParts[39m
[31m+             ? `${String(endParts.day).padStart(2, "0")} ${[39m
[31m+                 monthLabels[endParts.month - 1][39m
[31m+               }`[39m
[31m+             : "—";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           return ([39m
[31m+             <div[39m
[31m+               key={row.race_team_entry_id}[39m
[31m+               className={`rounded-2xl border p-4 transition ${[39m
[31m+                 raceAllWeatherCanceled[39m
[31m+                   ? "border-red-200 bg-red-50"[39m
[31m+                   : isMissedStartlist[39m
[31m+                     ? "border-red-200 bg-red-50"[39m
[31m+                     : selected[39m
[31m+                       ? "border-yellow-300 bg-yellow-50"[39m
[31m+                       : "border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50"[39m
[31m+               }`}[39m
[31m+             >[39m
[31m+               <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-[80px_1fr_auto] md:items-center">[39m
[31m+                 <div className="flex items-center gap-4">[39m
[31m+                   <div className="w-16 text-right text-sm font-semibold leading-tight text-slate-950">[39m
[31m+                     <div>{startDay}</div>[39m
[31m+                     {race.start_date !== race.end_date && <div>{endDay}</div>}[39m
[31m+                   </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+                   <div className="h-14 w-px bg-emerald-400" />[39m
[31m+                 </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+                 <button[39m
[31m+                   type="button"[39m
[31m+                   disabled={actionLoading}[39m
[31m+                   onClick={() => onPrepareRace(row.race_id)}[39m
[31m+                   className="min-w-0 text-left disabled:opacity-60"[39m
[31m+                 >[39m
[31m+                   <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-2">[39m
[31m+                     <CountryFlag code={String(race.country_code ?? "")} />[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+                     <div className="truncate text-base font-semibold text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+                       {race.name}[39m
[31m+                     </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+                     <span className="rounded-full bg-purple-100 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-purple-700">[39m
[31m+                       {raceClass}[39m
[31m+                     </span>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+                     {raceWeatherStatus ? ([39m
[31m+                       <span[39m
[31m+                         className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold ${[39m
[31m+                           raceAllWeatherCanceled[39m
[31m+                             ? "bg-red-100 text-red-700 ring-1 ring-red-200"[39m
[31m+                             : racePartlyWeatherCanceled[39m
[31m+                               ? "bg-orange-100 text-orange-700 ring-1 ring-orange-200"[39m
[31m+                               : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700"[39m
[31m+                         }`}[39m
[31m+                       >[39m
[31m+                         {getWeatherCancellationDisplayStatusForPreparation([39m
[31m+                           race,[39m
[31m+                         ) ?? titleFromSnake(raceWeatherStatus)}[39m
[31m+                       </span>[39m
[31m+                     ) : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+                     <span[39m
[31m+                       className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold ${[39m
[31m+                         row.stage_count > 1[39m
[31m+                           ? "bg-blue-100 text-blue-700"[39m
[31m+                           : "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700"[39m
[31m+                       }`}[39m
[31m+                     >[39m
[31m+                       {raceTypeLabel}[39m
[31m+                     </span>[39m
[31m+                   </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+                   <div className="mt-1 truncate text-xs text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+                     {getRaceRouteLine(race, row.stage_count)}[39m
[31m+                   </div>[39m
[31m+                 </button>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+                 <div className="flex flex-nowrap items-center justify-start gap-2 md:justify-end">[39m
[31m+                   {isMissedStartlist ? ([39m
[31m+                     <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-red-800">[39m
[31m+                       <span className="whitespace-nowrap">[39m
[31m+                         Your team missed the startlist and is not participating[39m
[31m+                       </span>[39m
[31m+                       <span className="shrink-0 rounded-full bg-red-100 px-2.5 py-0.5">[39m
[31m+                         Not Participating[39m
[31m+                       </span>[39m
[31m+                     </span>[39m
[31m+                   ) : ([39m
[31m+                     <span[39m
[31m+                       className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold ${prepState.className}`}[39m
[31m+                     >[39m
[31m+                       {prepState.label}[39m
[31m+                     </span>[39m
[31m+                   )}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+                   {prepState.racePlanEnabled ? ([39m
[31m+                     <button[39m
[31m+                       type="button"[39m
[31m+                       disabled={actionLoading}[39m
[31m+                       onClick={() => onPrepareRace(row.race_id)}[39m
[31m+                       className="rounded-full bg-yellow-400 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-950 hover:bg-yellow-300 disabled:opacity-50"[39m
[31m+                       title="Open Race Plan"[39m
[31m+                     >[39m
[31m+                       Race Plan[39m
[31m+                     </button>[39m
[31m+                   ) : ([39m
[31m+                     <button[39m
[31m+                       type="button"[39m
[31m+                       disabled={actionLoading || !prepState.stagePlansEnabled}[39m
[31m+                       onClick={() => onOpenStages(row.race_id)}[39m
[31m+                       className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold ${[39m
[31m+                         prepState.stagePlansEnabled[39m
[31m+                           ? "bg-yellow-400 text-slate-950 hover:bg-yellow-300"[39m
[31m+                           : "cursor-not-allowed bg-slate-100 text-slate-400"[39m
[31m+                       }`}[39m
[31m+                       title={[39m
[31m+                         prepState.stagePlansEnabled[39m
[31m+                           ? "Open Stage Plans"[39m
[31m+                           : "Stage Plans open after the Race Plan is submitted"[39m
[31m+                       }[39m
[31m+                     >[39m
[31m+                       Stage Plans[39m
[31m+                     </button>[39m
[31m+                   )}[39m
[31m+                 </div>[39m
[31m+               </div>[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+           );[39m
[31m+         })}[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     </section>[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStageHeaderProfileKind(stage: JsonRecord): {[39m
[31m+   label: string;[39m
[31m+   shortLabel: string;[39m
[31m+   className: string;[39m
[31m+ } {[39m
[31m+   const format = String(stage.stage_format ?? "").toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+   const profile = String([39m
[31m+     stage.profile_type ?? stage.terrain_type ?? stage.stage_type ?? "",[39m
[31m+   ).toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+   const combined = `${format} ${profile}`;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (format === "team_time_trial") {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       label: "Team Time Trial",[39m
[31m+       shortLabel: "TTT",[39m
[31m+       className: "border-purple-200 bg-purple-50 text-purple-700",[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (isTimeTrialStage(stage)) {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       label: "Time Trial",[39m
[31m+       shortLabel: "TT",[39m
[31m+       className: "border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700",[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if ([39m
[31m+     combined.includes("mountain") ||[39m
[31m+     combined.includes("climb") ||[39m
[31m+     combined.includes("summit")[39m
[31m+   ) {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       label: "Mountain",[39m
[31m+       shortLabel: "M",[39m
[31m+       className: "border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-700",[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if ([39m
[31m+     combined.includes("hilly") ||[39m
[31m+     combined.includes("hill") ||[39m
[31m+     combined.includes("puncheur")[39m
[31m+   ) {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       label: "Hilly",[39m
[31m+       shortLabel: "H",[39m
[31m+       className: "border-orange-200 bg-orange-50 text-orange-700",[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (combined.includes("cobble")) {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       label: "Cobbles",[39m
[31m+       shortLabel: "C",[39m
[31m+       className: "border-stone-200 bg-stone-50 text-stone-700",[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (combined.includes("sprint")) {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       label: "Sprint",[39m
[31m+       shortLabel: "S",[39m
[31m+       className: "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700",[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     label: "Flat",[39m
[31m+     shortLabel: "F",[39m
[31m+     className: "border-sky-200 bg-sky-50 text-sky-700",[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStageHeaderProfileSource(stage: JsonRecord): JsonRecord {[39m
[31m+   const metadata = asRecord(stage.metadata);[39m
[31m+   const routeProfile = asRecord(metadata.route_profile_v1);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (Object.keys(routeProfile).length > 0) {[39m
[31m+     return routeProfile;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return stage;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function StageHeaderMiniProfile({[39m
[31m+   stage,[39m
[31m+   profileOverride,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   stage: JsonRecord;[39m
[31m+   profileOverride: JsonRecord;[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const profile = profileOverride;[39m
[31m+   const points = normalizeProfilePoints(profile, stage);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (points.length < 2) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className="flex h-56 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+         Stage profile points are missing.[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const width = 680;[39m
[31m+   const height = 230;[39m
[31m+   const padding = {[39m
[31m+     top: 18,[39m
[31m+     right: 18,[39m
[31m+     bottom: 34,[39m
[31m+     left: 46,[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const innerWidth = width - padding.left - padding.right;[39m
[31m+   const innerHeight = height - padding.top - padding.bottom;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const distanceKm =[39m
[31m+     toFiniteNumberValue(profile.distance_km) ??[39m
[31m+     toFiniteNumberValue(stage.distance_km) ??[39m
[31m+     Math.max(...points.map((point) => point.km), 1);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const maxElevationRaw = Math.max(...points.map((point) => point.elevation_m));[39m
[31m+   const maxElevation = Math.max([39m
[31m+     500,[39m
[31m+     Math.ceil((maxElevationRaw * 1.12) / 100) * 100,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const xForKm = (km: number) =>[39m
[31m+     padding.left +[39m
[31m+     (Math.max(0, Math.min(distanceKm, km)) / distanceKm) * innerWidth;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const yForElevation = (elevation: number) =>[39m
[31m+     padding.top +[39m
[31m+     innerHeight -[39m
[31m+     (Math.max(0, elevation) / maxElevation) * innerHeight;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const coordinates = points.map((point) => ({[39m
[31m+     x: xForKm(point.km),[39m
[31m+     y: yForElevation(point.elevation_m),[39m
[31m+     ...point,[39m
[31m+   }));[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const linePath = coordinates.reduce((path, point, index) => {[39m
[31m+     if (index === 0) return `M ${point.x} ${point.y}`;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const previous = coordinates[index - 1];[39m
[31m+     const controlX = (previous.x + point.x) / 2;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return `${path} C ${controlX} ${previous.y}, ${controlX} ${point.y}, ${point.x} ${point.y}`;[39m
[31m+   }, "");[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const baselineY = height - padding.bottom;[39m
[31m+   const areaPath = `${linePath} L ${[39m
[31m+     coordinates[coordinates.length - 1].x[39m
[31m+   } ${baselineY} L ${coordinates[0].x} ${baselineY} Z`;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const elevationTicks = [0, 0.33, 0.66, 1].map([39m
[31m+     (ratio) => Math.round((maxElevation * ratio) / 100) * 100,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const distanceTicks = [0, 0.33, 0.66, 1].map((ratio) => ({[39m
[31m+     km: distanceKm * ratio,[39m
[31m+     x: xForKm(distanceKm * ratio),[39m
[31m+   }));[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white">[39m
[31m+       <svg[39m
[31m+         viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${height}`}[39m
[31m+         className="h-56 w-full"[39m
[31m+         role="img"[39m
[31m+         aria-label="Stage profile preview"[39m
[31m+       >[39m
[31m+         <rect width={width} height={height} fill="#ffffff" />[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         {elevationTicks.map((tick) => {[39m
[31m+           const y = yForElevation(tick);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           return ([39m
[31m+             <g key={tick}>[39m
[31m+               <line[39m
[31m+                 x1={padding.left}[39m
[31m+                 x2={width - padding.right}[39m
[31m+                 y1={y}[39m
[31m+                 y2={y}[39m
[31m+                 stroke="#e2e8f0"[39m
[31m+                 strokeWidth="1"[39m
[31m+               />[39m
[31m+               <text[39m
[31m+                 x={padding.left - 8}[39m
[31m+                 y={y + 4}[39m
[31m+                 textAnchor="end"[39m
[31m+                 fontSize="11"[39m
[31m+                 fill="#64748b"[39m
[31m+               >[39m
[31m+                 {tick} m[39m
[31m+               </text>[39m
[31m+             </g>[39m
[31m+           );[39m
[31m+         })}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <path d={areaPath} fill="#fde68a" opacity="0.95" />[39m
[31m+         <path[39m
[31m+           d={linePath}[39m
[31m+           fill="none"[39m
[31m+           stroke="#334155"[39m
[31m+           strokeLinecap="round"[39m
[31m+           strokeLinejoin="round"[39m
[31m+           strokeWidth="3"[39m
[31m+         />[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         {distanceTicks.map((tick, index) => ([39m
[31m+           <text[39m
[31m+             key={`${tick.km}-${index}`}[39m
[31m+             x={tick.x}[39m
[31m+             y={height - 10}[39m
[31m+             textAnchor={[39m
[31m+               index === 0[39m
[31m+                 ? "start"[39m
[31m+                 : index === distanceTicks.length - 1[39m
[31m+                   ? "end"[39m
[31m+                   : "middle"[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+             fontSize="11"[39m
[31m+             fontWeight="700"[39m
[31m+             fill="#334155"[39m
[31m+           >[39m
[31m+             {tick.km.toFixed(tick.km % 1 === 0 ? 0 : 1)} km[39m
[31m+           </text>[39m
[31m+         ))}[39m
[31m+       </svg>[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function RaceHeaderStageChip({[39m
[31m+   stage,[39m
[31m+   index,[39m
[31m+   profile,[39m
[31m+   profileLoading,[39m
[31m+   profileError,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   stage: JsonRecord;[39m
[31m+   index: number;[39m
[31m+   profile: JsonRecord | null;[39m
[31m+   profileLoading: boolean;[39m
[31m+   profileError: string | null;[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const stageNumber = String(stage.stage_number ?? index + 1);[39m
[31m+   const kind = getStageHeaderProfileKind(stage);[39m
[31m+   const title = `Stage ${stageNumber}: ${getStageProfileLabel(stage)} · ${[39m
[31m+     getStageDistance(stage) || "Distance pending"[39m
[31m+   }`;[39m
[31m+   const hasProfileChart = profile[39m
[31m+     ? normalizeProfilePoints(profile, stage).length >= 2[39m
[31m+     : false;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div[39m
[31m+       className="relative shrink-0"[39m
[31m+       onMouseEnter={() => setHovered(true)}[39m
[31m+       onMouseLeave={() => setHovered(false)}[39m
[31m+       onFocus={() => setHovered(true)}[39m
[31m+       onBlur={() => setHovered(false)}[39m
[31m+     >[39m
[31m+       <button[39m
[31m+         type="button"[39m
[31m+         className="inline-flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-slate-300 bg-white text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 shadow-sm transition hover:border-yellow-400 hover:bg-yellow-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-yellow-300"[39m
[31m+         aria-label={title}[39m
[31m+         title={title}[39m
[31m+       >[39m
[31m+         {stageNumber}[39m
[31m+       </button>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {hovered ? ([39m
[31m+         <div className="pointer-events-none absolute right-0 top-10 z-[80] w-[44rem] rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 text-left shadow-2xl">[39m
[31m+           <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">[39m
[31m+             <div className="min-w-0">[39m
[31m+               <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+                 Stage {stageNumber}[39m
[31m+               </div>[39m
[31m+               <div className="mt-0.5 truncate text-sm font-semibold text-slate-950">[39m
[31m+                 {getStageDisplayName(stage, stageNumber)}[39m
[31m+               </div>[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+             <span className="shrink-0 rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-700">[39m
[31m+               {kind.label}[39m
[31m+             </span>[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-600">[39m
[31m+             <div className="truncate">[39m
[31m+               <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700">Route:</span>{" "}[39m
[31m+               {getStageRoute(stage)}[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+             <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 gap-y-1">[39m
[31m+               <span>[39m
[31m+                 <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700">Profile:</span>{" "}[39m
[31m+                 {profile?.profile_type[39m
[31m+                   ? titleFromSnake(String(profile.profile_type))[39m
[31m+                   : getStageProfileLabel(stage)}[39m
[31m+               </span>[39m
[31m+               <span>[39m
[31m+                 <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700">Distance:</span>{" "}[39m
[31m+                 {profile?.distance_km[39m
[31m+                   ? `${Number(profile.distance_km).toFixed([39m
[31m+                       Number(profile.distance_km) % 1 === 0 ? 0 : 1,[39m
[31m+                     )} km`[39m
[31m+                   : getStageDistance(stage) || "—"}[39m
[31m+               </span>[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-3">[39m
[31m+             {profileLoading && !hasProfileChart ? ([39m
[31m+               <div className="flex h-56 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+                 Loading stage profile…[39m
[31m+               </div>[39m
[31m+             ) : hasProfileChart && profile ? ([39m
[31m+               <StageHeaderMiniProfile stage={stage} profileOverride={profile} />[39m
[31m+             ) : ([39m
[31m+               <div className="flex h-56 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 px-4 text-center text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+                 {profileError[39m
[31m+                   ? "Stage profile could not be loaded."[39m
[31m+                   : "Stage profile data is not available yet."}[39m
[31m+               </div>[39m
[31m+             )}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       ) : null}[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function RaceHeaderStageStrip({[39m
[31m+   stages,[39m
[31m+   fallbackStageCount,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   stages: JsonRecord[];[39m
[31m+   fallbackStageCount: number;[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const visibleStages = stages.length > 0 ? stages : [];[39m
[31m+   const fallbackCount = Math.max(0, Number(fallbackStageCount) || 0);[39m
[31m+   const stageIds = useMemo([39m
[31m+     () => visibleStages.map((stage) => String(stage.id ?? "")).filter(Boolean),[39m
[31m+     [visibleStages],[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   const [profileByStageId, setProfileByStageId] = useState<[39m
[31m+     Record<[39m
[31m+       string,[39m
[31m+       { profile: JsonRecord | null; loading: boolean; error: string | null }[39m
[31m+     >[39m
[31m+   >({});[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (stageIds.length === 0) {[39m
[31m+       setProfileByStageId({});[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     let cancelled = false;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     setProfileByStageId((current) => {[39m
[31m+       const next = { ...current };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       stageIds.forEach((stageId) => {[39m
[31m+         if (!next[stageId]) {[39m
[31m+           next[stageId] = { profile: null, loading: true, error: null };[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return next;[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     stageIds.forEach((stageId) => {[39m
[31m+       loadRaceStageProfileDetail(stageId)[39m
[31m+         .then((result) => {[39m
[31m+           if (cancelled) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           setProfileByStageId((current) => ({[39m
[31m+             ...current,[39m
[31m+             [stageId]: {[39m
[31m+               profile: result?.has_profile ? result : null,[39m
[31m+               loading: false,[39m
[31m+               error: null,[39m
[31m+             },[39m
[31m+           }));[39m
[31m+         })[39m
[31m+         .catch((error) => {[39m
[31m+           if (cancelled) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           setProfileByStageId((current) => ({[39m
[31m+             ...current,[39m
[31m+             [stageId]: {[39m
[31m+               profile: null,[39m
[31m+               loading: false,[39m
[31m+               error:[39m
[31m+                 error instanceof Error[39m
[31m+                   ? error.message[39m
[31m+                   : "Failed to load stage profile.",[39m
[31m+             },[39m
[31m+           }));[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return () => {[39m
[31m+       cancelled = true;[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }, [stageIds]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (visibleStages.length === 0 && fallbackCount <= 0) return null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (visibleStages.length === 0) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className="flex w-full items-center justify-end gap-2 overflow-visible text-xs">[39m
[31m+         <span className="shrink-0 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+           Stages:[39m
[31m+         </span>[39m
[31m+         <span className="inline-flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-slate-300 bg-white text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 shadow-sm">[39m
[31m+           {fallbackCount}[39m
[31m+         </span>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="flex w-full items-center justify-end gap-2 overflow-visible text-xs">[39m
[31m+       <span className="shrink-0 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+         Stages:[39m
[31m+       </span>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-nowrap items-center gap-1.5 overflow-visible">[39m
[31m+         {visibleStages.map((stage, index) => {[39m
[31m+           const stageId = String(stage.id ?? "");[39m
[31m+           const profileState = stageId ? profileByStageId[stageId] : null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           return ([39m
[31m+             <RaceHeaderStageChip[39m
[31m+               key={String(stage.id ?? stage.stage_number ?? index)}[39m
[31m+               stage={stage}[39m
[31m+               index={index}[39m
[31m+               profile={profileState?.profile ?? null}[39m
[31m+               profileLoading={profileState?.loading ?? false}[39m
[31m+               profileError={profileState?.error ?? null}[39m
[31m+             />[39m
[31m+           );[39m
[31m+         })}[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function RaceHeaderCard({[39m
[31m+   race,[39m
[31m+   raceClassCode,[39m
[31m+   minRiders,[39m
[31m+   maxRiders,[39m
[31m+   raceStatus,[39m
[31m+   currentGameDate,[39m
[31m+   packageOpensOn,[39m
[31m+   riderDeadlineOn,[39m
[31m+   stageCount,[39m
[31m+   stages,[39m
[31m+   squadOptions,[39m
[31m+   participatingClubId,[39m
[31m+   canChangeSquad,[39m
[31m+   squadChangeLoading,[39m
[31m+   onParticipatingClubChange,[39m
[31m+   onOpenRacePreview,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   race: unknown;[39m
[31m+   raceClassCode: string;[39m
[31m+   minRiders: number;[39m
[31m+   maxRiders: number;[39m
[31m+   raceStatus: string;[39m
[31m+   currentGameDate?: string;[39m
[31m+   packageOpensOn?: string;[39m
[31m+   riderDeadlineOn?: string;[39m
[31m+   stageCount: number;[39m
