[31m+       (option) => option.club_type === "main" || !option.parent_club_id,[39m
[31m+     ) ?? null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const developingSquadOption =[39m
[31m+     squadOptions.find([39m
[31m+       (option) =>[39m
[31m+         option.club_type === "developing" && Boolean(option.parent_club_id),[39m
[31m+     ) ?? null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const hasDevelopingTeam = Boolean(developingSquadOption);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const visibleSquadOptions = [firstSquadOption, developingSquadOption].filter([39m
[31m+     (option): option is RacePreparationSquadOption => Boolean(option),[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <section className="rounded-2xl border bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">[39m
[31m+       <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(280px,auto)_1fr_auto] lg:items-start">[39m
[31m+         <div className="min-w-0">[39m
[31m+           <div className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+             Selected race[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-2">[39m
[31m+             <CountryFlag code={getText(race, "country_code")} />[39m
[31m+             <h2 className="truncate text-xl font-semibold text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+               {getText(race, "name") || "Unnamed race"}[39m
[31m+             </h2>[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">[39m
[31m+             <InfoChip[39m
[31m+               label="Race dates"[39m
[31m+               value={formatGameDateRange([39m
[31m+                 getText(race, "start_date"),[39m
[31m+                 getText(race, "end_date"),[39m
[31m+               )}[39m
[31m+             />[39m
[31m+             <InfoChip label="Class" value={raceClassCode || "—"} />[39m
[31m+             <InfoChip[39m
[31m+               label="Riders"[39m
[31m+               value={`${minRiders || "—"}–${maxRiders || "—"}`}[39m
[31m+             />[39m
[31m+             {raceId && ([39m
[31m+               <button[39m
[31m+                 type="button"[39m
[31m+                 onClick={() => onOpenRacePreview(raceId)}[39m
[31m+                 className="inline-flex h-[38px] items-center rounded-xl border border-blue-100 bg-blue-50 px-3 text-sm font-semibold text-blue-700 hover:bg-blue-100"[39m
[31m+               >[39m
[31m+                 Open Race Page[39m
[31m+               </button>[39m
[31m+             )}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col items-end gap-3 lg:pt-2">[39m
[31m+           {raceStatus === "missed_startlist" ? ([39m
[31m+             <div className="flex w-full max-w-3xl items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-red-800">[39m
[31m+               <span className="min-w-0 truncate">[39m
[31m+                 Your team missed the rider startlist and is not participating in[39m
[31m+                 this race.[39m
[31m+               </span>[39m
[31m+               <span className="shrink-0 rounded-full bg-red-100 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-red-800 ring-1 ring-red-200">[39m
[31m+                 Not Participating[39m
[31m+               </span>[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+           ) : ([39m
[31m+             <span[39m
[31m+               className={`inline-flex rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold ${statusClass([39m
[31m+                 raceStatus,[39m
[31m+               )}`}[39m
[31m+             >[39m
[31m+               {getRacePlanStatusLabel(raceStatus)}[39m
[31m+             </span>[39m
[31m+           )}[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-2 text-right">[39m
[31m+           <InfoChip[39m
[31m+             label="Current game date"[39m
[31m+             value={formatFullGameDate(currentGameDate)}[39m
[31m+             alignRight[39m
[31m+           />[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <div className="mt-3 flex justify-end border-t border-slate-100 pt-3">[39m

[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {hasDevelopingTeam && ([39m
[31m+         <div className="mt-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-4">[39m
[31m+           <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">[39m
[31m+             <div>[39m
[31m+               <div className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+                 Competing squad[39m
[31m+               </div>[39m
[31m+               <div className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">[39m
[31m+                 Rider selection comes from this squad. Staff, assets, equipment,[39m
[31m+                 supplies and finance remain shared by the club.[39m
[31m+               </div>[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             <div className="inline-flex rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-1 shadow-sm">[39m
[31m+               {visibleSquadOptions.map((option) => {[39m
[31m+                 const active = option.id === participatingClubId;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+                 return ([39m
[31m+                   <button[39m
[31m+                     key={option.id}[39m
[31m+                     type="button"[39m
[31m+                     disabled={!canChangeSquad || squadChangeLoading}[39m
[31m+                     onClick={() => onParticipatingClubChange(option.id)}[39m
[31m+                     className={[[39m
[31m+                       "rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold transition",[39m
[31m+                       active[39m
[31m+                         ? "bg-yellow-400 text-slate-950 shadow-sm"[39m

[31m+                       !canChangeSquad || squadChangeLoading[39m
[31m+                         ? "cursor-not-allowed opacity-60"[39m
[31m+                         : "",[39m
[31m+                     ].join(" ")}[39m
[31m+                     title={option.name}[39m
[31m+                   >[39m
[31m+                     <span className="block">{option.label}</span>[39m

[31m+           value={formatFullGameDate(riderDeadlineOn)}[39m
[31m+         />[39m
[31m+         <InfoBox label="Stages" value={String(stageCount)} />[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     </section>[39m
[31m+   );[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+ function BonusBreakdownPopover({[39m
[31m+   title,[39m
[31m+   percent,[39m
[31m+   breakdown,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   title: string;[39m
[31m+   percent: number;[39m
[31m+   breakdown: BonusBreakdownRow[];[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const contributionTotal = breakdown.reduce([39m
[31m+     (sum, row) => sum + row.contributionPercent,[39m
[31m+     0,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="max-h-[360px] overflow-y-auto rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 text-xs shadow-xl">[39m
[31m+       <div className="mb-3 flex items-start justify-between gap-3">[39m
[31m+         <div>[39m
[31m+           <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+             {title} breakdown[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-1 text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+             Helpful effects are converted into positive standardized[39m
[31m+             contribution percentages.[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <div className="shrink-0 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-1 font-bold text-emerald-700">[39m
[31m+           +{formatBonusPercent(percent)}%[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {breakdown.length > 0 ? ([39m
[31m+         <div className="space-y-2">[39m
[31m+           {breakdown.map((row, index) => ([39m
[31m+             <div[39m
[31m+               key={`${row.sourceLabel}-${row.effectKey}-${index}`}[39m
[31m+               className="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-3"[39m
[31m+             >[39m
[31m+               <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">[39m
[31m+                 <div className="min-w-0">[39m
[31m+                   <div className="font-semibold text-slate-800">[39m
[31m+                     {row.sourceLabel}[39m
[31m+                   </div>[39m
[31m+                   <div className="mt-1 text-slate-600">{row.effectLabel}</div>[39m
[31m+                   <div className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-400">[39m
[31m+                     Raw effect: {row.rawValueText}[39m
[31m+                   </div>[39m
[31m+                 </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+                 <div className="shrink-0 font-bold text-emerald-700">[39m
[31m+                   {row.contributionLabel}[39m
[31m+                 </div>[39m
[31m+               </div>[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+           ))}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           <div className="border-t border-slate-200 pt-2">[39m
[31m+             <div className="flex justify-between font-semibold text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+               <span>Source contribution</span>[39m
[31m+               <span>+{formatBonusPercent(contributionTotal)}%</span>[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+             <div className="mt-1 flex justify-between font-semibold text-emerald-700">[39m
[31m+               <span>Standardized total</span>[39m
[31m+               <span>+{formatBonusPercent(percent)}%</span>[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+             <div className="mt-2 text-[11px] leading-5 text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+               If these two numbers differ later, the race engine cap or[39m
[31m+               standardization rule has limited the final bonus.[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       ) : ([39m
[31m+         <div className="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-3 text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+           No detailed source rows are available for this bonus yet. Team Policy[39m
[31m+           rows appear only when the current policy setup gives a non-zero bonus.[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       )}[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildStandardizedBreakdownMap([39m
[31m+   exactBonusPreview: JsonRecord,[39m
[31m+ ): Record<string, BonusBreakdownRow[]> {[39m
[31m+   const result: Record<string, BonusBreakdownRow[]> = {};[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   Object.keys(standardizedEffectKeyMap).forEach((key) => {[39m
[31m+     result[key] = [];[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const sourceGroups = [[39m
[31m+     ...toArray<JsonRecord>(exactBonusPreview.staff),[39m
[31m+     ...toArray<JsonRecord>(exactBonusPreview.assets),[39m
[31m+     ...toArray<JsonRecord>(exactBonusPreview.policies),[39m
[31m+   ];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   sourceGroups.forEach((sourceGroup) => {[39m
[31m+     const sourceType = String(sourceGroup.source_type ?? "");[39m
[31m+     const sourceLabel = String([39m
[31m+       sourceGroup.source_label ?? sourceGroup.source_key ?? "Bonus source",[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     toArray<JsonRecord>(sourceGroup.effects).forEach((effect) => {[39m
[31m+       const effectKey = String(effect.effect_key ?? "");[39m
[31m+       const effectLabel = String(effect.label ?? effectKey);[39m
[31m+       const rawValueText = String(effect.value ?? "");[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (!effectKey || !effectLabel || !rawValueText) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const matchingBonusKeys = getStandardizedBonusKeysForEffect(effectKey);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       matchingBonusKeys.forEach((bonusKey) => {[39m
[31m+         const contributionPercent = getStandardizedContributionPercent([39m
[31m+           effectKey,[39m
[31m+           rawValueText,[39m
[31m+         );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         if (contributionPercent <= 0) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         result[bonusKey] = [[39m
[31m+           ...(result[bonusKey] ?? []),[39m
[31m+           {[39m
[31m+             sourceType,[39m
[31m+             sourceLabel,[39m
[31m+             effectKey,[39m
[31m+             effectLabel: getContributionEffectLabel(effectKey, effectLabel),[39m
[31m+             rawValueText,[39m
[31m+             contributionPercent,[39m
[31m+             contributionLabel: `+${formatBonusPercent(contributionPercent)}%`,[39m
[31m+           },[39m
[31m+         ];[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   Object.keys(result).forEach((bonusKey) => {[39m
[31m+     result[bonusKey] = mergeBreakdownRows(result[bonusKey] ?? []);[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return result;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function mergeBreakdownRows(rows: BonusBreakdownRow[]): BonusBreakdownRow[] {[39m
[31m+   const grouped = new Map<string, BonusBreakdownRow & { count: number }>();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   rows.forEach((row) => {[39m
[31m+     const sourceLabel = normalizeBreakdownSourceLabel(row.sourceLabel);[39m
[31m+     const key = [sourceLabel, row.effectKey, row.effectLabel].join("|");[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const existing = grouped.get(key);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (!existing) {[39m
[31m+       grouped.set(key, {[39m
[31m+         ...row,[39m
[31m+         sourceLabel,[39m
[31m+         count: 1,[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     grouped.set(key, {[39m
[31m+       ...existing,[39m
[31m+       contributionPercent:[39m
[31m+         existing.contributionPercent + row.contributionPercent,[39m
[31m+       contributionLabel: `+${formatBonusPercent([39m
[31m+         existing.contributionPercent + row.contributionPercent,[39m
[31m+       )}%`,[39m
[31m+       rawValueText:[39m
[31m+         existing.count + 1 > 1[39m
[31m+           ? `${existing.count + 1} sources`[39m
[31m+           : existing.rawValueText,[39m
[31m+       count: existing.count + 1,[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return Array.from(grouped.values()).map(({ count, ...row }) => row);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeBreakdownSourceLabel(sourceLabel: string): string {[39m
[31m+   if (/^Team Car\s+\d+:/i.test(sourceLabel)) {[39m
[31m+     return "Team Cars";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return sourceLabel;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStandardizedBonusKeysForEffect(effectKey: string): string[] {[39m
[31m+   return Object.entries(standardizedEffectKeyMap)[39m
[31m+     .filter(([, effectKeys]) => effectKeys.includes(effectKey))[39m
[31m+     .map(([bonusKey]) => bonusKey);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStandardizedContributionPercent([39m
[31m+   effectKey: string,[39m
[31m+   rawValueText: string,[39m
[31m+ ): number {[39m
[31m+   const rawValue = parseSignedNumericValue(rawValueText);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!Number.isFinite(rawValue) || rawValue === 0) {[39m
[31m+     return 0;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (negativeRawMeansPositiveContribution.has(effectKey)) {[39m
[31m+     return Math.abs(rawValue);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return Math.max(0, rawValue);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function parseSignedNumericValue(value: string): number {[39m
[31m+   const normalized = value.replace("%", "").replace("+", "").trim();[39m
[31m+   const numeric = Number(normalized);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return Number.isFinite(numeric) ? numeric : 0;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getContributionEffectLabel([39m
[31m+   effectKey: string,[39m
[31m+   fallback: string,[39m
[31m+ ): string {[39m
[31m+   switch (effectKey) {[39m
[31m+     case "recovery_duration":[39m
[31m+       return "Recovery duration support";[39m
[31m+     case "daily_recovery_bonus":[39m
[31m+       return "Daily recovery support";[39m
[31m+     case "fatigue_floor_reduction":[39m
[31m+       return "Fatigue floor control";[39m
[31m+     case "injury_illness_risk":[39m
[31m+       return "Injury / illness protection";[39m
[31m+     case "tour_fatigue_reduction_pct":[39m
[31m+       return "Tour fatigue control";[39m
[31m+     case "mechanical_time_loss_reduction_pct":[39m
[31m+       return "Mechanical time-loss protection";[39m
[31m+     case "minor_injury_risk_reduction_pct":[39m
[31m+       return "Minor-injury protection";[39m
[31m+     case "race_fatigue_protection_pct":[39m
[31m+       return "Race fatigue control";[39m
[31m+     default:[39m
[31m+       return fallback;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getBreakdownForStandardizedGroup([39m
[31m+   group: JsonRecord,[39m
[31m+   fallbackBreakdownByBonusKey: Record<string, BonusBreakdownRow[]>,[39m
[31m+ ): BonusBreakdownRow[] {[39m
[31m+   const directBreakdown = toArray<JsonRecord>(group.breakdown)[39m
[31m+     .map((row) => normalizeBreakdownRow(row))[39m
[31m+     .filter(Boolean) as BonusBreakdownRow[];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (directBreakdown.length > 0) {[39m
[31m+     return directBreakdown;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const bonusKey = String(group.bonus_key ?? group.key ?? "");[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return fallbackBreakdownByBonusKey[bonusKey] ?? [];[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeBreakdownRow(row: JsonRecord): BonusBreakdownRow | null {[39m
[31m+   const effectKey = String(row.effect_key ?? row.key ?? "");[39m
[31m+   const effectLabel = String(row.effect_label ?? row.label ?? effectKey);[39m
[31m+   const rawValueText = String(row.raw_value ?? row.rawValue ?? row.value ?? "");[39m
[31m+   const contributionRaw = String([39m
[31m+     row.contribution_percent ??[39m
[31m+       row.contributionPercent ??[39m
[31m+       row.percent ??[39m
[31m+       row.points ??[39m
[31m+       "",[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const contributionPercent = parseSignedNumericValue(contributionRaw);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!effectLabel || !Number.isFinite(contributionPercent)) {[39m
[31m+     return null;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     sourceType: String(row.source_type ?? ""),[39m
[31m+     sourceLabel: String(row.source_label ?? row.source ?? "Bonus source"),[39m
[31m+     effectKey,[39m
[31m+     effectLabel,[39m
[31m+     rawValueText: rawValueText || contributionRaw,[39m
[31m+     contributionPercent: Math.abs(contributionPercent),[39m
[31m+     contributionLabel: `+${formatBonusPercent(Math.abs(contributionPercent))}%`,[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatBonusPercent(value: number): string {[39m
[31m+   if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return "0";[39m
[31m+   return value % 1 === 0 ? value.toFixed(0) : value.toFixed(1);[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+   | "team_time_trial_rider";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type StageRiderSupplyDraft = {[39m
[31m+   bidons: number;[39m

[31m+   stage?: { stage_format?: string | null } | null,[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeStageTacticPlan([39m
[31m+   value: unknown,[39m
[31m+   stage?: { stage_format?: string | null } | null,[39m
[31m+ ) {[39m
[31m+   const savedPlan = String(value ?? "");[39m
[31m+   const labels = getStageTacticPlanLabels(stage);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return labels[savedPlan] ? savedPlan : getDefaultStageTacticPlan(stage);[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+       return "fight_kom_points";[39m
[31m+     default:[39m

[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStagePlanKey(stage?: JsonRecord | null): string {[39m
[31m+   if (!stage) return "";[39m
[31m+   return String(stage.id ?? stage.stage_id ?? stage.stage_number ?? "");[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function findSavedStagePlan([39m
[31m+   stagePlans: JsonRecord[],[39m
[31m+   stage: JsonRecord | null,[39m
[31m+ ): JsonRecord | null {[39m
[31m+   if (!stage) return null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const stageId = String(stage.id ?? "");[39m
[31m+   const stageNumber = String(stage.stage_number ?? "");[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     stagePlans.find((plan) => {[39m
[31m+       const planStageId = String(plan.stage_id ?? "");[39m
[31m+       const planStageNumber = String(plan.stage_number ?? "");[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return ([39m
[31m+         (stageId && planStageId && planStageId === stageId) ||[39m
[31m+         (stageNumber && planStageNumber && planStageNumber === stageNumber)[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+     }) ?? null[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function findStagePlanReadiness([39m
[31m+   readinessByStageKey: Record<string, StagePlanReadinessStage>,[39m
[31m+   stage: JsonRecord | null,[39m
[31m+ ): StagePlanReadinessStage | null {[39m
[31m+   if (!stage) return null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const stageId = String(stage.id ?? stage.stage_id ?? "");[39m
[31m+   const stageNumber = String(stage.stage_number ?? "");[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     (stageId ? readinessByStageKey[stageId] : null) ??[39m
[31m+     (stageNumber ? readinessByStageKey[stageNumber] : null) ??[39m
[31m+     null[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStageDistanceNumber(stage?: JsonRecord | null): number {[39m
[31m+   if (!stage) return 0;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const direct = Number(stage.distance_km ?? stage.stage_distance_km);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (Number.isFinite(direct) && direct > 0) return direct;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const metadata = asRecord(stage.metadata);[39m
[31m+   const profile = asRecord(metadata.route_profile_v1);[39m
[31m+   const fallback = Number(profile.distance_km);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return Number.isFinite(fallback) && fallback > 0 ? fallback : 0;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatKmRangeValue(value: number): string {[39m
[31m+   if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return "0";[39m
[31m+   return value % 1 === 0 ? value.toFixed(0) : value.toFixed(1);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStagePhaseRanges(stage?: JsonRecord | null) {[39m
[31m+   const distance = getStageDistanceNumber(stage);[39m
[31m+   const safeDistance = distance > 0 ? distance : 120;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (isTimeTrialStage(stage)) {[39m
[31m+     const splitKm = Number((safeDistance / 2).toFixed(1));[39m
[31m+     const finishKm = Number(safeDistance.toFixed(1));[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return [[39m
[31m+       {[39m
[31m+         key: "before_split",[39m
[31m+         number: 1,[39m
[31m+         fromKm: 0,[39m
[31m+         toKm: splitKm,[39m
[31m+         label: "Before split",[39m
[31m+         rangeLabel: `${formatKmRangeValue(0)}–${formatKmRangeValue([39m
[31m+           splitKm,[39m
[31m+         )} km`,[39m
[31m+       },[39m
[31m+       {[39m
[31m+         key: "after_split",[39m
[31m+         number: 2,[39m
[31m+         fromKm: splitKm,[39m
[31m+         toKm: finishKm,[39m
[31m+         label: "After split",[39m
[31m+         rangeLabel: `${formatKmRangeValue(splitKm)}–${formatKmRangeValue([39m
[31m+           finishKm,[39m
[31m+         )} km`,[39m
[31m+       },[39m
[31m+     ];[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const phaseLength = safeDistance / 4;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return [0, 1, 2, 3].map((index) => {[39m
[31m+     const from = index === 0 ? 0 : Number((phaseLength * index).toFixed(1));[39m
[31m+     const to =[39m
[31m+       index === 3[39m
[31m+         ? Number(safeDistance.toFixed(1))[39m
[31m+         : Number((phaseLength * (index + 1)).toFixed(1));[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       key: `phase_${index + 1}`,[39m
[31m+       number: index + 1,[39m
[31m+       fromKm: from,[39m
[31m+       toKm: to,[39m
[31m+       label: `Phase ${index + 1}`,[39m
[31m+       rangeLabel: `${formatKmRangeValue(from)}–${formatKmRangeValue(to)} km`,[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function createDefaultIndividualTacticsForRider([39m
[31m+   stage?: JsonRecord | null,[39m
[31m+ ): Record<string, StageIndividualTacticPhaseCommand> {[39m
[31m+   return getStagePhaseRanges(stage).reduce([39m
[31m+     (acc, phase) => {[39m
[31m+       acc[phase.key] = {[39m
[31m+         command: "follow_team_plan",[39m
[31m+         from_km: phase.fromKm,[39m
[31m+         to_km: phase.toKm,[39m
[31m+         label: `${phase.label}: ${phase.rangeLabel}`,[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+       return acc;[39m
[31m+     },[39m
[31m+     {} as Record<string, StageIndividualTacticPhaseCommand>,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeIndividualTacticsForRider([39m
[31m+   value: unknown,[39m
[31m+   stage?: JsonRecord | null,[39m
[31m+ ): Record<string, StageIndividualTacticPhaseCommand> {[39m
[31m+   const saved = asRecord(value);[39m
[31m+   const fallback = createDefaultIndividualTacticsForRider(stage);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   getStagePhaseRanges(stage).forEach((phase) => {[39m
[31m+     const savedPhase = asRecord(saved[phase.key]);[39m
[31m+     const rawSavedCommand = String([39m
[31m+       savedPhase.command ?? saved[phase.key] ?? "",[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     const rawSavedUiCommand = String([39m
[31m+       savedPhase.ui_command ?? savedPhase.uiCommand ?? "",[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const candidateCommand = isTimeTrialStage(stage)[39m
[31m+       ? rawSavedUiCommand || rawSavedCommand[39m
[31m+       : rawSavedUiCommand ||[39m
[31m+         getRoadUiIndividualTacticCommand(rawSavedCommand, phase.key);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const allowedOptions = getStageIndividualTacticOptions(stage, phase.key);[39m
[31m+     const command = allowedOptions.some([39m
[31m+       (option) => option.value === candidateCommand,[39m
[31m+     )[39m
[31m+       ? candidateCommand[39m
[31m+       : "follow_team_plan";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     fallback[phase.key] = {[39m
[31m+       command,[39m
[31m+       ui_command: command,[39m
[31m+       from_km: phase.fromKm,[39m
[31m+       to_km: phase.toKm,[39m
[31m+       label: `${phase.label}: ${phase.rangeLabel}`,[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return fallback;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeRiderSupplyDraft(value: unknown): StageRiderSupplyDraft {[39m
[31m+   const record = asRecord(value);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     bidons: Number(record.bidons ?? record.bidons_water_bottles ?? 2),[39m
[31m+     gels: Number(record.gels ?? record.energy_gels ?? 2),[39m
[31m+     nutrition_packs: Number(record.nutrition_packs ?? 1),[39m
[31m+     race_jersey_complete: Boolean([39m
[31m+       record.race_jersey_complete ?? record.race_jersey ?? true,[39m
[31m+     ),[39m
[31m+     rain_jacket: Boolean(record.rain_jacket ?? record.rain_jackets ?? false),[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeStageRiderRole([39m
[31m+   value: unknown,[39m
[31m+   stage?: { stage_format?: string | null } | null,[39m
[31m+ ): StageRiderRoleCode | string {[39m
[31m+   if (isTimeTrialStage(stage)) {[39m
[31m+     return getTimeTrialStageRole(stage);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const savedRole = String(value ?? "");[39m
[31m+   const normalizedRole = LEGACY_STAGE_RIDER_ROLE_MAP[savedRole] ?? savedRole;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return STAGE_RIDER_ROLE_OPTIONS.some([39m
[31m+     (option) => option.value === normalizedRole,[39m
[31m+   )[39m
[31m+     ? normalizedRole[39m
[31m+     : DEFAULT_STAGE_RIDER_ROLE;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeRiderRolesForStage([39m
[31m+   riders: JsonRecord[],[39m
[31m+   riderRolesByRider: Record<string, StageRiderRoleCode | string>,[39m
[31m+   stage?: { stage_format?: string | null } | null,[39m
[31m+ ) {[39m
[31m+   return riders.reduce<Record<string, StageRiderRoleCode | string>>([39m
[31m+     (acc, rider) => {[39m
[31m+       const riderId = String(rider.id ?? "");[39m
[31m+       if (!riderId) return acc;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       acc[riderId] = normalizeStageRiderRole(riderRolesByRider[riderId], stage);[39m
[31m+       return acc;[39m
[31m+     },[39m
[31m+     {},[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeIndividualTacticsByRiderForStage([39m
[31m+   riders: JsonRecord[],[39m
[31m+   individualTacticsByRider: StageIndividualTacticsByRider,[39m
[31m+   stage?: JsonRecord | null,[39m
[31m+ ): StageIndividualTacticsByRider {[39m
[31m+   return riders.reduce<StageIndividualTacticsByRider>((acc, rider) => {[39m
[31m+     const riderId = String(rider.id ?? "");[39m
[31m+     if (!riderId) return acc;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const normalizedUiTactics = normalizeIndividualTacticsForRider([39m
[31m+       individualTacticsByRider[riderId],[39m
[31m+       stage,[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (isTimeTrialStage(stage)) {[39m
[31m+       acc[riderId] = normalizedUiTactics;[39m
[31m+       return acc;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     acc[riderId] = Object.entries(normalizedUiTactics).reduce<[39m
[31m+       Record<string, StageIndividualTacticPhaseCommand>[39m
[31m+     >((phaseAcc, [phaseKey, phaseCommand]) => {[39m
[31m+       phaseAcc[phaseKey] = {[39m
[31m+         ...phaseCommand,[39m
[31m+         ui_command: phaseCommand.command,[39m
[31m+         command: getRoadEngineIndividualTacticCommand(phaseCommand.command),[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+       return phaseAcc;[39m
[31m+     }, {});[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return acc;[39m
[31m+   }, {});[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function createStagePlanDraft({[39m
[31m+   riders,[39m
[31m+   equipmentPresetOptions,[39m
[31m+   savedPlan,[39m
[31m+   stage,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   riders: JsonRecord[];[39m
[31m+   equipmentPresetOptions: EquipmentSetupPresetOption[];[39m
[31m+   savedPlan?: JsonRecord | null;[39m
[31m+   stage?: JsonRecord | null;[39m
[31m+ }): StagePlanDraft {[39m
[31m+   const savedEquipment = asRecord([39m
[31m+     savedPlan?.rider_equipment_json ?? savedPlan?.equipment_json,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   const savedRoles = asRecord(savedPlan?.rider_roles_json);[39m
[31m+   const savedSupplies = asRecord(savedPlan?.rider_supplies_json);[39m
[31m+   const savedTactic = asRecord(savedPlan?.team_tactic_json);[39m
[31m+   const savedIndividualTactics = asRecord([39m
[31m+     savedPlan?.rider_individual_tactics_json,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   const defaultPresetId = equipmentPresetOptions[0]?.id ?? "";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const equipmentByRider: Record<string, string> = {};[39m
[31m+   const riderRolesByRider: Record<string, StageRiderRoleCode | string> = {};[39m
[31m+   const individualTacticsByRider: StageIndividualTacticsByRider = {};[39m
[31m+   const suppliesByRider: Record<string, StageRiderSupplyDraft> = {};[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   riders.forEach((rider) => {[39m
[31m+     const riderId = String(rider.id ?? "");[39m
[31m+     if (!riderId) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     equipmentByRider[riderId] = String([39m
[31m+       savedEquipment[riderId] ?? defaultPresetId,[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     riderRolesByRider[riderId] = normalizeStageRiderRole([39m
[31m+       savedRoles[riderId],[39m
[31m+       stage,[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     individualTacticsByRider[riderId] = normalizeIndividualTacticsForRider([39m
[31m+       savedIndividualTactics[riderId],[39m
[31m+       stage,[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     suppliesByRider[riderId] = normalizeRiderSupplyDraft([39m
[31m+       savedSupplies[riderId],[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     equipmentByRider,[39m
[31m+     riderRolesByRider,[39m
[31m+     individualTacticsByRider,[39m
[31m+     suppliesByRider,[39m
[31m+     teamTactic: {[39m
[31m+       plan: normalizeStageTacticPlan([39m
[31m+         savedTactic.plan ?? savedPlan?.team_strategy,[39m
[31m+         stage,[39m
[31m+       ),[39m
[31m+       notes: String(savedTactic.notes ?? savedPlan?.tactical_notes ?? ""),[39m
[31m+     },[39m
[31m+     lastSavedAt: savedPlan?.last_saved_at[39m
[31m+       ? String(savedPlan.last_saved_at)[39m
[31m+       : null,[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getSavedStagePlanDraftSignature(savedPlan?: JsonRecord | null): string {[39m
[31m+   if (!savedPlan) return "no-saved-plan";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return JSON.stringify({[39m
[31m+     id: savedPlan.id ?? null,[39m
[31m+     last_saved_at: savedPlan.last_saved_at ?? null,[39m
[31m+     updated_at: savedPlan.updated_at ?? null,[39m
[31m+     status: savedPlan.status ?? null,[39m
[31m+     team_tactic_json: savedPlan.team_tactic_json ?? null,[39m
[31m+     rider_roles_json: savedPlan.rider_roles_json ?? null,[39m
[31m+     rider_individual_tactics_json:[39m
[31m+       savedPlan.rider_individual_tactics_json ?? null,[39m
[31m+     rider_equipment_json:[39m
[31m+       savedPlan.rider_equipment_json ?? savedPlan.equipment_json ?? null,[39m
[31m+     rider_supplies_json: savedPlan.rider_supplies_json ?? null,[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function reconcileStagePlanDraftWithCurrentData({[39m
[31m+   current,[39m
[31m+   riders,[39m
[31m+   equipmentPresetOptions,[39m
[31m+   savedPlan,[39m
[31m+   stage,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   current: StagePlanDraft;[39m
[31m+   riders: JsonRecord[];[39m
[31m+   equipmentPresetOptions: EquipmentSetupPresetOption[];[39m
[31m+   savedPlan?: JsonRecord | null;[39m
[31m+   stage?: JsonRecord | null;[39m
[31m+ }): StagePlanDraft {[39m
[31m+   /*[39m
[31m+    * Background Race Preparation refreshes can replace riders/options/stages[39m
[31m+    * with new array/object references even though the manager is still editing[39m
[31m+    * the same Stage Plan. Reconcile structural data without replacing local[39m
[31m+    * selections. This keeps unsaved roles, tactics, equipment and supplies[39m
[31m+    * stable until the manager explicitly saves or changes race/preparation.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   const fallback = createStagePlanDraft({[39m
[31m+     riders,[39m
[31m+     equipmentPresetOptions,[39m
[31m+     savedPlan,[39m
[31m+     stage,[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   riders.forEach((rider) => {[39m
[31m+     const riderId = String(rider.id ?? "");[39m
[31m+     if (!riderId) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (current.equipmentByRider[riderId] !== undefined) {[39m
[31m+       fallback.equipmentByRider[riderId] = current.equipmentByRider[riderId];[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (current.riderRolesByRider[riderId] !== undefined) {[39m
[31m+       fallback.riderRolesByRider[riderId] = normalizeStageRiderRole([39m
[31m+         current.riderRolesByRider[riderId],[39m
[31m+         stage,[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (current.individualTacticsByRider[riderId] !== undefined) {[39m
[31m+       fallback.individualTacticsByRider[riderId] =[39m
[31m+         normalizeIndividualTacticsForRider([39m
[31m+           current.individualTacticsByRider[riderId],[39m
[31m+           stage,[39m
[31m+         );[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (current.suppliesByRider[riderId] !== undefined) {[39m
[31m+       fallback.suppliesByRider[riderId] = {[39m
[31m+         ...current.suppliesByRider[riderId],[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     ...fallback,[39m
[31m+     teamTactic: { ...current.teamTactic },[39m
[31m+     lastSavedAt: current.lastSavedAt ?? fallback.lastSavedAt ?? null,[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function parseGameTimestamp(value: unknown): number | null {[39m
[31m+   if (!value) return null;[39m
[31m+   const text = String(value).trim();[39m
[31m+   if (!text) return null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const normalized = text.includes("T") ? text : text.replace(" ", "T");[39m
[31m+   const parsed = Date.parse(normalized);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStageStartTimestamp(stage: JsonRecord): number | null {[39m
[31m+   const dateText = String([39m
[31m+     stage.stage_date ?? stage.date ?? stage.start_date ?? "",[39m
[31m+   ).slice(0, 10);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(dateText)) return null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const hour = Number([39m
[31m+     stage.planned_start_hour_number ??[39m
[31m+       stage.planned_start_hour ??[39m
[31m+       stage.start_hour ??[39m
[31m+       0,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   const minute = Number(stage.planned_start_minute ?? stage.start_minute ?? 0);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const safeHour = Number.isFinite(hour) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(23, hour)) : 0;[39m
[31m+   const safeMinute = Number.isFinite(minute)[39m
[31m+     ? Math.max(0, Math.min(59, minute))[39m
[31m+     : 0;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return Date.parse([39m
[31m+     `${dateText}T${String(safeHour).padStart(2, "0")}:${String([39m
[31m+       safeMinute,[39m
[31m+     ).padStart(2, "0")}:00`,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatGameTimestampLabel(value: number | null) {[39m
[31m+   if (value === null || !Number.isFinite(value)) return "—";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const date = new Date(value);[39m
[31m+   const season = date.getUTCFullYear() - 1999;[39m
[31m+   const weekday = date.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {[39m
[31m+     weekday: "short",[39m
[31m+     timeZone: "UTC",[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+   const monthLabel = monthLabels[date.getUTCMonth()] ?? "—";[39m
[31m+   const day = String(date.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, "0");[39m
[31m+   const hour = String(date.getUTCHours()).padStart(2, "0");[39m
[31m+   const minute = String(date.getUTCMinutes()).padStart(2, "0");[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return `S${season} · ${weekday} · ${monthLabel} ${day} · ${hour}:${minute}`;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStagePlanLockInfo({[39m
[31m+   stage,[39m
[31m+   currentGameTimestamp,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   stage: JsonRecord | null;[39m
[31m+   currentGameTimestamp?: string;[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const baseLabel = `Locks ${STAGE_PLAN_LOCK_HOURS_BEFORE_START} hours before stage start`;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!stage) {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       isLocked: false,[39m
[31m+       lockLabel: baseLabel,[39m
[31m+       lockMessage: "",[39m
[31m+       statusLabel: "Open",[39m
[31m+       statusTone: "open" as const,[39m
[31m+       statusHint: "Select a stage to see the exact lock time.",[39m
[31m+       lockAtLabel: "—",[39m
[31m+       stageStartLabel: "—",[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const stageStartTs = getStageStartTimestamp(stage);[39m
[31m+   const currentTs = parseGameTimestamp(currentGameTimestamp);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (stageStartTs === null || currentTs === null) {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       isLocked: false,[39m
[31m+       lockLabel: baseLabel,[39m
[31m+       lockMessage: "",[39m
[31m+       statusLabel: "Open",[39m
[31m+       statusTone: "open" as const,[39m
[31m+       statusHint: "Exact lock timing is not available from the current data.",[39m
[31m+       lockAtLabel: "—",[39m
[31m+       stageStartLabel: "—",[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const lockTs =[39m
[31m+     stageStartTs - STAGE_PLAN_LOCK_HOURS_BEFORE_START * 60 * 60 * 1000;[39m
[31m+   const isLocked = currentTs >= lockTs;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     isLocked,[39m
[31m+     lockLabel: baseLabel,[39m
[31m+     lockAtLabel: formatGameTimestampLabel(lockTs),[39m
[31m+     stageStartLabel: formatGameTimestampLabel(stageStartTs),[39m
[31m+     statusLabel: isLocked ? "Locked" : "Open",[39m
[31m+     statusTone: isLocked ? ("locked" as const) : ("open" as const),[39m
[31m+     statusHint: isLocked[39m
[31m+       ? "This stage plan is locked because the current game time is already at or after the stage lock time."[39m
[31m+       : "This stage plan is still open and can be edited until the lock time is reached.",[39m
[31m+     lockMessage: isLocked[39m
[31m+       ? `Stage Plan locked. This stage starts in less than ${STAGE_PLAN_LOCK_HOURS_BEFORE_START} hours, so changes can no longer be saved.`[39m
[31m+       : "",[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function StagePlansTab({[39m
[31m+   target,[39m
[31m+   packageSubmitted,[39m

[31m+           previousSavedSignature !== savedSignature;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         /*[39m
[31m+          * Never overwrite a locally edited Stage Plan because some unrelated[39m
[31m+          * background request refreshed riders/options/stage objects. Only a[39m
[31m+          * genuine server Stage Plan change may replace a clean local draft.[39m
[31m+          */[39m
[31m+         if (!previousDraft || (!isDirty && serverSavedPlanChanged)) {[39m
[31m+           next[key] = createStagePlanDraft({[39m
[31m+             riders: selectedRiders,[39m
[31m+             equipmentPresetOptions,[39m
[31m+             savedPlan,[39m
[31m+             stage,[39m
[31m+           });[39m
[31m+           return;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         next[key] = reconcileStagePlanDraftWithCurrentData({[39m
[31m+           current: previousDraft,[39m
[31m+           riders: selectedRiders,[39m
[31m+           equipmentPresetOptions,[39m
[31m+           savedPlan,[39m
[31m+           stage,[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return next;[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     stageDraftPreparationIdRef.current = preparationId;[39m
[31m+     savedStagePlanSignaturesRef.current = nextSavedSignatures;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (preparationChanged) {[39m
[31m+       setStageSaveMessage(null);[39m
[31m+       setStageSaveError(null);[39m
[31m+       setSportDirectorSuggestion(null);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }, [[39m
[31m+     target?.preparation?.id,[39m
[31m+     stages,[39m
[31m+     stagePlans,[39m
[31m+     selectedRiders,[39m
[31m+     equipmentPresetOptions,[39m
[31m+   ]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function updateSelectedStageDraft([39m
[31m+     updater: (current: StagePlanDraft) => StagePlanDraft,[39m
[31m+   ) {[39m
[31m+     if (!selectedStageKey) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     dirtyStageDraftKeysRef.current.add(selectedStageKey);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     setStageDraftsByStageKey((prev) => {[39m
[31m+       const current =[39m
[31m+         prev[selectedStageKey] ??[39m
[31m+         createStagePlanDraft({[39m
[31m+           riders: selectedRiders,[39m
[31m+           equipmentPresetOptions,[39m
[31m+           savedPlan: selectedSavedStagePlan,[39m
[31m+           stage: selectedStage,[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return {[39m
[31m+         ...prev,[39m
[31m+         [selectedStageKey]: updater(current),[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     setStageSaveMessage(null);[39m
[31m+     setStageSaveError(null);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   async function handleSaveStagePlan() {[39m
[31m+     if (!target || !selectedStage || !selectedStageKey) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const preparation = asRecord(target.preparation);[39m
[31m+     const race = asRecord(target.race);[39m
[31m+     const entry = asRecord(target.entry);[39m
[31m+     const racePreparationId = String(preparation.id ?? "");[39m
[31m+     const resolvedRaceId = String(race.id ?? raceId ?? "");[39m
[31m+     const clubId = String(preparation.club_id ?? entry.club_id ?? "");[39m
[31m+     const stageNumber = Number([39m
[31m+       selectedStage.stage_number ?? selectedStageIndex + 1,[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     const selectedStageId = String(selectedStage.id ?? "");[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (!racePreparationId || !resolvedRaceId || !clubId || !stageNumber) {[39m
[31m+       setStageSaveError([39m
[31m+         "Cannot save this stage plan because required IDs are missing.",[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (targetRaceAllWeatherCanceled) {[39m
[31m+       setStageSaveError([39m
[31m+         "This race was canceled due to weather, so Stage Plans are locked.",[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (lockInfo.isLocked) {[39m
[31m+       setStageSaveError(lockInfo.lockMessage);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (selectedStageWeatherCanceled) {[39m
[31m+       setStageSaveError([39m
[31m+         "This stage was canceled due to weather, so no Stage Plan can be saved.",[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (stagePlanControlsReadOnly) {[39m
[31m+       setStageSaveError([39m
[31m+         "This Stage Plan is managed by the U23 Head Coach and is view-only. Switch the Tactical Planner to Sport Director in the Race Plan before making manual changes.",[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     setSavingStagePlan(true);[39m
[31m+     setStageSaveMessage(null);[39m
[31m+     setStageSaveError(null);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const stagePhaseRanges = getStagePhaseRanges(selectedStage);[39m
[31m+       const riderIndividualTacticsJson =[39m
[31m+         normalizeIndividualTacticsByRiderForStage([39m
[31m+           selectedRiders,[39m
[31m+           selectedDraft.individualTacticsByRider,[39m
[31m+           selectedStage,[39m
[31m+         );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const result = await saveRaceStagePlan({[39m
[31m+         club_id: clubId,[39m
[31m+         race_preparation_id: racePreparationId,[39m
[31m+         race_id: resolvedRaceId,[39m
[31m+         stage_id: selectedStageId || null,[39m
[31m+         stage_number: stageNumber,[39m
[31m+         team_tactic_json: {[39m
[31m+           plan: normalizeStageTacticPlan([39m
[31m+             selectedDraft.teamTactic.plan,[39m
[31m+             selectedStage,[39m
[31m+           ),[39m
[31m+           engine_model_version: STAGE_TACTIC_ENGINE_MODEL_V1.version,[39m
[31m+           race_situation_factors: getStageRaceSituationFactors(selectedStage),[39m
[31m+           stage_phase_ranges: stagePhaseRanges,[39m
[31m+           phase_count: stagePhaseRanges.length,[39m
[31m+           is_time_trial_stage: isTTStage,[39m
[31m+           is_team_time_trial_stage: isTTTStage,[39m
[31m+         },[39m
[31m+         rider_individual_tactics_json: riderIndividualTacticsJson,[39m
[31m+         rider_roles_json: normalizeRiderRolesForStage([39m
[31m+           selectedRiders,[39m
[31m+           selectedDraft.riderRolesByRider,[39m
[31m+           selectedStage,[39m
[31m+         ),[39m
[31m+         rider_equipment_json: selectedDraft.equipmentByRider,[39m
[31m+         rider_supplies_json: isTTStage ? {} : selectedDraft.suppliesByRider,[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       setStageDraftsByStageKey((prev) => ({[39m
[31m+         ...prev,[39m
[31m+         [selectedStageKey]: {[39m
[31m+           ...selectedDraft,[39m
[31m+           lastSavedAt:[39m
[31m+             typeof result.last_saved_at === "string"[39m
[31m+               ? result.last_saved_at[39m
[31m+               : new Date().toISOString(),[39m
[31m+         },[39m
[31m+       }));[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       dirtyStageDraftKeysRef.current.delete(selectedStageKey);[39m
[31m+       setStageSaveMessage("Stage Plan saved for this stage.");[39m
[31m+       await Promise.all([[39m
[31m+         loadStagePlanReadinessForCurrentTarget(),[39m
[31m+         loadU23AutomationDashboardForCurrentTarget(),[39m
[31m+       ]);[39m
[31m+     } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+       setStageSaveError([39m
[31m+         error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to save Stage Plan.",[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+     } finally {[39m
[31m+       setSavingStagePlan(false);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   async function handleAskSportDirector([39m
[31m+     section: SportDirectorSuggestionSection,[39m
[31m+   ) {[39m
[31m+     if (!target || !selectedStage || !selectedStageKey) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (!hasSportDirectorAssigned || isU23ManagedRace) {[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const preparation = asRecord(target.preparation);[39m
[31m+     const race = asRecord(target.race);[39m
[31m+     const entry = asRecord(target.entry);[39m
[31m+     const racePreparationId = String(preparation.id ?? "");[39m
[31m+     const resolvedClubId = String(preparation.club_id ?? entry.club_id ?? "");[39m
[31m+     const selectedStageId = String(selectedStage.id ?? "");[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (!racePreparationId || !resolvedClubId || !selectedStageId) {[39m
[31m+       setStageSaveError([39m
[31m+         "Cannot ask the Sport Director because required IDs are missing.",[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (targetRaceAllWeatherCanceled) {[39m
[31m+       setStageSaveError([39m
[31m+         "This race was canceled due to weather, so the Sport Director cannot create Stage Plans for it.",[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (lockInfo.isLocked) {[39m
[31m+       setStageSaveError(lockInfo.lockMessage);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (selectedStageWeatherCanceled) {[39m
[31m+       setStageSaveError([39m
[31m+         "This stage was canceled due to weather, so the Sport Director cannot create a Stage Plan for it.",[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     setSportDirectorLoading(true);[39m
[31m+     setSportDirectorSuggestion(null);[39m
[31m+     setStageSaveMessage(null);[39m
[31m+     setStageSaveError(null);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     try {[39m
[31m+       const result = (await askSportDirectorForStagePlan({[39m
[31m+         racePreparationId,[39m
[31m+         stageId: selectedStageId,[39m
[31m+         clubId: resolvedClubId,[39m
[31m+       })) as SportDirectorSuggestionResponse;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const resultRecord = asRecord(result);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (String(resultRecord.status ?? "") !== "ok") {[39m
[31m+         setStageSaveError([39m
[31m+           String([39m
[31m+             resultRecord.message ??[39m
[31m+               resultRecord.safe_frontend_label ??[39m
[31m+               "Sport Director could not create a suggestion for this stage.",[39m
[31m+           ),[39m
[31m+         );[39m
[31m+         return;[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const suggestion = asRecord(resultRecord.suggestion);[39m
[31m+       const suggestedRoles = asRecord(suggestion.rider_roles_json);[39m
[31m+       const suggestedEquipment = asRecord(suggestion.rider_equipment_json);[39m
[31m+       const suggestedSupplies = asRecord(suggestion.rider_supplies_json);[39m
[31m+       const suggestedTeamTactic = asRecord(suggestion.team_tactic_json);[39m
[31m+       const suggestedIndividualTactics = asRecord([39m
[31m+         suggestion.rider_individual_tactics_json,[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       updateSelectedStageDraft((current) => {[39m

[31m+         const nextEquipmentByRider = { ...current.equipmentByRider };[39m
[31m+         const nextSuppliesByRider = { ...current.suppliesByRider };[39m
[31m+         const nextIndividualTacticsByRider = {[39m
[31m+           ...current.individualTacticsByRider,[39m
[31m+         };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         const roleHintsForEquipment = {[39m
[31m+           ...current.riderRolesByRider,[39m
[31m+           ...suggestedRoles,[39m
[31m+         };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         const smartEquipmentSuggestion = buildSportDirectorEquipmentSuggestion({[39m
[31m+           riders: selectedRiders,[39m
[31m+           stage: selectedStage,[39m
[31m+           equipmentPresetOptions,[39m
[31m+           currentEquipmentByRider: current.equipmentByRider,[39m
[31m+           suggestedRoles: roleHintsForEquipment,[39m
[31m+           backendEquipment: suggestedEquipment,[39m
[31m+         });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         selectedRiders.forEach((rider) => {[39m
[31m+           const riderId = String(rider.id ?? "");[39m
[31m+           if (!riderId) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           if (section === "team" && suggestedRoles[riderId] !== undefined) {[39m
[31m+             nextRolesByRider[riderId] = normalizeStageRiderRole([39m
[31m+               suggestedRoles[riderId],[39m
[31m+               selectedStage,[39m
[31m+             );[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           if ([39m
[31m+             section === "equipment" &&[39m
[31m+             smartEquipmentSuggestion[riderId] !== undefined[39m
[31m+           ) {[39m
[31m+             nextEquipmentByRider[riderId] = String([39m
[31m+               smartEquipmentSuggestion[riderId],[39m
[31m+             );[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           if ([39m
[31m+             section === "supplies" &&[39m
[31m+             suggestedSupplies[riderId] !== undefined[39m
[31m+           ) {[39m
[31m+             nextSuppliesByRider[riderId] = normalizeRiderSupplyDraft([39m
[31m+               suggestedSupplies[riderId],[39m

[31m+           if ([39m
[31m+             section === "individual" &&[39m
[31m+             suggestedIndividualTactics[riderId] !== undefined[39m
[31m+           ) {[39m
[31m+             nextIndividualTacticsByRider[riderId] =[39m
[31m+               normalizeIndividualTacticsForRider([39m

[31m+                 selectedStage,[39m
[31m+               );[39m
[31m+           }[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+         const nextDraft: StagePlanDraft = { ...current };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         if (section === "team") {[39m
[31m+           nextDraft.riderRolesByRider = nextRolesByRider;[39m
[31m+           nextDraft.teamTactic = {[39m

[31m+               suggestedTeamTactic.plan ?? current.teamTactic.plan,[39m
[31m+               selectedStage,[39m
[31m+             ),[39m
[31m+             notes: String([39m
[31m+               suggestedTeamTactic.notes ??[39m
[31m+                 current.teamTactic.notes ??[39m
[31m+                 "Auto-filled by Sport Director suggestion.",[39m
[31m+             ),[39m
[31m+           };[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         if (section === "equipment") {[39m
[31m+           nextDraft.equipmentByRider = nextEquipmentByRider;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         if (section === "supplies") {[39m
[31m+           nextDraft.suppliesByRider = isTTStage ? {} : nextSuppliesByRider;[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+         if (section === "individual") {[39m

[31m+       setSportDirectorSuggestion(result);[39m
[31m+       setStageSaveMessage([39m

[31m+       <section className="rounded-2xl border bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">[39m
[31m+         <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">[39m

[31m+               Stage Plans[39m
[31m+             </h2>[39m
[31m+             <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">[39m

[31m+                 </div>[39m
