[31m+[39m
[31m+ function formatTimestampLabel(value: string): string {[39m
[31m+   const parsed = new Date(value);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!Number.isFinite(parsed.getTime())) return value;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return parsed.toLocaleString(undefined, {[39m
[31m+     month: "short",[39m
[31m+     day: "2-digit",[39m
[31m+     hour: "2-digit",[39m
[31m+     minute: "2-digit",[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStageDisplayName(stage: JsonRecord, fallbackNumber: string) {[39m
[31m+   return String([39m
[31m+     stage.stage_name ??[39m
[31m+       stage.stage_title ??[39m
[31m+       stage.name ??[39m
[31m+       stage.route_label ??[39m
[31m+       `Stage ${fallbackNumber}`,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStageRoute(stage: JsonRecord) {[39m
[31m+   const routeLabel = String(stage.route_label ?? "").trim();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (routeLabel) return routeLabel;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const start = String(stage.start_city ?? "").trim();[39m
[31m+   const finish = String(stage.finish_city ?? "").trim();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (start && finish && start !== finish) return `${start} → ${finish}`;[39m
[31m+   if (start && finish && start === finish) return `${start} circuit`;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return start || finish || "Route details pending";[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStageStartTime(stage: JsonRecord) {[39m
[31m+   const directLabel = String(stage.planned_start_time_label ?? "").trim();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (directLabel) return directLabel;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const hour = Number(stage.planned_start_hour_number);[39m
[31m+   const minute = Number(stage.planned_start_minute);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!Number.isFinite(hour) || !Number.isFinite(minute)) return "";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return `${String(hour).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(minute).padStart(2, "0")}`;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStageProfileLabel(stage: JsonRecord) {[39m
[31m+   const value = String([39m
[31m+     stage.profile_type ?? stage.terrain_type ?? stage.stage_type ?? "",[39m
[31m+   ).trim();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!value) return "Profile pending";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return titleFromSnake(value);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStageDistance(stage: JsonRecord) {[39m
[31m+   const distance = Number(stage.distance_km);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!Number.isFinite(distance) || distance <= 0) return "";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return `${distance.toFixed(distance % 1 === 0 ? 0 : 1)} km`;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStageFinishLabel(stage: JsonRecord) {[39m
[31m+   const finishType = String(stage.finish_type ?? "").trim();[39m
[31m+   const summit = Boolean(stage.is_summit_finish);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (summit) return "Summit finish";[39m
[31m+   if (finishType) return titleFromSnake(finishType);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return "Finish details pending";[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function pickStageWeatherRecord(profile: JsonRecord | null, stage: JsonRecord) {[39m
[31m+   const stageMetadata = asRecord(stage.metadata);[39m
[31m+   const profileMetadata = asRecord(profile?.metadata);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   /**[39m
[31m+    * Race Page uses race_stages.weather_snapshot.[39m
[31m+    * Stage Plans previously only checked weather_json / weather_snapshot_json,[39m
[31m+    * so generated weather existed but was invisible here.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   const candidates = [[39m
[31m+     asRecord(profile?.weather_snapshot),[39m
[31m+     asRecord(profile?.weather_json),[39m
[31m+     asRecord(profile?.weather_snapshot_json),[39m
[31m+     asRecord(profile?.stage_weather_json),[39m
[31m+     asRecord(profile?.weather),[39m
[31m+     asRecord(profileMetadata.weather_snapshot),[39m
[31m+     asRecord(profileMetadata.weather),[39m
[31m+     asRecord(profileMetadata.stage_weather),[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     asRecord(stage.weather_snapshot),[39m
[31m+     asRecord(stage.weather_json),[39m
[31m+     asRecord(stage.weather_snapshot_json),[39m
[31m+     asRecord(stage.stage_weather_json),[39m
[31m+     asRecord(stage.weather),[39m
[31m+     asRecord(stageMetadata.weather_snapshot),[39m
[31m+     asRecord(stageMetadata.weather),[39m
[31m+     asRecord(stageMetadata.stage_weather),[39m
[31m+   ];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     candidates.find((candidate) => Object.keys(candidate).length > 0) ?? {}[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function pickWeatherNumber(record: JsonRecord, keys: string[]): number | null {[39m
[31m+   for (const key of keys) {[39m
[31m+     const value = Number(record[key]);[39m
[31m+     if (Number.isFinite(value)) return value;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return null;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getWeatherConditionLabel(record: JsonRecord): string {[39m
[31m+   const value = String([39m
[31m+     record.condition_label ??[39m
[31m+       record.label ??[39m
[31m+       record.name ??[39m
[31m+       record.condition ??[39m
[31m+       record.summary ??[39m
[31m+       record.weather_summary ??[39m
[31m+       record.weather ??[39m
[31m+       "",[39m
[31m+   ).trim();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return value ? titleFromSnake(value) : "";[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getWeatherRainLabel(record: JsonRecord): string {[39m
[31m+   const rainChance = pickWeatherNumber(record, [[39m
[31m+     "rain_chance_pct",[39m
[31m+     "rain_probability_pct",[39m
[31m+     "precipitation_chance_pct",[39m
[31m+     "precipitation_probability_pct",[39m
[31m+     "chance_of_rain_pct",[39m
[31m+   ]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (rainChance !== null) {[39m
[31m+     return `${Math.round(rainChance)}%`;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const rainMm = pickWeatherNumber(record, [[39m
[31m+     "avg_precip_mm",[39m
[31m+     "precip_mm",[39m
[31m+     "precipitation_mm",[39m
[31m+     "rain_mm",[39m
[31m+     "avg_rain_mm",[39m
[31m+   ]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (rainMm !== null) {[39m
[31m+     return rainMm === 0 ? "—" : `${rainMm.toFixed(1)} mm`;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return "—";[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getWeatherIcon(record: JsonRecord): string {[39m
[31m+   const text = String([39m
[31m+     record.icon ??[39m
[31m+       record.weather_icon ??[39m
[31m+       record.condition_icon ??[39m
[31m+       record.condition ??[39m
[31m+       record.summary ??[39m
[31m+       "",[39m
[31m+   ).toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (text.includes("rain") || text.includes("shower")) return "🌧️";[39m
[31m+   if (text.includes("storm") || text.includes("thunder")) return "⛈️";[39m
[31m+   if (text.includes("cloud")) return "☁️";[39m
[31m+   if (text.includes("wind")) return "💨";[39m
[31m+   if (text.includes("snow")) return "❄️";[39m
[31m+   if (text.includes("sun") || text.includes("clear")) return "☀️";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return "🌤️";[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function StageWeatherMiniCard({[39m
[31m+   profile,[39m
[31m+   stage,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   profile: JsonRecord | null;[39m
[31m+   stage: JsonRecord;[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const weather = pickStageWeatherRecord(profile, stage);[39m
[31m+   const temperature = pickWeatherNumber(weather, [[39m
[31m+     "temperature_c",[39m
[31m+     "temp_c",[39m
[31m+     "avg_temperature_c",[39m
[31m+     "average_temperature_c",[39m
[31m+     "avg_temp_c",[39m
[31m+     "average_temp_c",[39m
[31m+     "temperature",[39m
[31m+   ]);[39m
[31m+   const minTemperature = pickWeatherNumber(weather, [[39m
[31m+     "min_temperature_c",[39m
[31m+     "avg_min_temp_c",[39m
[31m+     "min_temp_c",[39m
[31m+   ]);[39m
[31m+   const maxTemperature = pickWeatherNumber(weather, [[39m
[31m+     "max_temperature_c",[39m
[31m+     "avg_max_temp_c",[39m
[31m+     "max_temp_c",[39m
[31m+   ]);[39m
[31m+   const wind = pickWeatherNumber(weather, [[39m
[31m+     "wind_kph",[39m
[31m+     "wind_speed_kph",[39m
[31m+     "wind_km_h",[39m
[31m+     "wind_kmh",[39m
[31m+     "avg_wind_kmh",[39m
[31m+     "wind_speed",[39m
[31m+     "wind",[39m
[31m+   ]);[39m
[31m+   const conditionLabel = getWeatherConditionLabel(weather);[39m
[31m+   const rainLabel = getWeatherRainLabel(weather);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const hasWeather =[39m
[31m+     temperature !== null ||[39m
[31m+     minTemperature !== null ||[39m
[31m+     maxTemperature !== null ||[39m
[31m+     wind !== null ||[39m
[31m+     rainLabel !== "—" ||[39m
[31m+     conditionLabel ||[39m
[31m+     Object.keys(weather).length > 0;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white/80 px-3 py-3">[39m
[31m+       <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-400">[39m
[31m+         <span className="text-base">{getWeatherIcon(weather)}</span>[39m
[31m+         Stage weather[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {isPreparationStageWeatherCanceled(stage) ? ([39m
[31m+         <div className="mt-2 rounded-lg border border-sky-200 bg-sky-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-5 text-sky-800">[39m
[31m+           Canceled:{" "}[39m
[31m+           {getPreparationWeatherCancellationReasonLabel([39m
[31m+             getPreparationStageWeatherCancellationReason(stage),[39m
[31m+           )}[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       ) : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {hasWeather ? ([39m
[31m+         <div className="mt-2 grid gap-2 text-sm text-slate-700 sm:grid-cols-3">[39m
[31m+           <div>[39m
[31m+             <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Temp</div>[39m
[31m+             <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+               {temperature !== null ? `${temperature.toFixed(1)}°C` : "—"}[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+           <div>[39m
[31m+             <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Wind</div>[39m
[31m+             <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+               {wind !== null ? `${Math.round(wind)} km/h` : "—"}[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+           <div>[39m
[31m+             <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Rain</div>[39m
[31m+             <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{rainLabel}</div>[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       ) : ([39m
[31m+         <div className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+           Weather data not available for this stage yet.[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       )}[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function SelectedStagePlanProfileCard({ stage }: { stage: JsonRecord }) {[39m
[31m+   const [profile, setProfile] = useState<JsonRecord | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const stageId = String(stage.id ?? "");[39m
[31m+   const stageNumber = String(stage.stage_number ?? "—");[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (!stageId) {[39m
[31m+       setProfile(null);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     let cancelled = false;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     async function loadProfile() {[39m
[31m+       setLoading(true);[39m
[31m+       setErrorMessage(null);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       try {[39m
[31m+         const result = await loadRaceStageProfileDetail(stageId);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         if (!cancelled) {[39m
[31m+           setProfile(result);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       } catch (error) {[39m
[31m+         if (!cancelled) {[39m
[31m+           setProfile(null);[39m
[31m+           setErrorMessage([39m
[31m+             error instanceof Error[39m
[31m+               ? error.message[39m
[31m+               : "Failed to load stage profile.",[39m
[31m+           );[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       } finally {[39m
[31m+         if (!cancelled) {[39m
[31m+           setLoading(false);[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     void loadProfile();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return () => {[39m
[31m+       cancelled = true;[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }, [stageId]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const profileData = profile?.has_profile ? profile : null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="mt-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-4">[39m
[31m+       <div className="grid gap-5 xl:grid-cols-[0.58fr_1.42fr]">[39m
[31m+         <div className="min-w-0">[39m
[31m+           <div className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+             Selected stage profile[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           <h3 className="mt-1 text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+             Stage {stageNumber}: {getStageDisplayName(stage, stageNumber)}[39m
[31m+           </h3>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-4 grid gap-2">[39m
[31m+             <CompactStageInfo[39m
[31m+               label="Date"[39m
[31m+               value={formatFullStageDateTime(stage)}[39m
[31m+             />[39m
[31m+             <CompactStageInfo label="Route" value={getStageRoute(stage)} />[39m
[31m+             <CompactStageInfo[39m
[31m+               label="Profile"[39m
[31m+               value={[39m
[31m+                 profileData?.profile_type[39m
[31m+                   ? titleFromSnake(String(profileData.profile_type))[39m
[31m+                   : getStageProfileLabel(stage)[39m
[31m+               }[39m
[31m+             />[39m
[31m+             <CompactStageInfo[39m
[31m+               label="Distance"[39m
[31m+               value={[39m
[31m+                 profileData?.distance_km[39m
[31m+                   ? `${Number(profileData.distance_km).toFixed([39m
[31m+                       Number(profileData.distance_km) % 1 === 0 ? 0 : 1,[39m
[31m+                     )} km`[39m
[31m+                   : getStageDistance(stage) || "—"[39m
[31m+               }[39m
[31m+             />[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           <StageWeatherMiniCard profile={profile} stage={stage} />[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <div className="rounded-2xl bg-white p-4">[39m
[31m+           {loading ? ([39m
[31m+             <div className="flex min-h-[360px] items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 text-sm text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+               Loading stage profile…[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+           ) : errorMessage ? ([39m
[31m+             <div className="flex min-h-[360px] items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 px-4 text-sm text-rose-700">[39m
[31m+               {errorMessage}[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+           ) : profileData ? ([39m
[31m+             <StagePlanProfileChart profile={profileData} stage={stage} />[39m
[31m+           ) : ([39m
[31m+             <div className="flex min-h-[360px] items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 text-sm text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+               Stage profile data is not available from the backend yet.[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+           )}[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function CompactStageInfo({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="rounded-xl bg-white/70 px-3 py-2">[39m
[31m+       <div className="text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-400">[39m
[31m+         {label}[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+       <div className="mt-0.5 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">{value}</div>[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type StagePlanProfilePoint = {[39m
[31m+   km: number;[39m
[31m+   elevation_m: number;[39m
[31m+ };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type StagePlanProfileMarker = {[39m
[31m+   km: number;[39m
[31m+   type: string;[39m
[31m+   label: string;[39m
[31m+ };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function toFiniteNumberValue(value: unknown): number | null {[39m
[31m+   const parsed = Number(value);[39m
[31m+   return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeProfilePoints(profile: JsonRecord, stage: JsonRecord) {[39m
[31m+   const direct = Array.isArray(profile.profile_points)[39m
[31m+     ? profile.profile_points[39m
[31m+     : [];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const metadata = asRecord(stage.metadata);[39m
[31m+   const routeProfile = asRecord(metadata.route_profile_v1);[39m
[31m+   const fallback = Array.isArray(routeProfile.profile_points)[39m
[31m+     ? routeProfile.profile_points[39m
[31m+     : [];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const source = direct.length > 0 ? direct : fallback;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return source[39m
[31m+     .map((raw): StagePlanProfilePoint | null => {[39m
[31m+       const point = asRecord(raw);[39m
[31m+       const km = toFiniteNumberValue(point.km);[39m
[31m+       const elevation = toFiniteNumberValue(point.elevation_m);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (km === null || elevation === null) return null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return {[39m
[31m+         km,[39m
[31m+         elevation_m: elevation,[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+     .filter((point): point is StagePlanProfilePoint => point !== null)[39m
[31m+     .sort((a, b) => a.km - b.km);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function isStagePlanTacticalMarkerType(type: string): boolean {[39m
[31m+   const normalized = type.toUpperCase();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     normalized === "START" ||[39m
[31m+     normalized === "FINISH" ||[39m
[31m+     normalized === "KOM" ||[39m
[31m+     normalized === "MOUNTAIN" ||[39m
[31m+     normalized === "INTERMEDIATE_SPRINT" ||[39m
[31m+     normalized === "BONUS_SPRINT" ||[39m
[31m+     normalized === "SPRINT"[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function normalizeProfileMarkers([39m
[31m+   profile: JsonRecord,[39m
[31m+   stage: JsonRecord,[39m
[31m+   distanceKm: number,[39m
[31m+ ) {[39m
[31m+   const direct = Array.isArray(profile.route_markers)[39m
[31m+     ? profile.route_markers[39m
[31m+     : [];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const stagePoints = Array.isArray(stage.points) ? stage.points : [];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const fromProfile = direct[39m
[31m+     .map((raw): StagePlanProfileMarker | null => {[39m
[31m+       const marker = asRecord(raw);[39m
[31m+       const km = toFiniteNumberValue(marker.km);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (km === null) return null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return {[39m
[31m+         km,[39m
[31m+         type: String(marker.type ?? marker.point_type ?? ""),[39m
[31m+         label: getStagePlanMarkerLabel(marker),[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+     .filter((marker): marker is StagePlanProfileMarker => marker !== null)[39m
[31m+     .filter((marker) => isStagePlanTacticalMarkerType(marker.type));[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const fromStagePoints = stagePoints[39m
[31m+     .map((raw): StagePlanProfileMarker | null => {[39m
[31m+       const point = asRecord(raw);[39m
[31m+       const km = toFiniteNumberValue(point.km_from_start);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       if (km === null) return null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return {[39m
[31m+         km,[39m
[31m+         type: String(point.point_type ?? ""),[39m
[31m+         label: getStagePlanMarkerLabel(point),[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+     })[39m
[31m+     .filter((marker): marker is StagePlanProfileMarker => marker !== null)[39m
[31m+     .filter((marker) => isStagePlanTacticalMarkerType(marker.type));[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const merged = fromProfile.length > 0 ? fromProfile : fromStagePoints;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const hasStart = merged.some((marker) => marker.km <= 0.5);[39m
[31m+   const hasFinish = merged.some([39m
[31m+     (marker) => Math.abs(marker.km - distanceKm) <= 0.5,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return [[39m
[31m+     ...(hasStart[39m
[31m+       ? [][39m
[31m+       : [{ km: 0, type: "START", label: "Start" } as StagePlanProfileMarker]),[39m
[31m+     ...merged,[39m
[31m+     ...(hasFinish[39m
[31m+       ? [][39m
[31m+       : [[39m
[31m+           {[39m
[31m+             km: distanceKm,[39m
[31m+             type: "FINISH",[39m
[31m+             label: "Finish",[39m
[31m+           } as StagePlanProfileMarker,[39m
[31m+         ]),[39m
[31m+   ].sort((a, b) => a.km - b.km);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStagePlanMarkerLabel(marker: JsonRecord) {[39m
[31m+   const type = String(marker.type ?? marker.point_type ?? "").toUpperCase();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (type === "START") return "Start";[39m
[31m+   if (type === "FINISH") return "Finish";[39m
[31m+   if ([39m
[31m+     type === "INTERMEDIATE_SPRINT" ||[39m
[31m+     type === "BONUS_SPRINT" ||[39m
[31m+     type === "SPRINT"[39m
[31m+   ) {[39m
[31m+     return "Sprint";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (type === "KOM" || type === "MOUNTAIN") {[39m
[31m+     const category = String([39m
[31m+       marker.category ?? marker.kom_category ?? "",[39m
[31m+     ).trim();[39m
[31m+     return category ? `Cat ${category}` : "KOM";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return "Point";[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getMarkerColor(type: string) {[39m
[31m+   const normalized = type.toUpperCase();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (normalized === "START") return "#64748b";[39m
[31m+   if (normalized === "FINISH") return "#2563eb";[39m
[31m+   if (normalized === "KOM" || normalized === "MOUNTAIN") return "#ef4444";[39m
[31m+   if ([39m
[31m+     normalized === "INTERMEDIATE_SPRINT" ||[39m
[31m+     normalized === "BONUS_SPRINT" ||[39m
[31m+     normalized === "SPRINT"[39m
[31m+   ) {[39m
[31m+     return "#22c55e";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return "#475569";[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function StagePlanProfileChart({[39m
[31m+   profile,[39m
[31m+   stage,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   profile: JsonRecord;[39m
[31m+   stage: JsonRecord;[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const points = normalizeProfilePoints(profile, stage);[39m
[31m+   const distanceKm =[39m
[31m+     toFiniteNumberValue(profile.distance_km) ??[39m
[31m+     toFiniteNumberValue(stage.distance_km) ??[39m
[31m+     Math.max(...points.map((point) => point.km), 1);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (points.length < 2) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className="flex min-h-[360px] items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 text-sm text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+         Stage profile points are missing.[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const width = 920;[39m
[31m+   const height = 360;[39m
[31m+   const padding = {[39m
[31m+     top: 38,[39m
[31m+     right: 24,[39m
[31m+     bottom: 54,[39m
[31m+     left: 58,[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const innerWidth = width - padding.left - padding.right;[39m
[31m+   const innerHeight = height - padding.top - padding.bottom;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const maxElevationRaw = Math.max(...points.map((point) => point.elevation_m));[39m
[31m+   const maxElevation = Math.max([39m
[31m+     500,[39m
[31m+     Math.ceil((maxElevationRaw * 1.12) / 100) * 100,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const xForKm = (km: number) =>[39m
[31m+     padding.left +[39m
[31m+     (Math.max(0, Math.min(distanceKm, km)) / distanceKm) * innerWidth;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const yForElevation = (elevation: number) =>[39m
[31m+     padding.top +[39m
[31m+     innerHeight -[39m
[31m+     (Math.max(0, elevation) / maxElevation) * innerHeight;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const coordinates = points.map((point) => ({[39m
[31m+     x: xForKm(point.km),[39m
[31m+     y: yForElevation(point.elevation_m),[39m
[31m+     ...point,[39m
[31m+   }));[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const linePath = coordinates.reduce((path, point, index) => {[39m
[31m+     if (index === 0) return `M ${point.x} ${point.y}`;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const previous = coordinates[index - 1];[39m
[31m+     const controlX = (previous.x + point.x) / 2;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return `${path} C ${controlX} ${previous.y}, ${controlX} ${point.y}, ${point.x} ${point.y}`;[39m
[31m+   }, "");[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const areaPath = `${linePath} L ${[39m
[31m+     coordinates[coordinates.length - 1].x[39m
[31m+   } ${height - padding.bottom} L ${coordinates[0].x} ${[39m
[31m+     height - padding.bottom[39m
[31m+   } Z`;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const markers = normalizeProfileMarkers(profile, stage, distanceKm);[39m
[31m+   const elevationTicks = [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1].map([39m
[31m+     (ratio) => Math.round((maxElevation * ratio) / 100) * 100,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white">[39m
[31m+       <svg[39m
[31m+         viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${height}`}[39m
[31m+         className="h-[360px] w-full"[39m
[31m+         role="img"[39m
[31m+         aria-label="Stage profile chart"[39m
[31m+       >[39m
[31m+         <rect width={width} height={height} fill="#ffffff" />[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         {elevationTicks.map((tick) => {[39m
[31m+           const y = yForElevation(tick);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           return ([39m
[31m+             <g key={tick}>[39m
[31m+               <line[39m
[31m+                 x1={padding.left}[39m
[31m+                 x2={width - padding.right}[39m
[31m+                 y1={y}[39m
[31m+                 y2={y}[39m
[31m+                 stroke="#e2e8f0"[39m
[31m+                 strokeWidth="1"[39m
[31m+               />[39m
[31m+               <text[39m
[31m+                 x={padding.left - 10}[39m
[31m+                 y={y + 4}[39m
[31m+                 textAnchor="end"[39m
[31m+                 fontSize="12"[39m
[31m+                 fill="#64748b"[39m
[31m+               >[39m
[31m+                 {tick} m[39m
[31m+               </text>[39m
[31m+             </g>[39m
[31m+           );[39m
[31m+         })}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <path d={areaPath} fill="#fde68a" opacity="0.9" />[39m
[31m+         <path[39m
[31m+           d={linePath}[39m
[31m+           fill="none"[39m
[31m+           stroke="#334155"[39m
[31m+           strokeWidth="3"[39m
[31m+           strokeLinecap="round"[39m
[31m+         />[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         {markers.map((marker, index) => {[39m
[31m+           const x = xForKm(marker.km);[39m
[31m+           const color = getMarkerColor(marker.type);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           return ([39m
[31m+             <g key={`${marker.type}-${marker.km}-${index}`}>[39m
[31m+               <line[39m
[31m+                 x1={x}[39m
[31m+                 x2={x}[39m
[31m+                 y1={padding.top}[39m
[31m+                 y2={height - padding.bottom}[39m
[31m+                 stroke={color}[39m
[31m+                 strokeWidth="2"[39m
[31m+                 strokeDasharray="4 4"[39m
[31m+                 opacity="0.75"[39m
[31m+               />[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+               <rect[39m
[31m+                 x={x - 34}[39m
[31m+                 y={14}[39m
[31m+                 width="68"[39m
[31m+                 height="22"[39m
[31m+                 rx="11"[39m
[31m+                 fill={color}[39m
[31m+               />[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+               <text[39m
[31m+                 x={x}[39m
[31m+                 y={29}[39m
[31m+                 textAnchor="middle"[39m
[31m+                 fontSize="11"[39m
[31m+                 fontWeight="700"[39m
[31m+                 fill="#ffffff"[39m
[31m+               >[39m
[31m+                 {marker.label}[39m
[31m+               </text>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+               <text[39m
[31m+                 x={x}[39m
[31m+                 y={height - 18}[39m
[31m+                 textAnchor="middle"[39m
[31m+                 fontSize="12"[39m
[31m+                 fontWeight="700"[39m
[31m+                 fill="#334155"[39m
[31m+               >[39m
[31m+                 {marker.km.toFixed(marker.km % 1 === 0 ? 0 : 1)} km[39m
[31m+               </text>[39m
[31m+             </g>[39m
[31m+           );[39m
[31m+         })}[39m
[31m+       </svg>[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function StageCardsScroller({[39m
[31m+   stages,[39m
[31m+   selectedStageIndex,[39m
[31m+   stagePlanReadinessByStageKey,[39m
[31m+   isU23ManagedRace = false,[39m
[31m+   u23DashboardStages = [],[39m
[31m+   onSelectStage,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   stages: JsonRecord[];[39m
[31m+   selectedStageIndex: number;[39m
[31m+   stagePlanReadinessByStageKey?: Record<string, StagePlanReadinessStage>;[39m
[31m+   isU23ManagedRace?: boolean;[39m
[31m+   u23DashboardStages?: U23StagePlanDashboardStage[];[39m
[31m+   onSelectStage: (index: number) => void;[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const stageSliderRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function scrollStages(direction: "left" | "right"): void {[39m
[31m+     const node = stageSliderRef.current;[39m
[31m+     if (!node) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     node.scrollBy({[39m
[31m+       left: direction === "left" ? -320 : 320,[39m
[31m+       behavior: "smooth",[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function renderStageCard(stage: JsonRecord, compact = false) {[39m
[31m+     const index = stages.findIndex([39m
[31m+       (item) => String(item.id) === String(stage.id),[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     const active = index === selectedStageIndex;[39m
[31m+     const stageNumber = String(stage.stage_number ?? index + 1);[39m
[31m+     const readiness = findStagePlanReadiness([39m
[31m+       stagePlanReadinessByStageKey ?? {},[39m
[31m+       stage,[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     const u23Stage =[39m
[31m+       u23DashboardStages.find((row) => {[39m
[31m+         const stageId = String(stage.id ?? "");[39m
[31m+         const rowStageId = String(row.stage_id ?? "");[39m
[31m+         const rowStageNumber = Number(row.stage_number ?? 0);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         return ([39m
[31m+           (stageId && rowStageId === stageId) ||[39m
[31m+           rowStageNumber === Number(stage.stage_number ?? index + 1)[39m
[31m+         );[39m
[31m+       }) ?? null;[39m
[31m+     const u23Management = asRecord(u23Stage?.management);[39m
[31m+     const u23ManagementMode = String([39m
[31m+       u23Management.management_mode ?? "",[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     const u23ManagementSource = String([39m
[31m+       u23Management.source_type ?? "",[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     const u23HasSavedPlan = Boolean(u23Stage?.last_saved_at);[39m
[31m+     const u23BadgeLabel =[39m
[31m+       u23ManagementMode === "manual"[39m
[31m+         ? "Manual plan"[39m
[31m+         : u23ManagementSource === "u23_head_coach" && u23HasSavedPlan[39m
[31m+           ? "Coach plan"[39m
[31m+           : "Scheduled";[39m
[31m+     const u23BadgeClasses =[39m
[31m+       u23ManagementMode === "manual"[39m
[31m+         ? "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800"[39m
[31m+         : u23ManagementSource === "u23_head_coach" && u23HasSavedPlan[39m
[31m+           ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800"[39m
[31m+           : "border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 text-slate-700";[39m
[31m+     const u23StageHint =[39m
[31m+       u23ManagementMode === "manual"[39m
[31m+         ? "Existing manual plan · view only."[39m
[31m+         : u23ManagementSource === "u23_head_coach" && u23HasSavedPlan[39m
[31m+           ? "Generated automatically by the U23 Head Coach."[39m
[31m+           : Number(stage.stage_number ?? index + 1) > 1[39m
[31m+             ? `Generated after Stage ${Math.max([39m
[31m+                 Number(stage.stage_number ?? index + 1) - 1,[39m
[31m+                 1,[39m
[31m+               )} finishes.`[39m
[31m+             : "Generated immediately when U23 automation is activated.";[39m
[31m+     const weatherCanceled = isPreparationStageWeatherCanceled(stage);[39m
[31m+     const weatherRiskReason = getPreparationStageWeatherRiskReason(stage);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <button[39m
[31m+         key={String(stage.id ?? stageNumber)}[39m
[31m+         type="button"[39m
[31m+         onClick={() => onSelectStage(index)}[39m
[31m+         className={[[39m
[31m+           compact[39m
[31m+             ? "min-h-[92px] min-w-[220px] snap-start rounded-2xl border px-4 py-3 text-left transition"[39m
[31m+             : "min-h-[92px] rounded-2xl border px-4 py-3 text-left transition",[39m
[31m+           weatherCanceled[39m
[31m+             ? "border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-950 shadow-sm"[39m
[31m+             : active[39m
[31m+               ? "border-yellow-200 bg-yellow-50 text-slate-950 shadow-sm"[39m
[31m+               : "border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50",[39m
[31m+         ].join(" ")}[39m
[31m+       >[39m
[31m+         <div className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+           {formatCompactStageDateTime(stage)}[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <div className="mt-1 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">[39m
[31m+           <div className="truncate text-base font-semibold">[39m
[31m+             Stage {stageNumber}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+           {isU23ManagedRace ? ([39m
[31m+             <span[39m
[31m+               className={[[39m
[31m+                 "shrink-0 rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold",[39m
[31m+                 u23BadgeClasses,[39m
[31m+               ].join(" ")}[39m
[31m+             >[39m
[31m+               {u23BadgeLabel}[39m
[31m+             </span>[39m
[31m+           ) : readiness ? ([39m
[31m+             <span[39m
[31m+               className={[[39m
[31m+                 "shrink-0 rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold",[39m
[31m+                 stagePlanReadinessBadgeClasses[readiness.ui_tone],[39m
[31m+               ].join(" ")}[39m
[31m+             >[39m
[31m+               {readiness.readiness_label}[39m
[31m+             </span>[39m
[31m+           ) : null}[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <div className="mt-1 truncate text-xs opacity-80">[39m
[31m+           {getStageRoute(stage)}[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <div className="mt-1 text-xs opacity-75">[39m
[31m+           {getStageProfileLabel(stage)} · {getStageDistance(stage) || "—"}[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         {weatherCanceled ? ([39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-2 inline-flex rounded-full bg-red-100 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-red-800">[39m
[31m+             Canceled ·{" "}[39m
[31m+             {getPreparationWeatherCancellationReasonLabel([39m
[31m+               getPreparationStageWeatherCancellationReason(stage),[39m
[31m+             )}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         ) : weatherRiskReason ? ([39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-2 inline-flex rounded-full bg-orange-100 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-orange-800">[39m
[31m+             Weather cancellation likely[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         ) : isU23ManagedRace ? ([39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-2 line-clamp-2 text-[11px] opacity-70">[39m
[31m+             {u23StageHint}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         ) : readiness?.recommended_action ? ([39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-2 line-clamp-2 text-[11px] opacity-70">[39m
[31m+             {readiness.recommended_action}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         ) : null}[39m
[31m+       </button>[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (stages.length === 0) {[39m
[31m+     return ([39m
[31m+       <div className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 text-sm text-slate-500 shadow-sm">[39m
[31m+         No stages found for this race.[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm">[39m
[31m+       <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">[39m
[31m+         <div className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+           Stages[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         {stages.length > 5 ? ([39m
[31m+           <div className="flex gap-2">[39m
[31m+             <button[39m
[31m+               type="button"[39m
[31m+               onClick={() => scrollStages("left")}[39m
[31m+               className="rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-1 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"[39m
[31m+             >[39m
[31m+               ←[39m
[31m+             </button>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             <button[39m
[31m+               type="button"[39m
[31m+               onClick={() => scrollStages("right")}[39m
[31m+               className="rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-1 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50"[39m
[31m+             >[39m
[31m+               →[39m
[31m+             </button>[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         ) : null}[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {stages.length <= 5 ? ([39m
[31m+         <div[39m
[31m+           className={[[39m
[31m+             "grid gap-2",[39m
[31m+             stages.length <= 1[39m
[31m+               ? "grid-cols-1"[39m
[31m+               : stages.length === 2[39m
[31m+                 ? "grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2"[39m
[31m+                 : stages.length === 3[39m
[31m+                   ? "grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3"[39m
[31m+                   : stages.length === 4[39m
[31m+                     ? "grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4"[39m
[31m+                     : "grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-5",[39m
[31m+           ].join(" ")}[39m
[31m+         >[39m
[31m+           {stages.map((stage) => renderStageCard(stage))}[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       ) : ([39m
[31m+         <div[39m
[31m+           ref={stageSliderRef}[39m
[31m+           className="flex snap-x gap-2 overflow-x-auto scroll-smooth pb-1"[39m
[31m+         >[39m
[31m+           {stages.map((stage) => renderStageCard(stage, true))}[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       )}[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function InfoTooltip({[39m
[31m+   label = "Info",[39m
[31m+   children,[39m
[31m+   panelWidthClass = "w-[26rem]",[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   label?: string;[39m
[31m+   children: React.ReactNode;[39m
[31m+   panelWidthClass?: string;[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const [pinned, setPinned] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const pinTimerRef = React.useRef<number | null>(null);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     return () => {[39m
[31m+       if (pinTimerRef.current !== null) {[39m
[31m+         window.clearTimeout(pinTimerRef.current);[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }, []);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function startPinCountdown() {[39m
[31m+     if (pinTimerRef.current !== null) {[39m
[31m+       window.clearTimeout(pinTimerRef.current);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     pinTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {[39m
[31m+       setPinned(true);[39m
[31m+       setOpen(true);[39m
[31m+     }, 3000);[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function stopPinCountdown() {[39m
[31m+     if (pinTimerRef.current !== null) {[39m
[31m+       window.clearTimeout(pinTimerRef.current);[39m
[31m+       pinTimerRef.current = null;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function handleMouseEnter() {[39m
[31m+     setOpen(true);[39m
[31m+     if (!pinned) {[39m
[31m+       startPinCountdown();[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function handleMouseLeave() {[39m
[31m+     stopPinCountdown();[39m
[31m+     if (!pinned) {[39m
[31m+       setOpen(false);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function handleToggleClick() {[39m
[31m+     if (open && pinned) {[39m
[31m+       setPinned(false);[39m
[31m+       setOpen(false);[39m
[31m+       stopPinCountdown();[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     setOpen(true);[39m
[31m+     setPinned(true);[39m
[31m+     stopPinCountdown();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function handleClose() {[39m
[31m+     setPinned(false);[39m
[31m+     setOpen(false);[39m
[31m+     stopPinCountdown();[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <span[39m
[31m+       className="relative inline-flex"[39m
[31m+       onMouseEnter={handleMouseEnter}[39m
[31m+       onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}[39m
[31m+     >[39m
[31m+       <button[39m
[31m+         type="button"[39m
[31m+         aria-label={label}[39m
[31m+         onClick={handleToggleClick}[39m
[31m+         className="inline-flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-slate-300 bg-white text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 shadow-sm hover:bg-slate-50"[39m
[31m+       >[39m
[31m+         i[39m
[31m+       </button>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {open && ([39m
[31m+         <div[39m
[31m+           className={`absolute right-0 top-full z-50 mt-2 ${panelWidthClass} rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 text-left text-xs leading-5 text-slate-600 shadow-xl`}[39m
[31m+         >[39m
[31m+           <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">[39m
[31m+             <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-400">[39m
[31m+               {label}[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+             {pinned ? ([39m
[31m+               <button[39m
[31m+                 type="button"[39m
[31m+                 onClick={handleClose}[39m
[31m+                 className="rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-600"[39m
[31m+               >[39m
[31m+                 ×[39m
[31m+               </button>[39m
[31m+             ) : null}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           <div className="max-h-80 overflow-y-auto pr-1">{children}</div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           {!pinned && ([39m
[31m+             <div className="mt-3 text-[11px] text-slate-400">[39m
[31m+               Hover for 3 seconds or click to keep this help window open.[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+           )}[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       )}[39m
[31m+     </span>[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function EquipmentPresetTooltip({[39m
[31m+   preset,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   preset?: EquipmentSetupPresetOption | null;[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const { weightedBonuses, selectedItems, caps } =[39m
[31m+     getPresetBonusPreview(preset);[39m
[31m+   const weightedEntries = Object.entries(weightedBonuses).filter([39m
[31m+     ([, value]) => {[39m
[31m+       const numeric = Number(value);[39m
[31m+       return Number.isFinite(numeric) && numeric !== 0;[39m
[31m+     },[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const selectedItemEntries = Array.isArray(selectedItems)[39m
[31m+     ? selectedItems.map((item, index) => [String(index + 1), item] as const)[39m
[31m+     : Object.entries(asRecord(selectedItems));[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const capEntries = Object.entries(caps).filter([39m
[31m+     ([, value]) => value !== null && value !== undefined,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <InfoTooltip label="Equipment package bonus preview">[39m

[31m+         <div className="mb-1 font-semibold text-slate-700">[39m
[31m+           Weighted bonus preview[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+         {weightedEntries.length > 0 ? ([39m
[31m+           <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">[39m
[31m+             {weightedEntries.map(([key, value]) => {[39m
[31m+               const numeric = Number(value);[39m
[31m+               const sign = numeric >= 0 ? "+" : "";[39m
[31m+               const isNegative = numeric < 0;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+               return ([39m
[31m+                 <span[39m
[31m+                   key={key}[39m
[31m+                   className={[[39m
[31m+                     "rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 font-semibold",[39m
[31m+                     isNegative[39m
[31m+                       ? "bg-rose-50 text-rose-700"[39m
[31m+                       : "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700",[39m
[31m+                   ].join(" ")}[39m
[31m+                 >[39m
[31m+                   {formatBonusPreviewLabel(key)} {sign}[39m
[31m+                   {formatBonusPercent(numeric)}%[39m
[31m+                 </span>[39m
[31m+               );[39m
[31m+             })}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         ) : ([39m

[31m+         )}[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {selectedItemEntries.length > 0 && ([39m

[31m+             Selected items[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+           <div className="space-y-1">[39m
[31m+             {selectedItemEntries.slice(0, 8).map(([key, raw]) => {[39m
[31m+               const item = asRecord(raw);[39m
[31m+               const label = String([39m
[31m+                 item.display_name ??[39m
[31m+                   item.name ??[39m
[31m+                   item.catalog_name ??[39m
[31m+                   raw ??[39m
[31m+                   "",[39m
[31m+               );[39m
[31m+               return ([39m
[31m+                 <div key={key} className="flex justify-between gap-3">[39m
[31m+                   <span className="text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+                     {formatBonusPreviewLabel(key)}[39m
[31m+                   </span>[39m

[31m+[39m

[31m+ type EquipmentPresetCapacity = {[39m
[31m+   maxAssignments: number | null;[39m
[31m+   limitingItemLabel: string | null;[39m
[31m+   itemCaps: Array<{[39m
[31m+     key: string;[39m

[31m+   }>;[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+ function parseEquipmentCountFromLabel(value: unknown): number | null {[39m
[31m+   if (typeof value !== "string") return null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const match = value.match(/\((\d+)\s*\/\s*(\d+)\)/);[39m
[31m+   if (!match) return null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const available = Number(match[1]);[39m
[31m+   const total = Number(match[2]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (Number.isFinite(available)) return available;[39m
[31m+   if (Number.isFinite(total)) return total;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return null;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getEquipmentItemAvailableCount(raw: unknown): number | null {[39m
[31m+   const item = asRecord(raw);[39m
[31m+   const metadata = asRecord(item.metadata);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const direct = [[39m
[31m+     item.available_count,[39m
[31m+     item.quantity_available,[39m
[31m+     item.available_quantity,[39m
[31m+     item.available,[39m
[31m+     item.usable_count,[39m
[31m+     item.owned_count,[39m
[31m+     item.total_owned,[39m
[31m+     item.count,[39m
[31m+     metadata.available_count,[39m
[31m+     metadata.quantity_available,[39m
[31m+     metadata.available,[39m
[31m+     metadata.usable_count,[39m
[31m+     metadata.owned_count,[39m
[31m+   ];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   for (const value of direct) {[39m
[31m+     const numeric = Number(value);[39m
[31m+     if (Number.isFinite(numeric) && numeric >= 0) {[39m
[31m+       return Math.floor(numeric);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const label = String([39m
[31m+     item.display_name ??[39m
[31m+       item.name ??[39m
[31m+       item.catalog_name ??[39m
[31m+       item.label ??[39m
[31m+       raw ??[39m
[31m+       "",[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return parseEquipmentCountFromLabel(label);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getEquipmentItemLabel(raw: unknown, fallback: string): string {[39m
[31m+   const item = asRecord(raw);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return String([39m
[31m+     item.display_name ??[39m
[31m+       item.name ??[39m
[31m+       item.catalog_name ??[39m
[31m+       item.label ??[39m
[31m+       fallback,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getEquipmentPresetCapacity([39m
[31m+   preset?: EquipmentSetupPresetOption | null,[39m
[31m+ ): EquipmentPresetCapacity {[39m
[31m+   const directCapacity = firstNonEmptyRecord([39m
[31m+     asRecord(preset).setup_capacity,[39m
[31m+     asRecord(preset).capacity,[39m
[31m+     asRecord(preset).equipment_capacity,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const directMaxAssignments = Number([39m
[31m+     directCapacity.max_assignments ??[39m
[31m+       directCapacity.maxAssignments ??[39m
[31m+       directCapacity.capacity ??[39m
[31m+       asRecord(preset).max_assignments,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (Number.isFinite(directMaxAssignments) && directMaxAssignments >= 0) {[39m
[31m+     const directCaps = toArray<JsonRecord>([39m
[31m+       directCapacity.item_caps ?? directCapacity.itemCaps,[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       maxAssignments: Math.floor(directMaxAssignments),[39m
[31m+       limitingItemLabel:[39m
[31m+         String([39m
[31m+           directCapacity.limiting_item_label ??[39m
[31m+             directCapacity.limitingItemLabel ??[39m
[31m+             asRecord(preset).limiting_item_label ??[39m
[31m+             "",[39m
[31m+         ) || null,[39m
[31m+       itemCaps: directCaps.map((item, index) => ({[39m
[31m+         key: String(item.equipment_category ?? item.key ?? index + 1),[39m
[31m+         label: String([39m
[31m+           item.label ?? item.display_name ?? item.name ?? "Equipment",[39m
[31m+         ),[39m
[31m+         available: Number.isFinite(Number(item.available_count))[39m
[31m+           ? Math.floor(Number(item.available_count))[39m
[31m+           : null,[39m
[31m+       })),[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const { selectedItems } = getPresetBonusPreview(preset);[39m
[31m+   const selectedItemEntries = Array.isArray(selectedItems)[39m
[31m+     ? selectedItems.map((item, index) => [String(index + 1), item] as const)[39m
[31m+     : Object.entries(asRecord(selectedItems));[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const itemCaps = selectedItemEntries.flatMap(([key, raw]) => {[39m
[31m+     const label = getEquipmentItemLabel(raw, formatBonusPreviewLabel(key));[39m
[31m+     const available = getEquipmentItemAvailableCount(raw);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (available === null) return [];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return [[39m
[31m+       {[39m
[31m+         key,[39m
[31m+         label,[39m
[31m+         available,[39m
[31m+       },[39m
[31m+     ];[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (itemCaps.length === 0) {[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       maxAssignments: null,[39m
[31m+       limitingItemLabel: null,[39m
[31m+       itemCaps: [],[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const maxAssignments = Math.min(...itemCaps.map((item) => item.available));[39m
[31m+   const limitingItem =[39m
[31m+     itemCaps.find((item) => item.available === maxAssignments) ?? itemCaps[0];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     maxAssignments,[39m
[31m+     limitingItemLabel: limitingItem?.label ?? null,[39m
[31m+     itemCaps,[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getEquipmentPresetAssignmentCounts([39m
[31m+   equipmentByRider: Record<string, string>,[39m
[31m+ ): Record<string, number> {[39m
[31m+   return Object.values(equipmentByRider).reduce<Record<string, number>>([39m
[31m+     (acc, presetId) => {[39m
[31m+       if (!presetId) return acc;[39m
[31m+       acc[presetId] = (acc[presetId] ?? 0) + 1;[39m
[31m+       return acc;[39m
[31m+     },[39m
[31m+     {},[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getEquipmentPresetAvailabilityLabel({[39m
[31m+   preset,[39m
[31m+   assignmentCount,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   preset: EquipmentSetupPresetOption;[39m
[31m+   assignmentCount: number;[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const capacity = getEquipmentPresetCapacity(preset);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (capacity.maxAssignments === null) {[39m
[31m+     return "";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const remaining = Math.max(capacity.maxAssignments - assignmentCount, 0);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return `${remaining}/${capacity.maxAssignments} left`;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function isDefaultEquipmentPreset([39m
[31m+   preset?: EquipmentSetupPresetOption | null,[39m
[31m+ ): boolean {[39m
[31m+   if (!preset) return false;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const record = asRecord(preset);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     record.is_default_setup === true ||[39m
[31m+     record.is_virtual_default === true ||[39m
[31m+     preset.id === "__default_race_setup__" ||[39m
[31m+     preset.setup_name === "Default" ||[39m
[31m+     preset.label === "Default"[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getEquipmentCapacityConflicts({[39m
[31m+   equipmentPresetOptions,[39m
[31m+   equipmentByRider,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   equipmentPresetOptions: EquipmentSetupPresetOption[];[39m
[31m+   equipmentByRider: Record<string, string>;[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const assignmentCounts = getEquipmentPresetAssignmentCounts(equipmentByRider);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return equipmentPresetOptions.flatMap((preset) => {[39m
[31m+     const capacity = getEquipmentPresetCapacity(preset);[39m
[31m+     const count = assignmentCounts[preset.id] ?? 0;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (capacity.maxAssignments === null || count <= capacity.maxAssignments) {[39m
[31m+       return [];[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return [[39m
[31m+       {[39m
[31m+         presetId: preset.id,[39m
[31m+         label: preset.label,[39m
[31m+         assigned: count,[39m
[31m+         maxAssignments: capacity.maxAssignments,[39m
[31m+         limitingItemLabel: capacity.limitingItemLabel,[39m
[31m+       },[39m
[31m+     ];[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type SportDirectorEquipmentFocus = "climbing" | "flat" | "standard" | "tt";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ type SportDirectorEquipmentPresetScore = {[39m
[31m+   presetId: string;[39m
[31m+   climbing: number;[39m
[31m+   flat: number;[39m
[31m+   standard: number;[39m
[31m+   tt: number;[39m
[31m+   label: string;[39m
[31m+ };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getEquipmentPresetSearchText([39m
[31m+   preset?: EquipmentSetupPresetOption | null,[39m
[31m+ ): string {[39m
[31m+   if (!preset) return "";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const record = asRecord(preset);[39m
[31m+   const { weightedBonuses, selectedItems, caps } =[39m
[31m+     getPresetBonusPreview(preset);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const selectedText = Array.isArray(selectedItems)[39m
[31m+     ? selectedItems.map((item) => JSON.stringify(item)).join(" ")[39m
[31m+     : JSON.stringify(asRecord(selectedItems));[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return [[39m
[31m+     preset.setup_name,[39m
[31m+     preset.label,[39m
[31m+     record.name,[39m
[31m+     record.description,[39m
[31m+     record.setup_type,[39m
[31m+     record.preset_type,[39m
[31m+     record.equipment_type,[39m
[31m+     record.limiting_item_label,[39m
[31m+     record.limiting_equipment_category,[39m
[31m+     JSON.stringify(weightedBonuses),[39m
[31m+     JSON.stringify(caps),[39m
[31m+     selectedText,[39m
[31m+   ][39m
[31m+     .filter(Boolean)[39m
[31m+     .join(" ")[39m
[31m+     .toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getEquipmentBonusScore([39m
[31m+   weightedBonuses: JsonRecord,[39m
[31m+   positiveKeys: string[],[39m
[31m+   negativeKeys: string[] = [],[39m
[31m+ ): number {[39m
[31m+   let score = 0;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   Object.entries(weightedBonuses).forEach(([rawKey, rawValue]) => {[39m
[31m+     const key = rawKey.toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+     const value = Number(rawValue);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (positiveKeys.some((candidate) => key.includes(candidate))) {[39m
[31m+       score += Math.max(value, 0);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (negativeKeys.some((candidate) => key.includes(candidate))) {[39m
[31m+       score -= Math.max(value, 0);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return score;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getSportDirectorEquipmentPresetScores([39m
[31m+   equipmentPresetOptions: EquipmentSetupPresetOption[],[39m
[31m+ ): SportDirectorEquipmentPresetScore[] {[39m
[31m+   return equipmentPresetOptions.map((preset) => {[39m
[31m+     const text = getEquipmentPresetSearchText(preset);[39m
[31m+     const { weightedBonuses } = getPresetBonusPreview(preset);[39m
[31m+     const defaultOrStandard =[39m
[31m+       isDefaultEquipmentPreset(preset) ||[39m
[31m+       /\b(default|standard|balanced|all[ -]?round|regular|normal)\b/i.test([39m
[31m+         text,[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const climbingKeywordScore = [[39m
[31m+       "climb",[39m
[31m+       "climber",[39m
[31m+       "climbing",[39m
[31m+       "mountain",[39m
[31m+       "lightweight",[39m
[31m+       "light weight",[39m
[31m+       "hill",[39m
[31m+       "hilly",[39m
[31m+       "puncheur",[39m
[31m+     ].reduce((sum, key) => sum + (text.includes(key) ? 18 : 0), 0);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const flatKeywordScore = [[39m
[31m+       "flat",[39m
[31m+       "aero",[39m
[31m+       "aerodynamic",[39m
[31m+       "sprint",[39m
[31m+       "sprinter",[39m
[31m+       "speed",[39m
[31m+       "fast",[39m
[31m+       "rouleur",[39m
[31m+       "rolling",[39m
[31m+     ].reduce((sum, key) => sum + (text.includes(key) ? 16 : 0), 0);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const ttKeywordScore = [[39m
[31m+       "time trial",[39m
[31m+       "timetrial",[39m
[31m+       "tt",[39m
[31m+       "chrono",[39m
[31m+       "tri",[39m
[31m+     ].reduce((sum, key) => sum + (text.includes(key) ? 18 : 0), 0);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const climbingBonusScore = getEquipmentBonusScore(weightedBonuses, [[39m
[31m+       "climb",[39m
[31m+       "mountain",[39m
[31m+       "hill",[39m
[31m+       "weight",[39m
[31m+       "acceleration",[39m
[31m+     ]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const flatBonusScore = getEquipmentBonusScore(weightedBonuses, [[39m
[31m+       "flat",[39m
[31m+       "sprint",[39m
[31m+       "speed",[39m
[31m+       "aero",[39m
[31m+       "endurance",[39m
[31m+       "resistance",[39m
[31m+     ]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const ttBonusScore = getEquipmentBonusScore(weightedBonuses, [[39m
[31m+       "time_trial",[39m
[31m+       "timetrial",[39m
[31m+       "tt",[39m
[31m+       "aero",[39m
[31m+       "speed",[39m
[31m+     ]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return {[39m
[31m+       presetId: preset.id,[39m
[31m+       label: String(preset.label ?? preset.setup_name ?? "Equipment setup"),[39m
[31m+       climbing: climbingKeywordScore + climbingBonusScore,[39m
[31m+       flat: flatKeywordScore + flatBonusScore,[39m
[31m+       tt: ttKeywordScore + ttBonusScore,[39m
[31m+       standard: defaultOrStandard ? 35 : 5,[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStageEquipmentProfile(stage?: JsonRecord | null) {[39m
[31m+   const profileType = String(stage?.profile_type ?? "").toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+   const terrainType = String(stage?.terrain_type ?? "").toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+   const finishType = String(stage?.finish_type ?? "").toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+   const stageFormat = String(stage?.stage_format ?? "").toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+   const elevationGain = normalizeNumericValue(stage?.elevation_gain_m, 0);[39m
[31m+   const komCount = normalizeNumericValue(stage?.kom_count, 0);[39m
[31m+   const sprintCount = normalizeNumericValue(stage?.sprint_count, 0);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const isTT = TIME_TRIAL_STAGE_FORMATS.has(stageFormat);[39m
[31m+   const isMountain =[39m
[31m+     profileType.includes("climb") ||[39m
[31m+     profileType.includes("mountain") ||[39m
[31m+     terrainType.includes("mountain") ||[39m
[31m+     elevationGain >= 1500 ||[39m
[31m+     komCount >= 2;[39m
[31m+   const isPuncheur =[39m
[31m+     profileType.includes("puncheur") ||[39m
[31m+     profileType.includes("hilly") ||[39m
[31m+     terrainType.includes("hilly") ||[39m
[31m+     (!isMountain && (komCount > 0 || elevationGain >= 700));[39m
[31m+   const isSprintOrFlatFinish =[39m
[31m+     profileType.includes("sprint") ||[39m
[31m+     profileType.includes("flat") ||[39m
[31m+     terrainType.includes("flat") ||[39m
[31m+     finishType.includes("flat") ||[39m
[31m+     sprintCount >= 2;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     isTT,[39m
[31m+     isMountain,[39m
[31m+     isPuncheur,[39m
[31m+     isSprintOrFlatFinish,[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getRiderEquipmentFocus({[39m
[31m+   rider,[39m
[31m+   role,[39m
[31m+   stage,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   rider: JsonRecord;[39m
[31m+   role?: unknown;[39m
[31m+   stage?: JsonRecord | null;[39m
[31m+ }): SportDirectorEquipmentFocus {[39m
[31m+   const stageProfile = getStageEquipmentProfile(stage);[39m
[31m+   const roleCode = String(role ?? "").toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+   const riderLabel = getRiderRoleLabel(rider).toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+   const riderText = `${roleCode} ${riderLabel}`;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const isLeaderLike =[39m
[31m+     riderText.includes("team_leader") ||[39m
[31m+     riderText.includes("leader") ||[39m
[31m+     riderText.includes("gc") ||[39m
[31m+     riderText.includes("protected");[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const isClimberLike =[39m
[31m+     riderText.includes("climber") ||[39m
[31m+     riderText.includes("mountain") ||[39m
[31m+     riderText.includes("kom") ||[39m
[31m+     riderText.includes("puncheur");[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const isSprinterLike =[39m
[31m+     riderText.includes("sprinter") ||[39m
[31m+     riderText.includes("lead_out") ||[39m
[31m+     riderText.includes("lead-out") ||[39m
[31m+     riderText.includes("lead out") ||[39m
[31m+     riderText.includes("sprint_train") ||[39m
[31m+     riderText.includes("sprint train");[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const isLeadOutLike =[39m
[31m+     riderText.includes("lead_out") ||[39m
[31m+     riderText.includes("lead-out") ||[39m
[31m+     riderText.includes("lead out") ||[39m
[31m+     riderText.includes("sprint_train") ||[39m
[31m+     riderText.includes("sprint train");[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const isRouleurLike =[39m
[31m+     riderText.includes("rouleur") ||[39m
[31m+     riderText.includes("breakaway") ||[39m
[31m+     riderText.includes("chaser");[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const isHelperLike =[39m
[31m+     riderText.includes("domestique") || riderText.includes("helper");[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const isMixedPuncheurSprintStage =[39m
[31m+     stageProfile.isPuncheur &&[39m
[31m+     stageProfile.isSprintOrFlatFinish &&[39m
[31m+     !stageProfile.isMountain;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (stageProfile.isTT || roleCode.includes("time_trial")) {[39m
[31m+     return "tt";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   /*[39m
[31m+    * Important Sport Director rule:[39m
[31m+    * Mixed stages should not give every rider the same setup.[39m
[31m+    * If a stage has a KOM / hilly middle and a flatter sprint or finish,[39m
[31m+    * climbers and leaders should chase climbing advantages while sprinters[39m
[31m+    * and sprint support should keep flatter / aero equipment.[39m
[31m+    */[39m
[31m+   if (isMixedPuncheurSprintStage) {[39m
[31m+     if (isLeaderLike || isClimberLike) return "climbing";[39m
[31m+     if (isSprinterLike || isLeadOutLike) return "flat";[39m
[31m+     if (isRouleurLike) return "flat";[39m
[31m+     if (isHelperLike) return "standard";[39m
[31m+     return "standard";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (stageProfile.isMountain) {[39m
[31m+     if (isLeaderLike || isClimberLike) return "climbing";[39m
[31m+     if (isSprinterLike || isLeadOutLike) return "standard";[39m
[31m+     if (isRouleurLike) return "climbing";[39m
[31m+     if (isHelperLike) return "standard";[39m
[31m+     return "climbing";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (stageProfile.isPuncheur) {[39m
[31m+     if (isLeaderLike || isClimberLike || isRouleurLike) return "climbing";[39m
[31m+     if (isSprinterLike || isLeadOutLike) {[39m
[31m+       return stageProfile.isSprintOrFlatFinish ? "flat" : "standard";[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+     return "standard";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (stageProfile.isSprintOrFlatFinish) {[39m
[31m+     if (isSprinterLike || isLeadOutLike || isRouleurLike) return "flat";[39m
[31m+     if (isLeaderLike || isClimberLike) return "standard";[39m
[31m+     return "flat";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (isLeaderLike || isClimberLike) return "climbing";[39m
[31m+   if (isSprinterLike || isLeadOutLike || isRouleurLike) return "flat";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return "standard";[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getPresetScoreForFocus([39m
[31m+   score: SportDirectorEquipmentPresetScore,[39m
[31m+   focus: SportDirectorEquipmentFocus,[39m
[31m+   stage?: JsonRecord | null,[39m
[31m+ ): number {[39m
[31m+   const stageProfile = getStageEquipmentProfile(stage);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (focus === "tt") {[39m
[31m+     return score.tt * 1.15 + score.flat * 0.25 + score.standard * 0.15;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (focus === "climbing") {[39m
[31m+     return score.climbing * 1.2 + score.standard * 0.25 + score.flat * 0.1;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (focus === "flat") {[39m
[31m+     return score.flat * 1.1 + score.standard * 0.25 + score.climbing * 0.08;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (stageProfile.isPuncheur) {[39m
[31m+     return score.standard * 0.8 + score.climbing * 0.45 + score.flat * 0.25;[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return score.standard + Math.max(score.climbing, score.flat, score.tt) * 0.12;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildSportDirectorEquipmentSuggestion({[39m
[31m+   riders,[39m
[31m+   stage,[39m
[31m+   equipmentPresetOptions,[39m
[31m+   currentEquipmentByRider,[39m
[31m+   suggestedRoles,[39m
[31m+   backendEquipment,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   riders: JsonRecord[];[39m
[31m+   stage?: JsonRecord | null;[39m
[31m+   equipmentPresetOptions: EquipmentSetupPresetOption[];[39m
[31m+   currentEquipmentByRider: Record<string, string>;[39m
[31m+   suggestedRoles: JsonRecord;[39m
[31m+   backendEquipment: JsonRecord;[39m
[31m+ }): Record<string, string> {[39m
[31m+   const validPresetIds = new Set([39m
[31m+     equipmentPresetOptions.map((preset) => preset.id),[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   const scores = getSportDirectorEquipmentPresetScores(equipmentPresetOptions);[39m
[31m+   const presetById = new Map([39m
[31m+     equipmentPresetOptions.map((preset) => [preset.id, preset]),[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   const plannedCounts: Record<string, number> = {};[39m
[31m+   const result: Record<string, string> = {};[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const sortedRiders = [...riders].sort((a, b) => {[39m
[31m+     const aRole = String([39m
[31m+       suggestedRoles[String(a.id ?? "")] ?? "",[39m
[31m+     ).toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+     const bRole = String([39m
[31m+       suggestedRoles[String(b.id ?? "")] ?? "",[39m
[31m+     ).toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+     const priority = (role: string) =>[39m
[31m+       role.includes("leader") || role.includes("gc")[39m
[31m+         ? 1[39m
[31m+         : role.includes("climber") || role.includes("mountain")[39m
[31m+           ? 2[39m
[31m+           : role.includes("sprinter") || role.includes("lead")[39m
[31m+             ? 3[39m
[31m+             : 5;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return priority(aRole) - priority(bRole);[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const canUsePreset = (presetId: string) => {[39m
[31m+     const preset = presetById.get(presetId);[39m
[31m+     if (!preset) return false;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const capacity = getEquipmentPresetCapacity(preset);[39m
[31m+     if (capacity.maxAssignments === null) return true;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return (plannedCounts[presetId] ?? 0) < capacity.maxAssignments;[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const addUse = (presetId: string) => {[39m
[31m+     plannedCounts[presetId] = (plannedCounts[presetId] ?? 0) + 1;[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   sortedRiders.forEach((rider) => {[39m
[31m+     const riderId = String(rider.id ?? "");[39m
[31m+     if (!riderId) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const backendPresetId = String(backendEquipment[riderId] ?? "");[39m
[31m+     if ([39m
[31m+       backendPresetId &&[39m
[31m+       validPresetIds.has(backendPresetId) &&[39m
[31m+       canUsePreset(backendPresetId)[39m
[31m+     ) {[39m
[31m+       result[riderId] = backendPresetId;[39m
[31m+       addUse(backendPresetId);[39m
[31m+       return;[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const focus = getRiderEquipmentFocus({[39m
[31m+       rider,[39m
[31m+       role: suggestedRoles[riderId],[39m
[31m+       stage,[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const currentPresetId = String(currentEquipmentByRider[riderId] ?? "");[39m
[31m+     const ranked = scores[39m
[31m+       .map((score) => ({[39m
[31m+         presetId: score.presetId,[39m
[31m+         score: getPresetScoreForFocus(score, focus, stage),[39m
[31m+       }))[39m
[31m+       .filter((candidate) => canUsePreset(candidate.presetId))[39m
[31m+       .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const bestPresetId = ranked[0]?.presetId;[39m
[31m+     const currentStillUsable =[39m
[31m+       currentPresetId &&[39m
[31m+       validPresetIds.has(currentPresetId) &&[39m
[31m+       canUsePreset(currentPresetId);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     /*[39m
[31m+      * Important availability rule:[39m
[31m+      * Do not leave a rider without equipment just because no perfect[39m
[31m+      * climbing/flat/TT match was found. If at least one equipment setup[39m
[31m+      * still has an available configuration slot, assign the best remaining[39m
[31m+      * available setup. This keeps Sport Director suggestions practical while[39m
[31m+      * still respecting per-setup capacity.[39m
[31m+      */[39m
[31m+     const anyAvailablePresetId = equipmentPresetOptions.find((preset) =>[39m
[31m+       canUsePreset(preset.id),[39m
[31m+     )?.id;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const chosenPresetId =[39m
[31m+       bestPresetId ||[39m
[31m+       (currentStillUsable ? currentPresetId : "") ||[39m
[31m+       anyAvailablePresetId ||[39m
[31m+       "";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     if (chosenPresetId) {[39m
[31m+       result[riderId] = chosenPresetId;[39m
[31m+       addUse(chosenPresetId);[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return result;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
