[31m+[39m
[31m+ function clampStageSupplyValue(value: number, min: number, max: number) {[39m
[31m+   if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return min;[39m
[31m+   return Math.min(Math.max(Math.floor(value), min), max);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getSupplyAvailableQuantity([39m
[31m+   supplyOptions: RaceSupplyOption[],[39m
[31m+   supplyKey: string,[39m
[31m+ ): number {[39m
[31m+   const option = supplyOptions.find((row) => row.supply_key === supplyKey);[39m
[31m+   return Number(option?.quantity_available ?? 0);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStageWeatherRisk(stage: JsonRecord | null) {[39m
[31m+   const weather = stage ? pickStageWeatherRecord(null, stage) : {};[39m
[31m+   const temperature = pickWeatherNumber(weather, [[39m
[31m+     "temperature_c",[39m
[31m+     "temp_c",[39m
[31m+     "avg_temperature_c",[39m
[31m+     "average_temperature_c",[39m
[31m+     "avg_temp_c",[39m
[31m+     "average_temp_c",[39m
[31m+     "temperature",[39m
[31m+   ]);[39m
[31m+   const wind = pickWeatherNumber(weather, [[39m
[31m+     "wind_kph",[39m
[31m+     "wind_speed_kph",[39m
[31m+     "wind_km_h",[39m
[31m+     "wind_kmh",[39m
[31m+     "avg_wind_kmh",[39m
[31m+     "wind_speed",[39m
[31m+     "wind",[39m
[31m+   ]);[39m
[31m+   const rainChance = pickWeatherNumber(weather, [[39m
[31m+     "rain_chance_pct",[39m
[31m+     "rain_probability_pct",[39m
[31m+     "precipitation_chance_pct",[39m
[31m+     "precipitation_probability_pct",[39m
[31m+     "chance_of_rain_pct",[39m
[31m+   ]);[39m
[31m+   const precipitationMm = pickWeatherNumber(weather, [[39m
[31m+     "avg_precip_mm",[39m
[31m+     "precip_mm",[39m
[31m+     "precipitation_mm",[39m
[31m+     "rain_mm",[39m
[31m+     "avg_rain_mm",[39m
[31m+   ]);[39m
[31m+   const rain = rainChance ?? precipitationMm;[39m
[31m+   const text = String([39m
[31m+     weather.condition_label ??[39m
[31m+       weather.label ??[39m
[31m+       weather.name ??[39m
[31m+       weather.condition ??[39m
[31m+       weather.summary ??[39m
[31m+       weather.weather_summary ??[39m
[31m+       weather.weather ??[39m
[31m+       weather.icon ??[39m
[31m+       "",[39m
[31m+   ).toLowerCase();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const isRain =[39m
[31m+     (rainChance !== null && rainChance >= 40) ||[39m
[31m+     (precipitationMm !== null && precipitationMm >= 2);[39m
[31m+   const isCold = temperature !== null && temperature < 15;[39m
[31m+   const isWindy = wind !== null && wind >= 35;[39m
[31m+   const textBad =[39m
[31m+     text.includes("rain") ||[39m
[31m+     text.includes("storm") ||[39m
[31m+     text.includes("shower") ||[39m
[31m+     text.includes("snow") ||[39m
[31m+     text.includes("cold");[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const isBadWeather = isRain || isCold || (isCold && isWindy) || textBad;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const rainJacketRequired = isRain || isCold || textBad;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     weather,[39m
[31m+     temperature,[39m
[31m+     wind,[39m
[31m+     rain,[39m
[31m+     isRain,[39m
[31m+     isCold,[39m
[31m+     isWindy,[39m
[31m+     textBad,[39m
[31m+     rainJacketRequired,[39m
[31m+     isBadWeather,[39m
[31m+     reason: isBadWeather[39m
[31m+       ? [[39m
[31m+           isRain ? "rain risk" : "",[39m
[31m+           isCold ? "cold below 15°C" : "",[39m
[31m+           isWindy ? "strong wind" : "",[39m
[31m+           textBad ? "bad-weather condition text" : "",[39m
[31m+         ][39m
[31m+           .filter(Boolean)[39m
[31m+           .join(", ")[39m
[31m+       : "no strong weather risk detected",[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStageTeamSupplyPlan({[39m
[31m+   riders,[39m
[31m+   suppliesByRider,[39m
[31m+   stage,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   riders: JsonRecord[];[39m
[31m+   suppliesByRider: Record<string, StageRiderSupplyDraft>;[39m
[31m+   stage: JsonRecord | null;[39m
[31m+ }): StageTeamSupplyPlan {[39m
[31m+   const firstRiderId = String(riders[0]?.id ?? "");[39m
[31m+   const first =[39m
[31m+     (firstRiderId && suppliesByRider[firstRiderId]) ||[39m
[31m+     normalizeRiderSupplyDraft(null);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const riderCount = riders.length;[39m
[31m+   const jacketCount = riders.reduce((count, rider) => {[39m
[31m+     const riderId = String(rider.id ?? "");[39m
[31m+     return count + (suppliesByRider[riderId]?.rain_jacket ? 1 : 0);[39m
[31m+   }, 0);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const weatherRisk = getStageWeatherRisk(stage);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   let rainJacketMode: StageRainJacketMode = "none";[39m
[31m+   if ([39m
[31m+     riderCount > 0 &&[39m
[31m+     (weatherRisk.rainJacketRequired || jacketCount === riderCount)[39m
[31m+   ) {[39m
[31m+     rainJacketMode = "all";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     bidonsPerRider: clampStageSupplyValue([39m
[31m+       Number(first.bidons),[39m
[31m+       STAGE_SUPPLY_RULES.bidons_water_bottles.minPerRider,[39m
[31m+       STAGE_SUPPLY_RULES.bidons_water_bottles.maxPerRider,[39m
[31m+     ),[39m
[31m+     gelsPerRider: clampStageSupplyValue([39m
[31m+       Number(first.gels),[39m
[31m+       STAGE_SUPPLY_RULES.energy_gels.minPerRider,[39m
[31m+       STAGE_SUPPLY_RULES.energy_gels.maxPerRider,[39m
[31m+     ),[39m
[31m+     nutritionPacksPerRider: clampStageSupplyValue([39m
[31m+       Number(first.nutrition_packs),[39m
[31m+       STAGE_SUPPLY_RULES.nutrition_packs.minPerRider,[39m
[31m+       STAGE_SUPPLY_RULES.nutrition_packs.maxPerRider,[39m
[31m+     ),[39m
[31m+     rainJacketMode,[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStageSupplyNeeds([39m
[31m+   riders: JsonRecord[],[39m
[31m+   plan: StageTeamSupplyPlan,[39m
[31m+   stage: JsonRecord | null,[39m
[31m+ ) {[39m
[31m+   const riderCount = riders.length;[39m
[31m+   const weatherRisk = getStageWeatherRisk(stage);[39m
[31m+   const rainJacketCount =[39m
[31m+     plan.rainJacketMode === "all" || weatherRisk.rainJacketRequired[39m
[31m+       ? riderCount[39m
[31m+       : 0;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return {[39m
[31m+     riderCount,[39m
[31m+     bidons_water_bottles: riderCount * plan.bidonsPerRider,[39m
[31m+     energy_gels: riderCount * plan.gelsPerRider,[39m
[31m+     nutrition_packs: riderCount * plan.nutritionPacksPerRider,[39m
[31m+     race_jersey_complete: riderCount,[39m
[31m+     rain_jackets: rainJacketCount,[39m
[31m+     weatherRisk,[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function buildSuppliesByRiderFromTeamPlan([39m
[31m+   riders: JsonRecord[],[39m
[31m+   plan: StageTeamSupplyPlan,[39m
[31m+   stage: JsonRecord | null,[39m
[31m+ ): Record<string, StageRiderSupplyDraft> {[39m
[31m+   const weatherRisk = getStageWeatherRisk(stage);[39m
[31m+   const useRainJacket =[39m
[31m+     plan.rainJacketMode === "all" || weatherRisk.rainJacketRequired;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return riders.reduce<Record<string, StageRiderSupplyDraft>>((acc, rider) => {[39m
[31m+     const riderId = String(rider.id ?? "");[39m
[31m+     if (!riderId) return acc;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     acc[riderId] = {[39m
[31m+       bidons: plan.bidonsPerRider,[39m
[31m+       gels: plan.gelsPerRider,[39m
[31m+       nutrition_packs: plan.nutritionPacksPerRider,[39m
[31m+       race_jersey_complete: true,[39m
[31m+       rain_jacket: useRainJacket,[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return acc;[39m
[31m+   }, {});[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   );[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+ function StageRaceSuppliesCard({[39m
[31m+   stage,[39m
[31m+   riders,[39m
[31m+   supplyOptions,[39m
[31m+   suppliesByRider,[39m
[31m+   onApplyTeamPlan,[39m
[31m+   onSave,[39m
[31m+   saveDisabled,[39m
[31m+   saving,[39m
[31m+   disabled,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   stage: JsonRecord | null;[39m
[31m+   riders: JsonRecord[];[39m
[31m+   supplyOptions: RaceSupplyOption[];[39m
[31m+   suppliesByRider: Record<string, StageRiderSupplyDraft>;[39m
[31m+   onApplyTeamPlan: (teamPlan: StageTeamSupplyPlan) => void;[39m
[31m+   onSave: () => void;[39m
[31m+   saveDisabled: boolean;[39m
[31m+   saving: boolean;[39m
[31m+   disabled: boolean;[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const teamPlan = getStageTeamSupplyPlan({ riders, suppliesByRider, stage });[39m
[31m+   const needs = getStageSupplyNeeds(riders, teamPlan, stage);[39m
[31m+   const jerseyAvailable = getSupplyAvailableQuantity([39m
[31m+     supplyOptions,[39m
[31m+     "race_jersey_complete",[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   const rainAvailable = getSupplyAvailableQuantity([39m
[31m+     supplyOptions,[39m
[31m+     "rain_jackets",[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   const rainJacketSelected =[39m
[31m+     teamPlan.rainJacketMode === "all" || needs.weatherRisk.rainJacketRequired;[39m
[31m+   const suppliesDisabledForTT = isTimeTrialStage(stage);[39m
[31m+   const suppliesInputDisabled = disabled || suppliesDisabledForTT;[39m
[31m+   const jerseyMissing =[39m
[31m+     !suppliesDisabledForTT && needs.race_jersey_complete > jerseyAvailable;[39m
[31m+   const displayNeeds = suppliesDisabledForTT[39m
[31m+     ? {[39m
[31m+         ...needs,[39m
[31m+         bidons_water_bottles: 0,[39m
[31m+         energy_gels: 0,[39m
[31m+         nutrition_packs: 0,[39m
[31m+         race_jersey_complete: 0,[39m
[31m+         rain_jackets: 0,[39m
[31m+       }[39m
[31m+     : needs;[39m
[31m+   const rainJacketsMissing =[39m
[31m+     !suppliesDisabledForTT && displayNeeds.rain_jackets > rainAvailable;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   function updatePlan(patch: Partial<StageTeamSupplyPlan>) {[39m
[31m+     onApplyTeamPlan({[39m
[31m+       ...teamPlan,[39m
[31m+       ...patch,[39m
[31m+       rainJacketMode: patch.rainJacketMode ?? teamPlan.rainJacketMode,[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <section[39m
[31m+       className={[[39m
[31m+         "rounded-2xl border p-5 shadow-sm",[39m
[31m+         suppliesDisabledForTT[39m
[31m+           ? "border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-slate-500"[39m
[31m+           : "bg-white",[39m
[31m+       ].join(" ")}[39m
[31m+     >[39m
[31m+       <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">[39m
[31m+         <div>[39m
[31m+           <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+             4. Stage Race Supplies[39m
[31m+           </h2>[39m
[31m+           <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">[39m
[31m+             Team-level supply setup for this stage. Consumables are applied per[39m
[31m+             rider; Race Jersey Kit is mandatory and Rain Jackets are a team-wide[39m
[31m+             yes/no choice.[39m
[31m+           </p>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2">[39m
[31m+           <button[39m
[31m+             type="button"[39m
[31m+             onClick={onSave}[39m
[31m+             disabled={saveDisabled || jerseyMissing || suppliesDisabledForTT}[39m
[31m+             className="rounded-lg bg-yellow-400 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-950 hover:bg-yellow-300 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-slate-200 disabled:text-slate-500"[39m
[31m+           >[39m
[31m+             {saving ? "Saving…" : "Save"}[39m
[31m+           </button>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           <InfoTooltip[39m
[31m+             label={[39m
[31m+               suppliesDisabledForTT[39m
[31m+                 ? "Stage Supplies on Time Trials"[39m
[31m+                 : "Stage race supplies help"[39m
[31m+             }[39m
[31m+             panelWidthClass="w-[30rem]"[39m
[31m+           >[39m
[31m+             {suppliesDisabledForTT ? ([39m
[31m+               <>[39m
[31m+                 <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+                   Stage Supplies on Time Trials[39m
[31m+                 </div>[39m
[31m+                 <p className="mt-2">[39m
[31m+                   Stage supplies are disabled for Prologue, ITT and TTT stages.[39m
[31m+                 </p>[39m
[31m+                 <p className="mt-2">[39m
[31m+                   Bidons, energy gels, nutrition packs and rain jackets do not[39m

[31m+                 </p>[39m

[31m+               </>[39m

[31m+                 </p>[39m
[31m+                 <div className="mt-3 space-y-3">[39m
[31m+                   {Object.entries(STAGE_SUPPLY_RULES).map(([key, rule]) => ([39m
[31m+                     <div[39m
[31m+                       key={key}[39m
[31m+                       className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-3"[39m

[31m+                       <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">[39m

[31m+                           </div>[39m
[31m+                           <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+                             {rule.durabilityText}[39m
[31m+                           </div>[39m
[31m+                         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+                         <span[39m
[31m+                           className={[[39m
[31m+                             "shrink-0 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold",[39m
[31m+                             rule.useType === "durable"[39m
[31m+                               ? "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700"[39m
[31m+                               : "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700",[39m
[31m+                           ].join(" ")}[39m
[31m+                         >[39m
[31m+                           {rule.useType === "durable"[39m
[31m+                             ? "durable"[39m
[31m+                             : "consumable"}[39m
[31m+                         </span>[39m
[31m+                       </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+                       <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3">[39m
[31m+                         <div>[39m
[31m+                           <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700">[39m
[31m+                             Positive[39m
[31m+                           </div>[39m
[31m+                           <ul className="mt-1 list-disc space-y-1 pl-4 text-xs text-slate-600">[39m
[31m+                             {rule.positiveEffects.map((effect) => ([39m
[31m+                               <li key={effect}>{effect}</li>[39m
[31m+                             ))}[39m
[31m+                           </ul>[39m
[31m+                         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+                         <div>[39m
[31m+                           <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-red-700">[39m
[31m+                             Negative / limits[39m
[31m+                           </div>[39m
[31m+                           <ul className="mt-1 list-disc space-y-1 pl-4 text-xs text-slate-600">[39m
[31m+                             {rule.negativeEffects.map((effect) => ([39m
[31m+                               <li key={effect}>{effect}</li>[39m
[31m+                             ))}[39m
[31m+                           </ul>[39m
[31m+                         </div>[39m
[31m+                       </div>[39m
[31m+                     </div>[39m
[31m+                   ))}[39m
[31m+                 </div>[39m
[31m+               </>[39m
[31m+             )}[39m
[31m+           </InfoTooltip>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {suppliesDisabledForTT ? ([39m
[31m+         <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-600">[39m

[31m+       ) : null}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {jerseyMissing ? ([39m
[31m+         <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-red-700">[39m

[31m+           {displayNeeds.race_jersey_complete}, but only {jerseyAvailable} are[39m

[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStagePlanRaceBonusRows(standardizedBonus: JsonRecord) {[39m
[31m+   const groups = toArray<JsonRecord>(standardizedBonus.groups);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (groups.length > 0) {[39m
[31m+     return groups.map((group) => {[39m
[31m+       const bonusKey = String(group.bonus_key ?? group.key ?? "");[39m
[31m+       return {[39m
[31m+         key: bonusKey || String(group.display_name ?? "bonus"),[39m
[31m+         label: String(group.display_name ?? titleFromSnake(bonusKey)),[39m
[31m+         value: Number(group.percent ?? group.points ?? 0),[39m
[31m+         description: String([39m
[31m+           group.description ??[39m
[31m+             standardizedBonusDescriptions[bonusKey] ??[39m
[31m+             "Race Plan bonus",[39m
[31m+         ),[39m
[31m+       };[39m
[31m+     });[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const totals = asRecord(standardizedBonus.totals);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return Object.entries(totals).map(([key, value]) => ({[39m
[31m+     key,[39m
[31m+     label: titleFromSnake(key),[39m
[31m+     value: Number(value),[39m
[31m+     description: standardizedBonusDescriptions[key] ?? "Race Plan bonus",[39m
[31m+   }));[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function sumEquipmentWeightedBonuses([39m
[31m+   equipmentPresetOptions: EquipmentSetupPresetOption[],[39m
[31m+   equipmentByRider: Record<string, string>,[39m
[31m+ ) {[39m
[31m+   return Object.values(equipmentByRider).reduce([39m
[31m+     (acc, presetId) => {[39m
[31m+       const preset = equipmentPresetOptions.find([39m
[31m+         (option) => option.id === presetId,[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+       const { weightedBonuses } = getPresetBonusPreview(preset);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       Object.values(weightedBonuses).forEach((value) => {[39m
[31m+         const numeric = Number(value);[39m
[31m+         if (!Number.isFinite(numeric)) return;[39m
[31m+         if (numeric >= 0) acc.positive += numeric;[39m
[31m+         if (numeric < 0) acc.negative += numeric;[39m
[31m+       });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       return acc;[39m
[31m+     },[39m
[31m+     { positive: 0, negative: 0 },[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStageIndividualOverrideCount(draft: StagePlanDraft) {[39m
[31m+   return Object.values(draft.individualTacticsByRider).reduce([39m
[31m+     (sum, riderPlan) => {[39m
[31m+       return ([39m
[31m+         sum +[39m
[31m+         Object.values(riderPlan).filter([39m
[31m+           (phase) => phase.command !== "follow_team_plan",[39m
[31m+         ).length[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+     },[39m
[31m+     0,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getStageRoleCounts(draft: StagePlanDraft) {[39m
[31m+   return Object.values(draft.riderRolesByRider).reduce<Record<string, number>>([39m
[31m+     (acc, role) => {[39m
[31m+       const label = STAGE_RIDER_ROLE_LABELS[String(role)] ?? String(role);[39m
[31m+       acc[label] = (acc[label] ?? 0) + 1;[39m
[31m+       return acc;[39m
[31m+     },[39m
[31m+     {},[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getAverageRiderSkill([39m
[31m+   riders: JsonRecord[],[39m
[31m+   keys: string[],[39m
[31m+ ): number | null {[39m
[31m+   const values = riders.flatMap((rider) => {[39m
[31m+     for (const key of keys) {[39m
[31m+       const numeric = Number(rider[key] ?? rider[`${key}_skill`]);[39m
[31m+       if (Number.isFinite(numeric)) return [numeric];[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return [];[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (values.length === 0) return null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / values.length;[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getPacingRiskLabel(plan: string) {[39m
[31m+   switch (plan) {[39m
[31m+     case "tt_balanced_pace":[39m
[31m+       return "Low";[39m
[31m+     case "tt_fast_start":[39m
[31m+       return "Medium-high";[39m
[31m+     case "tt_negative_split":[39m
[31m+       return "Medium";[39m
[31m+     case "tt_all_out":[39m
[31m+       return "High";[39m
[31m+     default:[39m
[31m+       return "Normal";[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getDroppedRiderRiskLabel([39m
[31m+   teamworkAverage: number | null,[39m
[31m+   plan: string,[39m
[31m+ ) {[39m
[31m+   if (plan === "tt_all_out") return "High";[39m
[31m+   if (plan === "tt_fast_start") return "Medium-high";[39m
[31m+   if (teamworkAverage !== null && teamworkAverage >= 75) return "Low";[39m
[31m+   if (teamworkAverage !== null && teamworkAverage < 55) return "High";[39m
[31m+   return "Medium";[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function StageFinalCalculationCard({[39m
[31m+   stage,[39m
[31m+   riders,[39m
[31m+   draft,[39m
[31m+   equipmentPresetOptions,[39m
[31m+   supplyOptions,[39m
[31m+   standardizedBonus,[39m
[31m+   exactBonusPreview,[39m
[31m+   onSave,[39m
[31m+   saveDisabled,[39m
[31m+   saving,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   stage: JsonRecord | null;[39m
[31m+   riders: JsonRecord[];[39m
[31m+   draft: StagePlanDraft;[39m
[31m+   equipmentPresetOptions: EquipmentSetupPresetOption[];[39m
[31m+   supplyOptions: RaceSupplyOption[];[39m
[31m+   standardizedBonus: JsonRecord;[39m
[31m+   exactBonusPreview: JsonRecord;[39m
[31m+   onSave: () => void;[39m
[31m+   saveDisabled: boolean;[39m
[31m+   saving: boolean;[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const isTTStage = isTimeTrialStage(stage);[39m
[31m+   const isTTTStage = stage?.stage_format === "team_time_trial";[39m
[31m+   const normalizedTeamPlan = normalizeStageTacticPlan([39m
[31m+     draft.teamTactic.plan,[39m
[31m+     stage,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   const teamPlan = getStageTeamSupplyPlan({[39m
[31m+     riders,[39m
[31m+     suppliesByRider: draft.suppliesByRider,[39m
[31m+     stage,[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+   const needs = getStageSupplyNeeds(riders, teamPlan, stage);[39m
[31m+   const equipmentTotals = sumEquipmentWeightedBonuses([39m
[31m+     equipmentPresetOptions,[39m
[31m+     draft.equipmentByRider,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   const raceBonusRows = getStagePlanRaceBonusRows(standardizedBonus);[39m
[31m+   const jacketSelected = needs.rain_jackets > 0;[39m
[31m+   const jacketBenefitActive =[39m
[31m+     jacketSelected && needs.weatherRisk.rainJacketRequired;[39m
[31m+   const jerseyAvailable = getSupplyAvailableQuantity([39m
[31m+     supplyOptions,[39m
[31m+     "race_jersey_complete",[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   const missingJerseys = isTTStage[39m
[31m+     ? 0[39m
[31m+     : Math.max(needs.race_jersey_complete - jerseyAvailable, 0);[39m
[31m+   const racePlanBonusTotal = raceBonusRows.reduce([39m
[31m+     (sum, row) => sum + (Number.isFinite(row.value) ? row.value : 0),[39m
[31m+     0,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   const teamworkAverage = getAverageRiderSkill(riders, [[39m
[31m+     "teamwork",[39m
[31m+     "team_work",[39m
[31m+   ]);[39m
[31m+   const ttAverage = getAverageRiderSkill(riders, ["time_trial", "timetrial"]);[39m
[31m+   const countingRiderCount =[39m
[31m+     riders.length > 0 ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil(riders.length * 0.75)) : 0;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   void exactBonusPreview;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <section className="rounded-2xl border bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">[39m
[31m+       <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">[39m
[31m+         <div>[39m
[31m+           <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+             5. Final Stage Calculation[39m
[31m+           </h2>[39m
[31m+           <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600">[39m
[31m+             {isTTStage[39m
[31m+               ? "Time-trial engine preview for equipment, support, fatigue, weather and pacing risk."[39m
[31m+               : "Team-level engine preview for this exact stage setup: Race Plan bonuses, equipment, supplies, weather and risk factors."}[39m
[31m+           </p>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         <div className="flex items-center gap-2">[39m
[31m+           <button[39m
[31m+             type="button"[39m
[31m+             onClick={onSave}[39m
[31m+             disabled={saveDisabled || missingJerseys > 0}[39m
[31m+             className="rounded-lg bg-yellow-400 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-950 hover:bg-yellow-300 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-slate-200 disabled:text-slate-500"[39m
[31m+           >[39m
[31m+             {saving ? "Saving…" : "Save"}[39m
[31m+           </button>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           <InfoTooltip[39m
[31m+             label="Final stage calculation help"[39m
[31m+             panelWidthClass="w-[30rem]"[39m
[31m+           >[39m
[31m+             <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+               What this preview means[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+             {isTTStage ? ([39m
[31m+               <p className="mt-2">[39m
[31m+                 TT stages ignore supply consumption/effects in v1. The preview[39m
[31m+                 focuses on equipment, equipment condition, race support, fatigue[39m
[31m+                 control, recovery support, reliability, weather/wind and pacing[39m
[31m+                 risk.[39m
[31m+               </p>[39m
[31m+             ) : ([39m
[31m+               <>[39m
[31m+                 <p className="mt-2">[39m
[31m+                   This is a team-level preview. The race engine should combine[39m
[31m+                   Race Plan staff/assets/policy bonuses, rider equipment, stage[39m
[31m+                   supplies, team tactic, rider roles and individual commands.[39m
[31m+                 </p>[39m
[31m+                 <p className="mt-2">[39m
[31m+                   Weather, crashes, mechanicals, fatigue, health and sickness[39m
[31m+                   risk should be applied later by the race engine during stage[39m
[31m+                   processing.[39m
[31m+                 </p>[39m
[31m+               </>[39m
[31m+             )}[39m
[31m+           </InfoTooltip>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {isTTStage ? ([39m
[31m+         <>[39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-3">[39m
[31m+             <InfoBox[39m
[31m+               label="TT equipment effect"[39m
[31m+               value={`+${formatBonusPercent([39m
[31m+                 equipmentTotals.positive,[39m
[31m+               )} / ${formatBonusPercent(equipmentTotals.negative)}%`}[39m
[31m+             />[39m
[31m+             <InfoBox label="Equipment condition" value="Included" />[39m
[31m+             <InfoBox[39m
[31m+               label="Race support"[39m

[31m+                 <p className="mt-2">[39m
[31m+                   For time-trial stages, individual tactics are simplified into[39m
[31m+                   two parts:[39m
[31m+                 </p>[39m
[31m+                 <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">[39m
[31m+                   <div>[39m
[31m+                     <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+                       Before split:[39m
[31m+                     </span>{" "}[39m
[31m+                     How hard the rider/team rides in the first half.[39m
[31m+                   </div>[39m
[31m+                   <div>[39m
[31m+                     <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+                       After split:[39m
[31m+                     </span>{" "}[39m
[31m+                     How hard the rider/team rides in the second half.[39m
[31m+                   </div>[39m
[31m+                 </div>[39m
[31m+                 <p className="mt-3">[39m
[31m+                   Strong TT riders can handle Hard or Maximum Effort better.[39m
[31m+                   Weaker or tired riders can start too hard, lose stamina before[39m
[31m+                   the split, and fade in the second half.[39m
[31m+                 </p>[39m
[31m+                 <div className="mt-3 space-y-1">[39m
[31m+                   <div>Controlled = safer and slower.</div>[39m
[31m+                   <div>Steady = normal rhythm.</div>[39m
[31m+                   <div>Hard = faster but more fatigue.</div>[39m
[31m+                   <div>Maximum Effort = fastest but high blow-up risk.</div>[39m
[31m+                 </div>[39m
[31m+               </>[39m
[31m+             ) : ([39m
[31m+               <>[39m
[31m+                 <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+                   Individual tactic commands[39m
[31m+                 </div>[39m
[31m+                 <p className="mt-2">[39m
[31m+                   These commands are optional. They override the general team[39m
[31m+                   stage role only for this rider and only for the selected phase of[39m
[31m+                   the stage. Phases 1–3 and Phase 4 intentionally use different command lists.[39m
[31m+                 </p>[39m
[31m+                 <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">[39m
[31m+                   {STAGE_INDIVIDUAL_TACTIC_OPTIONS.map((option) => ([39m
[31m+                     <div key={option.value}>[39m
[31m+                       <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+                         {option.label}[39m
[31m+                       </span>{" "}[39m
[31m+                       — {option.description}[39m
[31m+                     </div>[39m
[31m+                   ))}[39m
[31m+                 </div>[39m
[31m+               </>[39m
[31m+             )}[39m
[31m+           </InfoTooltip>[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-amber-800">[39m
[31m+         Do not forget to save this stage. These phase commands are saved only[39m
[31m+         for the selected stage.[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       <div className="mt-4 overflow-x-auto">[39m
[31m+         <div[39m
[31m+           className="space-y-3"[39m
[31m+           style={{ minWidth: isTTStage ? "650px" : "980px" }}[39m
[31m+         >[39m
[31m+           <div[39m
[31m+             className="grid gap-2 px-1 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500"[39m
[31m+             style={{ gridTemplateColumns: phaseGridTemplate }}[39m
[31m+           >[39m
[31m+             <div>Rider</div>[39m
[31m+             {phases.map((phase) => ([39m
[31m+               <div key={phase.key}>[39m
[31m+                 {phase.label}[39m
[31m+                 <span className="ml-1 normal-case text-slate-400">[39m
[31m+                   {phase.rangeLabel}[39m
[31m+                 </span>[39m
[31m+               </div>[39m
[31m+             ))}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           {riders.length === 0 && ([39m
[31m+             <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 p-4 text-sm text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+               No riders found from the submitted Race Plan yet.[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+           )}[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           {riders.map((rider) => {[39m
[31m+             const riderId = String(rider.id ?? "");[39m
[31m+             const riderTactics = normalizeIndividualTacticsForRider([39m
[31m+               individualTacticsByRider[riderId],[39m
[31m+               stage,[39m
[31m+             );[39m
[31m+             const selectedStageRole = String(riderRolesByRider[riderId] ?? "");[39m
[31m+             const selectedStageRoleLabel = selectedStageRole[39m
[31m+               ? (STAGE_RIDER_ROLE_LABELS[[39m
[31m+                   selectedStageRole as StageRiderRoleCode[39m
[31m+                 ] ?? titleFromSnake(selectedStageRole))[39m
[31m+               : isTTStage[39m
[31m+                 ? getTimeTrialStageRoleLabel(stage)[39m
[31m+                 : getRiderRoleLabel(rider);[39m
[31m+             const riderBaseRoleLabel = getRiderRoleLabel(rider);[39m
[31m+             const individualTacticsRoleLine =[39m
[31m+               riderBaseRoleLabel.toLowerCase() ===[39m
[31m+               selectedStageRoleLabel.toLowerCase()[39m
[31m+                 ? riderBaseRoleLabel[39m
[31m+                 : `${riderBaseRoleLabel} - ${selectedStageRoleLabel}`;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             return ([39m
[31m+               <div[39m
[31m+                 key={riderId}[39m
[31m+                 className="grid gap-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-3"[39m
[31m+                 style={{ gridTemplateColumns: phaseGridTemplate }}[39m
[31m+               >[39m
[31m+                 <div className="min-w-0">[39m
[31m+                   <div className="group relative inline-block max-w-full">[39m
[31m+                     <span className="cursor-help truncate font-medium text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+                       {getRiderDisplayName(rider)}[39m
[31m+                     </span>[39m
[31m+                     <RiderHoverCard rider={rider} />[39m
[31m+                   </div>[39m
[31m+                   <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+                     {individualTacticsRoleLine}[39m
[31m+                   </div>[39m
[31m+                 </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+                 {phases.map((phase) => {[39m
[31m+                   const phaseOptions = getStageIndividualTacticOptions([39m
[31m+                     stage,[39m
[31m+                     phase.key,[39m
[31m+                   );[39m
[31m+                   const savedCommand =[39m
[31m+                     riderTactics[phase.key]?.command ?? "follow_team_plan";[39m
[31m+                   const command = phaseOptions.some([39m
[31m+                     (option) => option.value === savedCommand,[39m
[31m+                   )[39m
[31m+                     ? savedCommand[39m
[31m+                     : "follow_team_plan";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+                   return ([39m
[31m+                     <select[39m
[31m+                       key={`${riderId}-${phase.key}`}[39m
[31m+                       value={command}[39m
[31m+                       disabled={disabled}[39m
[31m+                       onChange={(event) =>[39m
[31m+                         onChange(riderId, phase.key, event.target.value)[39m
[31m+                       }[39m
[31m+                       className="h-10 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-2 text-sm disabled:bg-slate-100"[39m
[31m+                     >[39m
[31m+                       {phaseOptions.map((option) => ([39m
[31m+                         <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>[39m
[31m+                           {option.label}[39m
[31m+                         </option>[39m
[31m+                       ))}[39m
[31m+                     </select>[39m
[31m+                   );[39m
[31m+                 })}[39m
[31m+               </div>[39m
[31m+             );[39m
[31m+           })}[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       </div>[39m
[31m+     </section>[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getRiderDisplayName(rider: JsonRecord) {[39m
[31m+   const fullName = String(rider.full_name ?? rider.name ?? "").trim();[39m
[31m+   if (fullName) return fullName;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const firstName = String(rider.first_name ?? "").trim();[39m
[31m+   const lastName = String(rider.last_name ?? "").trim();[39m
[31m+   const combinedName = `${firstName} ${lastName}`.trim();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return combinedName || "Unnamed rider";[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getRiderRoleLabel(rider: JsonRecord): string {[39m
[31m+   return String([39m
[31m+     rider.role_label ??[39m
[31m+       rider.assigned_role ??[39m
[31m+       rider.specialty ??[39m
[31m+       rider.rider_type ??[39m
[31m+       "Rider",[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getRiderAge(rider: JsonRecord): string {[39m
[31m+   const directAge = Number(rider.age);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (Number.isFinite(directAge) && directAge > 0) {[39m
[31m+     return String(Math.floor(directAge));[39m
[31m+   }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const birthDate = String(rider.birth_date ?? "").trim();[39m
[31m+   const yearMatch = birthDate.match(/^(\d{4})-/);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   if (!yearMatch) return "—";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const birthYear = Number(yearMatch[1]);[39m
[31m+   if (!Number.isFinite(birthYear)) return "—";[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   // Game dates use Season 1 = year 2000, so this is only a fallback.[39m
[31m+   const estimatedAge = 2000 - birthYear;[39m
[31m+   return estimatedAge > 0 ? String(estimatedAge) : "—";[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getRiderOverall(rider: JsonRecord): string {[39m
[31m+   const value =[39m
[31m+     rider.overall ??[39m
[31m+     rider.overall_rating ??[39m
[31m+     rider.rating ??[39m
[31m+     rider.ovr ??[39m
[31m+     rider.current_ability;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const numberValue = Number(value);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return Number.isFinite(numberValue) ? numberValue.toFixed(0) : "—";[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getRiderSkillEntries(rider: JsonRecord) {[39m
[31m+   const skills = [[39m
[31m+     ["Flat", rider.flat],[39m
[31m+     ["Hills", rider.hills ?? rider.hilly],[39m
[31m+     ["Mountain", rider.mountain ?? rider.climbing],[39m
[31m+     ["Sprint", rider.sprint],[39m
[31m+     ["Time Trial", rider.time_trial ?? rider.tt],[39m
[31m+     ["Stamina", rider.stamina],[39m
[31m+     ["Recovery", rider.recovery],[39m
[31m+     ["Downhill", rider.downhill],[39m
[31m+     ["Cobbles", rider.cobbles],[39m
[31m+   ];[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return skills[39m
[31m+     .map(([label, value]) => ({[39m
[31m+       label: String(label),[39m
[31m+       value: Number(value),[39m
[31m+     }))[39m
[31m+     .filter((skill) => Number.isFinite(skill.value))[39m
[31m+     .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function RiderHoverCard({ rider }: { rider: JsonRecord }) {[39m
[31m+   const skills = getRiderSkillEntries(rider);[39m
[31m+   const topSkillNames = new Set(skills.slice(0, 3).map((skill) => skill.label));[39m
[31m+   const score = getRiderRaceScore(rider);[39m
[31m+   const anchorRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const popoverRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);[39m
[31m+   const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const [position, setPosition] = useState({[39m
[31m+     left: 0,[39m
[31m+     top: 0,[39m
[31m+     ready: false,[39m
[31m+   });[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     const anchor = anchorRef.current?.parentElement;[39m
[31m+     if (!anchor) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const show = () => {[39m
[31m+       setPosition((current) => ({ ...current, ready: false }));[39m
[31m+       setOpen(true);[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+     const hide = () => setOpen(false);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     anchor.addEventListener("mouseenter", show);[39m
[31m+     anchor.addEventListener("mouseleave", hide);[39m
[31m+     anchor.addEventListener("focusin", show);[39m
[31m+     anchor.addEventListener("focusout", hide);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return () => {[39m
[31m+       anchor.removeEventListener("mouseenter", show);[39m
[31m+       anchor.removeEventListener("mouseleave", hide);[39m
[31m+       anchor.removeEventListener("focusin", show);[39m
[31m+       anchor.removeEventListener("focusout", hide);[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }, []);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   useLayoutEffect(() => {[39m
[31m+     if (!open || typeof window === "undefined") return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     function updatePosition() {[39m
[31m+       const anchor = anchorRef.current?.parentElement;[39m
[31m+       const popover = popoverRef.current;[39m
[31m+       if (!anchor || !popover) return;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const anchorRect = anchor.getBoundingClientRect();[39m
[31m+       const popoverRect = popover.getBoundingClientRect();[39m
[31m+       const viewportPadding = 12;[39m
[31m+       const gap = 10;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const maxLeft = Math.max([39m
[31m+         viewportPadding,[39m
[31m+         window.innerWidth - popoverRect.width - viewportPadding,[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+       const left = Math.min([39m
[31m+         Math.max(anchorRect.left, viewportPadding),[39m
[31m+         maxLeft,[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const roomAbove = anchorRect.top - gap - viewportPadding;[39m
[31m+       const roomBelow =[39m
[31m+         window.innerHeight - anchorRect.bottom - gap - viewportPadding;[39m
[31m+       const placeAbove =[39m
[31m+         roomAbove >= popoverRect.height || roomAbove >= roomBelow;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       const unclampedTop = placeAbove[39m
[31m+         ? anchorRect.top - popoverRect.height - gap[39m
[31m+         : anchorRect.bottom + gap;[39m
[31m+       const maxTop = Math.max([39m
[31m+         viewportPadding,[39m
[31m+         window.innerHeight - popoverRect.height - viewportPadding,[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+       const top = Math.min([39m
[31m+         Math.max(unclampedTop, viewportPadding),[39m
[31m+         maxTop,[39m
[31m+       );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       setPosition({ left, top, ready: true });[39m
[31m+     }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     updatePosition();[39m
[31m+     window.addEventListener("resize", updatePosition);[39m
[31m+     window.addEventListener("scroll", updatePosition, true);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     return () => {[39m
[31m+       window.removeEventListener("resize", updatePosition);[39m
[31m+       window.removeEventListener("scroll", updatePosition, true);[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+   }, [open, rider]);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const afterStageNumber = Number([39m
[31m+     rider.current_race_classification_after_stage_number ?? 0,[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+   const classificationLive = rider.current_race_classification_live === true;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <>[39m
[31m+       <span[39m
[31m+         ref={anchorRef}[39m
[31m+         className="pointer-events-none absolute h-0 w-0"[39m
[31m+         aria-hidden="true"[39m
[31m+       />[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+       {open && typeof document !== "undefined"[39m
[31m+         ? createPortal([39m
[31m+             <div[39m
[31m+               ref={popoverRef}[39m
[31m+               className="pointer-events-none fixed z-[10000] w-80 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 text-left shadow-2xl"[39m
[31m+               style={{[39m
[31m+                 left: position.left,[39m
[31m+                 top: position.top,[39m
[31m+                 visibility: position.ready ? "visible" : "hidden",[39m
[31m+               }}[39m
[31m+             >[39m
[31m+               <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+                 {getRiderDisplayName(rider)}[39m
[31m+               </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+               <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+                 Age {getRiderAge(rider)} · Overall {getRiderOverall(rider)} ·{" "}[39m
[31m+                 {getRiderRoleLabel(rider)}[39m
[31m+               </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+               <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-yellow-200 bg-yellow-50 p-3">[39m
[31m+                 <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">[39m
[31m+                   <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-amber-800">[39m
[31m+                     Current race classifications[39m
[31m+                   </div>[39m
[31m+                   <div className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-amber-700">[39m
[31m+                     {classificationLive && afterStageNumber > 0[39m
[31m+                       ? `After Stage ${afterStageNumber}`[39m
[31m+                       : "Race not started"}[39m
[31m+                   </div>[39m
[31m+                 </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+                 <div className="space-y-2 text-xs">[39m
[31m+                   <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">[39m
[31m+                     <RiderRaceScorePopoverItem[39m
[31m+                       label="GC #"[39m
[31m+                       value={score.position}[39m
[31m+                     />[39m
[31m+                     <RiderRaceScorePopoverItem[39m
[31m+                       label="Time"[39m
[31m+                       value={score.time}[39m
[31m+                     />[39m
[31m+                   </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+                   <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">[39m
[31m+                     <RiderRaceScorePopoverItem[39m
[31m+                       label="Sprint"[39m
[31m+                       value={score.sprintPoints}[39m
[31m+                     />[39m
[31m+                     <RiderRaceScorePopoverItem[39m
[31m+                       label="KOM"[39m
[31m+                       value={score.mountainPoints}[39m
[31m+                     />[39m
[31m+                   </div>[39m
[31m+                 </div>[39m
[31m+               </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+               <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">[39m
[31m+                 {skills.length > 0 ? ([39m
[31m+                   skills.slice(0, 8).map((skill) => {[39m
[31m+                     const isTopSkill = topSkillNames.has(skill.label);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+                     return ([39m
[31m+                       <div[39m
[31m+                         key={skill.label}[39m
[31m+                         className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg bg-slate-50 px-2 py-1"[39m
[31m+                       >[39m
[31m+                         <span[39m
[31m+                           className={[39m
[31m+                             isTopSkill[39m
[31m+                               ? "font-semibold text-slate-900"[39m
[31m+                               : "text-slate-500"[39m
[31m+                           }[39m
[31m+                         >[39m
[31m+                           {skill.label}[39m
[31m+                         </span>[39m
[31m+                         <span[39m
[31m+                           className={[39m
[31m+                             isTopSkill[39m
[31m+                               ? "font-bold text-slate-900"[39m
[31m+                               : "font-medium text-slate-700"[39m
[31m+                           }[39m
[31m+                         >[39m
[31m+                           {skill.value.toFixed(0)}[39m
[31m+                         </span>[39m
[31m+                       </div>[39m
[31m+                     );[39m
[31m+                   })[39m
[31m+                 ) : ([39m
[31m+                   <div className="col-span-2 text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+                     Rider skill details are not available yet.[39m
[31m+                   </div>[39m
[31m+                 )}[39m
[31m+               </div>[39m
[31m+             </div>,[39m
[31m+             document.body,[39m
[31m+           )[39m
[31m+         : null}[39m
[31m+     </>[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function RiderRaceScorePopoverItem({[39m
[31m+   label,[39m
[31m+   value,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   label: string;[39m
[31m+   value: unknown;[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-yellow-200 bg-yellow-100 px-2 py-1">[39m
[31m+       <span className="font-medium text-amber-800">{label}</span>[39m
[31m+       <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">[39m
[31m+         {String(value ?? "—")}[39m
[31m+       </span>[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+ function getRiderRaceScore(rider: JsonRecord) {[39m
[31m+   const position =[39m
[31m+     rider.gc_position ??[39m
[31m+     rider.general_position ??[39m
[31m+     rider.race_position ??[39m
[31m+     rider.standing_position ??[39m
[31m+     rider.tour_position ??[39m
[31m+     0;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   const time =[39m
[31m+     rider.gc_time_gap ??[39m
[31m+     rider.general_time_gap ??[39m
[31m+     rider.time_gap ??[39m
[31m+     rider.race_time_gap ??[39m

[31m+       position === null || position === undefined || position === ""[39m
[31m+         ? "—"[39m
[31m+         : String(position),[39m
[31m+     time:[39m
[31m+       time === null || time === undefined || time === "" ? "—" : String(time),[39m
[31m+     sprintPoints: Number.isFinite(Number(sprintPoints))[39m
[31m+       ? Number(sprintPoints)[39m
[31m+       : 0,[39m
[31m+     mountainPoints: Number.isFinite(Number(mountainPoints))[39m
[31m+       ? Number(mountainPoints)[39m
[31m+       : 0,[39m
[31m+   };[39m
[31m+ }[39m

[31m+ function RiderSelectionCard({[39m
[31m+   option,[39m
[31m+   selected,[39m
[31m+   canEdit,[39m
[31m+   currentGameDate,[39m
[31m+   raceSharpness,[39m
[31m+   blockedReason,[39m
[31m+   medicalUnavailableReason,[39m
[31m+   onToggle,[39m
[31m+ }: {[39m
[31m+   option: RacePreparationSelectableData["riders"][number];[39m
[31m+   selected: boolean;[39m
[31m+   canEdit: boolean;[39m
[31m+   currentGameDate?: string;[39m
[31m+   raceSharpness?: RiderRaceSharpnessUiRow | null;[39m
[31m+   blockedReason?: string | null;[39m
[31m+   medicalUnavailableReason?: string | null;[39m
[31m+   onToggle: () => void;[39m
[31m+ }) {[39m
[31m+   const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);[39m
[31m+   const rider = asRecord(option.rider);[39m
[31m+   const blocked = Boolean(blockedReason);[39m
[31m+   const medicallyUnavailable = Boolean(medicalUnavailableReason);[39m
[31m+   const selectable = canEdit && !blocked && !medicallyUnavailable;[39m
[31m+   const availabilityStatus = getRiderAvailabilityStatus(rider);[39m
[31m+   const availabilityLabel = formatAvailabilityStatusLabel(availabilityStatus);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+   return ([39m
[31m+     <div className="relative">[39m
[31m+       <button[39m
[31m+         type="button"[39m
[31m+         disabled={!canEdit || medicallyUnavailable}[39m
[31m+         aria-disabled={blocked || medicallyUnavailable}[39m
[31m+         onClick={(event) => {[39m
[31m+           if (blocked || medicallyUnavailable) {[39m
[31m+             event.preventDefault();[39m
[31m+             return;[39m
[31m+           }[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           onToggle();[39m
[31m+         }}[39m
[31m+         className={`w-full rounded-xl border p-4 text-left transition disabled:cursor-not-allowed ${[39m
[31m+           medicallyUnavailable[39m
[31m+             ? "border-red-200 bg-slate-100 opacity-70 grayscale"[39m
[31m+             : blocked[39m
[31m+               ? "cursor-not-allowed border-amber-200 bg-amber-50/70 opacity-80"[39m
[31m+               : selected[39m
[31m+                 ? "border-blue-400 bg-blue-50"[39m
[31m+                 : "border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50"[39m
[31m+         }`}[39m
[31m+       >[39m
[31m+         <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">[39m
[31m+           <div[39m
[31m+             className={`inline-block rounded-md px-1 py-0.5 font-semibold ${[39m
[31m+               medicallyUnavailable ? "text-slate-500" : "text-slate-900"[39m
[31m+             }`}[39m
[31m+             onMouseEnter={() => {[39m
[31m+               if (selectable) setOpen(true);[39m
[31m+             }}[39m
[31m+             onMouseLeave={() => setOpen(false)}[39m
[31m+             onFocus={() => {[39m
[31m+               if (selectable) setOpen(true);[39m
[31m+             }}[39m
[31m+             onBlur={() => setOpen(false)}[39m
[31m+             tabIndex={selectable ? 0 : -1}[39m

[31m+             {getRiderName(option.rider)}[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+           {medicallyUnavailable ? ([39m
[31m+             <span[39m
[31m+               className="inline-flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-red-200 bg-red-100 text-sm font-black text-red-700"[39m
[31m+               title={medicalUnavailableReason ?? "Rider unavailable"}[39m
[31m+               aria-label={medicalUnavailableReason ?? "Rider unavailable"}[39m
[31m+             >[39m
[31m+               ✕[39m
[31m+             </span>[39m
[31m+           ) : null}[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         {medicallyUnavailable ? ([39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">[39m
[31m+             <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+               <span>Role: {String(option.assigned_role ?? "—")}</span>[39m
[31m+               <span>·</span>[39m
[31m+               <span>Availability: {availabilityLabel}</span>[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             <div className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-2 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-red-800">[39m
[31m+               {medicalUnavailableReason}[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+             <div className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-slate-500">[39m
[31m+               This rider is medically unavailable, so race sharpness and[39m
[31m+               freshness preview are hidden and the rider cannot be selected.[39m
[31m+             </div>[39m
[31m+           </div>[39m
[31m+         ) : blockedReason ? ([39m
[31m+           <div className="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-100 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-amber-800">[39m

[31m+             </div>[39m

[31m+             raceSharpness={raceSharpness}[39m
[31m+           />[39m
[31m+         </div>[39m
[31m+       ) : null}[39m
[31m+     </div>[39m
[31m+   );[39m
[31m+ }[39m
